domains.name: network
domains.description: SSOT for all physical and logical network infrastructure including RAN, transport, core network elements, GPON/FTTH, MPLS, SD-WAN, NFV/SDN nodes, OLT/ONT, DSLAM, BNG, BRAS, POP sites, and spectrum allocation. products.name: element
products.description: Unified master record for every physical and logical network element in the operator's infrastructure — the Single Source of Truth for all managed network nodes. Covers RAN base stations (eNodeB, gNodeB), core network nodes (MME, AMF, SMF, UPF, IMS P-CSCF/S-CSCF/I-CSCF/HSS), transport nodes (MPLS routers, OTN switches), access nodes (DSLAM, BNG, BRAS, OLT), CPE-side ONT/ONU devices, and virtualized network functions (VNFs: vMME, vSGW, vPGW, vBNG, vFirewall). Tracks element type, subtype, vendor, model, hardware/software version, operational state, administrative state, lifecycle state, geographic location, POP site assignment, rack/slot position, management IP, and NFV-specific attributes (vCPU, vRAM, VNFD, MANO orchestrator) where applicable. Sourced from Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, and MANO platforms. This is the foundational master entity — all other network products reference elements via FK.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Network Resource — Network Element

products.name: topology
products.description: Represents the logical and physical connectivity graph between network elements — links, segments, and paths that form the network topology. Captures link type (fiber, microwave, copper, Ethernet, MPLS LSP), link capacity (bandwidth in Mbps/Gbps), link distance, latency, protection scheme (1+1, ring, mesh), operational state, and the two endpoint network elements. Supports topology visualization, path computation, and capacity planning for RAN, transport, and core network layers.

attributes.name: installation_date

attributes.name: is_protected

attributes.name: is_virtual

attributes.name: last_failure_timestamp

attributes.name: link_cost
attributes.description: Routing protocol cost or metric assigned to the link for path computation algorithms. Used in Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), Intermediate System to Intermediate System (IS-IS), and other routing protocols.

attributes.name: link_distance_km
attributes.description: Physical or logical distance of the link in kilometers. Used for latency calculations, signal degradation analysis, and network planning.

attributes.name: link_identifier

attributes.name: link_latency_ms

attributes.name: link_name

attributes.name: link_type

attributes.name: mpls_label

attributes.name: mtbf_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) in Hours
attributes.description: Average time between consecutive failures of the link, measured in hours. Used for reliability analysis and preventive maintenance planning.

attributes.name: mttr_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) in Hours
attributes.description: Average time required to restore the link to operational state after a failure, measured in hours. Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for fault management and Network Operations Center (NOC) efficiency.

attributes.name: network_layer
attributes.description: The hierarchical layer of the telecommunications network where this link operates. Used for layer-specific topology analysis and capacity planning.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, configuration details, or special handling instructions for the network link.

attributes.name: operational_state
attributes.description: Current operational status of the network link. Reflects real-time state from Network Management System (NMS) and Element Management System (EMS) platforms. Used by Network Operations Center (NOC) for fault management.

attributes.name: protection_scheme
attributes.description: Redundancy and failover mechanism configured for the link. Defines how the network recovers from link failures to maintain service continuity and meet Service Level Agreement (SLA) requirements.

attributes.name: sla_target_availability_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Availability Percentage
attributes.description: Contractual availability target for the link expressed as a percentage. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance monitoring and reporting.

attributes.name: source_interface_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the physical or logical interface on the source network element where the link originates. Used for detailed topology mapping and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: technology_standard
attributes.description: Industry standard or protocol specification governing the link technology. Examples include IEEE 802.3 for Ethernet, ITU-T G.652 for fiber, or 3GPP specifications for Radio Access Network (RAN) links.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Current bandwidth utilization of the link expressed as a percentage of total capacity. Key Performance Indicator (KPI) for capacity planning and congestion management.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the equipment vendor providing the network elements connected by this link. Used for vendor-specific management and support processes.

attributes.name: vlan_number
attributes.description: VLAN identifier for Ethernet-based links, used for logical network segmentation and traffic isolation. Applicable to Ethernet and Software-Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN) links.

Critical for RAN planning, optimization, and coverage management.

attributes.name: cell_operational_state

attributes.name: channel_number

attributes.name: coverage_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: deployment_scenario

attributes.name: electrical_tilt_degrees
attributes.description: Electronic beam steering tilt angle in degrees, adjustable via Remote Electrical Tilt (RET) systems. Enables dynamic coverage optimization.

attributes.name: energy_saving_mode

attributes.name: equipment_model
attributes.description: Specific model designation of the base station equipment serving this cell. Used for inventory management and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: frequency_band
attributes.description: The frequency band designation used by the cell (e.g., Band 1, Band 3, Band 7, n78, n260). Identifies the spectrum allocation for the cell.

attributes.name: handover_hysteresis_db
attributes.description: Hysteresis value in decibels to prevent ping-pong handovers between cells. Stabilizes mobility decisions in border areas.

attributes.name: handover_margin_db
attributes.description: Signal strength margin in decibels required to trigger handover to neighboring cells. Critical parameter for mobility management and call continuity.

attributes.name: last_configuration_change_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent configuration change applied to the cell. Critical for change management and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cell record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the cell antenna location in decimal degrees. Used for coverage mapping and network planning.

attributes.name: load_balancing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic load balancing is enabled to distribute traffic across neighboring cells during congestion.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the cell antenna location in decimal degrees. Used for coverage mapping and network planning.

attributes.name: maximum_cell_range_meters
attributes.description: Maximum designed coverage radius of the cell in meters. Used for network planning and capacity dimensioning.

attributes.name: mechanical_tilt_degrees
attributes.description: Physical downward tilt angle of the antenna in degrees. Used to control vertical coverage and reduce interference.

attributes.name: mimo_configuration
attributes.description: MIMO antenna configuration indicating the number of transmit and receive antenna paths. Higher configurations enable greater spectral efficiency and throughput.

products.name: transmission_link

attributes.name: link_type

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date

attributes.name: nms_object_reference

attributes.name: nms_system

attributes.name: notes

attributes.description: Identifier of the network element serving as the Label Edge Router (LER) where traffic enters the MPLS tunnel.

attributes.name: administrative_status
attributes.description: Administrative state of the tunnel indicating whether it is configured to be active by network operations.

attributes.name: affinity_bits
attributes.description: Administrative group or color constraints (32-bit mask) used to include or exclude specific links during path computation for traffic engineering.

attributes.name: auto_bandwidth_max_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum bandwidth limit in megabits per second that auto-bandwidth can adjust to, preventing over-allocation.

attributes.name: auto_bandwidth_min_mbps
attributes.description: Minimum bandwidth limit in megabits per second that auto-bandwidth can adjust to, ensuring baseline capacity.
attributes.references: Cisco IOS-XR / Juniper JUNOS Feature Documentation

attributes.name: bandwidth_reserved_mbps
attributes.description: Amount of bandwidth reserved for this tunnel in megabits per second, used for traffic engineering and capacity planning.

attributes.name: bandwidth_utilized_mbps
attributes.description: Current bandwidth utilization of the tunnel in megabits per second, measured from traffic statistics.

attributes.name: bytes_received

attributes.name: bytes_transmitted
attributes.description: Total number of bytes transmitted through the tunnel since establishment.

attributes.name: dscp_marking

attributes.name: failover_count
attributes.description: Number of times the tunnel has failed over to a protection path since establishment.

attributes.name: holding_priority
attributes.description: Priority level (0-7, where 0 is highest) used to determine whether an established LSP can be preempted by a new LSP with higher setup priority.

attributes.description: Current packet delay variation (jitter) measurement in milliseconds, indicating consistency of latency.

attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent failover event to a protection path.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the MPLS tunnel record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: last_reoptimization_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent path reoptimization event for this tunnel.

attributes.name: latency_ms
attributes.description: Current end-to-end latency measurement in milliseconds for traffic traversing the tunnel.

attributes.name: lsp_identifier
attributes.description: Numeric identifier for the specific Label Switched Path instance within the tunnel, used for multi-path or protection scenarios.

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.description: Type of metric used for path computation. IGP = Interior Gateway Protocol metric, TE = Traffic Engineering metric, delay = latency-based, hop-count = number of hops.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 3630 - OSPF-TE, RFC 5305 - IS-IS TE

attributes.name: metric_value
attributes.description: Numeric metric value associated with the tunnel path, used for routing decisions and path selection.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the MPLS tunnel indicating whether it is actively forwarding traffic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ITU-T M.3400

attributes.name: packet_loss_count
attributes.description: Total number of packets lost in transit through the tunnel, indicating quality degradation.

attributes.name: packets_received
attributes.description: Total number of packets received through the tunnel since establishment.

attributes.name: packets_transmitted
attributes.description: Total number of packets transmitted through the tunnel since establishment.

attributes.name: path_computation_method
attributes.description: Method used to compute the tunnel path. CSPF = Constrained Shortest Path First (local computation), PCE = Path Computation Element (centralized), manual = operator-defined.

attributes.name: pce_address
attributes.description: IP address of the Path Computation Element server used for centralized path computation when PCE method is enabled.

attributes.name: protection_path
attributes.description: Ordered list of network nodes or links defining the backup or protection LSP route used when the primary path fails.

attributes.name: protection_type
attributes.description: Type of protection mechanism configured for the tunnel to ensure resilience. Facility-backup protects multiple LSPs, one-to-one provides dedicated backup, fast-reroute enables sub-50ms recovery.

attributes.name: reoptimization_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether periodic path reoptimization is enabled to find more optimal routes as network conditions change.

attributes.name: reoptimization_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Time interval in seconds between automatic path reoptimization attempts.
attributes.references: Cisco IOS-XR / Juniper JUNOS Feature Documentation

attributes.name: setup_priority
attributes.description: Priority level (0-7, where 0 is highest) used during LSP setup to determine which tunnels can preempt others when resources are constrained.

attributes.name: signaling_protocol
attributes.description: Protocol used to signal and establish the MPLS tunnel. RSVP-TE = Resource Reservation Protocol Traffic Engineering, LDP = Label Distribution Protocol, BGP = Border Gateway Protocol, SR = Segment Routing.

attributes.name: tunnel_id_number
attributes.description: Numeric tunnel identifier used in RSVP-TE signaling to uniquely identify the tunnel on the ingress node.

attributes.name: tunnel_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to the MPLS tunnel for identification and operational reference.

attributes.name: tunnel_type
attributes.description: The signaling protocol or method used to establish the Label Switched Path (LSP). LDP = Label Distribution Protocol, RSVP-TE = Resource Reservation Protocol - Traffic Engineering, SR-MPLS = Segment Routing MPLS, MPLS-TP = MPLS Transport Profile, BGP-LU = BGP Labeled Unicast, Static = manually configured.

attributes.name: uptime_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds that the tunnel has been in operational up state since last establishment.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User or system identifier that created the MPLS tunnel configuration.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the IP address block: free (available for assignment), reserved (held for future use), allocated (actively assigned), quarantined (temporarily blocked due to security or abuse), or deprecated (scheduled for decommissioning).

attributes.name: assigned_addresses_count
attributes.description: Number of IP addresses from this block that are currently assigned to devices or services.

attributes.name: autonomous_system_number
attributes.description: Autonomous System Number (ASN) associated with this IP address block for BGP routing. Identifies the carrier or network operator.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 4893 - BGP Support for Four-octet AS Number Space

attributes.name: available_addresses_count
attributes.description: Number of IP addresses in this block that remain available for assignment.

attributes.name: block_size
attributes.description: Total number of IP addresses available in this block (e.g., /24 = 256 addresses, /30 = 4 addresses).

attributes.name: broadcast_address
attributes.description: Broadcast address for this IPv4 subnet, typically the last address in the block. Not applicable for IPv6.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP address plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dhcp_pool_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) Pool Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IP address block is configured as a DHCP pool for dynamic address assignment (True) or used for static assignment (False).

attributes.name: dns_zone
attributes.description: DNS zone or domain name associated with this IP address block for reverse DNS lookups (e.g., in-addr.arpa for IPv4, ip6.arpa for IPv6).
attributes.references: IETF RFC 1035 - DNS, IETF RFC 3596 - DNS Extensions for IPv6

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this IP address block allocation expires or is scheduled for review. Null for permanent allocations.

attributes.name: gateway_address
attributes.description: Default gateway IP address for this subnet, typically the first usable address in the block.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 1812 - Requirements for IPv4 Routers

attributes.name: ip_prefix
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internet Protocol (IP) Prefix in Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) Notation
attributes.description: IP address block in CIDR notation (e.g., 10.0.0.0/24 for IPv4 or 2001:db8::/32 for IPv6). Represents the network prefix and subnet mask.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 4632 - CIDR, IETF RFC 4291 - IPv6 Addressing Architecture

attributes.name: ip_version
attributes.description: Version of the IP protocol for this address block: IPv4 or IPv6.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 791 - IPv4, IETF RFC 8200 - IPv6

attributes.name: ipam_source_system
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internet Protocol Address Management (IPAM) Source System
attributes.description: Name of the IPAM or Network Management System (NMS/EMS) that is the authoritative source for this IP address plan record (e.g., Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, Infoblox).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - System of Record

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last IP Address Management (IPAM) Audit Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent IPAM audit or utilization review for this IP address block.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this IP address plan record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that last modified this IP address plan record.

attributes.name: network_function_type
attributes.description: Type of network function or service supported by this IP address block (e.g., RAN, Core, IMS, NFV, SDN, GPON, MPLS, SD-WAN).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Network Function Domain, ETSI NFV Architecture

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this IP address block allocation, including special configurations, exceptions, or operational instructions.

attributes.name: parent_prefix
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parent IP Prefix in Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) Notation
attributes.description: Parent or supernet IP prefix from which this block was subdivided. Supports hierarchical IP address planning and aggregation.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region or market code where this IP address block is deployed (e.g., NAM, EMEA, APAC, or country-specific codes).

attributes.name: responsible_team
attributes.description: Name of the Network Operations Center (NOC) team or organizational unit responsible for managing this IP address block.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Resource Management and Operations

attributes.name: routing_domain
attributes.description: Routing domain or autonomous system (AS) to which this IP address block belongs (e.g., internal, external, MPLS VPN instance name).
attributes.references: IETF RFC 4271 - Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), IETF RFC 4364 - MPLS VPN

attributes.name: security_zone
attributes.description: Security zone classification for this IP address block (e.g., DMZ, trusted, untrusted, management, customer-facing) used for firewall policy and access control.

attributes.name: subnet_mask
attributes.description: Subnet mask in dotted-decimal notation (e.g., 255.255.255.0) for IPv4 address blocks. Defines the network and host portions of the address.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of IP addresses in this block that are currently assigned or in use (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: vlan_number
attributes.description: VLAN tag associated with this IP address block for Layer 2 network segmentation (range 1-4094).

products.name: capacity
products.description: Tracks capacity metrics and utilization thresholds for network elements, links, and cells — the operational capacity management record. Captures resource type (RAN cell, transmission link, MPLS tunnel, BNG port), total capacity (bandwidth/channels/ports), committed capacity, peak utilization percentage, average utilization percentage, congestion threshold, measurement period, and capacity status (under-utilized/normal/congested/critical). Feeds network planning and capacity augmentation decisions. Distinct from performance KPIs — this is the capacity planning master record.
products.reference: TM Forum eTOM — Resource Capacity Management; TMF API 639

attributes.name: capacity_id
attributes.description: Primary key for capacity

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the associated capacity expansion or upgrade project. Links capacity records to capital expenditure tracking.

attributes.name: network_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific network element (RAN cell, OLT, BNG, MPLS node, etc.) for which capacity is being tracked.

attributes.name: pop_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.pop_facility. Business justification: Capacity measurements (space, power, cooling, rack units) are facility-specific. PoP-level capacity reporting drives expansion projects, site selection, and infrastructure investment planning in telec

attributes.name: available_capacity
attributes.description: Remaining capacity available for new service provisioning. Calculated as total capacity minus committed capacity and any reserved buffers.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management

attributes.name: average_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Mean utilization percentage across the measurement period. Used for trend analysis and capacity planning forecasting.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, ITU-T E.492

attributes.name: busy_hour_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this measurement represents the busy hour period. Busy hour metrics are critical for capacity dimensioning and network planning.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.492 - Traffic Engineering, TM Forum GB922

attributes.name: capacity_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the resource capacity relative to defined thresholds. Drives capacity augmentation and network planning decisions.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, ITU-T M.3400

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Method by which capacity data was collected or derived. Indicates data quality and reliability characteristics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, IETF RFC 3411

attributes.name: committed_capacity
attributes.description: Capacity already allocated or reserved for active services and customer commitments. Represents the portion of total capacity currently in use or reserved.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, IETF RFC 3272

attributes.name: congestion_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Utilization percentage threshold at which the resource is considered congested and requires capacity augmentation. Typically set based on QoS requirements and SLA commitments.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, ITU-T E.800

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601, TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: critical_threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Utilization percentage threshold indicating critical capacity exhaustion requiring immediate intervention. Triggers urgent capacity expansion or traffic engineering actions.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, 3GPP TS 32.425

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or tool from which capacity measurements were collected. Identifies the authoritative system of record for this capacity data. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: netact|ericsson_nm|nms|ems|oss|manual_survey|capacity_tool — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: equipment_model
attributes.description: Specific equipment model or platform type. Enables model-specific capacity profiling and upgrade path planning.

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: Projected date when capacity will reach congestion threshold based on current growth trends. Drives capital planning and network expansion timelines.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area where the network resource is deployed. Used for regional capacity planning and investment prioritization.

attributes.name: growth_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Observed or projected capacity growth rate percentage per period. Used for trend-based capacity forecasting and investment planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this capacity record. Tracks data freshness and change history for capacity management.
attributes.references: ISO 8601, TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: measurement_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Ending timestamp of the capacity measurement period. Used with start timestamp to define the observation window for capacity metrics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ISO 8601

attributes.name: measurement_interval_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the measurement period in minutes. Common intervals include 15, 30, 60 minutes for operational monitoring and daily/weekly for planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, 3GPP TS 32.401

attributes.name: measurement_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Beginning timestamp of the capacity measurement period. Defines the temporal window for utilization calculations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ISO 8601

attributes.name: network_layer
attributes.description: Hierarchical network layer classification of the resource. Aligns with network architecture topology and capacity planning domains.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ETSI NFV-IFA 005

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, anomalies, planned maintenance, or special conditions affecting capacity measurements.

attributes.name: peak_utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Maximum utilization percentage observed during the measurement period. Critical metric for identifying capacity bottlenecks and congestion events.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, 3GPP TS 32.425

attributes.name: planned_upgrade_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for capacity augmentation or upgrade activity. Links capacity monitoring to capital project execution.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management

attributes.name: qos_class
attributes.description: QoS classification of traffic carried by this resource. Different QoS classes may have different capacity thresholds and planning criteria.

attributes.name: redundancy_configuration
attributes.description: Redundancy architecture of the resource. Impacts effective capacity calculations and failure scenario planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ITU-T M.3400

attributes.name: reservation_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total capacity reserved for network resilience, traffic bursts, and emergency services. Not available for normal service provisioning.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, ITU-T E.800

attributes.name: resource_identifier
attributes.description: Business identifier or name of the specific resource (cell ID, link name, tunnel ID, port designation). Human-readable reference used in network operations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ETSI NFV-IFA 005

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Classification of the network resource being measured for capacity. Identifies the infrastructure layer and technology domain. attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, 3GPP TS 28.541

attributes.name: sla_target_availability_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Availability Percentage
attributes.description: Target availability percentage defined in SLA commitments. Capacity planning must ensure sufficient redundancy to meet availability targets.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB917 - SLA Management, ITU-T E.800

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Software or firmware version running on the network element. Capacity characteristics may vary by software release.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ETSI NFV-IFA 005

attributes.name: technology_domain
attributes.description: Technology domain classification of the network resource. Groups capacity records by major technology areas for domain-specific planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ran|transport|core|fixed_access|mobile_core|ip_backbone|optical — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, 3GPP TS 23.501

attributes.name: total_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum theoretical capacity of the resource. Represents the absolute upper limit for bandwidth, channels, ports, or connections depending on resource type.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB922 - Resource Capacity Management, 3GPP TS 32.425

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for capacity values. Varies by resource type (bandwidth for links, Erlangs for voice, channels for radio, ports for switches). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mbps|gbps|erlangs|channels|ports|connections|mhz|subscribers — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ITU-T E.800

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Equipment vendor or manufacturer of the network element. Used for vendor-specific capacity analysis and multi-vendor network planning.

products.name: element_config
products.description: Configuration management record for network elements — stores both the active configuration baseline AND the transactional history of all configuration changes. Baseline section: configuration version, type (running/startup/candidate), structured parameters (neighbor lists, handover thresholds, QoS policies, routing tables), compliance status. Change history section: change request reference, change type (planned/emergency/automated), parameters modified (before/after values), execution timestamp, operator/automation ID, outcome (success/partial/failed/rolled-back), rollback reference. Aligned with Nokia NetAct Configuration Management and Ericsson Network Manager. Supports configuration audit, drift detection, rollback, change management compliance, and root cause analysis.
products.reference: Nokia NetAct Configuration Management; Ericsson Network Manager CM; TM Forum SID — Resource Configuration

attributes.name: element_config_id

attributes.name: approver_employee_id

attributes.description: Reference to the physical or logical network element (RAN node, OLT, BNG, BRAS, router, switch) that this configuration applies to. Links to the network element inventory.

attributes.name: planned_outage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled maintenance window during which this configuration change was executed. Ensures changes occur during approved low-impact periods and supports SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ITIL Change Management, TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: primary_element_employee_id

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. attributes.name: rollback_reference_element_config_id

attributes.references: Nokia NetAct Configuration Management, ITIL Change Management

attributes.name: affected_subscribers_count
attributes.description: Estimated or actual number of subscribers impacted by this configuration change. Used for impact assessment, prioritization, and customer communication during planned maintenance or incident response.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Customer Domain, ITIL Service Level Management

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval state of the configuration change request. Approved indicates change authorized by Change Advisory Board (CAB). Emergency_override indicates expedited approval for critical fixes. Used for governance and audit compliance.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the configuration change was formally approved. Used to track approval-to-execution time and ensure changes are executed within approved maintenance windows.

attributes.name: archived_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this configuration was moved to archived status. Used for retention policy enforcement and historical analysis. Null for active or staged configurations.

attributes.name: automation_system
attributes.description: Name of the automation platform or orchestration system that executed this configuration change (e.g., Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, Ansible, Terraform, NSO). Null if manually executed by operator.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Automation Framework, NFV MANO

attributes.name: backup_location
attributes.description: Storage path or URI where the full configuration backup file is stored. Supports disaster recovery, audit compliance, and rapid restoration. May reference network file system, object storage, or configuration management database.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the configuration change: planned (scheduled maintenance window), emergency (urgent fix outside normal window), automated (system-initiated optimization), rollback (reversion to previous config).
attributes.references: ITIL Change Management, TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: checksum
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (MD5, SHA-256) of the configuration file to ensure integrity and detect unauthorized modifications. Used for security audit and tamper detection in compliance with security frameworks.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security, NIST Cybersecurity Framework

attributes.name: compliance_policy_version
attributes.description: Version of the compliance policy framework used to validate this configuration. Ensures audit trail of which standards were applied at the time of configuration deployment.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this configuration meets organizational policy standards, security baselines, and regulatory requirements. Non-compliant configurations trigger alerts for remediation. Used for configuration drift detection.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: config_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the configuration change purpose, scope, and expected outcome. Includes business justification such as capacity expansion, performance optimization, security hardening, or bug fix.
attributes.references: ITIL Change Management, TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: config_notes
attributes.description: Additional operational notes, lessons learned, or special considerations related to this configuration. Used for knowledge management and to inform future similar changes.
attributes.references: ITIL Knowledge Management, TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: config_parameters
attributes.description: Structured representation of configuration parameters including neighbor cell lists, handover thresholds, QoS (Quality of Service) policies, routing tables, VLAN assignments, MPLS labels, BGP peers, OSPF areas, and vendor-specific settings. Stored as JSON or XML for structured querying.

attributes.name: config_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or NMS (Network Management System) / EMS (Element Management System) that generated or captured this configuration record (e.g., Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, Netcracker OSS).

attributes.name: config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this configuration record. Active indicates currently deployed; staged indicates pending activation; archived indicates historical record; superseded indicates replaced by newer version; failed indicates deployment failure.

attributes.name: config_type
attributes.description: Type of configuration record: running (active operational config), startup (boot config), candidate (staged for activation), baseline (approved reference), golden (vendor-certified template).

attributes.name: config_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this configuration snapshot. Follows semantic versioning or vendor-specific versioning scheme (e.g., 2.4.1, R15B). Used for configuration baseline tracking and rollback operations.
attributes.references: Nokia NetAct Configuration Management, Ericsson Network Manager

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: drift_details
attributes.description: Detailed description of configuration drift including specific parameters that differ from baseline, magnitude of deviation, and potential impact on network performance or security. Used for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: drift_detected_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that the running configuration has diverged from the approved baseline configuration. Triggers automated alerts for investigation and remediation to maintain network stability and security posture.

attributes.name: execution_outcome

attributes.name: execution_timestamp

attributes.name: impact_assessment

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: network_layer
attributes.description: OSI or telecom-specific network layer this configuration applies to (e.g., Layer 2, Layer 3, application layer, control plane, user plane). Used for troubleshooting and impact analysis.

attributes.name: noc_site_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the NOC (Network Operations Center) or regional operations center responsible for managing this network element configuration. Used for operational accountability and escalation routing.

attributes.name: parameters_modified

attributes.name: threshold_breach_flag

attributes.name: threshold_upper_limit

attributes.name: planning_horizon

attributes.name: priority

attributes.name: projected_demand

attributes.name: recommended_action

attributes.name: roi_months

attributes.name: geo_location_filter

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the SD-WAN policy purpose, business rationale, and configuration intent for documentation and knowledge management.

attributes.name: policy_identifier

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to the SD-WAN policy for identification and management purposes.

attributes.name: policy_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for policy evaluation order when multiple policies apply to the same traffic. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the SD-WAN policy in its lifecycle: active (in production use), inactive (configured but not applied), draft (under development), suspended (temporarily disabled), or deprecated (scheduled for removal).

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SD-WAN policy based on its primary function: traffic steering for path selection, QoS for quality of service enforcement, security for threat protection, failover for redundancy management, hybrid for combined functions, or application-aware for intelligent routing.

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of this policy configuration, incremented with each modification to support version control and rollback capabilities.

attributes.name: port_range_filter
attributes.description: TCP/UDP port or port range filter specification defining which application ports are subject to this policy, enabling port-based traffic classification.
attributes.references: IANA Service Name and Transport Protocol Port Number Registry

attributes.name: protocol_filter
attributes.description: Network protocol filter specification (TCP, UDP, ICMP, etc.) defining which protocols are subject to this policy, enabling protocol-specific routing decisions.

attributes.name: sla_bandwidth_threshold_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Bandwidth Threshold Megabits Per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed bandwidth in megabits per second defined in the SLA for this policy to ensure adequate capacity for business-critical applications.

attributes.name: sla_jitter_threshold_ms
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Jitter Threshold Milliseconds
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable network jitter (latency variation) in milliseconds defined in the SLA for this policy. Critical for real-time applications like VoIP and video conferencing.

attributes.name: sla_latency_threshold_ms

attributes.description: Maximum acceptable network latency in milliseconds defined in the SLA for this policy. Exceeding this threshold may trigger failover or path re-selection.

attributes.name: sla_packet_loss_threshold_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Packet Loss Threshold Percentage
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable packet loss percentage defined in the SLA for this policy. Exceeding this threshold indicates degraded network quality requiring remediation.

attributes.name: source_network_segment
attributes.description: Source network segment, subnet, or VLAN identifier to which this policy applies, enabling granular traffic control based on origin.

attributes.name: time_based_activation
attributes.description: Time-based schedule defining when this policy is active, supporting business-hours routing, maintenance windows, or time-of-day traffic optimization.

attributes.name: traffic_shaping_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether traffic shaping is enabled for this policy to smooth traffic bursts and enforce rate limits, preventing network congestion.

products.name: network_qos_profile

Used by RAN, core, and transport layers for consistent end-to-end QoS enforcement.

attributes.name: applicable_technology
attributes.description: Network technology or service platform where this QoS profile is applicable. Supports LTE, 5G NR, VoLTE, IMS, MPLS, SD-WAN and other technology-specific QoS implementations.

attributes.name: arp_priority_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocation and Retention Priority (ARP) Priority Level
attributes.description: Allocation and Retention Priority level (1-15) used for admission control decisions. Lower values indicate higher priority for resource allocation and retention.

attributes.name: averaging_window_ms
attributes.description: Time window in milliseconds over which bit rate guarantees and measurements are averaged for GBR bearers. Used for traffic policing and shaping calculations.

attributes.name: burst_size_bytes
attributes.description: Maximum burst size in bytes allowed for traffic shaping token bucket algorithm. Defines how much traffic can exceed the sustained rate in short bursts.

attributes.name: charging_impact
attributes.description: Indicates how this QoS profile impacts subscriber charging. Premium for higher-tier billing, Standard for normal rates, Zero-rated for excluded from data caps, Sponsored for third-party paid.

attributes.name: configuration_template

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: guaranteed_bit_rate_uplink_kbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Guaranteed Bit Rate (GBR) Uplink in Kilobits per Second (kbps)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: maximum_bit_rate_uplink_kbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Bit Rate (MBR) Uplink in Kilobits per Second (kbps)
attributes.description: Maximum uplink bit rate in kbps that the bearer is allowed to utilize. Used for traffic shaping and policing to prevent bandwidth oversubscription.

attributes.name: modified_by_user

attributes.name: packet_error_rate

attributes.description: Indicates whether this QoS profile can trigger preemption of lower-priority bearers during resource congestion to establish or maintain its own bearer.

attributes.description: Indicates whether bearers using this QoS profile can be preempted by higher-priority bearers during resource congestion.

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: profile_code

attributes.name: profile_name

attributes.name: profile_status

attributes.name: qos_class

attributes.name: service_type

attributes.name: sla_tier

attributes.name: traffic_shaping_enabled

attributes.name: vendor_specific_parameters

products.name: peering_agreement
products.description: Master record for network peering and transit agreements with other operators and internet exchange points (IXPs) — the network interconnection agreement record. Captures peering partner name, peering type (public/private/transit), IXP name, peering location (POP site), BGP AS number, agreed bandwidth, traffic exchange policy (settlement-free/paid), peering IP addresses, BGP session state, agreement start date, agreement expiry date, and commercial terms reference. products.name: element_outage_impact
products.description: This association product represents the impact relationship between network elements and planned maintenance outages. It captures element-specific outage details including downtime windows, impact severity, rollback status, and validation outcomes. Each record links one network element to one planned outage with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific element-outage relationship. This enables granular element-level outage tracking, per-element downtime measurement, SLA impact analysis, and element-specific rollback/validation status tracking for NOC operations and network reliability reporting.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications network operations, planned maintenance outages routinely affect multiple network elements (RAN nodes, core network functions, transport equipment), and each network element participates in multiple planned outages over its lifecycle. The NOC actively manages element-specific outage impacts including per-element downtime windows, validation status, and rollback decisions. This is a core operational relationship that network engineers query and manage daily.

products.name: slice_vnf_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of Virtual Network Functions (VNFs) to 5G network slices. It captures the operational relationship between NFV virtualized network functions and the logical network slices they serve. Each record links one VNF instance to one network slice with slice-specific configuration, resource allocation, and role information that exists only in the context of this assignment. Critical for 5G slice orchestration, resource management, and performance assurance.. Existence Justification: In 5G network operations, a single VNF instance (e.g., a virtualized UPF or AMF) can simultaneously serve multiple network slices with different resource allocations and configurations, and each network slice requires multiple VNF instances (AMF, SMF, UPF, etc.) to provide end-to-end service. The business actively manages these assignments through MANO orchestration systems, tracking slice-specific VNF configurations, resource allocation percentages, and performance SLAs. This is a core operational relationship in 5G slice orchestration.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

products.name: cell_slice_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment of 5G network slices to individual RAN cells. It captures the many-to-many relationship where a single cell can simultaneously support multiple network slices (eMBB, URLLC, mMTC) with different resource allocations, and a network slice spans across multiple cells to provide end-to-end service coverage. Each record defines the slice activation status, resource block allocation, priority levels, and admission control thresholds that govern how the cell serves traffic for that specific slice.. Existence Justification: In 5G networks, RAN cells and network slices have a true many-to-many operational relationship as defined by 3GPP standards. A single physical RAN cell simultaneously supports multiple network slices (e.g., eMBB for consumer broadband, URLLC for industrial IoT, mMTC for massive sensor networks) with independent resource allocations and SLA parameters. Conversely, a network slice spans across multiple RAN cells to provide end-to-end service coverage across geographic areas. Network operations teams actively manage these assignments, configuring per-cell resource allocations, priority levels, and admission control thresholds for each slice.

attributes.name: acquisition_channel

attributes.name: activation_date

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: Day of month when billing cycle closes and invoice is generated. Value between 1 and 28 to accommodate all months. Determines invoice generation schedule and payment due dates. Critical for revenue recognition and cash flow management.

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag

attributes.name: churn_risk_score

Drives retention investment prioritization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_class

attributes.name: credit_limit

attributes.name: fraud_score

True means customer receives invoices via email or web portal only; false means paper invoices are mailed. Supports environmental sustainability initiatives and reduces operational costs (OPEX).

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: Customer's preferred channel for receiving notifications, billing statements, promotional offers, and service updates. Email for electronic delivery; SMS for text messages; phone for voice calls; mail for postal delivery; mobile app for push notifications; web portal for self-service access.

attributes.name: previous_status

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the primary account holder or authorized contact person. Used for identity verification, legal correspondence, and customer service authentication. For business accounts, this is the primary business contact. For consumer accounts, this is the account owner.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: primary_email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for account communications, billing notifications, service alerts, and password resets. Must be unique per account for authentication purposes. Used for electronic invoice delivery when paperless billing is enabled.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: primary_phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number in E.164 international format. Used for customer service callbacks, two-factor authentication, SMS notifications, and emergency contact. May be mobile or landline. For mobile accounts, often matches the service MSISDN (Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number).
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 - International Numbering Plan; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: security_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Refundable deposit held for accounts with credit risk or new customers without credit history. Returned after satisfactory payment history period. Expressed in account currency. Zero or null for accounts not requiring deposits.

attributes.name: service_address_same_as_billing_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Address Same As Billing Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether service delivery address matches billing address. True for most residential mobile accounts; false for business accounts with separate billing and service locations, or customers with PO Box billing addresses. Determines whether separate service address fields are populated.

attributes.name: status_change_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of most recent account status change. Used for status duration analysis, SLA compliance tracking, and lifecycle event sequencing. Null for accounts that have never changed status since creation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Account State History

attributes.name: status_change_initiated_by
attributes.description: Actor or system that triggered the most recent status change. Customer for self-service actions; system for automated processes; agent for customer service actions; billing for payment-related changes; fraud for security actions; credit for credit management; provisioning for technical changes. Used for accountability and process analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer|system|agent|billing|fraud|credit|provisioning — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Account State History

attributes.name: status_change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for most recent status change. Examples: payment received for suspension-to-active; non-payment for active-to-suspended; customer request for termination; fraud detection for suspension. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement. Null for accounts with no status changes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Account State History

attributes.name: sub_type
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing additional segmentation within account type. Individual accounts serve single consumers; family accounts serve household groups; business accounts serve commercial entities; government accounts serve public sector; nonprofit accounts serve charitable organizations; reseller accounts serve distribution partners.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether account is exempt from sales tax, value-added tax (VAT), or other telecommunications taxes. True for government entities, nonprofits, or accounts with valid tax exemption certificates; false for standard taxable accounts. Requires supporting documentation.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate or registration number proving tax-exempt status. Required for audit compliance when tax exempt flag is true. Issued by relevant tax authority. Null for non-exempt accounts.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when account was permanently closed and customer relationship ended. Null for active accounts. Used for churn analysis, win-back campaigns, and regulatory retention period compliance. Triggers final billing and service deactivation.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for account closure. Customer request for voluntary cancellation; non-payment for delinquency; fraud for security violations; relocation for move outside service area; competitor for churn to rival; service quality for dissatisfaction; price for cost concerns; deceased for customer death; duplicate for consolidation. Critical for churn root cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|non_payment|fraud|relocation|competitor|service_quality|price|deceased|duplicate — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this customer account record was last modified. Updated automatically on any field change. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental data processing. Critical for CDC (Change Data Capture) and real-time analytics.

attributes.name: vip_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether account is designated as VIP requiring special handling. True for high-value customers, executives, celebrities, government officials, or strategic partners. Triggers priority support routing, dedicated account management, and enhanced service level agreements (SLA). Used for customer retention and satisfaction optimization.

products.name: subscriber
products.description: Individual subscriber identity record representing a single SIM/line/service user within an account. Distinct from account (which is the billing/commercial entity) — a single account may have multiple subscribers. SSOT for individual subscriber identity. Sourced from HSS/UDM and provisioning systems.

attributes.name: customer_account_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.offering. Business justification: Subscribers are provisioned with specific offerings. Direct service-to-product link for network provisioning, QoS policy application, and service entitlement management.

attributes.name: price_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_plan. Business justification: Subscribers are rated under specific price plans. Essential for real-time charging, usage mediation, and prepaid/postpaid billing in telecommunications rating engines.

attributes.name: service_location_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.location_address. Business justification: Subscribers need authoritative service addresses for network slice assignment, coverage tier determination, field service dispatch, and roaming profile configuration. Location.location_address provide

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscriber was first activated on the network. Marks the start of the subscriber lifecycle.

attributes.name: biometric_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has completed biometric identity verification (fingerprint, facial recognition, etc.).

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Calculated probability that the subscriber will terminate service within the next period. Range 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: cltv_score
attributes.description: Predicted total revenue value of the subscriber over their expected lifetime with the company. Used for retention and marketing prioritization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscriber record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credit_class
attributes.description: Credit risk classification of the subscriber, used for deposit requirements and service eligibility decisions.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Marketing and service segmentation classification of the subscriber based on demographics, usage patterns, and value.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has consented to sharing their data with third parties for analytics or marketing purposes.

attributes.name: data_speed_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the data speed entitlement for the subscriber based on their service plan and current usage status.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Birth date of the subscriber. Used for age verification, parental controls, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscriber was deactivated or terminated. Null for active subscribers.

attributes.name: device_imei
attributes.description: Unique 15-digit identifier of the mobile device currently associated with the subscriber. Used for device tracking and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: esim_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is eligible for eSIM provisioning based on device capability and service plan.

attributes.name: five_g_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has access to 5G network services based on device capability and service plan.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Calculated risk score indicating the likelihood of fraudulent activity associated with the subscriber. Range 0.00 to 100.00.

attributes.name: hotspot_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is permitted to use mobile hotspot/tethering functionality.

attributes.name: iccid
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the SIM card. Used for SIM inventory and provisioning.

attributes.name: id_document_number
attributes.description: Unique number of the government-issued identification document. Used for KYC and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: id_document_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identification document provided by the subscriber during registration.
attributes.references: FCC Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Rules

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: Unique identifier stored on the SIM card, used to identify the subscriber on the network. Sourced from HSS/UDM.

attributes.name: international_dialing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is permitted to make international calls from the home network.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subscriber record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: last_nps_survey_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Net Promoter Score (NPS) Survey Date
attributes.description: Date when the subscriber last completed an NPS survey.

attributes.name: last_sim_swap_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent SIM card swap event for the subscriber.
attributes.references: GSMA Fraud and Security Group Guidelines

attributes.name: last_usage_date
attributes.description: Date when the subscriber last used any network service (voice, data, SMS). Used for dormancy detection and churn prediction.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has consented to receive marketing communications.

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The subscriber's mobile phone number in E.164 format. Primary contact identifier for the subscriber.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: Country of citizenship of the subscriber, represented as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Used for roaming profile and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score provided by the subscriber, ranging from -100 to 100. Measures customer loyalty and satisfaction.

attributes.name: parental_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental control restrictions are applied to the subscriber, typically for minor dependents.
attributes.references: FCC Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA)

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code representing the subscriber's preferred language for communication and service delivery.

attributes.name: qos_profile
attributes.description: Defines the Quality of Service parameters applied to the subscriber's traffic, including priority, latency, and throughput guarantees.

attributes.name: roaming_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether roaming services are currently enabled for the subscriber. Can be toggled for fraud prevention or cost control.

attributes.name: roaming_profile
attributes.description: Defines the subscriber's roaming permissions and geographic scope. Determines which networks the subscriber can access outside the home network.

attributes.name: sim_swap_count
attributes.description: Total number of times the subscriber has performed a SIM card swap. High frequency may indicate fraud risk.

attributes.name: subscriber_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subscriber. Active indicates the subscriber can use services; suspended/barred indicates temporary restriction; terminated indicates permanent closure.

attributes.name: subscriber_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscriber within the account structure. Primary is the main account holder, secondary/add-on are additional lines.

attributes.name: volte_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Voice over Long-Term Evolution (VoLTE) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether VoLTE service is enabled for the subscriber, allowing voice calls over LTE network.

attributes.name: vowifi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Voice over Wi-Fi calling is enabled for the subscriber.

attributes.name: city

attributes.name: communication_language

attributes.name: contact_role

attributes.name: contact_status

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The 3-letter ISO country code representing the country of the contact person's address (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The date of birth of the contact person. Used for identity verification and age-restricted service eligibility.

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The department or business unit within the organization where the contact person works. Primarily used for B2B enterprise accounts.

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact person has requested not to be contacted for any purpose. True if contact is prohibited, False otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this contact record ceases to be effective or is terminated. Null indicates the contact is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this contact record becomes effective and active for the customer account.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: The primary email address of the contact person used for electronic communication and correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, RFC 5322 - Internet Message Format

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this contact in the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: The facsimile (fax) number of the contact person, if applicable. Used primarily for B2B enterprise communications.

attributes.name: first_name

attributes.name: is_primary_contact

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The professional job title or position of the contact person within their organization. Primarily used for Business-to-Business (B2B) enterprise accounts.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: The family name or surname of the contact person.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact person provided consent to receive marketing communications. Used for compliance tracking and consent management.

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact person has explicitly opted in to receive marketing communications, promotional offers, and product updates. True if opted in, False otherwise.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: marketing_opt_out_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact person withdrew consent or opted out of receiving marketing communications.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: The middle name or initial of the contact person, if applicable.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: The mobile telephone number of the contact person. Primary contact channel for SMS and voice communication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, ITU-T E.164 - International Numbering Plan

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: The government-issued national identification number of the contact person (e.g., Social Security Number in USA, National Insurance Number in UK). Used for identity verification and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, FCC Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the contact person. Used by Customer Relationship Management (CRM) representatives for context.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal code or ZIP code of the contact person's address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, Universal Postal Union S42 Standard

attributes.name: preferred_contact_channel
attributes.description: The contact person's preferred communication channel for receiving notifications, updates, and correspondence from the telecommunications provider.

attributes.name: relationship_to_account_holder
attributes.description: Describes the personal or professional relationship of this contact to the primary account holder (e.g., spouse, parent, employee, business partner).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the operational system from which this contact record originated (e.g., Salesforce CRM, legacy billing system, customer portal).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: The state, province, or region of the contact person's address.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data, ISO 3166-2 - Country Subdivision Codes

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The honorific or courtesy title of the contact person (e.g., Mr., Mrs., Dr.).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contact record was last modified or updated. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date when the contact information was last verified or validated.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: The verification status of the contact information. Indicates whether the contact details (email, phone) have been validated through verification processes.
