attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the subscriber's contract with the donor operator. Used to validate eligibility for porting and identify potential early termination fees.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Customer Agreement ABE

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MNP request record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MNP request is subject to a dispute between operators, subscriber, or regulatory authority. Triggers escalation and resolution workflows.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when a dispute related to the MNP request was resolved, allowing the porting process to continue or be terminated.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MNP request record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes and data quality.

attributes.name: mnp_request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the MNP request. Used for customer communication, inter-operator coordination, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: nrtrde_notification_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Notification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether NRTRDE notification was sent to roaming partners about the number port. Required for maintaining accurate roaming records and billing across international networks.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.28 - Near Real Time Roaming Data Exchange

attributes.name: number_range_holder
attributes.description: The original operator to which the number range was allocated by the regulatory authority. May differ from the current donor operator if the number was previously ported.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 - International Public Telecommunication Numbering Plan

attributes.name: port_type
attributes.description: Classification of the porting complexity. Simple (single number), complex (number with associated services), or bulk (multiple numbers in one request).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: previous_port_count
attributes.description: The number of times this MSISDN has been ported between operators. Used for tracking porting history and identifying potential fraud patterns.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: recipient_operator_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the telecommunications operator to which the subscriber is porting (gaining carrier). Typically a regulatory-assigned carrier identification code.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the regulatory authority or central MNP database for tracking and compliance purposes. Used for regulatory reporting to FCC, BEREC, or national telecom regulators.

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the MNP request was rejected. Examples include account mismatch, outstanding balance, contract obligations, or technical validation failures.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable explanation of why the MNP request was rejected. Provides detailed context beyond the rejection reason code for customer service and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The date when the MNP request was initially submitted by the subscriber or receiving operator. This is the business event timestamp marking the start of the porting process.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MNP request. Tracks progression from initial submission through validation, approval, execution, or rejection/cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|validated|approved|rejected|completed|cancelled|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a port-in request (subscriber moving TO this operator) or port-out request (subscriber moving FROM this operator to another carrier).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The network routing number assigned to the MSISDN after porting. Used by all operators to correctly route calls and messages to the recipient operator's network.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: scheduled_port_date
attributes.description: The planned date for executing the number port. This is the target date agreed upon between operators for completing the MSISDN transfer.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The billing model of the service being ported. Indicates whether the subscriber is on a prepaid, postpaid, or hybrid billing plan.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MNP request was completed within the regulatory or contractual SLA timeframe. Typically measured against mandated porting windows (e.g., 24-48 hours).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours within which the MNP request must be completed to meet regulatory or contractual SLA requirements. Varies by jurisdiction (e.g., 24 hours in EU, 48 hours in some markets).

attributes.name: subscriber_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the subscriber at the donor operator. Used for validation and account matching during the porting process.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Customer Account ABE

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the technical and business validation checks performed on the MNP request. Includes account verification, subscriber identity validation, and technical feasibility checks.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when validation checks were completed for the MNP request.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD NG.113 - Mobile Number Portability

products.name: loyalty_account
products.description: Customer loyalty program account and full transaction ledger tracking points accumulation, redemption, tier status, and complete points history. Stores loyalty program code, loyalty tier (bronze/silver/gold/platinum), current points balance, lifetime points earned, points expiry date, tier qualification date, tier review date, enrolled date, program status, and all transaction records: transaction type (earn/redeem/expire/adjust/transfer), points amount, transaction date, trigger event (bill payment/top-up/referral/promotion/redemption), reference transaction ID, redemption reward type (discount/device/accessory/content), expiry date of earned points, and running balance after transaction. SSOT for loyalty program membership and the complete points ledger. Enables loyalty-driven retention, ARPU uplift through rewards, tier-based service differentiation, and full points reconciliation.
products.reference: TM Forum SID LoyaltyProgram

attributes.name: liability_general_ledger_id

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.promo_offer. Business justification: Loyalty accounts redeem specific promo offers (bonus data, discounts). Core loyalty program mechanics for points redemption, offer eligibility validation, and campaign tracking.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.segment_definition. Enables segment-based loyalty performance re

attributes.name: account_status

Active accounts can earn and redeem points; suspended accounts are temporarily blocked; inactive accounts have no recent activity; closed accounts are permanently terminated; pending_activation accounts are awaiting first enrollment confirmation; frozen accounts are under investigation or dispute.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty account was activated and became eligible for points earning. May differ from enrollment date if activation requires additional steps.

attributes.name: auto_redemption_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic points redemption is enabled for this account (e.g., auto-apply points to bill payment). True if enabled, False if manual redemption only.

attributes.name: churn_risk_score
attributes.description: Predictive churn risk score for this loyalty account, typically ranging from 0.00 (low risk) to 1.00 (high risk). Used for proactive retention interventions. Calculated using AI/ML models on usage and engagement patterns.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the loyalty account was permanently closed. Null if account is still open.

attributes.name: closure_reason
attributes.description: Reason for account closure (e.g., customer request, account termination, fraud, inactivity, program discontinuation). Null if account is still open.

attributes.name: cltv_segment
attributes.description: Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) segmentation category for this loyalty account holder. Used for targeted retention strategies and personalized reward offerings. Calculated in Salesforce CRM analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the loyalty account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: Most recent Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT) for loyalty program experience, typically on a scale of 1.0 to 5.0. Used for program quality monitoring. Sourced from Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: current_points_balance
attributes.description: Current available points balance that can be redeemed. Reflects all earned points minus redeemed and expired points. Updated in real-time via Comverse ONE prepaid balance management.

attributes.name: earning_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Current points earning rate multiplier for this account based on tier level and promotions (e.g., 1.0 for base rate, 1.5 for gold tier, 2.0 for platinum). Used for real-time rating in Comverse ONE.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer enrolled in the loyalty program (e.g., web, mobile app, retail store, call center, partner, auto-enroll). Used for channel effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Used for tenure analysis and anniversary rewards.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent points transaction (earn, redeem, or adjustment). Used for dormancy detection and churn risk scoring.

attributes.name: last_earn_date
attributes.description: Date when points were last earned by the customer. Used for engagement tracking and reactivation campaigns.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the loyalty account record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: last_redemption_date
attributes.description: Date when points were last redeemed by the customer. Used for redemption behavior analysis and reward catalog optimization.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Total cumulative points earned since account inception, including redeemed and expired points. Used for tier qualification and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) segmentation.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_expired
attributes.description: Total cumulative points that have expired due to inactivity or program rules since account inception. Used for churn risk analysis.

attributes.name: lifetime_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Total cumulative points redeemed by the customer since account inception. Used for engagement analytics and Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) uplift measurement.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the loyalty program this account is enrolled in (e.g., REWARDS_PLUS, PLATINUM_CLUB, BUSINESS_ADVANTAGE). Aligns with product catalog in Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite.

attributes.name: loyalty_program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the loyalty program (e.g., Rewards Plus, Platinum Club, Business Advantage).

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted in to receive loyalty program marketing communications and promotional offers. True if opted in, False if opted out.

attributes.name: next_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the next batch of points is scheduled to expire. Used for proactive customer engagement and churn prevention campaigns.

attributes.name: next_expiry_points_amount
attributes.description: Number of points scheduled to expire on the next expiry date. Used for customer notification and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) for this loyalty account holder, ranging from 0 to 10. Used for loyalty program satisfaction tracking and churn prediction. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Customer 360.

attributes.name: partner_account_number
attributes.description: Customer's account number in the partner loyalty program. Used for cross-program point transfers and reconciliation. Null if no partner linkage.

attributes.name: partner_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying any partner loyalty program this account is linked to for cross-program point transfers or earning (e.g., airline frequent flyer, hotel rewards). Null if no partner linkage.

attributes.name: points_expiry_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months after which earned points expire if not redeemed. Program rule applied at account level. Null if points never expire.

attributes.name: points_pending_credit
attributes.description: Points earned but not yet credited to the account balance, typically awaiting transaction settlement or validation period completion.

attributes.name: points_to_next_tier
attributes.description: Number of additional lifetime points required to qualify for the next tier level. Used for customer engagement and upsell campaigns.

attributes.name: redemption_rate
attributes.description: Monetary value per point when redeeming (e.g., 0.01 means 100 points = $1). Used for redemption transaction processing and reward valuation.

attributes.name: referral_bonus_points_earned
attributes.description: Total points earned through successful customer referrals. Used for referral program effectiveness measurement and Net Promoter Score (NPS) correlation.

attributes.name: referral_code
attributes.description: Unique referral code assigned to this loyalty account for customer acquisition campaigns. Used when this customer refers new subscribers to earn bonus points.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that created or manages this loyalty account record (e.g., Salesforce CRM, Comverse ONE, Netcracker). Used for data lineage and system-of-record identification.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the account was suspended. Null if account has never been suspended or is currently active.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for account suspension (e.g., fraud investigation, customer request, policy violation, billing dispute). Null if account is not suspended.

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Current tier or status level within the loyalty program (e.g., bronze, silver, gold, platinum, diamond, VIP). Tier determines benefits, earning rates, and service differentiation. Managed via Salesforce CRM segmentation.

attributes.name: tier_points_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum lifetime points required to maintain current tier level. Used for tier retention and upgrade eligibility calculations.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer qualified for their current tier level. Used for tier anniversary benefits and retention analysis.

attributes.name: tier_review_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled date for tier status review and potential upgrade or downgrade based on activity and points accumulation.

products.name: device_registration
products.description: Record of customer-owned and financed devices registered against a subscriber or account — handsets, tablets, CPE (routers/modems), ONT, and IoT devices. Stores device type, make, model, IMEI/serial number, registration date, device status (active/lost/stolen/replaced), BYOD flag, device financing flag (linked to installment plan), insurance enrollment flag, warranty expiry date, OS version, network capability (4G/5G/VoLTE/WiFi6), SIM slot type, and eSIM profile reference. Distinct from network inventory (operator-owned infrastructure) and inventory domain (stock/warehouse tracking) — this is the customer-premises device registry. Enables IMEI-based fraud detection, stolen device blocking (CEIR/EIR integration), device upgrade targeting, and insurance claim validation.
products.reference: GSMA IMEI Database, TM Forum SID CustomerEquipment

products.description: Know Your Customer identity verification record capturing the results of identity checks performed during customer onboarding and periodic re-verification. Stores verification type (ID document/biometric/credit check/address proof), verification status (pending/passed/failed/expired), document type (passport/national ID/driving licence/utility bill), document number (masked), issuing country, verification date, expiry date, verification provider, verification score, risk rating (low/medium/high), and regulatory framework (AML/KYC/eIDAS). Required for regulatory compliance and fraud prevention during onboarding.

products.name: customer_segment_membership
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of subscribers to analytical segments. It captures the dynamic, multi-dimensional segmentation of subscribers where each subscriber can belong to multiple segments simultaneously (e.g., High-Value Postpaid AND 5G Early Adopter AND Churn Risk), and each segment contains many subscribers. Each record links one subscriber to one segment with temporal validity, confidence scoring, priority ranking, and override logic that exist only in the context of this relationship. This is the operational SSOT for segment membership used by marketing automation, personalization engines, and campaign management systems.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications analytics operations, subscribers are simultaneously assigned to multiple segments (a high-value postpaid subscriber can also be a 5G early adopter AND a churn risk), and each segment contains thousands to millions of subscribers. The business actively manages segment membership through automated refresh cycles, manual overrides, and campaign-triggered assignments. Segment membership is a recognized operational entity with its own lifecycle, confidence scoring, priority ranking, and temporal validity.
