attributes.description: Classification of the QoS profile by service type (voice, data, video, IoT, converged, emergency).

attributes.name: qci_value
attributes.description: QCI value for LTE/4G networks (1-9 standardized, 65-255 operator-specific). Defines packet forwarding treatment and scheduling priority.

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Classification of resource allocation model: GBR (guaranteed bit rate), non-GBR (best effort), or delay-critical GBR.

attributes.name: service_qos_profile_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the QoS profile purpose, use cases, and technical characteristics.

attributes.name: service_qos_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the QoS profile (active, inactive, deprecated, testing).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that defined this QoS profile (e.g., Netcracker OSS, Ericsson Network Manager).

attributes.name: traffic_shaping_rule
attributes.description: Traffic shaping rule identifier or policy name applied to flows using this QoS profile (e.g., rate limiting, burst control).

products.name: volte_ims_state
products.description: Master record tracking the real-time and historical VoLTE/IMS service state for a subscriber's service instance — IMS registration status, P-CSCF/S-CSCF assignment, VoLTE capability flag, HD voice enablement, Wi-Fi calling (VoWiFi) status, emergency call (eSRVCC) capability, and last registration timestamp. Critical for voice service assurance and regulatory emergency services compliance. Sourced from IMS HSS/UDM and Ericsson Network Manager.
products.reference: 3GPP TS 23.228 IMS; 3GPP TS 24.229 SIP; GSMA IR.92 VoLTE Profile

attributes.name: volte_ims_state_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: VoLTE (Voice over Long-Term Evolution) IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) State ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the VoLTE IMS state record. Primary key for tracking individual service state instances across the IMS infrastructure.

attributes.name: ims_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.ims_node. Business justification: VoLTE/IMS registrations are anchored to specific IMS nodes (P-CSCF/S-CSCF). Essential for voice service assurance, IMS node capacity management, and troubleshooting registration failures. Replaces den

attributes.name: lawful_intercept_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.lawful_intercept_order. Business justification: VoLTE intercepts require IMS registration state (IMPI/IMPU, P-CSCF address, S-CSCF name) to provision call interception at the IMS layer. LEA orders targeting VoLTE services must reference IMS identit

attributes.name: network_analytics_kpi_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.network_analytics_kpi. Business justification: VoLTE/IMS registration states feed network KPIs like IMS registration success rate, VoLTE capability penetration, HD voice adoption, and VoWiFi usage. Essential for network performance monitoring, tec

attributes.name: network_qos_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Quality of Service profile applied to this VoLTE service instance, defining bandwidth, latency, and priority parameters.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.203 Policy and Charging Control Architecture

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber whose VoLTE/IMS service state is being tracked. Links to the customer domain subscriber entity.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active service instance for which this VoLTE/IMS state applies. Links to the service instance entity in the service domain.

attributes.name: visited_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: VoLTE roaming IMS registration state requires visited carrier tracking for inter-carrier IMS interworking, TAP CDR generation, and VoLTE roaming settlement. Critical for IR.92/IR.51 compliance.

attributes.name: barring_status
attributes.description: Indicates any call barring restrictions applied to the VoLTE service, such as outgoing, incoming, or international call restrictions.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 24.611 Anonymous Communication Rejection and Communication Barring

attributes.name: call_forwarding_status
attributes.description: Current call forwarding configuration for the VoLTE service. Indicates if and under what conditions calls are forwarded to another number.

attributes.name: call_waiting_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether call waiting supplementary service is enabled, allowing the subscriber to receive a second call while on an active call.

attributes.name: caller_id_presentation
attributes.description: Configuration for outgoing caller ID presentation. Determines whether the subscribers number is displayed to called parties.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 24.607 Originating Identification Presentation and Restriction

attributes.name: charging_function_address
attributes.description: The address of the Online Charging System (OCS) or Offline Charging System (OFCS) handling billing events for this VoLTE service instance.

attributes.name: codec_preference
attributes.description: The preferred voice codec configuration for this subscriber (e.g., EVS, AMR-WB, AMR-NB). Determines audio quality and bandwidth usage.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 26.114 IP Multimedia Subsystem Media Handling and Interaction

attributes.name: deregistration_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the subscriber was last deregistered from the IMS network, either explicitly or due to timeout/failure.

attributes.name: emergency_call_capability
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the subscriber can place emergency calls (E911/E112) over VoLTE. Critical for regulatory compliance with emergency services requirements.
attributes.references: FCC E911 Requirements, 3GPP TS 23.167 IMS Emergency Sessions

attributes.name: emergency_location_info
attributes.description: The most recent location information (cell ID, GPS coordinates, or civic address) available for emergency call routing. Critical for E911 compliance.

attributes.name: esrvcc_capability
attributes.business_glossary_term: eSRVCC (Enhanced Single Radio Voice Call Continuity) Capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber and network support enhanced SRVCC for seamless handover of VoLTE calls to 3G/2G networks and emergency call continuity.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.216 Single Radio Voice Call Continuity

attributes.name: hd_voice_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether High Definition voice codec (EVS or AMR-WB) is enabled for this subscriber, providing enhanced audio quality over VoLTE.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.94 IMS Profile for Conversational Video Service

attributes.name: hss_address
attributes.description: The address of the Home Subscriber Server storing the subscriber profile and authentication credentials for IMS services.

attributes.name: impi
attributes.description: The private identity used for IMS authentication and authorization. Typically derived from IMSI and used in SIP registration.

attributes.name: impu
attributes.description: The public identity (SIP URI or TEL URI) used for IMS service delivery. Visible to other users and used for call establishment.

attributes.name: ims_registration_status
attributes.description: Current registration state of the subscriber in the IMS core network. Indicates whether the subscriber can initiate or receive VoLTE calls.

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The 15-digit International Mobile Subscriber Identity uniquely identifying the subscriber in the IMS/HSS system. Critical for IMS registration and authentication.

attributes.name: last_call_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent VoLTE call (incoming or outgoing) made by this subscriber. Used for activity monitoring and churn prediction.

attributes.name: last_location_update
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent location update received from the subscriber device. Used for emergency services location accuracy.

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this VoLTE IMS state record was last synchronized from the source IMS HSS/UDM or network management system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID Common Business Entities

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: MSISDN (Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number)
attributes.description: The telephone number associated with the subscriber for VoLTE service. Used for call routing and billing correlation.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 International Public Telecommunication Numbering Plan

attributes.name: network_assigned_uri
attributes.description: The SIP URI assigned by the network for IMS service delivery. May differ from the public identity for routing purposes.

attributes.name: provisioning_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the OSS/BSS system that provisioned this VoLTE service state record (e.g., Oracle OSM, Netcracker OSS, Ericsson Network Manager).

attributes.name: rcs_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Rich Communication Services (advanced messaging over IMS) is enabled for this subscriber.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD RCC.07 Rich Communication Suite

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VoLTE IMS state record was first created in the data lakehouse. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VoLTE IMS state record was last modified in the data lakehouse. Tracks data currency for analytics and reporting.

attributes.name: registration_expiry_time
attributes.description: The timestamp when the current IMS registration will expire if not refreshed. Determines when re-registration is required.

attributes.name: registration_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the subscriber last successfully registered with the IMS network. Used for session management and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: roaming_status
attributes.description: Current roaming state of the subscriber for VoLTE service. Affects routing, charging, and service availability.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.65 IMS Roaming and Interworking Guidelines

attributes.name: service_activation_date
attributes.description: The date when VoLTE service was first activated for this subscriber. Used for service tenure analysis and billing cycle determination.

attributes.name: service_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VoLTE service instance. Determines whether the subscriber can use VoLTE features.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: The service level agreement tier assigned to this VoLTE service, determining priority, support level, and performance guarantees.

attributes.name: ue_capability_version
attributes.description: The IMS capability version reported by the subscribers device. Indicates supported features and protocol versions.

attributes.name: video_calling_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether video calling over IMS (ViLTE) is enabled for this subscriber. Requires additional QoS and device capability.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.94 IMS Profile for Conversational Video Service

attributes.name: visited_network_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the visited network when the subscriber is roaming. Null when in home network. Used for inter-operator billing and routing.

attributes.name: volte_capability_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: VoLTE (Voice over Long-Term Evolution) Capability Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the subscriber device and subscription support VoLTE service. True indicates VoLTE is enabled and available.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.92 IMS Profile for Voice and SMS

attributes.name: vowifi_status
attributes.description: Current status of Wi-Fi calling capability for the subscriber. Indicates whether the subscriber can make VoLTE calls over Wi-Fi networks.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 24.327 Mobility Management based on Mobile IPv4

products.name: esim_profile
products.description: Master record for each eSIM (eUICC) profile provisioned to a subscriber device — EID, ICCID, profile state (downloaded, enabled, disabled, deleted), SM-DP+ server reference, profile type (operational/test/bootstrap), activation code, and download timestamp. Tracks the full eSIM lifecycle from SM-DP+ provisioning through device enablement. Supports MNP and multi-profile eSIM scenarios. Governed by GSMA SGP.22 RSP specification.
products.reference: GSMA SGP.22 RSP Architecture; GSMA SGP.02 eUICC

attributes.name: esim_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service eSIM (Embedded Subscriber Identity Module) Profile ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the eSIM profile record. Primary key for the service eSIM profile entity.

attributes.name: device_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.device_model. Business justification: eSIM profile provisioning must validate device eSIM capability, firmware version, and LPA compatibility from device model master data. Critical for activation success and regulatory compliance reporti

attributes.name: network_analytics_kpi_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.network_analytics_kpi. Business justification: eSIM profile states feed network KPIs like eSIM activation success rate, profile download completion rate, multi-profile adoption, and remote provisioning performance. Required for eSIM technology per

attributes.name: network_qos_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the QoS profile that defines the service quality parameters for this eSIM profile. Includes bandwidth limits, latency targets, packet loss thresholds, and priority levels.

attributes.name: partner_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: eSIM profiles for multi-IMSI or roaming scenarios track the partner carrier for profile provisioning, SM-DP+ coordination, and international eSIM roaming agreements (GSMA SGP.22).

attributes.name: privacy_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_consent. Business justification: eSIM profile provisioning processes subscriber identity data (IMSI, EID, ICCID) and enables remote SIM management. GDPR/privacy laws require explicit consent for profile downloads, remote enable/disab

attributes.name: sim_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sim_stock. Business justification: eSIM profile lifecycle management requires linking to SIM inventory for activation code generation, SMDP+ provisioning, inventory depletion tracking, and regulatory compliance reporting. Tracks which

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who owns this eSIM profile. Links the eSIM profile to the customer subscriber record.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active service instance that this eSIM profile delivers. Links the eSIM profile to the logical service layer.

attributes.name: activation_code
attributes.description: QR code or alphanumeric string provided to the subscriber for profile download and installation. Contains the SM-DP+ address, matching ID, and confirmation code. Typically delivered via email, SMS, or printed on packaging.

attributes.name: confirmation_code
attributes.description: Security code used to authenticate the profile download request. Prevents unauthorized profile downloads. Part of the activation code and validated by the SM-DP+ during the download process.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this eSIM profile record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: deleted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eSIM profile was permanently deleted from the eUICC. The profile is removed from storage and cannot be recovered. The ICCID may be reused for a new profile.

attributes.name: device_imei
attributes.description: Unique 15-digit identifier of the mobile device hardware where this eSIM profile is installed. Used for device tracking, theft prevention, and network access control.

attributes.name: device_model
attributes.description: Make and model of the device where this eSIM profile is installed. Used for device compatibility tracking, troubleshooting, and targeted service offerings.

attributes.name: disabled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eSIM profile was disabled and deactivated from network access. The profile remains on the eUICC but cannot connect to the mobile network until re-enabled.

attributes.name: download_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eSIM profile was successfully downloaded from the SM-DP+ server to the eUICC. Marks the beginning of the profile installation process.

attributes.name: eid
attributes.business_glossary_term: eUICC (Embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card) Identifier (EID)
attributes.description: Unique 32-digit identifier of the embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card (eUICC) chip in the subscriber device. Globally unique hardware identifier assigned by the eUICC manufacturer per GSMA SGP.02 specification.

attributes.name: enabled_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eSIM profile was enabled and activated for network access. The profile is now the active profile on the eUICC and can connect to the mobile network.

attributes.name: euicc_firmware_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: eUICC (Embedded Universal Integrated Circuit Card) Firmware Version
attributes.description: Version of the firmware running on the eUICC chip. Determines compatibility with different profile formats, security features, and RSP specification versions.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the eSIM profile expires and can no longer be used for network access. Used for temporary profiles, trial subscriptions, and prepaid services with fixed validity periods.

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: Unique 14-15 digit identifier stored in the eSIM profile that identifies the subscriber on the mobile network. Used for authentication, authorization, and routing in the HLR/HSS. Format: MCC (3 digits) + MNC (2-3 digits) + MSIN (9-10 digits).

attributes.name: installation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eSIM profile was successfully installed on the eUICC. The profile is now stored on the chip but not yet enabled for network access.

attributes.name: is_mnp_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this eSIM profile is eligible for Mobile Number Portability (MNP). True if the MSISDN can be ported to another operator, false if porting is restricted or not supported.

attributes.name: is_multi_profile_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this eSIM profile is part of a multi-profile eUICC configuration. True if the eUICC can store and switch between multiple profiles, false if it supports only a single profile.

attributes.name: is_roaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether international and domestic roaming is enabled for this eSIM profile. True if the profile can connect to partner networks outside the home network, false if roaming is disabled.

attributes.name: last_location_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the network last received a location update from this eSIM profile. Used for subscriber location tracking, emergency services, and roaming analytics.

attributes.name: last_network_attach_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this eSIM profile last successfully attached to the mobile network. Used for activity monitoring, fraud detection, and service usage analytics.

attributes.name: lpa_version
attributes.description: Version of the Local Profile Assistant (LPA) software on the device. The LPA manages profile download, installation, enabling, disabling, and deletion on the eUICC.

attributes.name: matching_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier used by the SM-DP+ to match the eUICC with the correct profile during download. Part of the activation code and used in the secure profile download handshake.

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Three-digit code identifying the country of the mobile network operator. Part of the IMSI and used for international roaming and network selection.

attributes.name: mnc
attributes.description: Two or three-digit code identifying the mobile network operator within a country. Part of the IMSI and used for network identification and roaming partner selection.

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The telephone number associated with this eSIM profile. Used for voice calls, SMS, and subscriber identification. Format follows E.164 international numbering plan.

attributes.name: operator_name
attributes.description: Name of the mobile network operator (MNO) that issued this eSIM profile. Displayed in device settings and used for subscriber identification.

attributes.name: profile_class
attributes.description: Business classification of the eSIM profile. Consumer profiles for handsets and tablets, M2M (Machine-to-Machine) profiles for connected devices, IoT (Internet of Things) profiles for low-power sensors and embedded systems.

attributes.name: profile_nickname
attributes.description: User-defined friendly name for the eSIM profile displayed in the device settings. Helps subscribers distinguish between multiple profiles on the same eUICC (e.g., 'Personal', 'Work', 'Travel').

attributes.name: profile_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the encrypted eSIM profile package in kilobytes. Used for eUICC storage capacity planning and download bandwidth estimation.

attributes.name: profile_state
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the eSIM profile on the eUICC. Tracks the profile from creation through download, installation, activation, and deletion. Managed by the Local Profile Assistant (LPA) on the device. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|downloading|downloaded|installing|installed|enabled|disabled|deleted — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the eSIM profile purpose. Operational profiles are for live subscriber service, test profiles for QA and device testing, bootstrap profiles for initial device provisioning, and provisioning profiles for remote SIM provisioning workflows.

attributes.name: profile_version
attributes.description: Version number of the eSIM profile format and content. Indicates the profile generation and compatibility with different eUICC firmware versions and RSP specification releases.

attributes.name: provisioned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the eSIM profile was created and encrypted on the SM-DP+ server. Marks the beginning of the profile lifecycle before download.

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier assigned to this eSIM profile. Defines the guaranteed service quality, support response times, and compensation terms for service disruptions.

attributes.name: smdp_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: SM-DP+ (Subscription Manager Data Preparation Plus) Server Address
attributes.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) or IP address of the SM-DP+ server that hosts and delivers this eSIM profile. The SM-DP+ is responsible for profile encryption, secure delivery, and lifecycle management per GSMA RSP architecture.

attributes.name: smds_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: SM-DS (Subscription Manager Discovery Service) Server Address
attributes.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) or IP address of the SM-DS server used for profile discovery. The SM-DS enables the eUICC to discover available profiles from multiple SM-DP+ servers in multi-operator scenarios.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that created or last updated this eSIM profile record. Typically the SM-DP+ platform, OSS/BSS suite, or service provisioning system.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this eSIM profile record was last modified in the system. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and data synchronization.

products.name: svc_status_history
products.description: Append-only audit log of every lifecycle state transition for a service instance — from pending through active, suspended, and terminated states. Captures previous state, new state, transition timestamp, reason code, initiating actor (customer, CSR, automated system), and source system event reference. Immutable record essential for SLA measurement, regulatory compliance (disconnection timelines), churn analysis, and dispute resolution.
products.reference: TM Forum SID ServiceLifecycleState; eTOM Service Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: svc_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each service status transition event. Primary key for the service status history log.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account responsible for charges related to this service instance. Links service lifecycle to billing and revenue management.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise service status transitions must track corporate account for SLA reporting, contract compliance audits, and account-level service health dashboards. Essential for B2B service management.

attributes.name: customer_analytics_kpi_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.customer_analytics_kpi. Business justification: Service status transitions feed customer KPIs like service uptime percentage, suspension rate, churn indicators, and service stability metrics. Critical for customer experience measurement, churn pred

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific actor who or which initiated the status change. May be a customer ID, employee ID, system process name, or regulatory order reference depending on the actor type.

attributes.name: provisioning_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order that triggered this status transition, if applicable. Links service lifecycle events to the order management domain for fulfillment tracking.

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who owns or uses the service instance. Links service lifecycle events to the customer domain for churn and retention analysis.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service instance that underwent the status transition. Links to the service instance master record.

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trouble ticket or incident that caused this status transition, if applicable. Links service disruptions to fault management processes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Trouble Ticket Domain

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time for this status transition to complete, measured in minutes. Compared against SLA targets to determine compliance.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition required managerial or system approval before execution. True for high-risk transitions such as bulk disconnections or regulatory-mandated changes.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow state for this status transition. Captures whether the transition was approved, rejected, is pending approval, or did not require approval.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the status transition was approved. Used to measure approval cycle time and ensure timely execution of approved changes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the person or system that approved this status transition. Used for accountability and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: churn_category
attributes.description: Classification of the churn event by root cause. Distinguishes between voluntary customer-initiated churn, involuntary disconnection for non-payment, competitive loss to another provider, customer relocation, financial hardship, or service quality issues.

attributes.name: churn_indicator_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition represents a customer churn event. True when the transition to terminated status is customer-initiated and represents loss of revenue.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or context related to this status transition. Captures information not structured elsewhere for future reference and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this status history record was first created in the data platform. Immutable audit timestamp for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: dispute_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition is eligible for customer dispute. True for transitions that can be contested through formal dispute resolution processes.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the new status became effective for billing and service delivery purposes. May differ from transition timestamp for scheduled changes.

attributes.name: initiating_actor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label of the actor who initiated the transition. Provides business context for audit trails and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: initiating_actor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity that triggered the status transition. Distinguishes between customer self-service actions, customer service representative interventions, automated system processes, network-driven events, billing system actions, or regulatory mandates.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle state of the service instance after this transition. Captures the to-state in the state machine. This becomes the current status of the service instance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service State Model

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to notify the customer of this status transition. Captures how the customer was informed of the service state change.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether a customer notification was sent regarding this status transition. True if notification was dispatched via email, SMS, or other channel.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer notification was sent. Used to verify compliance with notification timing requirements and customer communication SLAs.

attributes.name: previous_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle state of the service instance immediately before this transition occurred. Captures the from-state in the state machine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service State Model

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition was subject to regulatory compliance requirements such as disconnection notice periods mandated by FCC or state public utility commissions.

attributes.name: regulatory_notice_period_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days advance notice required by regulation before this type of status transition can occur. Applicable to disconnections and suspensions.

attributes.name: rollback_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition represents a rollback or reversal of a previous transition. True when a failed provisioning or erroneous suspension is reversed.

attributes.name: rollback_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference to the original status history record that this transition is rolling back. Links forward and reverse transitions for audit trail completeness.

attributes.name: scheduled_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition was scheduled in advance or occurred immediately. True for pre-planned transitions such as scheduled maintenance or future-dated disconnections.

attributes.name: service_technology
attributes.description: The underlying network technology delivering the service. Examples include LTE, 5G NR, GPON, FTTH, DSL, cable, or satellite. Used for technology-specific lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service instance that underwent this status transition. Examples include mobile voice, mobile data, broadband internet, IPTV, VoIP, FTTH, or enterprise connectivity services.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether this status transition violated contractual SLA commitments. True if the transition timing or duration exceeded agreed service level targets.

attributes.name: sla_target_duration_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Duration Minutes
attributes.description: The contractual maximum time allowed for this type of status transition to complete, measured in minutes. Used to calculate SLA compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that recorded and published the status transition event. Examples include Oracle OSM, Netcracker OSS, Salesforce CRM, or Amdocs billing system.

attributes.name: source_system_event_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the status change event in the originating operational system. Enables traceability back to the source system for detailed investigation and reconciliation.

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the status change. Examples include customer request, non-payment, network fault, service upgrade, regulatory order, or system-initiated action.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Lifecycle Reason Codes

attributes.name: transition_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the status transition. Captures details not conveyed by the reason code alone, such as specific customer requests or technical fault descriptions.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the service status transition occurred. This is the business event timestamp used for SLA measurement, compliance reporting, and churn analysis.

attributes.name: win_back_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the customer associated with this terminated service is eligible for win-back marketing campaigns. Used to trigger retention and reacquisition workflows.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the system process or user that created this status history record. Used for data lineage and troubleshooting data quality issues.

products.name: number_assignment
products.description: Master record managing the assignment of MSISDN (mobile numbers), DID numbers, and VoIP DIDs to active service instances. Tracks number type (geographic, non-geographic, toll-free, short code), assignment date, porting status (MNP donor/recipient), number reservation state, and regulatory number range ownership. Supports MNP port-in and port-out workflows. Critical for regulatory number inventory reporting to FCC/Ofcom/BEREC. Does NOT own the number pool inventory (inventory domain) — owns only the active assignment binding between a number and a service instance.
products.reference: GSMA MNP; ITU-T E.164 Numbering; FCC Number Portability

attributes.name: number_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the number assignment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: MSISDN assignments drive billing account setup for number portability, vanity number fees, and regulatory compliance. Telecom billing requires account linkage for porting charges, number reservation f

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise DID number block assignments must link to corporate account for inventory management, billing, and number resource allocation tracking in B2B voice services and UC deployments.

attributes.name: esim_profile_id
attributes.description: The eSIM profile identifier associated with this number assignment. Applicable for eSIM-enabled service instances.

attributes.name: lawful_intercept_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.lawful_intercept_order. Business justification: Intercept orders specify target MSISDNs; number assignments track which service instance currently owns each MSISDN. LEA fulfillment workflows require this link to identify the correct service instanc

attributes.name: mnp_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.mnp_transaction. Business justification: MSISDN assignments link to MNP transactions when number portability occurs. Essential for porting workflow tracking, regulatory compliance reporting, and HLR/NPAC routing updates.

attributes.name: msisdn_range_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulatory number range from which this number was allocated. Links to the inventory domain number range master.

attributes.name: mvno_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.mvno_profile. Business justification: MSISDN assignments within MVNO number ranges must track MVNO owner for number inventory management, regulatory ownership reporting, porting coordination, and wholesale billing. Core MVNO operational r

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who owns this number assignment. Enables customer-level number inventory reporting.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active service instance to which this number is assigned. Links the number to the provisioned service.

attributes.name: activation_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the number was activated for service use. Distinct from assignment date; activation may occur after assignment.

attributes.name: area_code
attributes.description: The geographic area code or national destination code portion of the number. Applicable to geographic numbers.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The date when the number was assigned to the service instance. Marks the start of the assignment lifecycle.

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for this number assignment. Distinguishes between new activations, replacements, and porting scenarios.

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the number assignment. Active indicates the number is in service; reserved indicates temporary hold; quarantined indicates cooling-off period post-release; ported_out indicates number transferred to another carrier.

attributes.name: cnam_display_name
attributes.description: The caller ID display name associated with this number. Used for outbound call identification.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the geographic jurisdiction of the number. Critical for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this number assignment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: do_not_call_registry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber has registered this number on the national Do Not Call registry. Restricts telemarketing calls.

attributes.name: donor_carrier_code
attributes.description: The carrier code of the previous service provider from which the number was ported in. Nullable if the number was not ported.

attributes.name: emergency_services_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the number is enabled for emergency services (E911, E112). Critical for regulatory compliance and public safety.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this number assignment in the source system. Enables cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: hlr_location
attributes.description: The HLR or HSS node where the subscriber profile for this number is stored. Critical for routing and service provisioning.

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The IMSI associated with the service instance to which this number is assigned. Links the number to the subscriber identity in the HLR/HSS.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this number assignment record was last updated. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: lidb_listing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the number is listed in the LIDB for billing and validation purposes. Applicable primarily to North American carriers.

attributes.name: managed_in_system
attributes.description: The source system of record where this number assignment is managed. Typically Oracle OSM or Netcracker OSS.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user or system process that last modified this number assignment record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The assigned telephone number in E.164 international format. This is the primary business identifier for mobile number assignments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context about the number assignment, such as special handling instructions or customer requests.

attributes.name: number_category
attributes.description: Service category for which the number is assigned. Distinguishes between human-facing and machine-to-machine usage.

attributes.name: number_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assigned number based on regulatory and technical categorization. Determines routing, billing, and regulatory treatment.

attributes.name: number_usage_type
attributes.description: Indicates the primary service type for which the number is used. Some numbers may be voice-only, SMS-only, or support all services.

attributes.name: port_completion_date
attributes.description: The date when the MNP port transaction was completed and the number was successfully transferred.

attributes.name: port_request_date
attributes.description: The date when the MNP port request was initiated. Applicable to both port-in and port-out scenarios.

attributes.name: porting_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier is the donor (port_out) or recipient (port_in) in an MNP transaction. None indicates the number originated with this carrier.

attributes.name: porting_status
attributes.description: Current state of the number in the MNP porting workflow. Tracks whether the number was ported in from another carrier or is being ported out.

attributes.name: previous_msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Previous Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The previous number assigned to this service instance, if this is a replacement assignment. Supports number change history tracking.

attributes.name: quarantine_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the number exits the regulatory quarantine period and becomes available for reassignment. Applicable after release to prevent customer confusion.

attributes.name: recipient_carrier_code
attributes.description: The carrier code of the new service provider to which the number is being ported out. Nullable if the number is not being ported out.

attributes.name: regulatory_ownership
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier owns the number range outright, leases it from the regulator, or sub-allocates it from another carrier.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this number assignment must be included in regulatory number inventory reports to FCC, Ofcom, or BEREC.
attributes.references: FCC Part 52, Ofcom Numbering Plan, BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date when the number was released from the service instance and returned to inventory. Nullable for active assignments.

attributes.name: reservation_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when a reserved number assignment expires if not activated. Applicable only to reserved status assignments.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The network routing number used for call and SMS routing. May differ from the MSISDN in ported number scenarios.

attributes.name: vanity_number_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the number is a vanity or premium number with special alphanumeric patterns or easy-to-remember sequences. May carry premium pricing.

products.name: svc_suspension
products.description: Transactional record for each service suspension event — voluntary (customer-initiated travel hold) or involuntary (non-payment, fraud, regulatory). Captures suspension type, initiating reason code, suspension start date, expected reinstatement date, actual reinstatement date, and the billing impact flag (whether charges continue during suspension). Supports collections workflow integration with Amdocs Revenue Management and regulatory compliance for involuntary disconnection rules.
products.reference: TM Forum SID ServiceSuspension; eTOM Customer SLA Management

attributes.name: svc_suspension_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service suspension event. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account associated with the suspended service. Used for billing impact tracking in Amdocs Revenue Management.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service case in Salesforce CRM associated with this suspension. Used for tracking customer interactions, disputes, and resolution workflows. Null if no case was created.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise service suspensions must track corporate account for contract impact analysis, billing adjustments, account-level suspension policies, and escalation to account management teams in B2B scen

attributes.name: dunning_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dunning event in Amdocs Revenue Management that triggered this suspension for non-payment scenarios. Links to the collections workflow. Null for non-payment-related suspensions.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or system ID of the person or system that initiated the suspension. For agent-initiated suspensions, this is the Salesforce CRM user ID. For system-initiated, this is the system process identifier. Null for customer-initiated suspensions.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service order in Oracle OSM that executed the suspension or reinstatement. Links to the order management and fulfillment workflow. Null if no formal order was created.

attributes.name: originating_dealer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.dealer. Business justification: Suspensions of dealer-originated services require tracking originating dealer for fraud pattern analysis, commission clawback processing, and dealer compliance monitoring. Essential for indirect chann

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber whose service was suspended. Links to the customer subscriber record in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service instance that was suspended. Links to the active service instance in the service inventory managed by Oracle OSM and Netcracker OSS.

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.trouble_ticket. Business justification: Service suspensions may trigger customer disputes requiring trouble ticket investigation. Supports tracking wrongful suspension cases and regulatory compliance for service restoration timelines.

attributes.name: actual_reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the service was reinstated and became active again. Null if the service has not yet been reinstated. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: actual_reinstatement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the service was reinstated in the network. Captured from Oracle OSM service fulfillment system. Null if not yet reinstated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: auto_reinstatement_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service will be automatically reinstated when conditions are met. True: automatic reinstatement configured (e.g., upon payment receipt). False: manual reinstatement required. Common for payment-related suspensions integrated with Amdocs Revenue Management.

attributes.name: billing_adjustment_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a billing adjustment or credit was applied to the account due to the suspension. True if adjustments were made, False otherwise. Used for revenue assurance and customer account reconciliation.

attributes.name: billing_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether recurring charges continue during the suspension period. True: charges continue (customer still billed). False: charges are suspended (no billing during suspension). Critical for Amdocs Revenue Management billing cycle processing and customer billing inquiries.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the suspension record was first created in the system. Represents when the suspension request was initiated, not when it became effective. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: customer_acknowledgement_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer acknowledged receipt of the suspension notice. True: customer confirmed receipt. False: no acknowledgement received. Used for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: emergency_services_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency services (e.g., 911, E911) remain accessible during the suspension. True: emergency calls are allowed. False: all services including emergency are blocked. Regulatory compliance requirement per FCC and E911 regulations.

attributes.name: expected_reinstatement_date
attributes.description: The planned or expected date when the service will be reinstated. For voluntary suspensions, this is the customer-requested end date. For involuntary suspensions, this may be calculated based on payment terms or regulatory requirements. Nullable for indefinite suspensions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Indicates who or what initiated the suspension. Customer: customer-requested. System: automated system action (e.g., dunning workflow). Agent: customer service representative. Regulatory: regulatory authority order. Fraud_detection: automated fraud detection system.

attributes.name: initiated_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the suspension was initiated. Web: online self-service portal. Mobile_app: mobile application. Call_center: customer service call. Retail_store: in-store request. Automated_system: system-generated. Partner_portal: partner or MVNO portal.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the suspension record was last updated. Tracks changes to status, dates, or other attributes throughout the suspension lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the suspension record. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Links to Salesforce CRM user records or system process identifiers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: network_suspension_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension was successfully applied at the network level. True: service is blocked in the network (RAN, Core, IMS). False: suspension is pending network execution or failed. Critical for operational validation.

attributes.name: network_suspension_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the suspension was successfully applied in the network infrastructure (HSS, HLR, UDM, PCF). Captured from Ericsson Network Manager or Nokia NetAct. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the suspension event. Used by customer service representatives to document special circumstances, customer requests, or operational issues. Captured in Salesforce CRM case notes.

attributes.name: notice_method
attributes.description: Method used to notify the customer of the pending suspension. Multiple: more than one method was used. Required for regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of advance notice provided to the customer before involuntary suspension. Required by regulatory authorities (typically 15-30 days). Null for voluntary or immediate suspensions.

attributes.name: notice_sent_date
attributes.description: Date when the suspension notice was sent to the customer. Required for involuntary suspensions to demonstrate regulatory compliance. Null for voluntary suspensions. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: prorated_charge_amount
attributes.description: The prorated charge amount applied for partial billing periods affected by the suspension. Calculated by Amdocs Revenue Management based on suspension dates and rate plan. Null if no proration applies.

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the suspension complies with regulatory requirements for involuntary disconnection. True: all regulatory notice periods and procedures were followed. False: suspension may be non-compliant. Critical for FCC, state PUC, and international regulatory audits.

attributes.name: reinstatement_condition
attributes.description: Description of the conditions that must be met for service reinstatement. Examples: payment of outstanding balance, resolution of fraud investigation, completion of regulatory hold period, customer request. Used by collections and customer service teams.

attributes.name: reinstatement_condition_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinstatement conditions have been satisfied. True: conditions met, service can be reinstated. False: conditions not yet met. Null if not applicable or not yet evaluated.

attributes.name: reinstatement_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time fee charged to the customer for reinstating the suspended service. Common for involuntary suspensions due to non-payment. Null if no fee is charged. Amount in the billing account currency.

attributes.name: service_barring_profile
attributes.description: The network barring profile applied during suspension. Defines which services are blocked (e.g., outgoing calls only, all services, data only). Managed in Netcracker OSS service catalog and applied via IMS/PCF policy control.

attributes.name: suspension_duration_days
attributes.description: Calculated number of days the service was or is expected to be suspended. For active suspensions, this is calculated from start date to current date. For completed suspensions, this is the actual duration from start to reinstatement.

attributes.name: suspension_fee_amount
attributes.description: One-time fee charged to the customer for processing the suspension request. Typically applies to voluntary suspensions. Null if no fee is charged. Amount in the billing account currency.

attributes.name: suspension_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason for suspension. Examples: NONPAY (non-payment), FRAUD (fraud detection), TRAVEL (customer travel hold), DISPUTE (billing dispute), REGULATORY (regulatory order), TECHNICAL (network issue). Aligns with Amdocs Revenue Management dunning codes and ServiceNow incident categories.

attributes.name: suspension_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of why the service was suspended. Provides context beyond the reason code for customer service representatives and audit purposes.

attributes.name: suspension_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique reference number for the suspension event. Format: SUS-XXXXXXXXXX. Used for customer communication and case tracking.

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the service suspension became effective. This is the actual date the service was suspended, not the request date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: suspension_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the service suspension was activated in the network. Captured from Oracle OSM service fulfillment system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: suspension_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the suspension event. Pending: suspension scheduled but not yet active. Active: service currently suspended. Reinstated: service has been restored. Expired: suspension period ended without reinstatement. Cancelled: suspension request was cancelled before activation.

attributes.name: suspension_type
attributes.description: Classification of the suspension event. Voluntary: customer-initiated (e.g., travel hold, seasonal suspension). Involuntary: provider-initiated due to non-payment, policy violation, or fraud. Administrative: internal operational suspension. Regulatory: mandated by regulatory authority. Technical: network or service quality issue. Fraud: suspected fraudulent activity.

products.name: service_mnp_request
products.description: Transactional record managing Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in and port-out requests. Captures porting direction (in/out), donor/recipient operator, MSISDN being ported, requested port date, actual completion date, porting status (submitted, validated, completed, rejected, cancelled), rejection reason code, and regulatory reference number. Interfaces with national MNP clearinghouse. Governed by FCC/Ofcom MNP regulations.
products.reference: GSMA MNP Guidelines; FCC Number Portability Rules; Ofcom MNP Code

attributes.name: service_mnp_request_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Request ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the mobile number portability request transaction. Primary key for the service MNP request entity.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: MNP requests require billing account validation for outstanding balance checks, early termination fee calculation, and final bill generation. Regulatory requirement for port-out authorization and fina

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise MNP requests for bulk number porting must link to corporate account for contract validation, approval workflows, and coordinated porting schedules. Essential for enterprise customer migrati

attributes.name: donor_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: MNP requests require linking donor operator to partner entity for interconnect settlement, dispute resolution with donor, and regulatory clearinghouse reporting. Replaces denormalized donor_operator_n

attributes.name: interconnect_mnp_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.mnp_transaction. Business justification: Service-side MNP request directly maps to interconnect-side transaction for bilateral porting coordination between donor and recipient carriers. Critical for inter-carrier porting workflow and clearin

attributes.name: primary_service_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that submitted the MNP request (customer service representative, online portal, API).

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber who initiated or is subject to the mobile number portability request.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service instance being ported (the mobile service associated with the MSISDN).

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The subscriber account number with the donor operator, used for validation and authorization of the port request.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order - Customer Authorization Requirements

attributes.name: actual_port_completion_datetime
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Port Completion Date and Time
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the mobile number portability was successfully completed and the number became active on the recipient network.

attributes.name: actual_processing_hours
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time in hours from request submission to completion, used for SLA compliance measurement.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Security code or PIN provided by the subscriber to authorize the porting request and prevent unauthorized number transfers.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order - Customer Authorization Requirements

attributes.name: balance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the outstanding balance amount.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the MNP request was cancelled, including whether it was subscriber-initiated or operator-initiated cancellation.

attributes.name: clearinghouse_transaction_code
attributes.description: Transaction identifier assigned by the national MNP clearinghouse system for inter-operator coordination and reconciliation.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subscriber contract with the donor operator is scheduled to end, relevant for early termination fees.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MNP request record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: donor_operator_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the telecommunications operator from which the mobile number is being ported (the losing operator).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.77 - MNP Best Practices

attributes.name: donor_response_code
attributes.description: Standardized response code provided by the donor operator in response to the port request.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.77 - MNP Best Practices

attributes.name: early_termination_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the early termination fee charged by the donor operator, if applicable.

attributes.name: early_termination_fee_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether an early termination fee applies to this porting request due to contract obligations with the donor operator.

attributes.name: iccid
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the SIM card associated with the mobile number being ported.

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: Unique international identifier for the mobile subscriber, stored on the SIM card and used for network authentication.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this MNP request record was last updated or modified.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: mnp_request_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the MNP request, used for tracking and reference with national MNP clearinghouse and operators.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations, Ofcom General Condition C1

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The mobile phone number being ported. This is the primary identifier for the mobile subscriber in the public switched telephone network.

attributes.name: network_technology
attributes.description: The mobile network technology generation associated with the service being ported.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_amount
attributes.description: Any outstanding financial balance on the subscriber account with the donor operator at the time of the port request.

attributes.name: porting_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a port-in request (number coming into this operator) or port-out request (number leaving this operator).

attributes.name: porting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mobile number portability request in the porting workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|validated|in_progress|completed|rejected|cancelled|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Domain, FCC MNP Order

attributes.name: processing_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the MNP request for processing queue management and SLA adherence.

attributes.name: recipient_acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the recipient operator acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the port request.

attributes.name: recipient_operator_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the telecommunications operator to which the mobile number is being ported (the gaining operator).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.77 - MNP Best Practices

attributes.name: recipient_operator_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the recipient telecommunications operator.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.77 - MNP Best Practices

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the national MNP clearinghouse or regulatory authority for tracking and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations, Ofcom General Condition C1

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for rejection of the MNP request, if applicable. Null if request was not rejected.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.77 - MNP Best Practices, National MNP Clearinghouse Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of why the MNP request was rejected, providing context beyond the rejection code.

attributes.name: request_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MNP request based on processing priority and timeline requirements.

attributes.name: requested_port_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subscriber has requested the mobile number portability to be completed.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order, Ofcom General Condition C1

attributes.name: scheduled_port_datetime
attributes.description: The precise date and time scheduled for the porting cutover event, coordinated between donor and recipient operators.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.77 - MNP Best Practices

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the mobile service being ported based on billing model (prepaid, postpaid, or hybrid).

attributes.name: sim_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service uses a physical SIM card or an embedded SIM (eSIM) profile.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MNP request processing exceeded the SLA target completion time.

attributes.name: sla_target_completion_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Hours
attributes.description: The number of hours within which the MNP request must be completed according to regulatory or contractual SLA requirements.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order, Ofcom General Condition C1

attributes.name: submission_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the MNP request was submitted by the subscriber or on their behalf.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the MNP request was initially submitted to the system or clearinghouse.

attributes.name: subscriber_address
attributes.description: Registered address of the subscriber with the donor operator, used for validation purposes during the porting process.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Status of the validation checks performed on the MNP request data against donor operator records.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.77 - MNP Best Practices

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the MNP request validation was completed by the donor operator or clearinghouse.

products.name: ftth_ont_config
products.description: Master record for FTTH/GPON Optical Network Terminal (ONT) configuration assigned to a fiber service instance. Stores OLT node reference, PON port, ONT serial number, GPON T-CONT and GEM port assignments, upstream/downstream bandwidth profiles, VLAN configuration, ONT firmware version, and provisioning state. Represents the logical-to-physical binding between the FTTH service instance and the passive optical network infrastructure. Sourced from Netcracker OSS and OLT EMS.
products.reference: ITU-T G.984 GPON; ITU-T G.987 XG-PON; TR-156 GPON Provisioning

attributes.name: ftth_ont_config_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fiber to the Home (FTTH) Optical Network Terminal (ONT) Configuration ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FTTH ONT configuration record. Primary key for this master resource entity representing the logical-to-physical binding between FTTH service instance and passive optical network infrastructure.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: FTTH installations trigger billing account setup for installation charges, CPE rental fees, and bandwidth tier billing. Required for fiber service activation billing, technician dispatch charges, and

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capital_project. Business justification: FTTH ONT installations are part of fiber network build-out capex projects; linking enables project cost tracking, milestone-based budget consumption analysis, homes-passed ROI calculation, and regulat

attributes.name: enterprise_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.site. Business justification: FTTH ONT installations at enterprise customer sites must link to site for asset tracking, service delivery verification, and site-level fiber infrastructure management in B2B fiber deployments.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: ONT devices are capitalized customer premises equipment tracked in fixed asset register for depreciation calculation, asset lifecycle management, insurance valuation, and regulatory asset base reporti

attributes.name: installed_by_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the field technician who performed the ONT installation. Used for quality tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: network_qos_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the QoS profile defining traffic prioritization, latency targets, and packet handling rules for this ONT configuration.

attributes.name: olt_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the OLT node in the central office or remote cabinet that serves this ONT. Represents the aggregation point in the GPON architecture.

attributes.name: olt_network_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.element. Business justification: FTTH ONT configurations must reference the OLT network element for fiber service provisioning, PON port management, and fault isolation. Critical for fiber network operations, capacity planning, and s

attributes.name: ont_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.ont_asset. Business justification: FTTH service provisioning requires linking logical ONT configuration to physical ONT inventory asset for optical power monitoring, firmware management, warranty tracking, and field replacement workflo

attributes.name: ont_device_model_id
