domains.name: order
domains.description: SSOT for end-to-end order management and fulfillment — new activations, upgrades, downgrades, disconnections, MNP port-in/port-out, and change-of-service requests. Orchestrates order decomposition, workflow coordination, and fulfillment across OSS/BSS systems via Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
domains.references: TM Forum SID Customer Order, TM Forum TMF622 Product Ordering API, eTOM Order Handling

products.name: fulfillment_order
products.description: Core master record for every end-to-end order in the telecommunications lifecycle — new activations, upgrades, downgrades, disconnections, MNP port-in/port-out, and change-of-service requests. Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM). Captures order type, order channel, priority, customer reference, account reference, submitted timestamp, promised completion date, current order state, fallout reason, orchestration workflow instance ID, workflow template, decomposition strategy, SLA type (regulatory, commercial, enterprise), SLA target completion hours, warning threshold hours, breach threshold hours, SLA measurement start/end events, current SLA status (ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, BREACHED), and breach timestamp. This is the SSOT for order identity, lifecycle state, orchestration context, and SLA commitment within the order domain. All SLA monitoring, jeopardy detection, and regulatory compliance measurement derives from this master record's SLA attributes.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Order (eTOM 1.4.x) / OSM Order

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id

attributes.name: created_timestamp

Populated by Oracle Communications OSM when order_status transitions to FAILED or ON_HOLD. Critical for fallout management, root cause analysis, and process improvement.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications OSM Fallout Management

attributes.name: field_work_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fulfillment order requires a field technician dispatch for physical installation or maintenance (e.g., FTTH CPE installation, ONT provisioning). Drives integration with Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management for scheduling and dispatch.

attributes.name: is_regulatory_order

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this fulfillment order record was last updated in the order management system. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: mnp_donor_operator_code

attributes.description: For MNP_PORT_IN orders: the network operator code of the donor (losing) operator from whom the mobile number is being ported. Mandatory for MNP regulatory compliance reporting to FCC/Ofcom. Null for non-MNP order types.

attributes.name: mnp_recipient_operator_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Recipient Operator Code
attributes.description: For MNP_PORT_OUT orders: the network operator code of the recipient (gaining) operator to whom the mobile number is being ported. Used for inter-operator coordination and MNP regulatory reporting. Null for non-MNP order types.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA MNP Guidelines; BEREC MNP Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special instructions associated with the fulfillment order, entered by agents, customers, or automated systems. May include customer preferences, access instructions for field technicians, or escalation context. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: order_channel
attributes.description: The sales or service channel through which the fulfillment order was submitted. Used for channel performance analytics, cost-to-serve analysis, and omnichannel reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ONLINE|RETAIL_STORE|CALL_CENTER|DEALER|SELF_SERVICE|B2B_PORTAL|FIELD_SALES — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Channel Management; Salesforce CRM Lead Management

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the fulfillment order. Communicated to customers, field technicians, and partner systems. Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) as the canonical order reference number.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: order_priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the fulfillment order, influencing queue position in orchestration workflows and resource allocation. CRITICAL is reserved for regulatory-mandated orders (e.g., emergency services, MNP regulatory deadlines).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; FCC Emergency Communications Regulations

attributes.name: order_source_system
attributes.description: The originating system or application from which the fulfillment order was submitted. Used for channel attribution, integration troubleshooting, and data lineage tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSM|SALESFORCE_CRM|SELF_SERVICE_PORTAL|B2B_PORTAL|DEALER_PORTAL|IVR|RETAIL_POS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; Oracle Communications OSM; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fulfillment order within the OSS/BSS orchestration workflow. Drives jeopardy management, SLA monitoring, and customer communication triggers. Sourced from Oracle Communications OSM order state machine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM Order Lifecycle

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment order by the nature of the service change being requested. Drives orchestration workflow selection, SLA type assignment, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NEW_ACTIVATION|UPGRADE|DOWNGRADE|DISCONNECTION|MNP_PORT_IN|MNP_PORT_OUT|CHANGE_OF_SERVICE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; 3GPP TS 22.011 MNP; Oracle Communications OSM Order Types

attributes.name: porting_authorization_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Porting Authorization Code (PAC)
attributes.description: The Porting Authorization Code provided by the donor operator to authorize the number port. Required for MNP_PORT_IN orders to validate the customer's right to port. Null for non-MNP order types.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom MNP Code of Practice; GSMA MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_number
attributes.description: The MSISDN (mobile phone number) being ported in MNP_PORT_IN or MNP_PORT_OUT orders. Classified as confidential PII as it directly identifies a subscriber. Null for non-MNP order types. Required for NRTRDE and TAP regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Regulations 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA NRTRDE; GDPR Article 4; GSMA MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: promised_completion_date
attributes.description: The date committed to the customer for order fulfillment completion. Used for SLA breach detection, customer communication, and regulatory compliance reporting. Distinct from SLA target hours — this is the customer-facing commitment date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Service Provisioning Rules; BEREC Quality of Service Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_code
attributes.description: The specific regulatory rule, mandate, or case reference code applicable to this fulfillment order when is_regulatory_order is True. Examples: FCC MNP case number, Ofcom compliance reference. Used for regulatory audit trails and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines; BEREC Regulatory Framework

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of telecommunications service being provisioned or modified by this fulfillment order. Drives workflow template selection, resource inventory allocation, and regulatory reporting categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOBILE|BROADBAND|FIBER|IPTV|VOIP|FIXED_LINE|IOT|ENTERPRISE_WAN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Service Catalog; ITU-T Service Classification; Netcracker OSS/BSS Service Catalog

attributes.name: sla_breach_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of hours elapsed from SLA measurement start at which the SLA is formally classified as BREACHED. Typically equals sla_target_hours but may differ for grace-period configurations. Triggers regulatory reporting obligations and penalty calculations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_breach_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fulfillment order SLA was formally breached. Null for orders that have not breached. Used for regulatory reporting, penalty calculation, and SLA performance analytics. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_measurement_end_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement End Event
attributes.description: The business event that stops the SLA measurement clock for this fulfillment order. Defines what constitutes successful completion for SLA purposes — e.g., SERVICE_ACTIVATED for mobile activations, CPE_INSTALLED for FTTH orders.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Service Provisioning Rules; BEREC Quality of Service Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_measurement_start_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Event
attributes.description: The business event that triggers the start of SLA measurement clock for this fulfillment order. Varies by order type and SLA type — regulatory MNP orders typically start at ORDER_ACCEPTED, while commercial orders may start at PAYMENT_CONFIRMED.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC MNP Porting Rules; GSMA MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_measurement_start_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the SLA measurement clock started for this fulfillment order, corresponding to the sla_measurement_start_event. Used as the reference point for all SLA elapsed-time calculations and regulatory compliance measurement. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC MNP Porting Rules

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current SLA compliance status of the fulfillment order based on elapsed time versus SLA thresholds. ON_TRACK: within warning threshold. AT_RISK: between warning and breach thresholds. BREACHED: exceeded breach threshold. Primary field for jeopardy detection and regulatory compliance dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; TM Forum eTOM Jeopardy Management; FCC Telecommunications Regulations

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which the fulfillment order must be completed to meet the SLA commitment. Measured from the SLA measurement start event. Used for jeopardy detection and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Service Provisioning Rules; BEREC Quality of Service Guidelines

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA commitment governing this fulfillment order. REGULATORY: mandated by FCC/Ofcom/BEREC regulations (e.g., MNP porting windows). COMMERCIAL: standard commercial SLA per product tier. ENTERPRISE: premium SLA for enterprise/B2B customers.
attributes.references: FCC Telecommunications Regulations; Ofcom Service Quality Guidelines; BEREC Quality of Service; TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management

attributes.name: sla_warning_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Warning Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of hours elapsed from SLA measurement start at which an AT_RISK warning is triggered for proactive jeopardy management. Must be less than sla_target_hours. Drives automated alerting in NOC and order management dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; TM Forum eTOM Jeopardy Management

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fulfillment order was submitted by the customer or agent into the order management system. This is the principal business event timestamp and the anchor point for SLA measurement start calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: workflow_template_name
attributes.description: The name of the OSM workflow template (order specification) used to orchestrate this fulfillment order. Determines the decomposition strategy, task sequence, and system interactions. Examples: 'MOBILE_NEW_ACTIVATION_V3', 'FTTH_PROVISIONING_V2'.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

products.name: line
products.description: Individual line item within a fulfillment order representing a single product or service action (add, remove, modify, suspend, resume). Each line carries the commercial product reference, requested action code, quantity, requested service start date, line-level status, and decomposition state. Supports multi-line orders where a customer simultaneously activates a mobile plan, adds a broadband service, and ports a number in a single order transaction.
products.reference: TM Forum SID OrderItem / OSM Order Line

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order line item within the fulfillment order management system. Primary key for the order_line entity. Role: TRANSACTION_LINE.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: addon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.addon. Business justification: Addon products ordered as separate lines need direct catalog linkage for provisioning orchestration, billing setup, and quota management. Critical for value-added services fulfillment.

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.bundle. Business justification: Bundle orders require direct catalog reference for component validation, bundle pricing enforcement, discount calculation, and eligibility verification. Critical for multi-product offer fulfillment.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Line-level revenue must be attributed to legal entity for proper revenue recognition and GL posting. Required for multi-entity telcos with separate legal entities per market or service type.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Line-level corporate account tracking enables product-level revenue attribution per enterprise customer, supports multi-site service deployments, and facilitates usage analysis for account management

attributes.name: customer_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical service delivery address for fixed-line, broadband, or FTTH order lines. Used for field dispatch scheduling in Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management and network infrastructure provisioning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Resource Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: device_offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.device_offering. Business justification: Device orders must reference the specific device offering for subsidy calculation, inventory allocation, installment plan setup, and trade-in eligibility. Essential for device sales operations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or agent who captured this order line. Used for commission calculation, performance reporting, and accountability tracking in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Sales; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: enterprise_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.enterprise_contract. Business justification: Line-level contract linkage enables contract utilization tracking, commitment burn-down analysis, volume discount tier validation, and supports complex enterprise pricing schedules with product-specif

attributes.name: enterprise_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.site. Business justification: Line items provision services at specific enterprise sites (circuits, managed services, UC seats). Required for site-level service inventory management, capacity planning, and multi-site enterprise de

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent fulfillment order header. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category. Links this line item to its containing order transaction in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: inventory_cpe_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cpe_asset. Business justification: Order lines provision CPE devices (modems, routers, ONTs) to customers. Real business need: installation tracking, warranty claims, device lifecycle management, asset return processing. Telecommunicat

attributes.name: price_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_plan. Business justification: Order lines must reference the specific price plan being ordered for accurate rating, billing, and revenue recognition. Critical for order-to-cash process and finance reconciliation in telecom operati

attributes.name: ran_cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.ran_cell. Business justification: Mobile service order lines must specify serving RAN cell for coverage validation and capacity planning. Essential for mobile activations, cell load balancing, and ensuring service address is within ce

attributes.name: rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing rate plan in Amdocs Revenue Management that governs the recurring and usage-based charges for the product on this order line. Established at order capture and used to configure the billing account upon fulfillment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: sim_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sim_stock. Business justification: Order lines activate specific SIM cards for mobile service. Real business need: SIM allocation tracking, activation audit trail, MNP porting coordination, inventory consumption. Existing iccid/imsi ar

attributes.name: spec_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commercial product or service offering in the product catalog that this order line is acting upon (e.g., a specific mobile plan, broadband tier, or add-on). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category. Sourced from Netcracker OSS/BSS Product Catalog.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer subscription record that this order line creates, modifies, or terminates. Links the order line to the recurring billing subscription in Amdocs Revenue Management for revenue lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Customer Management; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provisioned service instance created or modified as a result of fulfilling this order line. Populated post-fulfillment by Oracle Communications Order and Service Management upon successful service activation. Links the commercial order line to the operational service layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Service Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to a ServiceNow ITSM trouble ticket raised against this order line due to a fulfillment failure, fallout, or customer complaint. Used for fault management correlation and order-to-ticket traceability.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Trouble Management; ServiceNow ITSM; eTOM 1.6.1

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field work order created in Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management for order lines requiring a field technician visit. Populated when requires_field_visit is TRUE and the work order has been dispatched.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Workforce Management; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: action_code
attributes.description: The fulfillment action to be performed for this line item. Drives order decomposition and workflow routing in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. ADD = new activation; REMOVE = disconnection; MODIFY = change of service; SUSPEND = temporary suspension; RESUME = reactivation; PORT_IN = Mobile Number Portability (MNP) inbound; PORT_OUT = MNP outbound. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ADD|REMOVE|MODIFY|SUSPEND|RESUME|PORT_IN|PORT_OUT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; 3GPP TS 22.042 MNP; GSMA PRD IR.67

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which fulfillment of this order line was completed and the service was activated, modified, or disconnected. Compared against committed_delivery_date for SLA performance measurement and MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: The sales or service channel through which this order line was initiated (e.g., ONLINE web portal, RETAIL_STORE, CALL_CENTER, DEALER partner, SELF_SERVICE app, B2B_PORTAL). Used for channel performance analytics, commission calculation, and order routing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Sales; eTOM 2.3.1

attributes.name: committed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date committed to the customer for delivery or activation of the service on this line, as agreed at order capture. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance monitoring and breach detection in service fulfillment reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: The minimum contract commitment period in months associated with the product on this order line (e.g., 0 for month-to-month, 12, 24, 36). Drives early termination fee (ETF) calculation and churn risk assessment in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Agreement Management; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cpe_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) device — such as a router, ONT (Optical Network Terminal), or set-top box — assigned or dispatched as part of this order line. Used for inventory tracking in Netcracker OSS/BSS and field installation management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this order line record was first created in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. Used for order aging analysis, SLA measurement baseline, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the monetary values on this order line (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency enterprise and wholesale order scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: decomposition_state
attributes.description: Indicates the order decomposition processing state for this line within Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. Order decomposition translates a commercial product order line into technical service and resource fulfillment tasks across OSS systems. Critical for orchestration monitoring and fault management.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; TM Forum SID GB922 Order Decomposition; eTOM 1.4.3.1

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary discount applied to this order line at the time of order capture, reflecting promotional offers, loyalty discounts, or negotiated enterprise pricing. Used by Amdocs Revenue Management for billing and revenue assurance reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: early_termination_fee
attributes.description: The early termination fee amount applicable if the customer cancels this order line before the end of the contract_term_months. Calculated at order capture based on the rate plan and contract term. Used by Amdocs Revenue Management for billing upon disconnection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: fallout_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the order line fallout or failure, supplementing the fallout_reason_code. Captured by Oracle Communications Order and Service Management workflow engine for manual intervention and customer communication.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3.4

attributes.name: fallout_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for order line fallout or failure during fulfillment orchestration (e.g., 'CREDIT_FAIL', 'INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE', 'ADDRESS_NOT_SERVICEABLE', 'PORTING_REJECTED'). Used for fallout management, root cause analysis, and process improvement in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3.4

attributes.name: iccid
attributes.description: The unique SIM card identifier (ICCID) assigned to this order line for mobile service activations. Used for SIM provisioning in HLR/HSS/UDM systems and inventory management in Netcracker OSS/BSS. Classified as confidential as it identifies a specific subscriber SIM.

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity assigned to the SIM for this order line. Used for subscriber provisioning in HSS (Home Subscriber Server) and UDM (Unified Data Management) systems. Restricted PII as it uniquely identifies a mobile subscriber globally.

attributes.name: is_esim
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line involves an eSIM (Embedded SIM) provisioning rather than a physical SIM card. When TRUE, triggers eSIM profile download orchestration via GSMA SGP.22 RSP (Remote SIM Provisioning) instead of physical SIM dispatch.
attributes.references: GSMA SGP.22 RSP Architecture; ETSI TS 103 383; 3GPP TS 22.022

attributes.name: is_mnp_line
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Line Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line involves a Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in or port-out transaction. When TRUE, triggers MNP-specific workflow orchestration including donor operator notification and number portability clearinghouse coordination.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 MNP; 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this order line record was last updated in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trail, and concurrency control.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent order. Used for ordering, display, and referencing individual lines in multi-line orders (e.g., line 1 = mobile plan, line 2 = broadband, line 3 = MNP port-in). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle state of this individual order line. Tracks granular progress independently from the parent order header status, enabling partial fulfillment scenarios where some lines complete while others are held. Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management workflow engine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework 1.4.3

attributes.name: mnp_donor_operator
attributes.description: For PORT_IN action lines, the name or code of the donor (losing) network operator from whom the mobile number is being ported. Required for MNP (Mobile Number Portability) process orchestration, GSMA NRTRDE compliance, and inter-operator coordination.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 MNP; 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: mnp_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the number portability clearinghouse or regulatory body for a PORT_IN or PORT_OUT order line. Used for inter-operator tracking, regulatory compliance reporting to FCC/Ofcom/BEREC, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 MNP; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The mobile phone number (MSISDN) associated with this order line for mobile service activations, modifications, or MNP port transactions. Follows E.164 international numbering format. Classified as confidential PII as it directly identifies a subscriber.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.003; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Net commercial price for this order line after applying discounts (unit_price × quantity − discount_amount). Represents the agreed charge basis passed to Amdocs Revenue Management for billing. Distinct from tax-inclusive total.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Processing priority assigned to this order line for fulfillment queue management. HIGH and CRITICAL priorities are used for enterprise SLA orders, regulatory-mandated activations, and emergency service restorations. Drives scheduling in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the product or service being ordered on this line (e.g., '5G Unlimited Plan', 'FTTH 1Gbps Broadband', 'VoLTE Add-On'). Denormalized from the product catalog for operational reporting and customer-facing order confirmations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog

attributes.name: product_offering_code
attributes.description: External-facing alphanumeric code identifying the specific product offering or SKU in the product catalog (e.g., 'MOB-5G-UNL-001', 'BB-FTTH-1G-002'). Used for catalog lookup, billing rate plan association, and order decomposition in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the product or service being ordered on this line. Drives workflow routing, provisioning system selection, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOBILE|BROADBAND|FIXED_LINE|IPTV|VOIP|IOT|ENTERPRISE|ADD_ON — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or campaign code applied to this order line at the time of order capture, qualifying the customer for a specific discount, bundle offer, or incentive. Used for marketing campaign effectiveness analysis and discount validation in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the product or service being ordered on this line. Typically 1 for most telecom service lines but may be greater for bulk SIM orders, enterprise seat licenses, or CPE equipment orders. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The customer-requested date on which the product or service on this line should become active. Drives service provisioning scheduling in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management and SLA commitment tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: requires_field_visit
attributes.description: Indicates whether fulfillment of this order line requires a field technician visit (e.g., FTTH installation, CPE installation, ONT splicing). When TRUE, triggers work order creation and field dispatch scheduling in Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Workforce Management; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Billing and operational service type for this order line, distinguishing postpaid subscription, prepaid (Comverse ONE), hybrid, MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator) resale, or wholesale service arrangements. Determines downstream billing system routing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this order line record in the originating operational system (Oracle Communications Order and Service Management). Enables lineage tracing, reconciliation, and idempotent upsert processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Data Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: Network access technology associated with the product on this order line (e.g., LTE, 5G NR, FTTH/GPON, DSL). Used for network provisioning routing to Ericsson Network Manager or Nokia NetAct, capacity planning, and technology migration analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 2G|3G|4G_LTE|5G_NR|FTTH_GPON|FTTB|DSL|CABLE|FIXED_WIRELESS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.261; ITU-T G.984 GPON; ETSI EN 302 099

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Commercial price per unit for the product or service on this line at the time of order placement, before discounts and taxes. Represents the catalog or negotiated price used for billing rate plan association in Amdocs Revenue Management. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Product Catalog; Amdocs Revenue Management

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit trail of every state transition and post-submission amendment for a fulfillment order throughout its lifecycle — from SUBMITTED through VALIDATED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_PROVISIONING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, or FALLOUT. For state transitions: records previous state, new state, transition timestamp, triggering actor (system or user), and reason code. For amendments: records amendment type (appointment change, product selection change, address change, service configuration change), original value, new value, amendment request timestamp, amendment status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, APPLIED), approving agent reference, impact assessment (SLA reset flag, cost delta), and override justification. This is the SSOT for all order change history — both system-driven state transitions and customer/agent-initiated amendments. Essential for SLA measurement, fallout root-cause analysis, dispute resolution, and regulatory audit trails required by FCC and BEREC.
products.reference: TM Forum SID OrderStateChange

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order status history record. Primary key of the order_status_history data product. Immutable once assigned.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: actor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific actor (system process name, agent employee ID, or customer reference) that triggered the transition or amendment. Supports audit trail requirements for FCC and BEREC regulatory reporting and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: appointment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field service appointment associated with this order history record, particularly relevant for APPOINTMENT_CHANGE amendments or transitions triggered by appointment outcomes. Links to Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management scheduling records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Appointment Management; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with the fulfillment order. Enables customer-level SLA tracking, dispute resolution, and churn analysis across the order lifecycle.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party Management; Salesforce CRM Customer 360

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or system identifier of the agent or supervisor who approved or rejected the amendment. Null for state transition records and for system-auto-approved amendments. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party Management; ISO/IEC 27001; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order for which this status history record was created. Links every history entry back to its originating order in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: service_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the decomposed service order generated from the parent fulfillment order in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management or Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite. Supports traceability between commercial order history and service fulfillment execution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Service Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to a ServiceNow ITSM trouble ticket or incident raised in association with this state transition or amendment (e.g., a FALLOUT event that triggered an incident). Null when no ticket is associated. Supports cross-system traceability for fault management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Trouble Ticket Management; ServiceNow ITSM; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: workflow_task_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific workflow task or orchestration step within Oracle Communications Order and Service Management that generated this history record. Enables traceability from the history record back to the originating workflow execution for technical root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management

attributes.name: actor_system
attributes.description: Name of the OSS/BSS system that originated the transition or amendment event (e.g., Oracle Communications Order and Service Management, Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite, Salesforce CRM, ServiceNow ITSM). Enables source-system traceability for fallout root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Resource Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: actor_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the type of actor that triggered the state transition or amendment. SYSTEM indicates an automated OSS/BSS process; AGENT indicates a human CSR or field technician; CUSTOMER indicates a self-service action; SUPERVISOR indicates a management override; AUTOMATED_RULE indicates a policy engine or workflow rule.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party Interaction; eTOM Process Framework; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: amended_field_name
attributes.description: For amendment records, the logical name of the order attribute that was changed (e.g., installation_address, appointment_date, selected_product_id, service_configuration_value). Provides context for interpreting original_value and new_value. Null for state transition records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_request_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the amendment was formally requested by the customer or agent. Distinct from transition_timestamp (which records when the event was processed). Used to measure amendment processing lead time and SLA compliance. Null for state transition records. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the amendment request. PENDING: awaiting review; APPROVED: authorized but not yet applied to the order; REJECTED: denied by agent or system rule; APPLIED: successfully incorporated into the active order. Null for state transition records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: For amendment records, classifies the type of post-submission change requested. Null for state transition records. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: APPOINTMENT_CHANGE|PRODUCT_SELECTION_CHANGE|ADDRESS_CHANGE|SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_CHANGE|CONTACT_CHANGE|PAYMENT_METHOD_CHANGE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: cost_delta
attributes.description: For amendment records, the incremental cost impact (positive or negative, in the account currency) resulting from the amendment — e.g., a product selection change that increases or decreases the order value. Null for state transition records and zero-cost amendments. Used for revenue assurance and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Amdocs Revenue Management; ISO 4217

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this history record was first written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from transition_timestamp (the business event time). Used for data pipeline monitoring, late-arrival detection, and audit trail completeness verification. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the cost_delta amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null when cost_delta is null. Supports multi-currency operations across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities

attributes.name: duration_in_state_seconds
attributes.description: Number of seconds the order spent in the previous_state before transitioning to new_state. Calculated at ingestion time as the difference between this record's transition_timestamp and the prior record's transition_timestamp for the same order. Used for SLA bottleneck analysis and process mining.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; eTOM Process Framework; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: fallout_category
attributes.description: When new_state is FALLOUT, classifies the root-cause category of the fallout event (e.g., PROVISIONING_FAILURE, CREDIT_REJECTION, ADDRESS_VALIDATION_FAILURE, MNP_REJECTION, NETWORK_CAPACITY, SYSTEM_ERROR). Null for non-FALLOUT transitions. Essential for fallout root-cause analysis and NOC/OSS remediation workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: fallout_resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating how a FALLOUT condition was resolved (e.g., AUTO_RETRY_SUCCESS, MANUAL_INTERVENTION, ORDER_CANCELLED, REROUTED_TO_ALTERNATE_RESOURCE). Populated when transitioning out of FALLOUT state. Null for non-FALLOUT records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this history record is subject to regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., FCC order completion reporting, BEREC quality-of-service metrics, OFCOM service provisioning KPIs). True flags records that must be included in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory Reporting Requirements; BEREC Guidelines; Ofcom Reporting Requirements; NTIA

attributes.name: mnp_reference_number
attributes.description: For MNP port-in or port-out order types, the inter-operator MNP reference number assigned by the number portability clearinghouse. Null for non-MNP orders. Required for GSMA MNP compliance reporting and inter-carrier dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA MNP Guidelines; 3GPP TS 22.011; FCC Number Portability Rules; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: new_state
attributes.description: The order lifecycle state entered as a result of this transition. For amendment records, reflects the order state at the time the amendment was recorded. Valid states include SUBMITTED, VALIDATED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_PROVISIONING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FALLOUT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SUBMITTED|VALIDATED|IN_PROGRESS|PENDING_PROVISIONING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED|FALLOUT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: For amendment records, the proposed or applied new value for the amended field (serialized as string for flexibility across amendment types). Null for state transition records. Paired with original_value to provide a complete before/after audit record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: For amendment records, the value of the amended field before the change was applied (serialized as string for flexibility across amendment types). Null for state transition records. Supports dispute resolution and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a standard business rule, credit policy, or SLA policy was overridden to process this transition or amendment. When True, override_justification must be populated. Supports compliance monitoring and exception reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; ISO/IEC 27001; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: override_justification
attributes.description: Free-text justification provided by a supervisor or authorized agent when a standard business rule or SLA policy is overridden to approve an amendment or force a state transition. Required for compliance audit trails when override_flag is True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; ISO/IEC 27001; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: previous_state
attributes.description: The order lifecycle state immediately before this transition occurred. Null for the initial SUBMITTED state entry. Valid states include SUBMITTED, VALIDATED, IN_PROGRESS, PENDING_PROVISIONING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FALLOUT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SUBMITTED|VALIDATED|IN_PROGRESS|PENDING_PROVISIONING|COMPLETED|CANCELLED|FALLOUT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the state transition or amendment (e.g., CREDIT_CHECK_FAILED, PROVISIONING_TIMEOUT, CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_CANCEL, MNP_PORT_DELAY, NETWORK_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE). Used for fallout root-cause analysis and SLA reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the state transition or amendment reason, supplementing the structured reason_code. May include agent notes, system error messages, or customer-provided explanations captured at the time of the event.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this history record captures a state transition (order lifecycle state change) or a post-submission amendment (customer or agent-initiated change to order attributes). Drives downstream processing logic and reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing integer representing the chronological order of history records for a given order_id. Sequence 1 is the initial SUBMITTED state entry. Enables ordered reconstruction of the complete order lifecycle and detection of out-of-sequence processing anomalies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: sla_reset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this state transition or amendment triggered a reset of the order fulfillment SLA clock. True when the SLA measurement window is restarted (e.g., due to a customer-requested amendment or a FALLOUT recovery). Critical for accurate SLA compliance reporting to FCC and BEREC.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: sla_target_timestamp
attributes.description: The committed SLA completion deadline applicable at the time of this history record. If sla_reset_flag is True, this reflects the recalculated SLA target post-reset. Enables point-in-time SLA compliance measurement and regulatory reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or event identifier of this record in the originating source system (e.g., the Oracle Communications Order and Service Management order history event ID). Enables reverse traceability from the Silver Layer back to the operational system for reconciliation and reprocessing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this history record was sourced (e.g., Oracle Communications Order and Service Management, Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite, Salesforce CRM). Supports data lineage tracking and multi-system reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the state transition or amendment event occurred. This is the principal business event timestamp used for SLA measurement, fallout root-cause analysis, and regulatory audit trails. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Order Management; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this history record was last modified in the Silver Layer (e.g., due to a late-arriving amendment status update or correction). For a fully immutable audit trail, updates should be rare and logged. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Common Business Entities; ISO/IEC 27001

products.name: task
products.description: Granular decomposed work task generated by OSM order orchestration engine from a specific order line during order decomposition. Represents both the decomposition mapping (tracing commercial order line to lower-level service/resource/network orders) and the atomic fulfillment execution step (HLR/HSS provisioning, IP address assignment, CPE dispatch, GPON ONT activation, number portability submission). Captures parent order line reference, decomposition rule applied, child system target, child order type (service_order, resource_order, network_order), task type, execution sequence, dependency chain, start time, completion time, retry count, task-level status, synchronisation status with downstream systems, creation timestamp, and fallout detail. Provides full decomposition traceability from commercial order line through orchestration logic to network provisioning action — serving as the SSOT for both order decomposition mapping and task execution within this domain.
products.reference: OSM Task / TM Forum SID FulfillmentTask

attributes.name: actual_start_time

attributes.name: automation_indicator

attributes.name: child_order_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of lower-level order generated by the decomposition of the parent commercial order line. attributes.name: child_system_target
attributes.description: Identifies the downstream OSS/BSS system to which this task is dispatched for execution (e.g., HLR, HSS, GPON-OLT, Amdocs, Netcracker, Ericsson Network Manager). Critical for cross-system orchestration traceability and fallout diagnosis.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 Resource Domain; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: child_system_task_ref
attributes.description: The task or work order identifier assigned by the downstream target system (e.g., Ericsson Network Manager work order ID, Netcracker service order number, ServiceNow change request number). Enables cross-system correlation and reconciliation between OSM and downstream fulfillment systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); Ericsson Network Manager; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: completion_time
attributes.description: The date and time at which this task reached a terminal state (completed, failed, or cancelled) in the OSM orchestration engine. Used to calculate task duration, SLA compliance, and MTTR for fulfillment operations.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T E.800 QoS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this order task record was first created in the OSM orchestration engine following order decomposition. Serves as the audit creation timestamp and the baseline for SLA elapsed-time calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Data governance classification level for this order task record per the enterprise data classification policy. Determines access controls, retention policies, and handling requirements in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; FCC Data Protection Rules; GDPR Article 32; NTIA Data Governance

attributes.name: decomposition_rule_version
attributes.description: Version of the decomposition rule applied at the time this task was generated. Supports impact analysis when orchestration rules are updated and enables reproducibility of order decomposition logic for audit purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dependency_task_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of order_task_id values that must reach 'completed' status before this task can begin execution. Captures the dependency chain within the OSM orchestration workflow to enforce correct fulfillment sequencing (e.g., HLR provisioning must complete before VoLTE IMS registration).
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 Order Orchestration

attributes.name: due_time
attributes.description: The SLA-committed deadline by which this task must reach 'completed' status. Derived from the parent order's committed delivery date and the task's position in the fulfillment sequence. Breach of this timestamp triggers escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; ITU-T E.800

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: Machine-readable error code returned by the downstream target system upon task execution failure (e.g., HLR error codes, GPON provisioning error codes, HTTP status codes from REST APIs). Distinct from fallout_reason_code which is an OSM-normalised classification.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); 3GPP TS 29.002 MAP Error Codes; ETSI

attributes.name: execution_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The elapsed time in seconds between actual_start_time and completion_time for this task. Populated upon task completion. Used for provisioning performance benchmarking, SLA analysis, and identification of slow downstream systems contributing to order fulfillment delays.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T E.800 QoS

attributes.name: execution_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering position of this task within the overall order fulfillment workflow. Determines the sequence in which tasks are executed relative to sibling tasks on the same order line. Lower values execute first.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: fallout_detail
attributes.description: Free-text description of the error or exception that caused this task to fall out, as returned by the downstream target system or the OSM orchestration engine. Provides diagnostic context for manual resolution by NOC or BSS operations teams.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum eTOM Fault Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: fallout_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this task has entered fallout status requiring manual intervention or escalation. True when the task has exceeded retry limits or encountered an unrecoverable error. Drives fallout management queues in OSM and ServiceNow ITSM.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum eTOM Fulfillment; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: fallout_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the root cause of task fallout (e.g., DOWNSTREAM_TIMEOUT, INVALID_MSISDN, RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, GPON_PORT_EXHAUSTED, HLR_REJECT). Populated when fallout_indicator is True. Used for fallout trend analysis and systemic issue identification.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 Fault Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI) of the SIM card being provisioned by this task. Populated for HLR/HSS provisioning and SIM activation tasks. A 15-digit globally unique subscriber identifier per 3GPP standards. Classified as confidential as it uniquely identifies a subscriber on the network.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003; ITU-T E.212; GSMA; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this order task record was most recently modified in the OSM orchestration engine. Tracks state transitions, retry attempts, and synchronisation updates for audit and change-management purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: max_retry_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of retry attempts permitted for this task before it is automatically escalated to fallout management. Configured per task type and downstream system target in the OSM orchestration engine.

attributes.name: mnp_port_reference

attributes.name: msisdn

Populated for HLR/HSS provisioning, SIM activation, and MNP tasks. Classified as confidential as it is a customer-linked network identifier.

attributes.name: network_technology

attributes.references: 3GPP TS 38.300 (5G NR); 3GPP TS 36.300 (LTE); ITU-T G.984 (GPON); ETSI NFV; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.description: Serial number of the Optical Network Terminal (ONT) / Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) being activated or configured by this task. Populated for GPON ONT activation and CPE dispatch tasks. Used for FTTH inventory reconciliation and field technician dispatch coordination.

attributes.description: The commercial order action that triggered the creation of this task. attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this task, inherited from the parent order or overridden by the OSM orchestration engine based on customer segment, SLA tier, or order type. Drives execution queue ordering and resource allocation in fulfillment operations.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times execution of this task has been retried following a failure or timeout. Used to enforce maximum retry thresholds, trigger fallout management escalation, and analyse systemic provisioning failure patterns across downstream systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum eTOM Fault Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned date and time at which this task is scheduled to begin execution within the OSM orchestration engine. Used for SLA target calculation, capacity planning, and workforce scheduling in field dispatch scenarios.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: sla_breach_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this task has breached its SLA due_time commitment. Set to True when completion_time exceeds due_time, or when the task remains in a non-terminal state past due_time. Drives SLA reporting, customer compensation workflows, and regulatory compliance reporting to FCC/Ofcom.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 SLA Management; ITU-T E.800; FCC Service Quality Rules; Ofcom Quality of Service Regulations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this order task record originates (e.g., OSM, Netcracker, Amdocs). Used for data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and cross-system reconciliation in the Revenue Assurance domain.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: sync_status
