attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fallout record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.creationDate

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The customer segment of the account associated with the fallen-out order. Denormalized for workqueue prioritization and segment-level SLA application without requiring a join to the customer domain.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CustomerSegment; Salesforce CRM Account Type

attributes.name: detected_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the order orchestration engine first detected and recorded the fallout condition. This is the principal business event timestamp for SLA measurement and aging calculations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TroubleTicket.creationDate; Oracle Communications OSM Event Timestamp

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: System-generated error code returned by the failing downstream system or orchestration engine (e.g., OSM, HLR/HSS, provisioning platform). Used for automated pattern detection and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM Error Code Registry; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Full descriptive error message returned by the failing system at the time of fallout detection. Provides technical context for resolution agents and is used in automated error classification models.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM Error Logging; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: escalated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fallout record was most recently escalated to a higher resolution tier. Null if the record has never been escalated.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM Escalation Log; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation tier for this fallout record (0 = not escalated, 1 = team lead, 2 = manager, 3 = vendor/third-party). Incremented automatically when SLA thresholds are breached.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM Escalation Policy; TM Forum SID GB922 — TroubleTicket.escalationLevel

attributes.name: failing_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the downstream OSS/BSS system that returned the error or failed to respond, causing the order to fall out. Examples: HLR, HSS, PROVISIONING_ENGINE, INVENTORY_MANAGER, CREDIT_SYSTEM, MNP_CLEARINGHOUSE.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3 — Resource Provisioning; Oracle Communications OSM Integration Framework

attributes.name: failing_system_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The transaction or correlation identifier returned by the failing downstream system. Enables cross-system tracing and incident correlation in ServiceNow ITSM and NOC tooling.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM CMDB — Correlation ID; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: fallout_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause that drove the order into fallout state. Drives workqueue routing and resolution team assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VALIDATION_FAILURE|PROVISIONING_TIMEOUT|INVENTORY_SHORTAGE|DOWNSTREAM_SYSTEM_ERROR|CREDIT_CHECK_FAILURE|DUPLICATE_ORDER|MNP_PORT_FAILURE|FRAUD_HOLD|CAPACITY_EXHAUSTION|CONFIGURATION_ERROR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3 Order Handling; Oracle Communications OSM Fallout Classification

attributes.name: fallout_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fallout record within the NOC/BSS operations workqueue. Drives SLA breach prevention workflows and management dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TroubleTicket State; ServiceNow ITSM Incident Lifecycle

attributes.name: last_retry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent automated or manual re-submission attempt for this fallout order. Used to enforce retry interval policies and prevent retry storms.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM Retry Log; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: max_retry_allowed
attributes.description: Maximum number of automated re-submission attempts permitted for this order type before mandatory escalation to manual resolution. Configured per order type and fallout category.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM Retry Configuration; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: mnp_port_reference
attributes.description: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) porting reference number applicable when the fallout is associated with a port-in or port-out order. Null for non-MNP order types. Used for MNP clearinghouse reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — MNP; 3GPP TS 22.066 MNP; FCC 47 CFR Part 52 Number Portability

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to this fallout record, determining workqueue position and escalation urgency. Derived from order type, customer segment, and SLA exposure at time of fallout detection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TroubleTicket.priority; ServiceNow ITSM Priority Matrix

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this fallout event by the OSS/BSS operations center. Used by NOC and BSS workqueue agents to track and communicate about the fallout case.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management — Fallout Reference; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3 Order Handling

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code where the order was being fulfilled. Used for regional fallout rate analysis and to route cases to geographically appropriate field or provisioning teams.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 Country/Region Codes; TM Forum SID GB922 — GeographicAddress

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective action taken by the resolution agent to address the fallout root cause. Captured at resolution time and used for knowledge base and automation training.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM — Resolution Notes; TM Forum SID GB922 — TroubleTicket.resolutionDate

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the resolution action applied to close this fallout. Enables resolution pattern analysis and automation opportunity identification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AUTO_RETRY_SUCCESS|MANUAL_CORRECTION|ORDER_CANCELLED|ORDER_MODIFIED|INVENTORY_ALLOCATED|SYSTEM_BYPASS|ESCALATED_TO_VENDOR|CUSTOMER_CONTACTED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TroubleTicket.closeCode; ServiceNow ITSM Close Code

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fallout record was marked as resolved in the operations workqueue. Used to calculate mean time to resolve (MTTR) for fallout SLA reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TroubleTicket.resolutionDate; FCC Order 22-58 MTTR Reporting

attributes.name: resubmission_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the order re-submission attempt after resolution action was applied. Indicates whether the order successfully completed fulfillment, failed again, is awaiting outcome, or was cancelled.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM Resubmission Result; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: resubmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the order was resubmitted into the orchestration engine after resolution action was applied. Null if the order has not yet been resubmitted.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM Resubmission Log; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of automated or manual re-submission attempts made for this fallout order. Used to determine when to escalate from automated retry to manual intervention.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM Retry Policy; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Structured root cause analysis narrative captured by the resolution agent or automated diagnostic engine. Documents the underlying cause beyond the error code for knowledge management and recurrence prevention.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM Problem Management — Root Cause; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3

attributes.name: sla_breach_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this fallout record will breach its applicable SLA if not resolved. Calculated at fallout detection time based on order type SLA thresholds. Null if no SLA applies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA; FCC Order 22-58 Service Quality Reporting

attributes.name: sla_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA for this fallout record has been breached at the time of last update. True when current timestamp exceeds sla_breach_timestamp without resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Compliance; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record that originated this fallout record. Enables data lineage tracking and source-system-specific reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Data Provenance; TM Forum SID GB922 — DataSource

attributes.name: sub_category
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the fallout category providing additional specificity for root cause analysis. Examples: ADDRESS_VALIDATION_FAILED under VALIDATION_FAILURE, HLR_TIMEOUT under PROVISIONING_TIMEOUT, SIM_STOCK_DEPLETED under INVENTORY_SHORTAGE.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.3; Oracle Communications OSM Sub-Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this fallout record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.lastUpdate

attributes.name: workflow_step_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific orchestration workflow step or process node within Oracle OSM that was executing when the fallout occurred. Enables precise identification of the failure point in the order decomposition graph.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management — Workflow Step; TM Forum eTOM Process Decomposition

attributes.name: workflow_step_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position of the failing workflow step within the overall order orchestration process. Used to understand how far into fulfillment the order progressed before failing.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management — Process Sequence; TM Forum eTOM

products.name: jeopardy
products.description: Proactive jeopardy alert record raised when a fulfillment order is at risk of breaching its committed completion date or SLA threshold. Captures jeopardy type (capacity constraint, field technician unavailability, MNP donor delay, CPE shipment delay), severity level, detection timestamp, predicted breach time, assigned owner, escalation tier, and resolution status. Feeds real-time dashboards for order operations managers and customer care agents.
products.reference: TM Forum SID OrderJeopardy / eTOM Jeopardy Management

attributes.name: jeopardy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the order jeopardy alert record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management

attributes.name: assigned_technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: At-risk orders requiring field intervention are assigned to specific technicians for expedited completion. Essential for jeopardy management, SLA breach prevention, and tracking technician-driven reco

attributes.name: blocking_task_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific order task or workflow step within Oracle Communications OSM that is currently blocked and causing the jeopardy condition. Used for targeted remediation.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) — Task Management; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise jeopardy management requires corporate account context for escalation routing to account teams, SLA penalty calculation per contract terms, and executive visibility for high-value customer

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Jeopardy management costs (escalation resources, expedited provisioning, premium logistics) must be allocated to cost centers for operational budgeting and to measure the financial impact of SLA risk

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer whose order is in jeopardy. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Customer 360 and Oracle OSM order context.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer Domain; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (order operations manager, customer care agent, or field technician) currently assigned as the responsible owner for resolving this jeopardy alert.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Party Role; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment order that is at risk. Links to the parent order record in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Jeopardy detection rules are defined as KPIs (SLA breach risk %, on-time delivery rate). Links jeopardy records to their governing KPI definitions for threshold management, reporting, and regulatory c

attributes.name: network_element_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the network element (e.g., Optical Line Terminal (OLT), Radio Access Network (RAN) node, Digital Subscriber Line Access Multiplexer (DSLAM)) involved in the jeopardy condition, where the root cause is network-related.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Domain; Nokia NetAct; Ericsson Network Manager

attributes.name: outage_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.outage_record. Business justification: Order jeopardies caused by network outages require outage tracking for SLA exclusion clauses and regulatory reporting. Prevents customer penalties during force majeure events.

attributes.name: product_offering_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or service offering associated with the at-risk order. Links to the product catalog in Netcracker OSS/BSS Product Catalog.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Product Catalog; Netcracker OSS/BSS

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Business justification: When order jeopardy risks regulatory penalty (missed MNP porting deadline, failed E911 activation), telcos link jeopardy records to penalty exposure for executive escalation and remediation prioritiza

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated ServiceNow ITSM incident or change ticket raised to track and resolve the underlying technical issue causing the jeopardy condition.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket

attributes.name: assigned_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual currently assigned as the responsible owner for resolving this jeopardy alert. Retained for operational display on dashboards without requiring a join.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Party Role; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: assigned_team
attributes.description: Name of the operational team (e.g., Order Operations, Field Engineering, MNP Coordination, CPE Logistics) currently responsible for resolving the jeopardy condition.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.6 Order Handling; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: blocking_system
attributes.description: The Operations Support System (OSS) or Business Support System (BSS) component where the blocking condition exists. Identifies which system team must act to resolve the jeopardy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: osm|crm|network_provisioning|mnp_gateway|cpe_logistics|billing|workforce_management|external_carrier — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM OSS/BSS Framework; Oracle Communications OSM; Netcracker OSS/BSS

attributes.name: committed_completion_date
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally committed date by which the fulfillment order must be completed and delivered to the customer. Serves as the SLA baseline against which jeopardy is measured.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order SLA; FCC Broadband Service Commitments

attributes.name: compensation_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of service credit or compensation to be applied to the customer account as a result of the SLA breach. Expressed in the local operating currency. Feeds billing adjustment workflows in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: Ofcom Automatic Compensation Scheme; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; TM Forum SID GB922 — Billing Adjustment

attributes.name: compensation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is eligible for service credit or compensation as a result of the SLA breach associated with this jeopardy event. Drives downstream billing adjustment workflows in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Penalty; Ofcom Automatic Compensation Scheme; FCC Consumer Protection

attributes.name: cpe_tracking_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) Shipment Tracking Number
attributes.description: Logistics shipment tracking number for the Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) associated with the order, applicable when the jeopardy type is CPE shipment delay. Used to monitor delivery status.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Logistics; Oracle Communications OSM Inventory Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this jeopardy alert record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Data Governance; ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the compensation amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Ensures multi-currency support for international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922 — Billing

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer was notified about the jeopardy condition and potential order delay. Null if the customer has not yet been notified.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer Interaction; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: customer_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been proactively notified about the jeopardy condition and the potential delay to their order. True if notification has been sent; False if not yet notified.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer Interaction; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: The source or mechanism by which the jeopardy condition was detected. Distinguishes between automated SLA monitoring engine alerts, manual review by operations staff, customer complaints, Network Operations Center (NOC) alerts, and field reports.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Jeopardy; Nokia NetAct; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the jeopardy condition was first detected by the order management system or monitoring process. This is the principal business event timestamp for this entity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Jeopardy; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the jeopardy alert was escalated to a higher tier, capturing the business context for the escalation decision.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: escalation_tier
attributes.description: Current escalation level of the jeopardy alert. Tier 1 is front-line order operations; Tier 2 is specialist or supervisor level; Tier 3 is senior management; Executive is C-suite or regulatory escalation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket Escalation; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the jeopardy alert was most recently escalated to a higher tier. Null if the alert has not been escalated.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket Escalation; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region or territory where the order fulfillment is taking place. Used for regional jeopardy trend analysis and resource allocation by Network Operations Center (NOC) and field operations teams.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Geographic Address; NTIA Broadband Coverage

attributes.name: hours_to_breach
attributes.description: Calculated number of hours remaining before the order is predicted to breach its SLA threshold at the time of jeopardy detection. Drives urgency scoring and escalation routing on operations dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Jeopardy; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.6

attributes.name: jeopardy_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for the jeopardy alert, used by order operations managers and customer care agents when communicating about the at-risk order. Format: JEP- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework — Order Handling (1.4.6); Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: jeopardy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the jeopardy alert. Tracks progression from initial detection through resolution or closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|acknowledged|in_progress|escalated|resolved|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket / Jeopardy Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: jeopardy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause category driving the jeopardy condition. Examples include capacity constraint, field technician unavailability, Mobile Number Portability (MNP) donor delay, Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) shipment delay, network outage, or provisioning failure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: capacity_constraint|field_technician_unavailable|mnp_donor_delay|cpe_shipment_delay|network_outage|provisioning_failure|system_integration_failure|regulatory_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.6 Order Handling; 3GPP TS 22.261; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: mnp_reference_number
attributes.description: The Mobile Number Portability (MNP) reference number assigned by the donor network or porting authority, applicable when the jeopardy type is MNP donor delay. Used to track and chase the porting request.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — Mobile Number Portability; 3GPP TS 22.042; FCC MNP Rules

attributes.name: predicted_breach_timestamp
attributes.description: The predicted date and time at which the fulfillment order is expected to breach its committed completion date or Service Level Agreement (SLA) threshold if no corrective action is taken. Used for prioritisation on real-time operations dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Management; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.6

attributes.name: priority_score
attributes.description: Numeric priority score assigned to the jeopardy alert based on factors such as customer segment, service type, SLA tier, and hours to breach. Used to rank and sequence remediation actions on operations dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Jeopardy; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.6

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this jeopardy alert has been reopened after a previous resolution. A high reopen count indicates recurring or persistent fulfillment issues and is used for quality and process improvement analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: resolution_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken or planned to resolve the jeopardy condition and restore the order to its committed completion timeline.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket Resolution; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the jeopardy condition was resolved and the order was returned to a non-jeopardy state. Null if the jeopardy is still active.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Jeopardy; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: revised_completion_date
attributes.description: The updated expected completion date for the order after the jeopardy condition has been assessed and a revised delivery commitment has been established. May differ from the original committed completion date.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management; FCC Broadband Service Commitments

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardised code identifying the confirmed or suspected root cause of the jeopardy condition, aligned with the OSS/BSS fault taxonomy. Used for trend analysis and process improvement reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket Root Cause; Nokia NetAct; Ericsson Network Manager

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause of the jeopardy condition, providing operational context beyond the root cause code for use by order operations managers and customer care agents.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of telecommunications service associated with the order in jeopardy. Examples include mobile, broadband, Fiber to the Home (FTTH), fixed voice, Internet Protocol Television (IPTV), Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP), Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS), or Software-Defined Wide Area Network (SD-WAN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile|broadband|fiber_ftth|fixed_voice|iptv|voip|enterprise_mpls|sd_wan — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Service Domain; ITU-T I.112; 3GPP TS 22.261

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the jeopardy alert indicating urgency and business impact. Critical indicates imminent SLA breach; High indicates breach likely within hours; Medium indicates breach risk within the day; Low indicates early warning with time to remediate.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Alarm/Severity Classification; ITU-T M.3100

attributes.name: sla_breach_occurred
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Service Level Agreement (SLA) was actually breached for this order. True if the committed completion date was missed; False if the order was completed within SLA despite the jeopardy alert.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Management; ITU-T E.800

attributes.name: sla_breach_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time at which the Service Level Agreement (SLA) was breached, i.e., when the committed completion date was passed without order fulfillment. Null if no breach occurred.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Management; ITU-T E.800; FCC Broadband Performance Standards

attributes.name: sla_threshold_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours allowed for order fulfillment as defined in the applicable Service Level Agreement (SLA). Jeopardy is triggered when the predicted completion time approaches or exceeds this threshold.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Management; ITU-T E.800 Quality of Service

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this jeopardy alert record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary source is Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Data Governance; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this jeopardy alert record was most recently updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Audit trail field for data lineage and change tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Data Governance; ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security

products.name: order_interaction
products.description: Unified communication and notification log for all customer-facing, system-generated, and internal interactions associated with a fulfillment order. Covers both inbound interactions (status enquiries, complaints, escalation contacts) and outbound notifications (SMS, email, push, IVR) dispatched at key order lifecycle milestones — order confirmation, appointment reminder, provisioning completion, MNP port execution, and cancellation notice. Captures interaction type, direction (inbound/outbound), channel, timestamp, initiator (customer/agent/system), notification template reference, template version, language code, delivery status (SENT, DELIVERED, FAILED, BOUNCED), recipient reference, outcome, retry count, and linked CRM case reference. Supports FCR measurement, regulatory notification compliance for MNP and disconnection (FCC, Ofcom, BEREC), proactive customer communication SLAs, and end-to-end customer experience analytics. This is the single source of truth for all order-related communications within this domain.
products.reference: TM Forum SID CustomerInteraction / Salesforce Case

attributes.name: order_interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order interaction or notification record within the order communication log. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction entity

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is the subject of the fulfillment order and the primary recipient or initiator of this interaction. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Customer 360.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer entity; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: customer_interaction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier linking this interaction to a prior related interaction record, for example a retry attempt referencing the original failed notification, or a follow-up contact referencing the initial enquiry. Enables interaction chain analysis and retry lineage tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent or field technician who initiated or handled this interaction, when the initiator type is AGENT. Null for system-generated or customer-initiated interactions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PartyRole entity; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order with which this interaction is associated. Links the communication record to the end-to-end order lifecycle managed in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CustomerOrder entity; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: notification_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the notification template used to generate outbound communications. Applicable for system-generated outbound interactions such as order confirmation, appointment reminder, and provisioning completion notices.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage entity

attributes.name: privacy_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_consent. Business justification: Customer interactions (order status calls, notifications) require valid consent under GDPR/CPNI rules. Telcos must verify consent before each interaction; operational systems check consent records in

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the interaction was conducted or the notification was dispatched. SMS — Short Message Service; EMAIL — electronic mail; PUSH — mobile push notification; IVR — Interactive Voice Response; AGENT_CALL — voice call handled by a customer service agent; LIVE_CHAT — real-time text chat; SELF_SERVICE_PORTAL — customer self-service web or app portal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SMS|EMAIL|PUSH|IVR|AGENT_CALL|LIVE_CHAT|SELF_SERVICE_PORTAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.channel; TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1

attributes.name: consent_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's consent to receive communications via the selected channel has been verified at the time of dispatch (True = consent confirmed). Supports GDPR Article 6/7, CCPA, and TCPA compliance for outbound marketing and operational notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 6 and 7; CCPA; TCPA (US); Ofcom Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this interaction record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Distinct from interaction_timestamp which captures the real-world event time.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit logging; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: csat_score
attributes.description: The Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) score provided by the customer following this interaction, typically on a 1–5 scale. Captured via post-interaction survey (IVR, SMS, or email). Null when no survey response was received. Supports customer experience analytics and agent performance management.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1; CSAT industry standard; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: The data sensitivity classification of this interaction record per the enterprise data governance policy. restricted — contains PII or regulatory data; confidential — sensitive business data; internal — operational data for internal use; public — non-sensitive data. Supports ISO/IEC 27001 information security controls and data governance compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security; GDPR Article 32; enterprise data governance policy

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which delivery of the outbound notification was confirmed by the receiving endpoint (e.g., SMS delivery receipt, email open/delivery acknowledgement). Null for inbound interactions or undelivered notifications. Used to calculate notification delivery latency.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage.sendTime; GSMA NRTRDE

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interaction was initiated by the customer or external party toward the operator (INBOUND) or dispatched by the operator toward the customer (OUTBOUND). Critical for First Call Resolution (FCR) measurement and proactive communication SLA tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.interactionDirection; TM Forum eTOM 1.4

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: The duration of the interaction in seconds, applicable to voice (IVR, AGENT_CALL) and live chat channels. Captures the length of the customer contact from initiation to closure. Used in First Call Resolution (FCR) and Average Handle Time (AHT) analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 — Customer Problem Handling; FCR/AHT industry KPI standards

attributes.name: escalation_tier
attributes.description: The support escalation tier at which this interaction is being handled. TIER_1 — front-line customer service; TIER_2 — specialist support; TIER_3 — technical or back-office resolution; EXECUTIVE — executive complaints handling. Null for non-escalated interactions. Supports escalation management analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 — Customer Problem Handling; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or structured description of the reason for delivery failure when interaction_status is FAILED or BOUNCED. Examples: invalid MSISDN, mailbox full, device token expired, network timeout. Supports root cause analysis and notification reliability improvement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage; Amdocs notification engine error codes

attributes.name: fcr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's issue or enquiry was fully resolved during this single interaction without requiring a follow-up contact (True = resolved on first contact). A key customer experience KPI used in contact centre performance management and NPS correlation analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1; FCR industry KPI standard; CSAT/NPS analytics

attributes.name: initiator_type
attributes.description: Identifies who or what originated this interaction. CUSTOMER — the customer contacted the operator; AGENT — a customer service or field agent initiated the interaction; SYSTEM — an automated BSS/OSS process (e.g., Amdocs, Oracle OSM) generated the communication.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.relatedParty.role; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current delivery or processing status of the interaction. SENT — dispatched to the delivery channel; DELIVERED — confirmed receipt by the recipient endpoint; FAILED — delivery attempt unsuccessful; BOUNCED — message returned undeliverable (e.g., invalid email); PENDING — queued for dispatch; CANCELLED — interaction voided before dispatch. Supports regulatory notification compliance tracking for MNP and disconnection per FCC, Ofcom, and BEREC requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage.status; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: interaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the interaction event occurred — for outbound notifications this is the dispatch time; for inbound interactions this is the time the contact was received. This is the principal business event timestamp for this record. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.interactionDate; ISO 8601

attributes.name: interaction_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the interaction. STATUS_ENQUIRY — customer or agent querying order progress; COMPLAINT — customer dissatisfaction contact; ESCALATION — escalated issue requiring senior handling; NOTIFICATION — system-generated outbound alert; APPOINTMENT_REMINDER — pre-appointment outbound notice; CANCELLATION_NOTICE — order or service cancellation communication; MNP_PORT_NOTICE — Mobile Number Portability (MNP) regulatory notification; PROVISIONING_COMPLETE — service activation confirmation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STATUS_ENQUIRY|COMPLAINT|ESCALATION|NOTIFICATION|APPOINTMENT_REMINDER|CANCELLATION_NOTICE|MNP_PORT_NOTICE|PROVISIONING_COMPLETE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.interactionType; GSMA MNP guidelines; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The BCP 47 / ISO 639-1 language code in which the interaction content was delivered or received (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, es-MX). Supports multilingual customer communication compliance and customer experience analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; BCP 47 (IETF RFC 5646); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: max_retry_limit
attributes.description: The configured maximum number of delivery retry attempts permitted for this interaction before the status is set to FAILED. Enables analysis of retry policy effectiveness and notification delivery SLA compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage; Amdocs notification SLA configuration

attributes.name: mnp_port_reference
attributes.description: The MNP transaction reference number associated with this interaction when the interaction type is MNP_PORT_NOTICE. Links the communication record to the specific port-in or port-out transaction for regulatory audit purposes under FCC 47 CFR Part 52, Ofcom, and BEREC MNP notification requirements.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52 — Number Portability; Ofcom General Conditions C5; BEREC Guidelines on MNP; GSMA MNP guidelines

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted out of receiving communications via the channel used for this interaction at the time of dispatch (True = opted out). When True, the interaction should only proceed if it is a mandatory regulatory or transactional notification. Supports GDPR, CCPA, and TCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CCPA; TCPA (US); Ofcom PECR

attributes.name: order_lifecycle_milestone
attributes.description: The specific order fulfillment milestone that triggered or is associated with this interaction. Enables milestone-level communication analytics and SLA compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_CONFIRMED|APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULED|PROVISIONING_STARTED|PROVISIONING_COMPLETE|MNP_PORT_EXECUTED|ORDER_CANCELLED|ORDER_FAILED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CustomerOrder lifecycle; Oracle Communications OSM; TM Forum eTOM 1.4

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The business outcome of the interaction upon completion. RESOLVED — customer issue or enquiry fully addressed; UNRESOLVED — issue remains open; ESCALATED — interaction escalated to a higher support tier or CRM case; INFORMATION_PROVIDED — informational response given; NO_ACTION_REQUIRED — notification only, no customer response needed. Supports First Call Resolution (FCR) measurement.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 — Customer Problem Handling; FCR industry KPI standard

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The business priority assigned to this interaction, used to govern dispatch sequencing and escalation handling. CRITICAL — regulatory or SLA-breach-risk notifications; HIGH — customer-impacting issues; MEDIUM — standard operational notifications; LOW — informational communications.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.priority; ServiceNow ITSM priority classification

attributes.name: recipient_device_token
attributes.description: The mobile device push notification token (e.g., APNs or FCM token) used to deliver PUSH channel notifications to the customer's registered device. Classified as confidential as it is a device-level identifier. Null for non-push channels.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Apple APNs; Google FCM

attributes.name: recipient_email
attributes.description: The email address of the notification recipient for EMAIL channel interactions. Classified as restricted PII. Null for non-email channels.

attributes.name: recipient_msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recipient Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The mobile phone number (MSISDN) of the notification recipient for SMS and IVR channel interactions. Stored in E.164 international format. Classified as restricted PII as it directly identifies an individual subscriber.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; GSMA; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for this interaction record, used in customer-facing communications and regulatory audit trails. Formatted per BSS interaction numbering conventions (e.g., INT-2024-0001234).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.interactionId; FCC regulatory notification compliance

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which this regulatory notification must be dispatched to remain compliant with applicable regulatory requirements (FCC, Ofcom, BEREC). Populated only when regulatory_notification_flag is True. Enables SLA breach detection for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions C5; BEREC Guidelines on MNP

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction constitutes a mandatory regulatory notification (True) as required by FCC, Ofcom, or BEREC rules — for example, MNP port execution notices or disconnection notifications. False for standard operational communications. Supports regulatory compliance reporting and audit.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ITU-T regulatory frameworks

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of delivery retry attempts made for this interaction after an initial FAILED or unacknowledged delivery. Applicable primarily to outbound notifications (SMS, EMAIL, PUSH). A value of 0 indicates the first attempt succeeded or no retry was needed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage; Amdocs Revenue Management notification engine

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interaction was dispatched or handled after the SLA target dispatch timestamp (True = SLA breached). Supports proactive communication SLA compliance monitoring and customer experience analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA entity; TM Forum eTOM 1.4

attributes.name: sla_target_dispatch_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Dispatch Timestamp
attributes.description: The target date and time by which this outbound notification should be dispatched per the proactive customer communication SLA. Distinct from regulatory_deadline which applies only to regulatory notifications. Used to measure SLA adherence for customer experience KPIs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA entity; TM Forum eTOM 1.4; internal SLA policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this interaction record. SALESFORCE_CRM — Salesforce CRM Case Management; ORACLE_OSM — Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; AMDOCS — Amdocs Revenue Management notification engine; NETCRACKER — Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite; SERVICENOW — ServiceNow ITSM; COMVERSE_ONE — Comverse ONE prepaid notification; MANUAL — manually entered record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SALESFORCE_CRM|ORACLE_OSM|AMDOCS|NETCRACKER|SERVICENOW|COMVERSE_ONE|MANUAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SystemResource; Oracle Communications OSM; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: source_system_interaction_ref
attributes.description: The native interaction or message identifier assigned by the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Case Number, Oracle OSM interaction ID, Amdocs notification batch reference). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SystemResource.systemResourceIdentifier; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: subject_line
attributes.description: The subject line of the outbound notification, applicable to EMAIL and PUSH channels. Captures the actual subject text as dispatched (post template rendering), enabling content audit and regulatory compliance review.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage.subject; FCC regulatory notification compliance

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: A brief free-text summary of the interaction content or agent notes captured during the interaction. For inbound contacts, this records the customer's stated reason or issue. For outbound notifications, this may capture the rendered message preview. Supports customer experience analytics and CRM case linkage.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interaction.description; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: template_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the notification template used to generate this outbound communication (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables audit of which template version was active at the time of dispatch, supporting regulatory compliance and A/B testing of communication content.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CommunicationMessage; FCC regulatory notification compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this interaction record was last modified, for example when delivery status is updated from SENT to DELIVERED or FAILED following carrier acknowledgement.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit logging; TM Forum SID GB922

products.name: order_mnp_request
products.description: Dedicated master record for Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in and port-out requests, tracking the full regulatory porting lifecycle as mandated by FCC, Ofcom, and BEREC. Captures MSISDN being ported, donor operator code, recipient operator code, porting request date, regulatory submission timestamp, donor acknowledgement timestamp, porting execution date, porting status (PENDING, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED), rejection reason code, and NRTRDE reference. Links to the parent fulfillment order.
products.reference: GSMA MNP / ITU-T E.164 / FCC Number Portability

attributes.name: order_mnp_request_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the MNP port-in or port-out request record within the order management system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise MNP requests (bulk number porting for corporate customers) require corporate account linkage for authorization validation, bulk porting coordination, and account-level porting history track

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account initiating the MNP port-in or port-out request, serving as the primary party reference for this transaction.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order that initiated this MNP request, linking the porting lifecycle to the broader order orchestration workflow in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: mnp_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.mnp_transaction. Business justification: MNP porting requires inter-operator coordination tracked in interconnect.mnp_transaction (donor carrier handoff, routing updates, regulatory compliance). Order domain tracks customer-facing port reque

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: MNP requests are governed by specific regulatory obligations (porting timelines per FCC/EU rules, consumer protection mandates). Telcos must link each port request to its governing regulation for SLA

attributes.name: sim_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sim_stock. Business justification: MNP porting requires SIM card swap and activation for recipient operator. Real business need: porting execution tracking, SIM inventory allocation, donor/recipient coordination, regulatory compliance

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.trouble_ticket. Business justification: MNP porting failures generating trouble tickets for donor/recipient coordination issues. Critical for regulatory compliance and porting SLA tracking.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why the MNP porting request was cancelled. Populated only when porting_status is CANCELLED. Used for operational analysis and customer retention reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the MNP porting request was formally cancelled. Populated only when porting_status is CANCELLED. Used for regulatory reporting and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MNP request record was first created in the order management system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker per data governance requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: customer_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent for the MNP porting request, as required by regulatory frameworks. Must be True before a porting request can be submitted to the donor operator.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; GDPR Article 7; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: customer_consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer provided explicit consent for the MNP porting request. Required for regulatory audit trails under GDPR and FCC consumer protection rules.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8

attributes.name: donor_acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the donor operator formally acknowledged receipt of the MNP porting request. Regulatory compliance requires acknowledgement within defined windows (e.g., Ofcom 2-hour rule). Null if not yet acknowledged.
attributes.references: Ofcom General Condition C8; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: donor_operator_code
attributes.description: Standardized operator code identifying the losing (donor) network operator from which the MSISDN is being ported. Used in inter-operator porting communications and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26; ITU-T E.212; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8

attributes.name: donor_operator_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the donor (losing) network operator, captured at the time of the porting request for reporting and customer communication purposes.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: hlr_update_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Location Register (HLR) / Home Subscriber Server (HSS) Update Status
attributes.description: Status of the HLR/HSS provisioning update on the recipient network following port execution. SUCCESS confirms the subscriber is fully provisioned; FAILED triggers a technical remediation workflow.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.26; Ericsson Network Manager

attributes.name: hlr_update_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Location Register (HLR) / Home Subscriber Server (HSS) Update Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the HLR/HSS provisioning update was completed on the recipient network. Marks the point at which the subscriber's service is technically active on the new network.

attributes.name: icc_number
attributes.description: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier (ICCID) of the SIM card associated with the MSISDN being ported. Required for network provisioning and HLR/HSS update during port execution.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.118; 3GPP TS 22.042; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI) assigned to the subscriber on the recipient network post-porting. Used for HLR/HSS provisioning and network authentication. Populated after port acceptance.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MNP request record was last modified in the order management system. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The mobile phone number (MSISDN) being ported between operators. This is the primary subject of the MNP request and is a personally identifiable subscriber identifier per ITU-T E.164 numbering plan.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: mvno_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the donor or recipient operator involved in this MNP request is a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO). MVNO ports may require additional clearinghouse steps and host MNO coordination.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: mvno_host_operator_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) Host Operator Code
attributes.description: Operator code of the host Mobile Network Operator (MNO) for the MVNO involved in this porting request. Populated only when mvno_flag is True. Required for routing porting requests through the correct network infrastructure.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: The radio access network technology type of the subscription being ported (e.g., 4G LTE, 5G NR, VoLTE). Used to determine provisioning requirements on the recipient network post-porting.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.042; GSMA PRD IR.26; ITU-T; ETSI

attributes.name: nrtrde_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this MNP request to the associated Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) file or record, used for inter-operator settlement and fraud prevention during the porting transition period.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.32 NRTRDE; GSMA PRD IR.26; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: number_portability_database_update_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the national Number Portability Database (NPDB) or clearinghouse routing database has been updated to reflect the completed port. Required for correct call routing to the ported number.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.26; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: number_range_holder
attributes.description: The operator that holds the number range allocation for the MSISDN being ported, as assigned by the national numbering authority. May differ from the donor operator in complex porting chains.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom National Telephone Numbering Plan; NTIA

attributes.name: pac_code
attributes.description: The Porting Authorisation Code (PAC) provided by the donor operator to the subscriber, authorizing the port-out. Required for UK/Ofcom-regulated ports. Stored as confidential as it is a one-time authorization credential.
attributes.references: Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the MNP porting request was initiated by the customer (e.g., ONLINE self-service portal, retail STORE, CALL_CENTER agent, authorized DEALER, or API integration).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; Salesforce CRM; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: porting_clearinghouse_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the national or regional MNP clearinghouse (e.g., NPAC in the US, Syniverse in Europe) to track the porting transaction through the inter-operator clearinghouse system.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.26; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_execution_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual calendar date on which the number port is executed and the MSISDN becomes active on the recipient network. Null if the port has not yet been executed.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: porting_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the number port was technically executed at the network level, including HLR/HSS update confirmation. Provides sub-day precision for SLA measurement and NRTRDE reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26; GSMA NRTRDE; 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: porting_request_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer formally submitted the MNP porting request. Used as the anchor date for regulatory porting window compliance (e.g., FCC 1-business-day porting rule, Ofcom 1-working-day rule).
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_request_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Porting Request Number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the MNP request, used in regulatory submissions and inter-operator communications. Conforms to the operator-assigned porting reference format.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: porting_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory lifecycle status of the MNP request. PENDING: submitted and awaiting donor acknowledgement; ACCEPTED: donor has approved the port; REJECTED: donor has rejected the port; COMPLETED: number successfully ported and active on recipient network; CANCELLED: request withdrawn before completion.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: porting_type
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the porting request relative to the operator: PORT_IN means the subscriber is moving their number to this operator (recipient); PORT_OUT means the subscriber is leaving this operator (donor).
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: porting_window_end_time
attributes.description: The end of the agreed porting execution window. If the port is not completed within this window, an SLA breach may be triggered and escalation procedures initiated.
attributes.references: Ofcom General Condition C8; GSMA PRD IR.26; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_window_start_time
attributes.description: The start of the agreed porting execution window during which the technical port will be performed. Agreed between donor and recipient operators to minimize service disruption.
attributes.references: Ofcom General Condition C8; GSMA PRD IR.26; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: recipient_operator_code
attributes.description: Standardized operator code identifying the gaining (recipient) network operator to which the MSISDN is being ported. Used in inter-operator porting communications and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26; ITU-T E.212; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8

attributes.name: recipient_operator_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the recipient (gaining) network operator, captured at the time of the porting request for reporting and customer communication purposes.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline_date
attributes.description: The latest date by which the port must be completed to comply with regulatory mandates (e.g., FCC 1-business-day rule, Ofcom 1-working-day rule). Derived from porting_request_date and applicable regulatory framework.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the regulatory jurisdiction governing this MNP request. Determines which regulatory body's rules (FCC, Ofcom, BEREC member NRA) apply to porting timelines and procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|GBR|DEU|FRA|AUS|CAN|IND|BRA|NLD|BEL — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the MNP request was formally submitted to the inter-operator porting clearinghouse or regulatory body. Marks the start of the regulatory porting window and is used for SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized inter-operator code indicating the reason the donor operator rejected the MNP request (e.g., INVALID_ACCOUNT, OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, INCORRECT_PAC, CONTRACT_ACTIVE). Populated only when porting_status is REJECTED. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INVALID_ACCOUNT|OUTSTANDING_BALANCE|INCORRECT_PAC|CONTRACT_ACTIVE|INVALID_MSISDN|DUPLICATE_REQUEST|INVALID_DONOR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines; GSMA PRD IR.26

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the rejection reason beyond the standardized rejection_reason_code. Used for customer communication and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times this MNP porting request has been resubmitted following a rejection or failure. Used to track persistent porting issues and trigger escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The billing service type of the subscription being ported: PREPAID (balance-based), POSTPAID (invoice-based), or HYBRID. Determines porting validation rules and balance settlement requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MNP porting request breached the applicable regulatory or contractual SLA deadline. True if the porting_execution_date exceeded the regulatory_deadline_date.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: stac_code
attributes.description: The Service Termination Authorisation Code (STAC) used when a subscriber wishes to leave a network without porting their number. Applicable in Ofcom-regulated markets as an alternative to PAC.

attributes.name: subscriber_account_number
attributes.description: The subscriber's account number at the donor operator, required for identity verification during the porting process. Used to validate the porting request against donor records.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Condition C8; BEREC MNP Guidelines

products.name: provisioning_request
products.description: Downstream provisioning instruction record generated by OSM and dispatched to OSS systems (HLR/HSS, UDM, IMS, GPON OLT, IP address management, DSLAM) to activate, modify, or deactivate a service on the network. Captures target system identifier, provisioning action, service parameters payload, dispatch timestamp, acknowledgement timestamp, provisioning outcome (SUCCESS, FAILURE, TIMEOUT), and retry history. Bridges the order domain to the service and network domains.
products.reference: TM Forum SID ProvisioningOrder / OSM Service Order

attributes.name: provisioning_request_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the provisioning request record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) — Provisioning Order Entity

attributes.name: change_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.change_record. Business justification: Service activations coordinated with network change windows for HLR updates, port configurations. Prevents provisioning failures during maintenance windows.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Provisioning requests for enterprise services need corporate account context for proper system routing, account-specific configuration templates, and enterprise provisioning workflow orchestration.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Provisioning activities consume network operations resources with associated labor and system costs. Cost center allocation enables accurate OpEx tracking and capacity planning for provisioning teams.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer on whose behalf this provisioning request is being executed. Enables customer-centric analytics and SLA tracking across the provisioning lifecycle.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Customer 360; TM Forum SID GB922 — Party

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order in the order management domain that triggered this provisioning request. Links the provisioning instruction back to the originating customer order for end-to-end traceability. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE (via order → customer chain).
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management

attributes.name: managed_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.managed_service. Business justification: Provisioning requests target specific managed service instances for configuration updates, capacity changes, service modifications, or feature activations. Essential for managed service lifecycle mana

attributes.name: network_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.element. Business justification: Provisioning requests target specific network elements for service activation (HLR/HSS for mobile, BRAS for broadband). Essential for OSS/BSS integration, tracking provisioning status per network elem

attributes.name: noc_incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ServiceNow ITSM incident ticket raised when this provisioning request results in a FAILURE or TIMEOUT outcome. Enables correlation between provisioning failures and incident management workflows for root cause analysis and MTTR tracking.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket; ITU-T M.3400 — TMN Management Functions

attributes.name: ont_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.ont_asset. Business justification: Fiber provisioning requests activate specific ONT devices on GPON network. Real business need: OLT port binding, bandwidth profile assignment, optical power monitoring, device firmware management. Exi

attributes.name: ott_platform_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.ott_platform. Business justification: Multi-play service activation provisions access to specific OTT platforms (Netflix, Disney+). Provisioning system must know which platform API to call for account creation and SSO token generation dur

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: The internal task or work order identifier assigned by Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) to this provisioning instruction within its orchestration workflow. Used for cross-referencing with OSM audit logs and workflow tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) — Order Orchestration

attributes.name: sim_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sim_stock. Business justification: Provisioning requests configure specific SIM cards in network elements (HLR/HSS/UDM). Real business need: network activation audit, provisioning failure resolution, SIM lifecycle state synchronization

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service instance being provisioned, modified, or deactivated. Links to the service domain to identify the specific service (e.g., mobile line, broadband subscription, IPTV package) subject to this provisioning action.
attributes.references: Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite — Service Catalog; TM Forum SID GB922 — Service

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the target OSS system acknowledged receipt of the provisioning instruction. Used to calculate dispatch-to-acknowledgement latency and detect timeout conditions against SLA thresholds.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: The Access Point Name (APN) configured for the mobile data service being provisioned. Determines the packet data network gateway and internet access policy for the subscriber. Applicable for mobile broadband and IoT service provisioning.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003 — APN Definition; 3GPP TS 23.401 — EPS Bearer Management

attributes.name: bandwidth_profile_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the bandwidth profile (upstream/downstream speed tier) to be applied to the service. Maps to a predefined bandwidth template in the OLT, DSLAM, or BNG configuration. Examples: 100M_FTTH, 1G_FTTH, 50M_ADSL.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.984 — GPON; TM Forum SID GB922 — Service Quality; ETSI TS 101 270 — ADSL

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The originating channel through which the customer order that triggered this provisioning request was placed. ONLINE: self-service web/app; STORE: retail point of sale; CALL_CENTER: agent-assisted; PARTNER: MVNO or wholesale partner; FIELD_TECH: field technician dispatch; AUTOMATED: system-triggered (e.g., auto-renewal, policy enforcement).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Channel; Salesforce CRM — Lead Management

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the target OSS system reported final completion (success or failure) of the provisioning action. Used to measure end-to-end provisioning cycle time and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment Order

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this provisioning request record was first created in the OSM system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity Lifecycle

attributes.name: data_classification
attributes.description: Data governance classification level for this provisioning request record, indicating sensitivity and access control requirements. Aligned with the enterprise data classification policy: restricted (highest sensitivity), confidential, internal, public.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; GDPR Article 5 — Data Minimisation; FCC CPNI Rules 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the provisioning instruction was dispatched from Oracle Communications OSM to the target OSS system. Represents the principal real-world business event time. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment Order

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized error or failure reason code returned by the target OSS system when provisioning_outcome is FAILURE or TIMEOUT. Used for fault management, root cause analysis, and automated retry logic. Examples: RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_PARAMETER, SYSTEM_UNREACHABLE, DUPLICATE_REQUEST.
attributes.references: Nokia NetAct — Fault Management; Ericsson Network Manager — Fault Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — Trouble Ticket

attributes.name: failure_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the failure reason as returned by the target OSS system or populated by the OSM orchestration layer. Provides operational context for NOC engineers and support teams investigating provisioning failures.
attributes.references: Nokia NetAct — Fault Management; ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management

attributes.name: iccid
attributes.description: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier (ICCID) — the unique serial number of the SIM or eSIM card — associated with this provisioning request. Used to link the provisioning action to the physical or embedded SIM being activated.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.118 — ICCID; GSMA SGP.02 — eSIM Specification; 3GPP TS 22.022

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity (IMSI) — a unique 15-digit identifier stored on the SIM/eSIM — being provisioned in the HLR/HSS/UDM. Applicable for mobile service activations and MNP port-in operations. Classified as restricted PII as it uniquely identifies a subscriber.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003 — Numbering, Addressing and Identification; GSMA SGP.02 — eSIM; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: ip_address_assigned
attributes.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address assigned to the subscriber or CPE device as part of this provisioning action. Populated by the IP Address Management (IPAM) system upon successful provisioning. Applicable for broadband, FTTH, and fixed-line services.
