attributes.references: IETF RFC 791 — IPv4; IETF RFC 8200 — IPv6; TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource

attributes.name: is_rollback_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a rollback of previously applied provisioning changes is required due to a downstream failure in a multi-step orchestration workflow. When TRUE, the OSM compensation workflow is triggered to reverse partial provisioning actions.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) — Order Orchestration; TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment

attributes.name: last_retry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent retry attempt for this provisioning request. Used in conjunction with retry_count to calculate retry intervals and enforce exponential backoff policies.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment

attributes.name: max_retry_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of retry attempts configured for this provisioning request before it is escalated or marked as permanently failed. Derived from the service type SLA policy at the time of request creation.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Management

attributes.name: mnp_donor_operator_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Donor Operator Code
attributes.description: For Mobile Number Portability (MNP) PORT_IN provisioning actions, the network operator code of the donor (losing) operator from whom the number is being ported. Populated per GSMA PRD IR.26 and national MNP regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — MNP; 3GPP TS 22.042 — MNP; FCC 47 CFR Part 52 — Number Portability; Ofcom — General Conditions

attributes.name: mnp_port_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual date on which the Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in or port-out is to be executed. Applicable only when provisioning_action is PORT_IN or PORT_OUT. Governed by national MNP regulatory timelines.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — MNP; FCC 47 CFR Part 52 — Number Portability; Ofcom — General Conditions of Entitlement

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN) — the subscriber's mobile phone number — being provisioned or modified. Applicable for mobile service provisioning actions. Classified as confidential PII as it directly identifies a subscriber.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003 — Numbering, Addressing and Identification; ITU-T E.164 — Numbering Plan; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: network_region_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic network region or Point of Presence (POP) within which the provisioning action is being executed. Used for regional capacity planning, NOC routing, and geographic SLA analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource; ITU-T M.3010 — TMN Principles; Nokia NetAct — Configuration Management

attributes.name: ont_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the Optical Network Terminal (ONT) / Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) device being provisioned on the GPON OLT for FTTH fiber services. Used to bind the physical device to the subscriber's service profile in the OLT configuration.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.984 — GPON; ITU-T G.988 — ONU Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this provisioning request, determining queue position and resource allocation in the OSM orchestration engine. CRITICAL: emergency/regulatory-mandated; HIGH: premium customer or SLA-sensitive; MEDIUM: standard commercial; LOW: batch/bulk provisioning.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Priority

attributes.name: provisioning_action
attributes.description: The type of provisioning operation to be performed on the target OSS system. ACTIVATE: new service activation; MODIFY: change of service parameters; DEACTIVATE: service disconnection; SUSPEND: temporary service suspension; RESUME: reinstatement after suspension; PORT_IN: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) inbound port; PORT_OUT: MNP outbound port. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ACTIVATE|MODIFY|DEACTIVATE|SUSPEND|RESUME|PORT_IN|PORT_OUT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment; 3GPP TS 22.042 — MNP; GSMA PRD IR.26 — MNP

attributes.name: provisioning_outcome
attributes.description: Final result of the provisioning execution as reported by the target OSS system. SUCCESS: service fully activated/modified/deactivated as requested; FAILURE: provisioning could not be completed; TIMEOUT: target system did not respond within the configured timeout window; PARTIAL: some but not all service components were provisioned (e.g., multi-component service). Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category for non-monetary transactions.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment Order

attributes.name: qos_profile_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Quality of Service (QoS) profile to be applied to the service being provisioned. Maps to a predefined QoS template in the PCF/PCRF defining bandwidth limits, priority class, and traffic shaping parameters.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.203 — Policy and Charging Control; TM Forum SID GB922 — Service Quality

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the provisioning request as generated by Oracle Communications OSM (e.g., PROV-2024-0001234). Used for cross-system traceability across OSS/BSS platforms. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment Order

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the provisioning request. PENDING: awaiting dispatch; DISPATCHED: sent to target OSS system; IN_PROGRESS: being processed by target system; SUCCESS: provisioning completed successfully; FAILURE: provisioning failed; TIMEOUT: no acknowledgement received within SLA window; CANCELLED: request withdrawn before execution. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|DISPATCHED|IN_PROGRESS|SUCCESS|FAILURE|TIMEOUT|CANCELLED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment Order State Machine

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times this provisioning request has been retried after an initial failure or timeout. Used to enforce maximum retry policies, trigger escalation workflows, and analyze systemic provisioning issues.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment

attributes.name: rollback_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the rollback compensation action was executed for this provisioning request. Populated only when is_rollback_required is TRUE and the rollback has been completed.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) — Order Orchestration; TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment

attributes.name: scheduled_activation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the service activation or modification is scheduled to take effect, as agreed with the customer or mandated by the order. May differ from dispatch_timestamp for future-dated provisioning requests.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM); TM Forum SID GB922 — Fulfillment Order

attributes.name: service_parameters_payload
attributes.description: Serialized (JSON or XML) payload containing the service-specific configuration parameters dispatched to the target OSS system. For mobile services: MSISDN, IMSI, APN, QoS profile; for FTTH/GPON: ONT serial number, VLAN ID, bandwidth profile; for IMS: SIP URI, codec list. Stored as STRING to accommodate heterogeneous service types.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.401 — EPS Architecture; ITU-T G.984 — GPON; ETSI TS 124 229 — IMS SIP

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the telecommunications service being provisioned. Determines the provisioning workflow, target OSS system, and service parameters payload structure. Examples: MOBILE (LTE/5G NR), BROADBAND (DSL/cable), FIBER_FTTH (Gigabit Passive Optical Network), VoIP, IPTV, FIXED_LINE, SD-WAN, MPLS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOBILE|BROADBAND|FIBER_FTTH|VOIP|IPTV|FIXED_LINE|SD_WAN|MPLS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Service Specification; ITU-T Y.2001 — NGN Framework

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provisioning request breached its SLA target duration. Set to TRUE when the actual provisioning duration exceeded sla_target_duration_seconds. Used for SLA reporting, penalty calculations, and operational performance management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Management; FCC Broadband Performance Standards; Ofcom — Quality of Service Regulations

attributes.name: sla_target_duration_seconds
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Provisioning Duration (Seconds)
attributes.description: The contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) target duration in seconds within which this provisioning request must be completed end-to-end. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and breach detection in NOC dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA Management; FCC Broadband Performance Standards; Ofcom — Quality of Service Regulations

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the upstream BSS/OSS system that originated this provisioning request. OSM: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; NETCRACKER: Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite; AMDOCS: Amdocs Revenue Management; COMVERSE: Comverse ONE prepaid charging; MANUAL: manually created by NOC operator.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity Lifecycle; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM)

attributes.name: target_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the downstream OSS system to which this provisioning instruction is dispatched. Valid values include: HLR (Home Location Register), HSS (Home Subscriber Server), UDM (Unified Data Management), IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem), GPON_OLT (Gigabit Passive Optical Network Optical Line Terminal), IPAM (IP Address Management), DSLAM (Digital Subscriber Line Access Multiplexer), RAN (Radio Access Network), PCRF (Policy and Charging Rules Function), PCF (Policy Control Function). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HLR|HSS|UDM|IMS|GPON_OLT|IPAM|DSLAM|RAN|PCRF|PCF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.002 — Network Architecture; ETSI TS 123 002; TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource

attributes.name: target_system_instance_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific system instance or node within the target OSS system (e.g., HSS cluster node ID, OLT shelf/port identifier) to which the provisioning command is routed. Supports multi-node environments and geo-redundant deployments.
attributes.references: Ericsson Network Manager — Core Network Management; Nokia NetAct — Configuration Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this provisioning request record was last modified. Tracks state transitions, retry events, and status updates for audit trail and data lineage. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity Lifecycle

attributes.name: vlan_number
attributes.description: The Virtual LAN (VLAN) ID assigned to the subscriber's service on the GPON OLT or DSLAM for traffic segregation and QoS enforcement. Applicable for FTTH and broadband service provisioning.
attributes.references: IEEE 802.1Q — VLAN Tagging; ITU-T G.984 — GPON; TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource

products.name: service_qualification
products.description: Pre-order service qualification check record determining whether a customer address or network location is eligible for a requested service (FTTH, GPON, LTE, 5G NR, ADSL, VDSL). Captures qualification request timestamp, customer address reference, requested service type, qualification outcome (ELIGIBLE, NOT_ELIGIBLE, ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS), available technology options, maximum achievable bandwidth, estimated installation lead time, and network node reference. Drives product offer eligibility in the sales and ordering flow.
products.reference: TM Forum SID ServiceQualification (TMF645)

attributes.name: service_qualification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the service qualification record. Primary key for the service_qualification data product in the order domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management

attributes.name: content_channel_lineup_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.channel_lineup. Business justification: Geographic qualification determines available channel lineups (regional sports blackouts, local broadcast affiliates vary by market). Real process: IPTV feasibility assessment returns specific lineup

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise service qualification requests require corporate account linkage for credit validation, contract eligibility checks, account-level service portfolio management, and pre-sales feasibility an

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (prospect or existing subscriber) on whose behalf the service qualification is being performed. Links to the customer master in Salesforce CRM / Netcracker BSS. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Party Management; Salesforce CRM Customer 360

attributes.name: customer_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer premises or installation address record against which the network eligibility check is performed. Resolves to the address master in Netcracker Resource Inventory or the geographic address repository.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Geographic Address; TMF673 Geographic Address Management API

attributes.name: exchange_id
attributes.description: Reference to the serving network node (e.g., OLT, DSLAM, BNG, eNodeB, gNodeB) identified as the nearest eligible network access point for the qualified address. Sourced from Netcracker Resource Inventory or Ericsson Network Manager.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order or pre-order request that triggered this service qualification check in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. Null if the qualification was initiated as a standalone eligibility check outside of a formal order.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management; Oracle OSM

attributes.name: mvno_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.mvno_profile. Business justification: MVNO service qualifications must check MVNO-specific constraints: subscriber capacity limits, IMSI/MSISDN range availability, spectrum access rights, and technical capabilities - required for MVNO sub

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_package. Business justification: Address qualification for IPTV checks which content packages are technically feasible (4K/UHD requires fiber bandwidth, HD requires minimum DSL speed). Real process: pre-sale service availability and

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.premise. Business justification: Qualifications assess premise-level serviceability flags (fttp_serviceable_flag, hfc_serviceable_flag, fwa_serviceable_flag) to determine technology options and installation requirements. Direct FK en

attributes.name: product_offering_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product offering in the Netcracker Product Catalog for which eligibility is being assessed. Drives which product offers are surfaced to the sales agent or digital channel upon a positive qualification outcome.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Product Catalog; TMF620 Product Catalog Management API

attributes.name: ran_cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.ran_cell. Business justification: Mobile service qualification identifies serving cell, measures signal strength, and validates capacity availability. Critical pre-sale process for determining mobile service eligibility and setting cu

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the customer premises being qualified for service. Captured at qualification time as a point-in-time snapshot to avoid dependency on address master changes post-qualification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; TM Forum TMF673 Geographic Address Management API

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (apartment, suite, floor, unit number) of the customer premises being qualified. Nullable for single-dwelling units.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; TM Forum TMF673 Geographic Address Management API

attributes.name: available_technology_options
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of all access technologies technically available at the qualified address (e.g., 'FTTH|LTE|5G_NR'). Enables the sales system to present all eligible product offers, not just the primary requested technology. Sourced from Netcracker Resource Inventory network coverage data.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: broadband_subsidy_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service address qualifies for government broadband subsidy programs (e.g., FCC Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP), NTIA BEAD, UK Gigabit Voucher Scheme). Determined based on regulatory_zone_code and address-level coverage data. Relevant for compliance reporting to FCC, NTIA, and Ofcom.
attributes.references: FCC Affordable Connectivity Program (ACP); NTIA BEAD Program; Ofcom Gigabit Voucher Scheme; BEREC

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the service installation address. Used for geographic coverage reporting and network rollout planning analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF673 Geographic Address Management API; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: constraint_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any technical or operational constraints identified during the qualification check when the outcome is ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS. Examples: 'Maximum speed limited to 100 Mbps due to copper loop length', 'CPE upgrade required', 'Shared GPON port — peak-hour congestion possible'. Null when outcome is ELIGIBLE or NOT_ELIGIBLE.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the service installation address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Required for multi-country operators and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: cpe_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) installation or upgrade is required to deliver the requested service at the qualified address. True: CPE installation/upgrade is mandatory; False: existing CPE is compatible or no CPE is needed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Oracle OSM Service Fulfillment

attributes.name: cpe_type
attributes.description: Type of CPE required for service delivery at the qualified address. ONT (Optical Network Terminal) for FTTH/GPON; ROUTER for broadband; MODEM for DSL; GATEWAY for combined modem/router; OUTDOOR_UNIT/INDOOR_UNIT for fixed wireless. Null when cpe_required is False.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.984.2 (ONT/GPON); TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this service qualification record was first persisted in the Silver layer data product. Populated by the ingestion pipeline from Oracle OSM source system.

attributes.name: estimated_installation_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Estimated number of calendar days from order confirmation to service activation at the qualified address. Derived from field workforce availability (Granite WFM), infrastructure readiness, and network node capacity. Displayed to customers during the ordering flow to set delivery expectations.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — Service Fulfillment; Oracle OSM Order Orchestration; Granite WFM

attributes.name: estimated_latency_ms
attributes.description: Estimated round-trip network latency in milliseconds at the qualified address for the requested service type. Relevant for QoS-sensitive product offers (VoLTE, gaming, enterprise SD-WAN) and SLA eligibility determination.
attributes.references: ITU-T Y.1541 (QoS); 3GPP TS 22.261; TM Forum SLA Management

attributes.name: field_survey_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical field survey by a Telecommunication technician is required before service can be provisioned at this address. True when infrastructure readiness is PARTIAL or NOT_READY, or when the qualification engine cannot determine feasibility remotely. Triggers a field dispatch work order in Granite WFM.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — Service Fulfillment; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: ineligibility_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the address is NOT_ELIGIBLE for the requested service. NO_COVERAGE: outside network footprint; CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED: node at full capacity; INFRASTRUCTURE_NOT_BUILT: planned but not yet deployed; ADDRESS_NOT_FOUND: address could not be geocoded or matched; TECHNICAL_BARRIER: physical impediment; REGULATORY_RESTRICTION: regulatory constraint. Null when outcome is ELIGIBLE or ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; FCC Broadband Data Collection

attributes.name: infrastructure_readiness
attributes.description: Indicates the physical network infrastructure readiness at or near the service address. READY: full infrastructure in place; PARTIAL: partial build-out, service possible with constraints; NOT_READY: no infrastructure present; UNDER_CONSTRUCTION: active network build in progress with a planned completion date.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent update to this service qualification record in the Silver layer. Updated on any status change, outcome determination, or data correction.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the service installation point. Used for precise network coverage mapping, field dispatch routing via Granite WFM, and FCC broadband location fabric matching.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection — Location Fabric; WGS84; NTIA BroadbandUSA

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the service installation point. Used in conjunction with latitude for geospatial coverage analysis and network node proximity calculations.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection — Location Fabric; WGS84; NTIA BroadbandUSA

attributes.name: max_download_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum technically achievable downstream bandwidth in Megabits per second (Mbps) at the qualified address, as determined by the network qualification engine based on distance to node, line quality, and technology capability. Drives product tier eligibility in the sales flow.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection; ITU-T G.9700 (G.fast); 3GPP TS 38.306 (5G NR); ETSI TS 101 388 (ADSL)

attributes.name: max_upload_speed_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum technically achievable upstream bandwidth in Megabits per second (Mbps) at the qualified address. Critical for symmetric service offerings (FTTH/GPON) and business-grade SLA commitments.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection; ITU-T G.984 (GPON); 3GPP TS 38.306 (5G NR)

attributes.name: mnp_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Mobile Number Portability (MNP) is applicable to this service qualification, relevant for mobile service types (LTE, 5G NR) where the customer intends to port an existing number. True triggers MNP eligibility checks in the downstream order flow.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — Mobile Number Portability; FCC MNP Rules 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or remarks added by the sales agent, network engineer, or automated qualification engine to provide additional context about the qualification result. May include special instructions for the field team, customer-specific considerations, or escalation notes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle OSM

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the service installation address. Key dimension for network coverage gap analysis, FCC broadband availability reporting, and NTIA compliance.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection (BDC); NTIA BroadbandUSA; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: qualification_channel
attributes.description: The sales or service channel through which the qualification request was initiated. ONLINE: digital self-service portal; RETAIL_STORE: in-store agent; CALL_CENTER: inbound/outbound agent via Salesforce CRM; PARTNER_API: wholesale or MVNO partner API; FIELD_AGENT: mobile field sales; SELF_SERVICE: automated IVR or chatbot.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — Customer Relationship Management; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: qualification_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the qualification check was fully resolved and an outcome was determined. Null if the qualification is still IN_PROGRESS or was CANCELLED before completion.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; ISO 8601

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the qualification result is considered stale and must be re-evaluated before an order can be placed. Network conditions, capacity, and infrastructure status can change; this date enforces re-qualification for orders placed after a defined validity window (typically 30–90 days).
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; Oracle OSM Order Orchestration

attributes.name: qualification_outcome
attributes.description: Business result of the pre-order service qualification check. ELIGIBLE: the address/location can receive the requested service without restriction; NOT_ELIGIBLE: service cannot be delivered to this location; ELIGIBLE_WITH_CONSTRAINTS: service is technically feasible but subject to limitations (e.g., reduced bandwidth, extended lead time, CPE upgrade required).
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; ETSI TS 103 221

attributes.name: qualification_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the qualification request by Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM). Used by sales agents and customers to track the qualification check.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — TMF645 Service Qualification API

attributes.name: qualification_request_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the qualification request was submitted by the sales or ordering system. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; ISO 8601

attributes.name: qualification_source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system that submitted the qualification request. OSM: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; SALESFORCE: Salesforce CRM; NETCRACKER: Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite; PARTNER_PORTAL: wholesale/MVNO partner portal; SELF_SERVICE_PORTAL: customer-facing digital portal. Used for data lineage and system-of-record traceability.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Data Lineage; Oracle OSM; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the qualification request workflow within Oracle OSM. IN_PROGRESS: check is being executed; COMPLETED: outcome determined; FAILED: system error prevented completion; CANCELLED: request withdrawn before completion.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: regulatory_zone_code
attributes.description: Regulatory or geographic zone code assigned to the service address, used to determine applicable regulatory obligations (e.g., FCC Universal Service Fund (USF) eligible area, NTIA BEAD-eligible zone, Ofcom Universal Service Obligation (USO) area, BEREC regulated zone). Drives compliance reporting and subsidy eligibility.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund (USF); NTIA BEAD Program; Ofcom USO; BEREC; ITU-T D.50

attributes.name: requalification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this qualification result has been flagged as requiring re-execution before an order can proceed. Set to True when the qualification_expiry_date has passed, when network topology changes have occurred in the serving area, or when the customer requests a different service type.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF645 Service Qualification API v4; Oracle OSM

attributes.name: requested_service_type
attributes.description: The access technology or service type for which eligibility is being assessed. Values align with the network technologies offered by Telecommunication: FTTH (Fiber to the Home), GPON (Gigabit Passive Optical Network), LTE (Long-Term Evolution), 5G NR (5G New Radio), ADSL, VDSL, FTTB (Fiber to the Building), FTTC (Fiber to the Cabinet), FIXED_WIRELESS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTTH|GPON|LTE|5G_NR|ADSL|VDSL|FTTB|FTTC|FIXED_WIRELESS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.261; ITU-T G.984 (GPON); ETSI TS 136 300 (LTE); 3GPP TS 38.300 (5G NR); ITU-T G.992 (ADSL/VDSL)

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Measured or predicted radio signal strength in dBm at the qualified address for wireless service types (LTE, 5G NR, Fixed Wireless). Null for wireline technologies. Sourced from Ericsson Network Manager RAN coverage data or Nokia NetAct RF planning tools.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 36.214 (LTE RSRP); 3GPP TS 38.215 (5G NR RSRP); ITU-R M.2135

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the service installation address. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping (FCC, NTIA) and regional network coverage analytics.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Data Collection; NTIA BroadbandUSA; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: survey_scheduled_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the field survey is scheduled to be conducted at the customer premises, when field_survey_required is True. Populated by Granite WFM upon technician dispatch scheduling. Null when no survey is required.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM

products.name: appointment
products.description: Field technician installation or service appointment record associated with a fulfillment order requiring on-site work — FTTH/GPON installation, CPE swap, ONT replacement, or enterprise circuit commissioning. Captures appointment type, scheduled date and time window, customer address, assigned technician reference (linked to workforce domain), appointment status (SCHEDULED, CONFIRMED, COMPLETED, MISSED, RESCHEDULED), customer confirmation flag, and completion notes. Integrates with Granite Telecommunications WFM for dispatch.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Appointment (TMF646) / Granite WFM

attributes.name: appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the field technician appointment record within the order fulfillment domain. Primary key for the appointment data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order & Fulfillment Domain

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Field service appointments incur direct costs (technician labor, vehicle, materials) that must be allocated to cost centers for workforce management budgeting and field operations cost control.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom the on-site appointment is being conducted. Enables customer-centric reporting and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer Domain; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.depot. Business justification: Appointments are scheduled from depots managing technician territories and service zones. Essential for capacity planning, technician assignment optimization, and tracking which facility supports cust

attributes.name: enterprise_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.site. Business justification: Field appointments for enterprise customers target specific sites. Critical for technician dispatch, site access coordination, site contact management, and tracking installation history per location.

attributes.name: inventory_cpe_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cpe_asset. Business justification: Field appointments install or swap specific CPE devices at customer premises. Real business need: technician dispatch with correct device, installation verification, asset tracking, warranty activatio

attributes.name: location_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.location_address. Business justification: Field technician appointments require precise service location for dispatch routing, travel time estimation, and on-site work. Currently denormalized across 6 address columns. Direct FK enables workfo

attributes.name: noc_incident_id
attributes.description: Reference to a ServiceNow ITSM incident record associated with this appointment, if the appointment was triggered by or resulted in a fault management incident. Enables cross-domain traceability between order fulfillment and fault management.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management; TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6 — Fault Management

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order that triggered this appointment. Links the appointment to the end-to-end order lifecycle managed in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management; Oracle Communications OSM

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned field technician from the workforce domain. Populated by Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management (WFM) during dispatch scheduling.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: access_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for the field technician to gain access to the customer premises (e.g., gate codes, building manager contact, parking instructions, safety requirements). Critical for enterprise and multi-dwelling unit installations.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum SID GB922 — Geographic Address

attributes.name: actual_arrival_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the field technician arrived at the customer premises. Compared against scheduled_start_time to measure on-time arrival performance and SLA adherence.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM; FCC Broadband Performance Standards

attributes.name: actual_completion_time
attributes.description: Actual date and time the field technician completed the on-site work and closed the appointment. Used to calculate job duration, MTTR (Mean Time to Repair), and workforce productivity metrics.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM; KPI: MTTR

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time in minutes taken to complete the on-site work, calculated from actual_arrival_time to actual_completion_time. Used for workforce productivity analysis and future duration estimation model training.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM; KPI: MTTR

attributes.name: appointment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable appointment reference number communicated to the customer and field technician. Follows the format APT-NNNNNNNNNN. Used in customer notifications, WFM dispatch sheets, and trouble ticket references.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Scheduling; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the appointment. Drives downstream workflow actions: SCHEDULED (created, not yet confirmed), CONFIRMED (customer acknowledged), COMPLETED (work done), MISSED (technician or customer no-show), RESCHEDULED (new slot assigned), CANCELLED (appointment voided).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment Entity; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the on-site work to be performed. Drives technician skill matching, equipment pre-staging, and estimated duration in WFM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTTH_INSTALLATION|GPON_INSTALLATION|CPE_SWAP|ONT_REPLACEMENT|ENTERPRISE_CIRCUIT_COMMISSIONING|FAULT_REPAIR|UPGRADE|DOWNGRADE|DISCONNECTION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6 — Service Problem Management; FTTH Council; ITU-T G.984 GPON

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the field technician upon appointment completion. Captures work performed, issues encountered, materials used, and any follow-up actions required. Populated when appointment_status is COMPLETED.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management

attributes.name: confirmation_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer confirmed the appointment. Supports omnichannel analytics and confirmation effectiveness reporting. Populated only when customer_confirmed is True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer Interaction; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: confirmation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer confirmed the appointment. Populated only when customer_confirmed is True. Used for lead-time analysis and confirmation workflow SLA measurement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: cpe_model
attributes.description: Model identifier of the Customer Premises Equipment (CPE) or Optical Network Terminal (ONT) to be installed, swapped, or replaced during the appointment. Used for pre-staging equipment and inventory reservation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS — Resource Inventory; ITU-T G.984

attributes.name: cpe_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the specific CPE or ONT unit assigned for installation or replacement. Enables asset tracking, warranty management, and post-installation inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Inventory; Netcracker OSS/BSS; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appointment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field aligned with data governance and regulatory record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: customer_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has explicitly confirmed the scheduled appointment. True = confirmed by customer; False = not yet confirmed. Drives automated reminder workflows and no-show risk scoring.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: customer_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the customer or on-site contact person who will be present during the appointment. Required for technician identification and access coordination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; TM Forum SID GB922 — Party Contact

attributes.name: customer_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the on-site contact person for appointment day coordination, technician arrival notification, and access instructions. Follows ITU-T E.164 format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; ITU-T E.164; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dispatch_work_order_number
attributes.description: External work order reference number generated by Granite Telecommunications WFM upon technician dispatch. Used to cross-reference appointment records with WFM dispatch sheets and field activity logs.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Field Dispatch; TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes required to complete the on-site work. Derived from appointment type and technology type during WFM scheduling. Used for route optimization and technician capacity planning.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Route Optimization; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: follow_up_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of why a follow-up appointment or action is required. Populated only when follow_up_required is True. Used for work order creation and technician briefing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; ServiceNow ITSM — Incident Management; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up appointment or action is required after this appointment. True = follow-up needed (e.g., incomplete installation, pending network provisioning). Triggers creation of a new appointment or trouble ticket.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; ServiceNow ITSM — Problem Management; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the appointment record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: missed_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the appointment was missed. Populated only when appointment_status is MISSED. Used for SLA breach analysis, customer compensation workflows, and workforce accountability reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; FCC Broadband Service Standards; Granite Telecommunications WFM

attributes.name: osm_task_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) Task ID
attributes.description: Task identifier from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) that corresponds to the appointment fulfillment step in the order orchestration workflow. Enables end-to-end order traceability.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM — Order Orchestration; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the appointment, influencing scheduling queue position and technician dispatch urgency. CRITICAL is reserved for enterprise SLA-bound circuits and regulatory commitments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment Priority; FCC Broadband Service Standards; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: reschedule_count
attributes.description: Number of times this appointment has been rescheduled. Tracks appointment instability, customer experience impact, and operational efficiency. High reschedule counts may trigger escalation workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM; KPI: FCR (First Call Resolution)

attributes.name: reschedule_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the most recent reschedule of this appointment. Populated when appointment_status is RESCHEDULED. Used for root cause analysis and operational improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_REQUEST|TECHNICIAN_UNAVAILABLE|WEATHER|EQUIPMENT_NOT_READY|ACCESS_ISSUE|NETWORK_DEPENDENCY|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment; Granite Telecommunications WFM; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the field technician appointment is scheduled to occur. Used for day-level planning, route optimization, and customer communication.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Scheduling; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the appointment window is scheduled to end. Defines the committed service window communicated to the customer and used for SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Scheduling; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Broadband Service Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the appointment window is scheduled to begin. Used for technician dispatch, customer notification, and SLA (Service Level Agreement) measurement.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Dispatch; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Broadband Service Standards

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the customer service segment for which the appointment is being conducted. Drives SLA tier assignment, technician skill requirements, and regulatory reporting categorization.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Service Classification; FCC Broadband Data Collection

attributes.name: sla_commitment_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Commitment Met Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the appointment was completed within the committed SLA (Service Level Agreement) window. True = SLA met; False = SLA breached. Drives regulatory reporting, customer compensation, and performance dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA; FCC Broadband Service Standards; BEREC Guidelines; Ofcom — UK Service Standards

attributes.name: sla_target_date
attributes.description: The contractual or regulatory deadline by which the appointment must be completed to satisfy the SLA commitment. Derived from order creation date and applicable SLA tier.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — SLA; FCC Broadband Service Standards; BEREC Guidelines; Ofcom

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this appointment record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking. Primary source is Granite Telecommunications WFM; secondary sources include Oracle OSM and Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Data Lineage; ISO/IEC 27001; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: Network access technology associated with the appointment work. Determines required technician certifications, tools, and equipment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTTH|GPON|FTTB|HFC|DSL|FIXED_WIRELESS|ENTERPRISE_FIBER|5G_FWA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ITU-T G.984 GPON; FTTH Council; TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Technology; ETSI

attributes.name: wfm_job_reference
attributes.description: Unique job identifier assigned by Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management system for this appointment. Enables bidirectional traceability between the order domain and the WFM dispatch system.
attributes.references: Granite Telecommunications WFM — Scheduling; TM Forum TAM

products.name: sla
products.description: SLA commitment record attached to a fulfillment order or order type, defining the contracted or regulatory completion timeframe. Captures SLA type (regulatory, commercial, enterprise), target completion hours, warning threshold hours, breach threshold hours, measurement start event, measurement end event, current SLA status (ON_TRACK, AT_RISK, BREACHED), breach timestamp if applicable, and applicable regulatory body (FCC, Ofcom, BEREC). Enables real-time SLA monitoring and regulatory compliance reporting.
products.reference: TM Forum SID SLA / eTOM SLA Management

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the order SLA commitment record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner_agreement. Business justification: Partner-originated orders may have SLA terms defined in partner agreements rather than standard retail SLAs - required for partner SLA compliance measurement and penalty/credit calculation in telecomm

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment order to which this SLA commitment is attached. Links the SLA record to its parent order in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source System Service Level Agreement (SLA) ID
attributes.description: The native SLA record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Oracle OSM SLA task ID, ServiceNow SLA record sys_id). Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and source systems.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Many order SLAs are regulatory-mandated (FCC broadband deployment commitments, EU consumer protection timelines, MNP porting deadlines). Telcos must link SLA definitions to their regulatory source for

attributes.name: sla_template_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sla_template. Business justification: Order SLA measurements must reference the catalog template defining targets, measurement methods, and penalty calculations for compliance reporting, penalty assessment, and service level governance.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Waiver Approved By Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: Regulatory SLA waivers (e.g., force majeure, customer-caused delay) require documented approval by authorized personnel in telecom. Linking to approving employee enables compliance audit trail, regula

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Actual Completion Timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the measurement_end_event occurred, marking fulfillment of the order. Null if the order has not yet been completed. Used to compute final SLA outcome (met or breached) for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: breach_notification_sent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Notification Sent Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal breach notification has been dispatched to the customer and/or regulatory authority (True) following a BREACHED status. Required for compliance with FCC, Ofcom, and BEREC breach reporting obligations.
attributes.references: FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: breach_notification_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Notification Timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the breach notification was sent to the customer and/or regulatory authority. Null if no notification has been sent. Used to verify compliance with mandatory notification timeframes.
attributes.references: FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: breach_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of elapsed hours from the measurement start event at which the SLA is formally classified as BREACHED. May equal target_completion_hours or include a grace period defined in the contract or regulatory instrument.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: breach_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the SLA was formally classified as BREACHED (i.e., elapsed hours exceeded breach_threshold_hours). Null if the SLA has not been breached. Critical for regulatory penalty calculations and breach notification obligations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: calendar_type
attributes.description: Defines how elapsed time is measured for this SLA: CALENDAR_HOURS (24x7 clock), BUSINESS_HOURS (measured only during defined business operating hours), or BUSINESS_DAYS (measured in working days). Determines how target_completion_timestamp is calculated.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: clock_suspended
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Clock Suspended Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA measurement clock is currently paused (True) due to a customer hold, third-party dependency, or regulatory exclusion event. When True, elapsed_hours accumulation is halted until the clock is resumed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this SLA record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty_credit_amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Ensures multi-currency support for international operations.

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: The customer segment to which the order and SLA apply: CONSUMER (residential), SMB (Small and Medium Business), ENTERPRISE (large corporate), WHOLESALE (carrier/partner), or MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator). Determines SLA tier and applicable contractual terms.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA PRD

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective From Date
attributes.description: The date from which this SLA definition version became effective. Used for SLA versioning and to ensure the correct SLA terms are applied to orders placed within a given period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Effective Until Date
attributes.description: The date until which this SLA definition version remains effective. Null for open-ended SLA definitions. Used for SLA versioning and regulatory compliance period tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: elapsed_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours elapsed since the measurement start event as of the last status evaluation. Used for real-time SLA monitoring dashboards and regulatory compliance reporting. Excludes any suspended clock periods.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Current escalation tier for this SLA record (e.g., 0 = no escalation, 1 = team lead, 2 = manager, 3 = executive). Incremented automatically by the SLA monitoring engine as thresholds are crossed. Used for NOC and operations reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; ServiceNow ITSM; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: measurement_end_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement End Event
attributes.description: The business event that stops the SLA clock and marks fulfillment completion. Used to calculate actual elapsed time against the SLA target. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SERVICE_ACTIVATED|ORDER_COMPLETED|PORT_COMPLETED|FAULT_RESOLVED|CPE_INSTALLED|CUSTOMER_CONFIRMED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: measurement_start_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Event
attributes.description: The business event that triggers the start of SLA clock measurement. Defines the precise moment from which target completion hours are counted, per regulatory or contractual terms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_SUBMITTED|ORDER_ACCEPTED|PAYMENT_CONFIRMED|SITE_SURVEY_COMPLETE|PORT_REQUEST_SUBMITTED|TECHNICIAN_DISPATCHED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: measurement_start_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Measurement Start Timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the SLA clock started, corresponding to the occurrence of the measurement_start_event. This is the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for SLA clock initiation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO 8601; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments associated with this SLA record, such as escalation context, customer communication history, or regulatory exception justifications. Intended for NOC and operations team use.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: penalty_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Applicable Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial penalty or service credit is contractually or regulatorily applicable upon breach of this SLA (True). Drives downstream penalty calculation and credit note generation in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions; FCC Order 22-58; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: penalty_credit_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Penalty Credit Amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the service credit or penalty payable to the customer upon SLA breach, expressed in the billing currency. Null if penalty_applicable is False or if the breach has not yet been assessed. Feeds into Amdocs Revenue Management credit note generation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; Ofcom General Conditions; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The operational priority assigned to this SLA record, used to drive escalation routing and resource allocation in ServiceNow ITSM and Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. CRITICAL typically applies to regulatory MNP or enterprise SLAs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this SLA commitment record, used in regulatory submissions, customer communications, and cross-system reconciliation (e.g., SLA-2024-00123456). Sourced from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Order 22-58; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: The regulatory authority whose rules govern this SLA commitment: FCC (Federal Communications Commission, USA), OFCOM (Office of Communications, UK), BEREC (Body of European Regulators for Electronic Communications), ITU (International Telecommunication Union), ETSI, NTIA, GSMA, or NONE for purely commercial SLAs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FCC|OFCOM|BEREC|ITU|ETSI|NTIA|GSMA|NONE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ITU-T E.800; GSMA PRD

attributes.name: regulatory_instrument_reference
attributes.description: The specific regulatory rule, order, or directive citation that mandates this SLA (e.g., 'FCC 47 CFR Part 52 Section 52.35', 'Ofcom General Conditions C5.3', 'BEREC Guidelines on Switching 2020'). Enables precise regulatory compliance traceability.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines on Switching

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of telecommunications service to which this SLA applies: MOBILE, BROADBAND, FIBER_FTTH (Fiber to the Home), VOIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), IPTV (Internet Protocol Television), ENTERPRISE_MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching), SD_WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network), or FIXED_LINE. Determines applicable SLA regime and regulatory framework. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOBILE|BROADBAND|FIBER_FTTH|VOIP|IPTV|ENTERPRISE_MPLS|SD_WAN|FIXED_LINE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; 3GPP TS 22.261; ITU-T G.984 (GPON/FTTH); FCC Broadband Data Collection

attributes.name: sla_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the SLA defining the business process it governs: PROVISIONING (new service activation), REPAIR (fault resolution), PORTABILITY (Mobile Number Portability / MNP), INSTALLATION (physical CPE or FTTH installation), ACTIVATION (service turn-up), or DISCONNECTION (service termination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PROVISIONING|REPAIR|PORTABILITY|INSTALLATION|ACTIVATION|DISCONNECTION — promote to reference product if additional categories are required]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; 3GPP TS 22.261; GSMA PRD IR.73 (MNP)

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current real-time status of the SLA commitment: ON_TRACK (within target), AT_RISK (warning threshold exceeded), BREACHED (breach threshold exceeded), COMPLETED (fulfilled within SLA), WAIVED (SLA obligation formally waived), or SUSPENDED (clock paused due to customer or third-party hold).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SLA commitment: REGULATORY (mandated by FCC, Ofcom, BEREC, or ITU), COMMERCIAL (contractually agreed with the customer), ENTERPRISE (premium business customer SLA), or INTERNAL (operational target not contractually binding).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 64; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this SLA record originated: ORACLE_OSM (Oracle Communications Order and Service Management), NETCRACKER (Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite), SERVICENOW (ServiceNow ITSM), AMDOCS (Amdocs Revenue Management), or MANUAL (manually entered).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Clock Suspension Reason
attributes.description: The reason the SLA measurement clock was most recently suspended. Used for regulatory exclusion reporting and dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_HOLD|THIRD_PARTY_DEPENDENCY|REGULATORY_EXCLUSION|FORCE_MAJEURE|AWAITING_PAYMENT|SITE_ACCESS_DENIED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC Order 22-58; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: target_completion_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Hours
attributes.description: The contracted or regulatory maximum number of hours within which the order must be fulfilled from the measurement start event. This is the primary SLA commitment value (e.g., 24.00 hours for MNP port-in per FCC rules, 48.00 hours for residential broadband activation).
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52 (MNP); Ofcom General Conditions C5; BEREC Guidelines on Switching; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: target_completion_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Timestamp
attributes.description: The calculated deadline timestamp by which the order must be fulfilled to meet the SLA commitment. Derived from measurement_start_timestamp plus target_completion_hours, adjusted for any calendar or business-hours rules. Stored for direct comparison in monitoring queries.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions C5

attributes.name: total_suspended_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Total Suspended Hours
attributes.description: Cumulative number of hours the SLA clock has been suspended for this record due to customer holds, third-party delays, or regulatory exclusions. Subtracted from gross elapsed time to compute net elapsed hours for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions C5; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this SLA record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED timestamp for change tracking, incremental processing, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the SLA template or regulatory instrument applied to this record (e.g., 'v2.1', '2024-Q1'). Enables tracking of SLA policy changes over time and ensures correct terms are applied for historical reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the SLA obligation was formally waived (e.g., customer-requested delay, force majeure, regulatory exclusion). Populated only when sla_status is WAIVED. Required for audit and regulatory justification.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ofcom General Conditions; FCC Order 22-58

attributes.name: warning_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Warning Threshold Hours
attributes.description: The number of elapsed hours from the measurement start event at which the SLA status transitions to AT_RISK, triggering proactive escalation workflows in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management and ServiceNow ITSM. Typically set as a percentage of target_completion_hours (e.g., 75%).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: warning_triggered_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Warning Triggered Timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the SLA status transitioned to AT_RISK (warning threshold exceeded). Used to measure the effectiveness of proactive escalation workflows and to audit response times.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management; ServiceNow ITSM

products.name: notification
products.description: Outbound notification record dispatched to customers or internal stakeholders at key order lifecycle milestones — order confirmation, appointment reminder, provisioning completion, port-in execution, and order cancellation. Captures notification type, delivery channel (SMS, email, push, IVR), recipient reference, dispatch timestamp, delivery status (SENT, DELIVERED, FAILED, BOUNCED), template version, and language code. Supports regulatory notification obligations for MNP and service disconnection.
products.reference: TM Forum SID CustomerNotification

attributes.name: notification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each outbound order notification record dispatched to a customer or internal stakeholder. Primary key of the order_notification data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification entity

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is the primary recipient of this notification. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Customer 360 and used to resolve recipient contact details.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Customer entity; Salesforce CRM Customer 360

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order that triggered this notification. Links the notification to the end-to-end order lifecycle managed in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CustomerOrder entity; Oracle OSM Order reference

attributes.name: privacy_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_consent. Business justification: Notifications (SMS, email, push) require consent verification under privacy regulations (GDPR Article 6, FCC CPNI rules). Real-world telco notification systems check consent records before dispatching

attributes.name: template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the notification template used to render the message content. Links to the notification template catalog managed in the BSS product/service catalog (Netcracker OSS/BSS).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationTemplate entity; Netcracker OSS/BSS Product Catalog

attributes.name: appointment_date
attributes.description: The scheduled field technician appointment date included in appointment reminder notifications. Populated only when notification_type is APPOINTMENT_REMINDER. Sourced from Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management scheduling.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment entity; Granite Telecommunications WFM Scheduling

attributes.name: appointment_time_slot
attributes.description: The scheduled appointment time window communicated to the customer in appointment reminder notifications (e.g., AM, PM, or specific time band). Sourced from Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Appointment.timeSlot; Granite Telecommunications WFM Field Dispatch

attributes.name: body_hash
attributes.description: SHA-256 hash of the rendered notification body content at the time of dispatch. Provides tamper-evident audit evidence of the exact message content sent without storing the full message body (which may contain PII).
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Information integrity; GDPR Article 5(1)(f) integrity and confidentiality; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code for order cancellation included in ORDER_CANCELLATION notifications (e.g., CUSTOMER_REQUEST, CREDIT_FAIL, DUPLICATE_ORDER, FRAUD_DETECTED). Populated only when notification_type is ORDER_CANCELLATION.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CustomerOrder.cancellationReason; Oracle OSM Order Cancellation

attributes.name: consent_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's communication consent record that authorises dispatch of this notification via the selected channel. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and TCPA compliance for SMS/IVR channels.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 — Lawful basis; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CCPA Section 1798.120; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this notification record was first created in the order notification system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit logging; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.createdDate; GDPR Article 5(2) accountability

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when delivery confirmation was received from the messaging gateway or carrier, confirming the notification reached the recipient endpoint. Null if delivery has not yet been confirmed or failed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.receivedTime; GSMA PRD IR.73 delivery receipt timestamp

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to dispatch this notification to the recipient (e.g., SMS, EMAIL, PUSH notification, IVR automated call, WhatsApp, or POSTAL mail). Determines routing logic and delivery SLA expectations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ContactMedium.type; ETSI TS 102 690 M2M notification channels

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current delivery outcome status of the notification as reported by the downstream messaging gateway or carrier. SENT = dispatched to gateway; DELIVERED = confirmed receipt by endpoint; FAILED = gateway rejection; BOUNCED = undeliverable address; PENDING = queued for dispatch.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.status; GSMA PRD IR.73 delivery reporting

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the notification was submitted to the messaging gateway or delivery platform. Principal business event timestamp for SLA measurement and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.sendTime; FCC MNP notification timing requirements

attributes.name: failed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when a delivery failure or bounce was reported by the messaging gateway. Populated only when delivery_status is FAILED or BOUNCED. Used to trigger retry logic and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.failureTime; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: The error or failure reason code returned by the messaging gateway when delivery_status is FAILED or BOUNCED (e.g., INVALID_NUMBER, MAILBOX_FULL, UNSUBSCRIBED, NETWORK_ERROR). Used for root cause analysis and retry strategy.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.73 — Delivery failure codes; SMTP RFC 5321 bounce codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: failure_reason_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the delivery failure reason as returned by the messaging gateway. Complements failure_reason_code with additional context for operations and customer service teams.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.failureDescription; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: fallback_channel
attributes.description: The alternative delivery channel to be used if the primary delivery_channel fails after exhausting retry attempts (e.g., fall back to SMS if EMAIL bounces). Supports multi-channel notification resilience.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationPolicy.fallbackChannel; ETSI TS 102 690

attributes.name: fallback_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fallback delivery channel was activated for this notification because the primary channel failed. True = fallback was used; False = primary channel was used.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationPolicy.fallbackTriggered; Oracle OSM Notification Engine

attributes.name: gateway_message_reference
attributes.description: The unique message identifier assigned by the external messaging gateway or carrier (e.g., SMS aggregator message ID, email SMTP message ID, push notification token). Used for delivery receipt correlation and dispute resolution with gateway providers.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.73 — Message reference; SMTP RFC 5321 Message-ID

attributes.name: gateway_provider
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the external messaging gateway or aggregator used to deliver this notification (e.g., Twilio, Syniverse, AWS SNS). Supports vendor performance monitoring and SLA management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — MessageGateway entity; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The IETF BCP 47 language tag identifying the language in which the notification was rendered (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, es-MX). Supports multilingual customer communication obligations and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 Language Tags; TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.language; FCC accessibility requirements

attributes.name: max_retry_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of delivery retry attempts permitted for this notification before it is marked as permanently failed and escalated. Configured per notification_type and delivery_channel in the notification policy.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationPolicy.maxRetries; Oracle OSM Notification Engine

attributes.name: mnp_port_reference
attributes.description: The Mobile Number Portability (MNP) porting reference number included in port-in or port-out notifications. Populated only when order_type is MNP_PORT_IN or MNP_PORT_OUT. Required for regulatory audit under FCC MNP rules and GSMA PRD IR.73.
