attributes.references: FCC MNP Order 18-122; GSMA PRD IR.73 — Number Portability notification; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this notification record (e.g., NTF-0012345678). Used in customer-facing correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory evidence for MNP and disconnection notifications.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.notificationId; FCC MNP notification requirements

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Classifies the business event that triggered this notification. Drives template selection, regulatory logging, and SLA measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_CONFIRMATION|APPOINTMENT_REMINDER|PROVISIONING_COMPLETE|PORT_IN_EXECUTION|ORDER_CANCELLATION|DISCONNECTION_NOTICE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework B2C Notification; FCC MNP Order 18-122; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recipient had opted out of this notification type or delivery channel at the time of dispatch. True = opt-out was recorded (notification may have been suppressed or sent as regulatory override). Used for GDPR/TCPA compliance audit.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 — Right to object; TCPA 47 U.S.C. § 227; CAN-SPAM Act; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: port_execution_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Port Execution Date
attributes.description: The date on which the MNP port-in or port-out was executed, as communicated in PORT_IN_EXECUTION notifications. Required for regulatory audit under FCC MNP Order 18-122 and GSMA PRD IR.73.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order 18-122; GSMA PRD IR.73 — Port execution date; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The dispatch priority assigned to this notification, governing queue position and SLA targets in the messaging gateway. CRITICAL = regulatory/MNP notifications requiring immediate dispatch; HIGH = time-sensitive operational; NORMAL = standard; LOW = informational.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.priority; Oracle OSM Notification Engine priority levels

attributes.name: provisioning_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which service provisioning was completed, as communicated in PROVISIONING_COMPLETE notifications. Sourced from Oracle OSM service fulfillment completion event.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — ServiceOrder.completionDate; Oracle OSM Service Fulfillment

attributes.name: recipient_address
attributes.description: The actual delivery endpoint used for this notification — phone number (E.164 format for SMS/IVR), email address, push device token, or postal address depending on delivery_channel. Stored as dispatched for audit and re-delivery purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation; CCPA Section 1798.140; TM Forum SID GB922 — ContactMedium.medium

attributes.name: recipient_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether the notification was dispatched to an external customer, an internal business stakeholder, a customer service agent, or a field technician. Governs data handling and privacy obligations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Party.partyType; GDPR Article 4 data subject classification

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this notification fulfils a mandatory regulatory obligation (e.g., MNP port-in confirmation, service disconnection advance notice). True = regulatory notification; False = operational/informational notification. Used for compliance reporting to FCC, Ofcom, BEREC.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order 18-122; Ofcom General Conditions of Entitlement; BEREC Guidelines; NTIA

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_reference
attributes.description: The specific regulatory rule, order, or article reference that mandates this notification (e.g., FCC MNP Order 18-122, Ofcom GC C7.9, BEREC Guidelines 2021). Populated only when regulatory_notification_flag is True.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Order 18-122; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of delivery retry attempts made for this notification following an initial FAILED or BOUNCED status. Used to enforce maximum retry policies and trigger escalation to an alternative channel.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 — Notification Retry Management; Oracle OSM Notification Engine

attributes.name: scheduled_dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time at which the notification was scheduled to be dispatched. Compared against dispatch_timestamp to measure scheduling accuracy and identify delayed notifications.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM 1.4.1 — Order Notification Scheduling; Oracle OSM Notification Scheduler

attributes.name: service_number
attributes.description: The MSISDN or service telephone number (E.164 format) associated with the order being notified about. Included in the notification for customer identification and MNP regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164 numbering plan; FCC MNP Order 18-122; GSMA PRD IR.73

attributes.name: source_event_reference
attributes.description: The unique event or transaction identifier from the originating source system (OSM, Salesforce, Amdocs) that triggered this notification. Enables end-to-end traceability from the source business event to the dispatched notification.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Event.eventId; Oracle OSM Event correlation; ISO/IEC 27001 audit trail

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system that triggered this notification event (e.g., OSM = Oracle Communications Order and Service Management, SALESFORCE_CRM, AMDOCS, NETCRACKER, COMVERSE). Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM — OSS/BSS Integration; Oracle OSM; Salesforce CRM; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: The subject line or title of the notification as rendered and dispatched (e.g., email subject line, SMS header, push notification title). Captured for audit, content review, and regulatory evidence.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Notification.subject; CAN-SPAM Act Section 5

attributes.name: template_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the notification template used at the time of dispatch (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables audit of which template content was sent, supporting regulatory compliance and A/B testing analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — NotificationTemplate.version; ISO/IEC 27001 change management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this notification record was last modified (e.g., delivery status updated from SENT to DELIVERED). Audit trail field for change tracking and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit logging; TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.lastModifiedDate; GDPR Article 5(2) accountability

products.name: amendment
products.description: Record of every post-submission modification to a fulfillment order — customer-requested changes to appointment date, product selection, delivery address, or service configuration before order completion. Captures amendment type, amendment request timestamp, original value, new value, amendment status (PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED, APPLIED), approving agent reference, and impact assessment (SLA reset flag, cost delta). Maintains a complete change history for dispute resolution and audit.
products.reference: TM Forum SID OrderAmendment / OSM Change Order

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each order amendment record in the Telecommunication order management system. Primary key for the order_amendment data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Management

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who requested or is impacted by this order amendment. Supports customer-level audit trails and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Customer Domain; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service agent or system identity that approved or rejected this amendment. Used for accountability, quality assurance, and agent performance reporting in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Party Role; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: enterprise_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.enterprise_contract. Business justification: Order amendments for enterprise customers require contract linkage to validate change authorization per contract terms, assess pricing impacts, and trigger contract modification workflows for material

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to its originating order in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item affected by this amendment, when the modification is scoped to a single line rather than the entire order header.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Line Management; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: parent_amendment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to a prior amendment that this record supersedes or is derived from. Supports amendment chains where a rejected amendment is resubmitted with corrections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment History

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field work order created or modified as a result of this amendment, when requires_field_visit is True. Links to the workforce management dispatch record in Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Work Order; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: amended_field_name
attributes.description: The logical name of the order attribute that was changed by this amendment (e.g., appointment_date, delivery_address_id, product_offering_code, service_configuration_value). Enables fine-grained change history and audit trail per field.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this amendment, used in customer communications, agent desktops, and dispute resolution workflows. Format: AMD- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the amendment request: PENDING (submitted, awaiting review), APPROVED (authorised by agent or system), REJECTED (denied), APPLIED (successfully propagated to the fulfillment order), WITHDRAWN (retracted by the customer before decision).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment Lifecycle; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Categorises the nature of the post-submission modification: APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULE (change of installation/delivery date), PRODUCT_CHANGE (swap of selected product or offering), ADDRESS_CHANGE (new delivery or service address), SERVICE_CONFIG_CHANGE (alteration to service parameters), CONTACT_UPDATE (change of contact details), CANCELLATION_REQUEST (request to cancel the order before completion). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULE|PRODUCT_CHANGE|ADDRESS_CHANGE|SERVICE_CONFIG_CHANGE|CONTACT_UPDATE|CANCELLATION_REQUEST — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment Type; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the approved amendment was successfully propagated and applied to the underlying fulfillment order in Oracle Communications Order and Service Management. Null until status reaches APPLIED.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the amendment was approved by an authorised agent or automated workflow. Null if the amendment has not yet been approved or was rejected.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this amendment record to the immutable audit log entry in the compliance audit system (e.g., ServiceNow CMDB audit record or enterprise audit repository). Supports regulatory audit and dispute resolution evidence chains.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB921; FCC Record Retention Rules

attributes.name: billing_adjustment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment triggers a billing adjustment in Amdocs Revenue Management (e.g., pro-rated credit, revised charge). When True, the billing team must process a corresponding adjustment record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Billing; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cost_delta
attributes.description: The incremental cost impact of this amendment on the order, expressed as a signed decimal. Positive values indicate an increase in order cost; negative values indicate a reduction. Used for revenue assurance and billing adjustment workflows in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Financial Impact; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cost_delta_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_delta amount (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Ensures multi-currency support for international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB921

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this amendment record was first persisted in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from requested_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB921

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the customer was notified of the amendment outcome. Null if customer_notified_flag is False. Used for regulatory compliance reporting on customer communication timeliness.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Customer Notification; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: customer_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been formally notified of the amendment outcome (approval, rejection, or application). Supports compliance with customer communication obligations and SLA notification requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Customer Notification; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Ofcom General Conditions

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date by which a PENDING amendment must be approved or it will automatically expire and be treated as WITHDRAWN. Enforces amendment processing SLAs and prevents stale pending requests from blocking order fulfillment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: impact_assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the agent's or system's assessment of the downstream impact of this amendment on network provisioning, billing, scheduling, or third-party dependencies. Used during the approval workflow.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: is_customer_initiated
attributes.description: Distinguishes amendments initiated by the customer from those initiated internally by agents or automated systems (e.g., error corrections, product availability changes). Supports root-cause analysis of amendment volumes and customer experience reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; eTOM Customer Interaction Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent update to this amendment record in the Silver Layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and change detection.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging; TM Forum SID GB921

attributes.name: mnp_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment affects a Mobile Number Portability (MNP) port-in or port-out request associated with the parent order. When True, the MNP coordinator must be notified to update the porting window with the donor or recipient operator.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.26 — Mobile Number Portability; 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC MNP Rules

attributes.name: new_committed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The revised committed delivery or installation date resulting from this amendment, applicable when the amendment type is APPOINTMENT_RESCHEDULE or when sla_reset_flag is True. Null if the amendment does not affect the delivery date.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Fulfillment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The replacement value for the amended field as requested by the customer or agent. Stored as a string to accommodate heterogeneous field types. Becomes the effective value once the amendment status reaches APPLIED.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: original_committed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The committed delivery or installation date that was in effect on the parent order before this amendment was applied. Preserved for SLA impact analysis and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Fulfillment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The value of the amended field as it existed on the order before this amendment was applied. Stored as a string to accommodate heterogeneous field types (dates, codes, identifiers, free text). Essential for dispute resolution and rollback.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this amendment for processing queue management: CRITICAL (immediate action required, e.g., regulatory or safety), HIGH (same-day processing), MEDIUM (standard SLA), LOW (best-effort). Drives agent workqueue ordering.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Priority; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised reason code explaining why the amendment was raised: CUSTOMER_REQUEST (voluntary change), AGENT_ERROR_CORRECTION (fix for data entry error), SYSTEM_ERROR (automated correction), PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE (original product no longer available), ADDRESS_VALIDATION_FAIL (address rejected by validation), SCHEDULING_CONFLICT (appointment slot no longer available). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_REQUEST|AGENT_ERROR_CORRECTION|SYSTEM_ERROR|PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE|ADDRESS_VALIDATION_FAIL|SCHEDULING_CONFLICT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the amendment reason beyond the structured reason code. Captured from agent notes or customer-provided comments during the amendment request.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment is subject to a regulatory hold (e.g., MNP porting window freeze, FCC-mandated processing pause, Ofcom dispute freeze). When True, the amendment cannot be processed until the hold is lifted.
attributes.references: FCC MNP Rules; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines on Number Portability

attributes.name: rejected_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the amendment was rejected. Null if the amendment was not rejected.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code indicating why the amendment was rejected: ORDER_ALREADY_FULFILLED, AMENDMENT_WINDOW_EXPIRED, PRODUCT_NOT_ELIGIBLE, CREDIT_CHECK_FAILED, DUPLICATE_REQUEST, POLICY_VIOLATION. Null when amendment is not in REJECTED status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_ALREADY_FULFILLED|AMENDMENT_WINDOW_EXPIRED|PRODUCT_NOT_ELIGIBLE|CREDIT_CHECK_FAILED|DUPLICATE_REQUEST|POLICY_VIOLATION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the amendment was rejected, provided by the approving agent or automated decision system. Null when amendment is not in REJECTED status.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the customer or agent submitted the amendment request. This is the principal business event timestamp for the amendment lifecycle and is used for SLA measurement and audit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment; ISO 8601

attributes.name: requesting_channel
attributes.description: The customer interaction channel through which the amendment request was submitted: IVR (Interactive Voice Response), AGENT_ASSISTED (call centre), SELF_SERVICE_WEB, SELF_SERVICE_APP, RETAIL_STORE, CHAT, EMAIL. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IVR|AGENT_ASSISTED|SELF_SERVICE_WEB|SELF_SERVICE_APP|RETAIL_STORE|CHAT|EMAIL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Channel; eTOM 1.4.1 Customer Interaction Management

attributes.name: requires_field_visit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment necessitates a new or rescheduled field technician visit (e.g., address change for FTTH installation). Triggers workforce management dispatch in Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management when True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Work Order Management; Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management

attributes.name: servicenow_change_request_reference
attributes.description: The ServiceNow ITSM Change Request identifier raised to govern the technical configuration changes required to fulfil this amendment. Format: CHG followed by 7 digits. Null if no ITSM change request was required.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM — Change Management; ITIL v4 Change Enablement

attributes.name: sla_reset_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether applying this amendment resets the SLA clock on the parent order. True when the amendment materially changes the fulfillment scope (e.g., address change, product swap) and the committed delivery date must be recalculated. Critical for SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — SLA Management; eTOM 1.4.6 Service Level Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating operational system that submitted this amendment: OMS (Oracle Communications Order and Service Management), CRM (Salesforce CRM), SELF_SERVICE (customer portal or app), IVR, RETAIL_POS, BATCH (automated batch correction). Used for lineage and root-cause analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — System of Record; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: source_system_amendment_ref
attributes.description: The native amendment or change-request identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Oracle OMS internal amendment ID, Salesforce case number). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — System Reference; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version counter for amendments on the same order, starting at 1. Enables ordering of the complete change history and identification of the latest amendment state for a given order.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB921 — Order Amendment History; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

products.name: order_charge
products.description: One-time or recurring charge record generated at order completion and passed to the billing domain for invoicing — activation fees, installation charges, CPE purchase or rental fees, early termination fees, and MNP administrative charges. Captures charge type, charge amount, currency, tax category, charge trigger event, billing account reference, charge status (PENDING, BILLED, WAIVED, REVERSED), and waiver reason if applicable. Represents the commercial financial output of the order fulfillment process.
products.reference: TM Forum SID ProductOrderPrice / Amdocs OMS Charge

attributes.name: order_charge_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order charge record. Primary key.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account that will be invoiced for this charge. Links the charge to the customer financial account for payment collection.

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer dispute case if this charge is under investigation. Null if charge is not disputed. Links to dispute management system for resolution tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Charges allocated to cost centers for internal management reporting, especially for B2B/enterprise orders where costs must be tracked by sales channel, region, or product line for profitability analys

attributes.name: customer_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical location where the service is delivered. Used for installation charges, equipment delivery fees, and location-based taxation. Null for non-location-specific charges.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or agent identifier for the sales representative who originated the order. Used for commission calculation and sales performance tracking. Null for self-service channels.

attributes.name: enterprise_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.enterprise_contract. Business justification: Order charges for enterprise customers must link to contracts for pricing validation, discount application per contract terms, revenue recognition rules, and contract-specific billing arrangements.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order that generated this charge. Links the charge to the originating service order.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice that includes this charge. Null if charge has not yet been invoiced. Enables reconciliation between order charges and billing invoices.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Order charges generate journal entries for GL posting. Direct traceability from charge to journal entry is required for revenue assurance audits, SOX compliance, and financial reconciliation processes

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item that triggered this charge. Enables traceability to the product or service being charged.

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_package. Business justification: Billing line items for IPTV/OTT subscriptions reference the content package tier for pricing, revenue recognition, and invoice detail. Real process: monthly recurring charge calculation and billing st

attributes.name: price_alteration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_alteration. Business justification: Discounts and promotional adjustments applied to charges must trace to catalog price alterations for audit trail, revenue assurance, and campaign ROI analysis. Required for finance reconciliation.

attributes.name: price_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.price_plan. Business justification: Charges originate from catalog price plans; linkage required for revenue assurance audits, charge validation, and GL account mapping. Essential for financial controls and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue attribution to profit centers is standard practice for segment P&L reporting in telcos with multiple business units (mobile, fixed, enterprise). Required for management accounting and performa

attributes.name: promo_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.promo_offer. Business justification: Promotional charges must link to catalog promo_offer for campaign ROI tracking, budget consumption monitoring, redemption limit enforcement, and finance reconciliation. Required for marketing analytic

attributes.name: revenue_leakage_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.revenue_leakage_case. Business justification: Order charges disputed or unbilled triggering revenue leakage investigations. Links order-to-cash discrepancies to revenue assurance cases for recovery actions.

attributes.name: spec_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product catalog entry associated with this charge. Identifies the specific service or equipment being charged.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of the charge before taxes, discounts, or adjustments. Represents the base price for the service or product being charged.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the charge was approved for billing. Null if charge is still pending approval or was waived/cancelled before approval.

attributes.name: billed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the charge was successfully posted to a customer invoice. Null if charge has not yet been billed or was waived/cancelled.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the order was placed. RETAIL_STORE for physical locations, ONLINE_WEB for website orders, MOBILE_APP for mobile application, CALL_CENTER for phone orders, DEALER for authorized resellers, PARTNER for co-branded channels, DIRECT_SALES for field sales teams, TELESALES for outbound sales. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RETAIL_STORE|ONLINE_WEB|MOBILE_APP|CALL_CENTER|DEALER|PARTNER|DIRECT_SALES|TELESALES — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: Detailed classification of the charge purpose. ACTIVATION for new service setup, INSTALLATION for field technician deployment, CPE_PURCHASE for customer premises equipment sale, CPE_RENTAL for equipment lease, MNP_FEE for mobile number portability administrative charge, EARLY_TERMINATION for contract breach penalty, SERVICE_CHANGE for mid-contract modifications, UPGRADE/DOWNGRADE for plan changes, DISCONNECTION for service termination, ADMINISTRATIVE for processing fees. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ACTIVATION|INSTALLATION|CPE_PURCHASE|CPE_RENTAL|MNP_FEE|EARLY_TERMINATION|SERVICE_CHANGE|UPGRADE|DOWNGRADE|DISCONNECTION|ADMINISTRATIVE — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the charge. PENDING awaiting approval or billing system processing, APPROVED validated and ready for invoicing, BILLED successfully included in customer invoice, WAIVED forgiven per policy or customer service decision, REVERSED cancelled post-billing with credit issued, DISPUTED under customer challenge investigation, CANCELLED voided before billing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PENDING|APPROVED|BILLED|WAIVED|REVERSED|DISPUTED|CANCELLED — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge based on billing frequency and nature. ONE_TIME for activation/installation fees, RECURRING for subscription charges, USAGE for consumption-based charges, PENALTY for early termination or late payment fees, ADJUSTMENT for manual corrections, CREDIT for refunds or promotional credits.

attributes.name: contract_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the service contract commitment in months. Used to calculate early termination fees and contract expiration dates. Null for month-to-month services.

attributes.name: cpe_serial_number
attributes.description: Serial number of the customer premises equipment associated with this charge. Applicable for CPE purchase, rental, or installation charges. Null for non-equipment charges.

attributes.name: creation_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this charge record was first created in the order management system. Used for audit trail and charge lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this charge record. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, AUD.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the charge. Includes promotional discounts, loyalty credits, bundle savings, and negotiated contract reductions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the charge becomes applicable for billing purposes. Determines which billing cycle will include this charge.

attributes.name: external_charge_reference
attributes.description: Charge identifier from the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracking. Format varies by source system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Financial accounting code for revenue recognition. Maps the charge to the appropriate general ledger account for financial reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: is_prorated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the charge amount was prorated based on partial billing period. True for mid-cycle activations or changes, False for full-period charges.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that performed the most recent update to this charge record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this charge record. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data synchronization.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: net_charge_amount
attributes.description: Final billable amount after applying discounts and adding taxes. Calculated as charge_amount minus discount_amount plus tax_amount. This is the amount that will appear on the customer invoice.

attributes.name: product_offering_code
attributes.description: Business code identifying the commercial product offering. Used for product catalog lookup, pricing rule application, and revenue reporting.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Marketing campaign or promotional offer code that influenced the charge amount. Used to track discount attribution and campaign effectiveness. Null if no promotion was applied.

attributes.name: proration_days
attributes.description: Number of days used to calculate prorated charge amount. Null if charge is not prorated.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique business identifier for the charge. Used for customer communication, dispute resolution, and cross-system reconciliation.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue from this charge should be recognized in financial statements. May differ from charge_effective_date based on accounting policies and revenue recognition standards.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers, ASC 606

attributes.name: reversal_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the charge reversal. Includes investigation findings, customer communication notes, or corrective action details. Null if charge was not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why a previously billed charge was reversed. BILLING_ERROR for incorrect invoicing, DUPLICATE_CHARGE for double-billing, SERVICE_NOT_DELIVERED for unfulfilled orders, CUSTOMER_DISPUTE for contested charges, SYSTEM_ERROR for technical failures, FRAUD for unauthorized charges, REGULATORY_ADJUSTMENT for compliance corrections. Null if charge was not reversed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BILLING_ERROR|DUPLICATE_CHARGE|SERVICE_NOT_DELIVERED|CUSTOMER_DISPUTE|SYSTEM_ERROR|FRAUD|REGULATORY_ADJUSTMENT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the charge reversal was processed. Null if charge was not reversed. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this charge record. OSM for Oracle Communications Order and Service Management, NETCRACKER for Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite, AMDOCS for Amdocs Revenue Management, COMVERSE for Comverse ONE, SALESFORCE for Salesforce CRM. Used for data lineage and system integration troubleshooting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax liability for this charge. Includes sales tax, value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), telecommunications-specific regulatory fees, and universal service fund contributions.
attributes.references: FCC - Universal Service Fund, ETSI - Taxation Standards

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax treatment classification for this charge. STANDARD for normal sales tax rate, REDUCED for discounted rate items, EXEMPT for non-taxable services, ZERO_RATED for taxable but 0% rate, TELECOM_SPECIFIC for industry regulatory fees, USF for Universal Service Fund contributions.
attributes.references: FCC - Universal Service Fund, ETSI - Taxation Standards

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: Business event that caused this charge to be generated. ORDER_COMPLETION for order fulfillment charges, SERVICE_ACTIVATION for go-live fees, INSTALLATION_COMPLETE for field work charges, CONTRACT_SIGNATURE for commitment fees, MNP_PORT_IN for number portability administrative charges, SERVICE_DISCONNECTION for termination fees, CONTRACT_TERMINATION for early exit penalties, PLAN_CHANGE for modification fees, EQUIPMENT_DELIVERY for CPE charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ORDER_COMPLETION|SERVICE_ACTIVATION|INSTALLATION_COMPLETE|CONTRACT_SIGNATURE|MNP_PORT_IN|SERVICE_DISCONNECTION|CONTRACT_TERMINATION|PLAN_CHANGE|EQUIPMENT_DELIVERY — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the employee who authorized the charge waiver. Used for audit trail and policy compliance verification. Null if charge was not waived.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: waiver_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the charge waiver. Includes customer service notes, manager approval justification, or policy reference. Null if charge was not waived.

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining why a charge was waived. CUSTOMER_RETENTION for churn prevention, SERVICE_FAILURE for quality issues, BILLING_ERROR for system mistakes, PROMOTIONAL for marketing campaigns, GOODWILL for customer satisfaction, EXECUTIVE_ESCALATION for senior management decisions, REGULATORY_COMPLIANCE for legal requirements, CONTRACT_NEGOTIATION for commercial agreements. Null if charge was not waived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CUSTOMER_RETENTION|SERVICE_FAILURE|BILLING_ERROR|PROMOTIONAL|GOODWILL|EXECUTIVE_ESCALATION|REGULATORY_COMPLIANCE|CONTRACT_NEGOTIATION — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: bulk_order
products.description: Master record for enterprise and wholesale bulk order submissions where a single commercial request encompasses multiple individual fulfillment orders — B2B enterprise site rollouts, MVNO subscriber batch activations, government contract deployments, and SD-WAN/MPLS multi-site provisioning. Captures bulk order reference, submitting entity type (enterprise, MVNO, wholesale partner), total line count, submission method (file upload, API batch), processing status, success count, failure count, and account manager reference.
products.reference: TM Forum SID BulkOrder / OSM Bulk Processing

attributes.name: bulk_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bulk order submission. Primary key for the bulk order entity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Enterprise bulk orders (corporate contracts, wholesale agreements) must be assigned to legal entity for contract accounting, revenue recognition, and statutory reporting. Essential for multi-entity te

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Bulk orders are predominantly enterprise use cases (new site rollouts, mass upgrades, fleet provisioning). Corporate account linkage essential for contract validation, consolidated billing, and bulk o

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enterprise customer, MVNO partner, wholesale carrier, or government entity that submitted the bulk order request.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Party Management ABE

attributes.name: dealer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.dealer. Business justification: Dealer networks submit bulk activation orders for multiple customers (e.g., corporate sales, promotional campaigns) - requires dealer attribution for bulk activation quota tracking and tiered commissi

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enterprise account manager or partner relationship manager responsible for this bulk order customer relationship.

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.offering. Business justification: Corporate/wholesale bulk orders often target specific catalog offerings for contract compliance validation, volume pricing enforcement, and enterprise sales tracking. Required for B2B order management

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Bulk orders often submitted by enterprise partners or wholesale customers require partner attribution for contract compliance tracking, volume commitment verification, and partner-specific pricing/set

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the orchestration workflow instance managing the bulk order decomposition and fulfillment coordination.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Workflow Engine

attributes.name: reconciliation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.reconciliation_run. Business justification: Bulk order billing reconciliation detecting revenue leakage from provisioning vs. billing mismatches. Standard revenue assurance process for enterprise/wholesale orders.

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the bulk order processing was completed (all individual orders reached terminal state).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: bulk_order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the bulk order submission, used for customer communication and tracking. Format: BLK followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Order Reference Standards

attributes.name: bulk_order_type
attributes.description: Category of bulk order operation being requested across all individual orders within the batch. Determines decomposition strategy and fulfillment orchestration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_activation|upgrade|downgrade|disconnection|mnp_port_in|change_of_service|site_rollout|batch_provisioning — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Type Classification

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for bulk order cancellation (e.g., customer request, contract termination, validation failure).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context for the bulk order cancellation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bulk order was cancelled by the customer or system, halting further processing of pending individual orders.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: committed_completion_date
attributes.description: Service provider committed delivery date for bulk order completion, based on capacity planning and SLA agreements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement ABE

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master service agreement, enterprise contract, or wholesale agreement governing the terms of this bulk order.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Agreement Management ABE

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bulk order record was first created in the order management system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values associated with this bulk order.

attributes.name: decomposition_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all individual fulfillment orders were successfully created and queued from the bulk order batch.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Order Decomposition

attributes.name: decomposition_started_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bulk order began decomposition into individual fulfillment orders for orchestration.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Order Decomposition

attributes.name: decomposition_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy used to decompose the bulk order into individual fulfillment orders (sequential processing, parallel processing, or hybrid approach).
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Order Decomposition

attributes.name: error_summary_report_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Error Summary Report Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed error report listing all validation failures and processing errors for failed order lines.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Reporting Framework

attributes.name: failure_count
attributes.description: Number of individual order lines that have failed validation, decomposition, or fulfillment within this bulk order batch. Requires remediation or manual intervention.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management Metrics

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bulk order record was last updated, reflecting the most recent status or attribute change.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing special instructions, deployment notes, or additional context provided by the submitter for this bulk order.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: pending_count
attributes.description: Number of individual order lines still in progress or awaiting fulfillment within this bulk order batch.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management Metrics

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the bulk order, determining SLA targets, resource allocation, and escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Priority Classification

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bulk order as it progresses through intake, validation, decomposition, and fulfillment orchestration stages. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|validating|validated|decomposing|in_progress|completed|partially_completed|failed|cancelled — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order State Model

attributes.name: requested_completion_date
attributes.description: Customer-requested target date by which all individual orders within the bulk batch should be fulfilled and activated.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: sales_channel_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the sales channel through which the bulk order was originated (e.g., enterprise direct, partner portal, wholesale desk).

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the bulk order has breached its committed SLA target completion time.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement ABE

attributes.name: sla_breach_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the SLA breach was detected for this bulk order, triggering escalation and notification workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement ABE

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: Target number of hours for bulk order completion as defined by the applicable SLA tier and contract terms.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement ABE

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier applicable to this bulk order based on customer contract and submitting entity type. Determines target completion timeframes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement ABE

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the upstream system or portal from which the bulk order originated (e.g., partner portal, enterprise self-service, wholesale API).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - System Integration ABE

attributes.name: submission_file_format
attributes.description: Data format of the bulk order submission file. Determines parsing logic and validation schema applied during intake processing.
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF622 Product Ordering API Specification

attributes.name: submission_file_name
attributes.description: Original file name of the uploaded bulk order file, if submission method was file-based. Used for audit trail and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Technical channel through which the bulk order was submitted to the OSS/BSS platform. Impacts validation rules and processing workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Integration Patterns

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bulk order was initially submitted to the order management system. Marks the start of SLA measurement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: submitter_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the individual who submitted the bulk order, used for status notifications and error report delivery.

attributes.name: submitter_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who submitted the bulk order on behalf of the enterprise or partner organization.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Party Management ABE

attributes.name: submitter_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the individual who submitted the bulk order, used for urgent escalations and clarifications.

attributes.name: submitting_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organization type submitting the bulk order request. Determines routing, approval workflows, and SLA tiers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Party Role ABE

attributes.name: success_count
attributes.description: Number of individual order lines that have been successfully fulfilled and completed within this bulk order batch.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management Metrics

attributes.name: total_line_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual order lines or subscriber records included in the bulk order submission. Used for progress tracking and capacity planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management Metrics

attributes.name: total_order_value
attributes.description: Aggregate monetary value of all individual orders within the bulk order batch, representing total revenue opportunity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Revenue Management ABE

attributes.name: validation_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when intake validation and business rule checks were completed for the bulk order submission.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Validation Framework

attributes.name: validation_error_count
attributes.description: Number of individual order lines that failed business rule validation during intake processing. Typically requires correction and resubmission.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Validation Framework

attributes.name: workflow_template_name
attributes.description: Name of the workflow template used for orchestrating this bulk order type (e.g., Enterprise_Site_Rollout, MVNO_Batch_Activation).
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Workflow Templates

products.name: inventory_reservation
products.description: Inventory reservation record created at order submission to hold physical or logical resources required for fulfillment — SIM/eSIM stock, ONT/CPE hardware, IP address blocks, MSISDN ranges, and fiber port capacity. Captures resource type, resource identifier, reserved quantity, reservation timestamp, expiry timestamp, reservation status (ACTIVE, CONSUMED, EXPIRED, RELEASED), and consuming order reference. Prevents double-allocation of scarce resources across concurrent orders.
products.reference: TM Forum SID ResourceReservation / Oracle OSM Inventory

attributes.name: inventory_reservation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory reservation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer for whom this resource is reserved. Enables customer-level reservation tracking and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: device_model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.device_model. Business justification: Device inventory reservations must specify the exact catalog model being reserved for warehouse picking, stock allocation, and supply chain planning. Essential for device logistics operations.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or service account that created the reservation. Supports audit and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment order that triggered this reservation. Links the reservation to the consuming order workflow.

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item that requires this reserved resource. Enables line-level resource tracking.

attributes.name: location_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or logical warehouse location holding the reserved resource. Relevant for CPE, ONT, and physical SIM inventory.

attributes.name: reconciliation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.reconciliation_run. Business justification: Inventory reservation vs. consumption reconciliation for resource leakage detection (SIM cards, CPE). Standard inventory assurance control in telco operations.

attributes.name: resource_pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory pool from which this resource was reserved. Enables pool-level capacity management and replenishment.

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the target service instance that will consume this resource upon fulfillment. Null until service is provisioned.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_code
attributes.description: Reference to the business rule that governed this reservation. Enables audit of allocation logic and policy compliance.

attributes.name: consumed_quantity
attributes.description: Number of reserved units that have been consumed by fulfillment. Tracks partial consumption for bulk reservations.

attributes.name: consumed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reserved resource was consumed by fulfillment and allocated to the service. Null if not yet consumed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reservation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation will automatically expire if not consumed. Prevents indefinite resource locking.

attributes.name: is_auto_released
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reservation was automatically released by system expiry logic (true) or manually released by an operator (false).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reservation record was last updated. Tracks all state transitions and attribute changes.

attributes.name: release_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for reservation release. Examples: EXPIRY, ORDER_CANCELLED, MANUAL_OVERRIDE, INVENTORY_REBALANCE, FULFILLMENT_FAILURE.

attributes.name: release_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the reservation was released. Supports operational analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reservation was manually released back to inventory. Null if not released.

attributes.name: reservation_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Configured hold period in minutes before automatic expiry. Derived from order type and resource type policies.

attributes.name: reservation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes about the reservation. Captures special handling instructions, constraints, or exceptions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: reservation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the reservation. Used for operational tracking and customer service reference.

attributes.name: reservation_priority
attributes.description: Priority level for this reservation. Influences allocation sequence when inventory is constrained. Inherited from order priority.

attributes.name: reservation_reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason for the reservation. Aligns with order action type and supports reservation analytics.

attributes.name: reservation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reservation. ACTIVE=held and available, CONSUMED=used by fulfillment, EXPIRED=time limit exceeded, RELEASED=manually freed, CANCELLED=order cancelled.

attributes.name: reservation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the resource was reserved from inventory. Marks the start of the reservation hold period.

attributes.name: reserved_by_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that initiated the reservation. Typically Oracle Communications Order and Service Management or equivalent OSS.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Number of resource units reserved. Typically 1 for discrete items like SIM cards, may be greater for bulk resources like IP address blocks.

attributes.name: resource_identifier
attributes.description: The actual identifier of the reserved resource instance. For MSISDN this is the phone number, for SIM the ICCID, for IP the address block, for ONT the serial number.

attributes.name: resource_specification_code
attributes.description: Reference to the resource catalog specification defining the characteristics and constraints of the reserved resource type.

attributes.name: resource_type
attributes.description: Category of resource being reserved. Determines inventory pool and allocation rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SIM|ESIM|MSISDN|ICCID|IMSI|IP_ADDRESS|ONT|CPE|FIBER_PORT|GPON_PORT|VLAN|MAC_ADDRESS|EQUIPMENT_SERIAL — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: service_region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for which this resource is reserved. Ensures regional inventory alignment for MSISDN ranges and local resources.

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: Network technology for which the resource is reserved. Ensures technology-compatible resource allocation.

products.name: validation_result
products.description: Record of all validation checks executed against a submitted order before orchestration begins — credit check outcome, service eligibility confirmation, address validation, MSISDN availability, regulatory compliance check (MNP cooling-off period, CALEA compliance), and product compatibility validation. Captures validation rule code, validation outcome (PASS, FAIL, WARNING), failure message, validation timestamp, and override flag with authorising agent reference for manual overrides.
products.reference: TM Forum SID OrderValidation / OSM Pre-Validation

attributes.name: validation_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order validation result record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compatibility_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.compatibility_rule. Business justification: Compatibility validation outcomes must reference the catalog rule evaluated for troubleshooting order fallouts, rule tuning, and product configuration quality improvement. Critical for order success r

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise order validation (credit checks, service eligibility) requires corporate account context for account-level credit limits, contract-based eligibility rules, and enterprise-specific validatio

attributes.name: eligibility_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.eligibility_rule. Business justification: Validation results must trace to the specific eligibility rule evaluated for audit trail, rule effectiveness analysis, override justification, and regulatory compliance reporting. Essential for order

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or agent identifier who authorized the validation override. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting. Nullable if no override was applied.

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the order that was validated. Links this validation result to the parent order being processed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific order line item that was validated. Nullable if validation applies to the entire order rather than a specific line.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Validation rules often enforce regulatory requirements (credit checks under consumer protection law, MNP cooling period compliance, E911 capability verification). Telcos must link validation rules to

attributes.name: address_validation_status
attributes.description: Result of address validation check. VALID indicates address is verified, CORRECTED indicates address was standardized, INVALID indicates address cannot be verified. Applicable only for ADDRESS validation category.

attributes.name: calea_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Communications Assistance for Law Enforcement Act (CALEA) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the order complies with Communications Assistance for Law Enforcement Act (CALEA) requirements for lawful intercept capability. Applicable for regulated telecommunications services.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation result record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_limit_approved
attributes.description: Maximum credit limit approved for the customer based on credit check. Applicable only for CREDIT validation category. Nullable for non-credit validations.

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score returned by credit check validation. Applicable only for CREDIT validation category. Nullable for non-credit validations.

attributes.name: deposit_required_amount
attributes.description: Security deposit amount required based on credit check outcome. Applicable only for CREDIT validation category. Nullable if no deposit required or for non-credit validations.

attributes.name: inventory_availability_status
attributes.description: Availability status of required inventory items (Customer Premises Equipment (CPE), Subscriber Identity Module (SIM) cards, etc.) for order fulfillment. Applicable for orders requiring physical inventory.

attributes.name: is_overridden
attributes.description: Indicates whether a failed validation was manually overridden by an authorized agent. True if override was applied, False otherwise.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Order Handling Process

attributes.name: is_override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this validation failure can be manually overridden by an authorized agent. True if override is permitted, False if validation failure is absolute.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Order Handling Process

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation result record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mnp_cooling_period_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Cooling Period Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Mobile Number Portability (MNP) request complies with regulatory cooling-off period requirements. Applicable only for MNP port-in orders. Nullable for non-MNP orders.

attributes.name: mnp_cooling_period_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Cooling Period End Date
attributes.description: Date when the Mobile Number Portability (MNP) regulatory cooling-off period expires and porting can proceed. Applicable only for MNP port-in orders. Nullable for non-MNP orders.

attributes.name: msisdn_availability_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN) Availability Status
attributes.description: Availability status of the requested Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN). Applicable for new activation and Mobile Number Portability (MNP) orders. Nullable for non-mobile service orders.

attributes.name: network_capacity_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether sufficient network capacity exists to fulfill the service request at the specified location. Applicable for bandwidth-intensive services (Fiber to the Home (FTTH), 5G New Radio (5G NR), etc.).

attributes.name: override_agent_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee or agent who authorized the validation override. Used for audit reporting. Nullable if no override was applied.

attributes.name: override_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for validation override (e.g., CUST_REQUEST, EXEC_APPROVAL, SYSTEM_ERROR, BUSINESS_EXCEPTION). Nullable if no override was applied.

attributes.name: override_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description explaining why the validation failure was overridden. Required for compliance and audit purposes when override is applied.

attributes.name: override_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validation failure was overridden. Nullable if no override was applied.

attributes.name: product_compatibility_status
attributes.description: Result of product compatibility validation checking whether requested products can coexist or if existing services require modification. Applicable for change-of-service and upgrade orders.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times this validation check was retried due to transient errors or timeouts. Used for reliability monitoring and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: service_eligibility_status
attributes.description: Outcome of service eligibility check indicating whether requested service can be provisioned at the specified location. Applicable only for ELIGIBILITY validation category.

attributes.name: validation_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the validation check performed. Groups validation rules into functional domains for reporting and orchestration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CREDIT|ELIGIBILITY|ADDRESS|INVENTORY|REGULATORY|COMPATIBILITY|TECHNICAL|BUSINESS_RULE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Order Handling Process

attributes.name: validation_duration_ms
attributes.description: Time taken to execute the validation check in milliseconds. Used for performance monitoring and optimization of validation processes.

attributes.name: validation_error_code
attributes.description: Standardized error code for failed validations. Used for automated error handling, routing, and reporting. Nullable if validation passed.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Error Catalog

attributes.name: validation_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this validation result expires and must be re-executed. Some validations (credit checks, inventory reservations) have time-limited validity.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Validation Framework

attributes.name: validation_message
attributes.description: Detailed message describing the validation result. For failures, contains specific reason and remediation guidance. For warnings, contains advisory information.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Validation Framework

attributes.name: validation_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the validation check execution. PASS indicates validation succeeded, FAIL indicates validation failed and order cannot proceed, WARNING indicates potential issue but order may proceed, SKIPPED indicates validation was not executed, ERROR indicates validation could not be completed due to technical issue.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Validation Framework

attributes.name: validation_response_payload
attributes.description: Raw response payload from the validation system. Stored for audit and detailed troubleshooting. May contain JSON or XML formatted data.

attributes.name: validation_rule_code
attributes.description: Unique code identifying the validation rule that was executed (e.g., CREDIT_CHECK, ADDRESS_VAL, MSISDN_AVAIL, MNP_COOLING, CALEA_COMP, PROD_COMPAT, SVC_ELIGIBILITY). Used to categorize and track validation types.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Validation Framework

attributes.name: validation_rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the validation rule executed (e.g., Credit Check, Service Eligibility Verification, Mobile Number Portability (MNP) Cooling-Off Period Check).
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Validation Framework

attributes.name: validation_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order in which this validation was executed within the overall validation workflow. Used to track validation orchestration and dependencies.
attributes.references: Oracle Communications Order and Service Management - Orchestration Framework

attributes.name: validation_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of the validation result. CRITICAL failures block order progression, HIGH failures require manual review, MEDIUM and LOW may allow conditional progression.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: validation_system_source
attributes.description: Name of the system or service that performed the validation check (e.g., Amdocs Credit Engine, Salesforce Address Validator, Netcracker Inventory, Internal MNP Gateway). Used for troubleshooting and system dependency tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - System Integration ABE

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the validation check was executed. Critical for audit trail and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

products.name: decomposition
products.description: Decomposition mapping record that links a high-level fulfillment order line to the set of lower-level service orders and resource orders generated by OSM during orchestration. Captures parent order line reference, child order type (service_order, resource_order, network_order), child system target, decomposition rule applied, creation timestamp, and synchronisation status. Provides full traceability from commercial order to network provisioning action.
products.reference: Oracle OSM Decomposition / TM Forum SID OrderDecomposition

attributes.name: decomposition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the order decomposition mapping record. Primary key.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: child_order_fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lower-level order generated during decomposition. May point to service order, resource order, or network order depending on child_order_type.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: decomposition_fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order. Provides context for the order line being decomposed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: decomposition_prerequisite_order_fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to another child order that must complete before this child order can begin execution. Null if no prerequisite exists.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: parent_order_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the high-level fulfillment order line that was decomposed. Links to the commercial order line from which child orders were generated.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Native order identifier assigned by the target fulfillment system. Used for cross-system correlation and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the orchestration rule or template applied by Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) to generate the child order. Enables traceability to the decomposition logic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: child_order_number
attributes.description: Business-readable identifier for the child order. Used for operational tracking and cross-system correlation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: child_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the child order generated during decomposition. Indicates the layer of the fulfillment stack this order targets (service, resource, or network).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: child_system_target
attributes.description: Target system or domain responsible for fulfilling the child order. Examples: Netcracker Service Inventory, Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, CPE Provisioning System.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the child order was marked as completed in the target system and synchronized back to the orchestration layer. Null if not yet completed.

attributes.name: created_by_system
attributes.description: Source system that created this decomposition mapping record. Typically Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the decomposition mapping record was created and the child order was generated by the orchestration engine.

attributes.name: decomposition_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical depth of this decomposition step. Level 1 indicates first-level decomposition from commercial order line; higher levels indicate nested decomposition.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: decomposition_status
attributes.description: Current state of this decomposition mapping. Tracks whether the child order has been successfully created, dispatched, and synchronized with the target system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: dependency_type
