attributes.description: Execution dependency relationship between this child order and other child orders. Sequential requires completion before next; parallel allows concurrent execution; conditional depends on outcome; blocking prevents downstream execution until resolved.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the child order was dispatched to the target system for fulfillment. Null if not yet dispatched.

attributes.name: failure_description
attributes.description: Detailed human-readable description of the failure reason. Provides context for troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for child order failure. Examples: RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, VALIDATION_ERROR, SYSTEM_TIMEOUT, NETWORK_UNREACHABLE.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: failure_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the child order failed in the target system. Null if no failure occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this decomposition mapping record. Tracks changes to status, synchronization state, or retry attempts.

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent synchronization event between the orchestration layer and the target system for this child order.

attributes.name: max_retry_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of retry attempts allowed for this child order before escalation or manual intervention is required.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: next_retry_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp for the next retry attempt. Null if no retry is scheduled or max retries exceeded.

attributes.name: orchestration_context
attributes.description: Additional context or metadata passed from the orchestration engine to the target system. May include workflow variables, customer preferences, or technical parameters.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Execution priority of this child order. Inherited from parent order or adjusted based on decomposition rules and SLA requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times the orchestration engine has attempted to dispatch or synchronize this child order after initial failure. Used for retry policy enforcement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: rollback_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this child order requires rollback due to parent order cancellation or downstream failure. True triggers compensating transaction.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: rollback_status
attributes.description: Current state of the rollback process for this child order. Tracks whether compensating actions have been successfully executed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: rollback_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the rollback action was initiated for this child order. Null if no rollback occurred.

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordering of this child order within the set of child orders generated from the same parent order line. Used to enforce execution dependencies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this child order has breached its SLA target. True triggers escalation and reporting workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement ABE

attributes.name: sla_target_completion_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Timestamp
attributes.description: Target timestamp by which this child order must be completed to meet the parent order SLA. Used for proactive breach detection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Agreement ABE

attributes.name: synchronization_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child order state in the target system is synchronized with the orchestration layer. Critical for maintaining end-to-end order visibility.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

attributes.name: target_system_status
attributes.description: Current status of the child order as reported by the target system. May differ from decomposition_status during synchronization lag.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Order Management ABE

products.name: decomposition_rule

attributes.name: action_expression

attributes.name: applicable_order_category

attributes.name: condition_expression

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: rule_description

attributes.name: rule_owner

attributes.name: rule_type

attributes.name: updated_by

attributes.name: created_by

attributes.description: Primary key for notification_template

attributes.name: body
attributes.description: Main content body of the notification template.

attributes.name: communication_channel

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the template record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which the template is no longer valid (null if indefinite).

attributes.name: has_attachment

attributes.name: is_html

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: locale

attributes.name: max_retries

attributes.name: priority

attributes.name: retry_interval_seconds

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: subject

attributes.name: template_code

attributes.name: template_description

attributes.name: template_name

attributes.name: template_type
attributes.description: Category of communication the template supports (e.g., email, SMS, push notification).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent modification to the template record.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version of the template for change management.

attributes.name: fallback_notification_template_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on notification_template (fallback_notification_template_id)

domains.name: billing
domains.description: SSOT for all customer financial transactions including rating, charging, invoicing, collections, payment processing, prepaid balance management, postpaid billing cycles, disputes, adjustments, dunning, MRR/ARPU reporting, and revenue recognition. Managed via Amdocs Revenue Management and Comverse ONE.
domains.references: TM Forum SID Customer Bill Management, TM Forum TMF678, GSMA TAP/RAP

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Master record for a customer's billing account serving as the financial anchor for all monetary transactions. Captures billing cycle assignment, payment terms, credit class, bill delivery preferences (paper/eBill/app), currency, tax exemption status, dunning profile rules, account-level credit limit, auto-pay configuration, and account status (active, suspended, closed). Links subscriber identity to charges, invoices, payments, and collections. One customer may have multiple billing accounts (split billing). Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Party Account / Amdocs Billing Account

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the billing account record in the Amdocs Revenue Management system. Serves as the primary key and financial anchor for all monetary transactions, invoices, payments, and collections associated with this account.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (party) who owns this billing account. One customer may have multiple billing accounts to support split billing arrangements across different service lines or business units.

attributes.name: customer_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the postal address record used for paper invoice delivery and tax jurisdiction determination. Drives state and local tax calculation based on service address rules.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Geographic Address; FCC Jurisdictional Separations

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: Enterprise/B2B billing accounts are assigned account managers for relationship management, escalation routing, and commission tracking. Standard telco practice for high-value accounts. No existing col

attributes.name: parent_account_billing_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent billing account in a hierarchical account structure. Used for enterprise split billing where a master account consolidates charges from multiple child accounts. Null for standalone accounts.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account Hierarchy; eTOM 1.4.1

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: MVNO and wholesale customers have billing accounts managed by host operator. Required for MVNO billing, wholesale invoicing, partner revenue tracking, and settlement reconciliation in telecommunicatio

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.service_territory. Business justification: Accounts are assigned to service territories for sales team management, regional revenue reporting, franchise fee calculation, and regulatory jurisdiction determination. Standard telco ops practice fo

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name assigned to the billing account, typically the customer legal name or a business unit label for corporate accounts. Displayed on invoices and used in collections correspondence.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable account number assigned by Amdocs Revenue Management and printed on invoices and statements. Used by customers and agents to reference the account in all billing interactions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account; Amdocs Revenue Management Account Object

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing account as managed in Amdocs Revenue Management. Controls whether new charges can be applied, invoices generated, and services provisioned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|suspended|closed|pending|delinquent|write_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account State; eTOM 1.4.1

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account by customer segment. Drives applicable rate plans, credit policies, dunning rules, and regulatory treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|small_business|enterprise|wholesale|mvno|government — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account Type; eTOM 1.4.1

attributes.name: arpu_segment_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) Segment Code
attributes.description: Segment classification of the billing account based on Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) banding (e.g., HIGH_VALUE, MID_VALUE, LOW_VALUE). Used for targeted retention campaigns, churn management, and revenue analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA Intelligence ARPU Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment is configured for this billing account. When true, the system initiates payment collection on the due date using the stored payment instrument without manual customer action.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Auto-Pay Configuration; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: bill_delivery_method
attributes.description: Preferred channel through which invoices are delivered to the customer. Drives the bill production and distribution workflow in Amdocs Revenue Management. Suppressed is used for internal or wholesale accounts billed via EDI.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Bill Format; FCC E-Billing Guidelines

attributes.name: bill_language_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag specifying the language in which invoices and billing communications are generated for this account (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-CA). Supports multilingual billing for diverse customer bases.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; TM Forum SID GB922 - Bill Format

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle assigned to this account in Amdocs Revenue Management (e.g., MONTHLY-01, MONTHLY-15, QUARTERLY). Determines the invoice generation schedule and the period over which charges are accumulated.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Cycle; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Cycle Object

attributes.name: consolidated_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing account is configured to receive a consolidated invoice aggregating charges from multiple sub-accounts or service lines. Common for enterprise customers with split billing arrangements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Bill Structure; eTOM 1.4.1

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with this billing account for internal financial allocation and OPEX/CAPEX reporting. Relevant for enterprise and wholesale accounts where charges are allocated to specific business units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing account record was first created in Amdocs Revenue Management. Used for account age calculations, onboarding analytics, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: credit_class_code
attributes.description: Credit risk classification assigned to the billing account by the credit management system (e.g., GOLD, SILVER, BRONZE, HIGH_RISK). Drives credit limit assignment, deposit requirements, and dunning profile selection in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Credit Profile; FCC Credit Practices Rules 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding balance permitted on this billing account before service suspension is triggered. Set based on credit class and customer risk profile. Monitored in real time by Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Credit Limit; FCC Credit Practices Rules 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all charges, invoices, and payments on this billing account are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Critical for multi-currency billing in international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922 - Financial Account

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding monetary balance on the billing account as of the last billing run or payment posting. Positive value indicates amount owed by the customer; negative value indicates a credit balance. Used for collections prioritization and MRR reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Financial Account; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management Balance Object

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Monetary deposit held by the carrier against this billing account as a credit risk mitigation measure. Applied to high-risk credit classes. Refundable upon account closure in good standing per FCC deposit rules.
attributes.references: FCC Credit Practices Rules 47 CFR Part 64; TM Forum SID GB922 - Financial Account

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the security deposit was collected from the customer. Used to calculate deposit holding period and determine refund eligibility under FCC regulations.
attributes.references: FCC Credit Practices Rules 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: dispute_in_progress
attributes.description: Indicates whether there is an active billing dispute on this account. When true, dunning escalation may be paused per dispute resolution policy. Linked to the dispute management workflow in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; FCC Consumer Complaint Rules 47 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: dunning_profile_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the dunning workflow profile assigned to this billing account in Amdocs Revenue Management. Defines the sequence, timing, and escalation steps (reminder, warning, suspension, collections referral) applied when payment is overdue.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; eTOM 1.4.2 Revenue Assurance

attributes.name: dunning_status
attributes.description: Current step in the dunning escalation workflow for this billing account. Tracks the collections lifecycle from initial reminder through suspension and potential write-off. Updated by Amdocs Revenue Management collections engine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; eTOM 1.4.2

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing account became active and eligible to receive charges. Marks the start of the billing relationship and is used for revenue recognition and contract term calculations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing account is scheduled to close or was closed. Null for open-ended accounts. Used for contract expiry tracking, churn analysis, and revenue recognition cutoff.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP S/4HANA to which revenue and receivables from this billing account are posted. Ensures accurate financial reporting and audit trail between the BSS billing system and the ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Financial Account

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this billing account within the enterprise account hierarchy (1 = top-level master account, 2 = sub-account, 3 = sub-sub-account). Supports multi-tier corporate billing structures.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account Hierarchy

attributes.name: invoice_format_code
attributes.description: Specifies the invoice presentation format assigned to this billing account. Itemized includes per-call detail; summary shows charge categories only; consolidated merges multiple sub-accounts into a single invoice.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Bill Format; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoice Template

attributes.name: last_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent invoice was generated for this billing account. Used to track billing cycle adherence, identify accounts that have not been billed, and support collections workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Bill; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoice Object

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the billing account record in Amdocs Revenue Management. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Account; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the most recent payment posted to this billing account. Used alongside last_payment_date to assess partial vs. full payment behavior and inform collections strategy.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment; Amdocs Revenue Management Payment Object

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent payment was posted to this billing account. Used by collections agents to assess payment recency, calculate days since last payment, and prioritize dunning actions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment; Amdocs Revenue Management Payment Object

attributes.name: mrr_amount
attributes.description: The contracted Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) value of this billing account, representing the predictable monthly charge for subscribed services excluding one-time and usage-based charges. Used for revenue forecasting and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA Intelligence MRR Reporting; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: overdue_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount past the payment due date on this billing account. Drives dunning escalation, credit limit monitoring, and collections referral decisions in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Financial Account; eTOM 1.4.2 Revenue Assurance

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument used to settle invoices on this billing account. Determines auto-pay eligibility and dunning escalation paths. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: auto_pay_card|auto_pay_ach|manual_card|manual_ach|check|wire|cash|voucher — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Method; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment is due (e.g., 14, 21, 30). Governs the due date calculation on each invoice and triggers dunning escalation if payment is not received within this window.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Terms; IFRS 15

attributes.name: prepaid_postpaid_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing account operates on a prepaid (advance payment, Comverse ONE), postpaid (invoice-based, Amdocs Revenue Management), or hybrid charging model. Determines the rating engine and balance management system used.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Financial Account Type; 3GPP TS 32.240 Charging Architecture; GSMA PRD BA.27

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the revenue recognition treatment applied to charges on this billing account per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 (e.g., STRAIGHT_LINE, USAGE_BASED, MILESTONE). Used by the finance team for accurate revenue reporting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: sales_channel_code
attributes.description: Channel through which the billing account was originally acquired. Used for ARPU and revenue attribution analysis by channel, commission calculations, and churn analysis by acquisition source. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|retail|online|dealer|telesales|mvno|wholesale — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Channel; eTOM 2.1.1 Customer Acquisition

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating operational system from which this billing account record was sourced (e.g., AMDOCS_RM, COMVERSE_ONE). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - System Reference; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: spend_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total spend threshold configured on this billing account for real-time usage control. When the accumulated charges approach this limit, alerts are triggered or services are throttled. Distinct from credit_limit which governs outstanding balance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Spending Limit; 3GPP TS 32.296 Online Charging; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: tax_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing account is exempt from applicable taxes (e.g., government entities, non-profit organizations). When true, the rating and invoicing engine suppresses tax calculation for charges on this account.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exemption Rules; FCC Universal Service Fund Exemptions; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate
attributes.description: Reference number of the tax exemption certificate provided by the customer. Required for audit and regulatory compliance when tax_exempt is true. Stored for verification by the finance and compliance teams.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 557; FCC Universal Service Fund Rules; ISO/IEC 27001

products.name: invoice
products.description: Periodic billing document issued to a customer summarizing all charges, credits, taxes, and fees for a billing cycle. Captures invoice number, bill date, due date, total amount due, previous balance, payments received, current charges, tax breakdown, bill format, delivery channel, and invoice status (draft, issued, paid, disputed, written-off). SSOT for all customer-facing billing statements. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management.
products.reference: TM Forum SID CustomerBill / Amdocs Invoice

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the invoice record in the billing system. Primary key for the invoice data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing cycle period during which this invoice was generated. Determines the charge period start and end dates for postpaid billing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Cycle

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise invoices must link directly to corporate legal entities for consolidated billing reports, multi-site GL reconciliation, contract compliance auditing, and tax jurisdiction determination. B2B

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is the recipient of this invoice. Supports customer-level billing analytics and ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Domain

attributes.name: generated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: Manual invoices, corrections, and off-cycle bills require audit trail of generating employee for dispute resolution and regulatory compliance. Critical for billing operations accountability and SOX co

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Partner-related invoices (wholesale, MVNO, roaming settlements) must track originating partner. Required for partner invoicing, revenue share calculation, settlement reconciliation, and partner accoun

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Invoice generation pipelines must be traceable for SOX compliance, revenue assurance audits, and data lineage requirements. Enables root cause analysis when invoice discrepancies occur and supports re

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.service_territory. Business justification: Invoices inherit territory assignment for regional revenue recognition, tax jurisdiction determination, regulatory reporting by geography, and franchise authority compliance. Essential for state/local

attributes.name: adjustments_amount
attributes.description: Net total of all billing adjustments, credits, and discounts applied to the invoice. Can be negative (credit to customer) or positive (additional charge). Includes dispute resolutions, goodwill credits, and promotional adjustments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment; IFRS 15

attributes.name: bill_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was generated and issued to the customer. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the invoice. Used as the reference date for payment due date calculation and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: bill_format
attributes.description: The level of detail included in the customer-facing billing statement. Detailed includes full CDR (Call Detail Record) itemization; Summary shows charge categories only; Itemized shows line-item charges without full CDR detail.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Preference; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules

attributes.name: bill_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code specifying the language in which the invoice is rendered for the customer (e.g., en, es, fr, zh-CN). Supports multilingual billing for diverse customer bases and regulatory language requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the billing cycle period covered by this invoice. Defines the end boundary for all charges, usage, and credits included in the invoice.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Cycle; IFRS 15

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the billing cycle period covered by this invoice. Defines the start boundary for all charges, usage, and credits included in the invoice.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Cycle; IFRS 15

attributes.name: billing_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment classification for this invoice, used for segmented revenue reporting, ARPU (Average Revenue Per User) analysis, and MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) tracking. MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator) segment covers reseller billing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Segment; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with the business unit responsible for this invoice. Used for internal financial reporting, OPEX (Operational Expenditure) allocation, and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Module; Internal Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the billing system (Amdocs Revenue Management). Represents the audit creation time for data lineage and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922 - Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this invoice are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing for international and roaming customers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: current_charges_amount
attributes.description: Total of all new charges incurred during the current billing period before taxes and fees. Includes recurring subscription charges, usage charges, and one-time charges rated by Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Charge; IFRS 15

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the invoice is delivered to the customer. Drives the bill presentment workflow in Amdocs Revenue Management. Email: electronic PDF delivery; Paper: physical mail; Portal: self-service web/app; SMS: summary notification; API: machine-to-machine for enterprise customers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Preference; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the total invoice amount that is under active dispute by the customer. May be less than or equal to total_amount_due. Used for revenue assurance reporting and collections hold management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer must settle the invoice to avoid late payment charges or dunning actions. Calculated from bill_date plus the payment terms defined on the billing account.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level for overdue invoices, ranging from 0 (not in dunning) to the maximum configured dunning step. Drives automated collections actions in Amdocs Revenue Management including reminder notices, service suspension warnings, and write-off triggers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss

attributes.name: dunning_status
attributes.description: Current state of the collections/dunning process for this invoice. Tracks the progression of overdue invoice handling from initial reminder through potential write-off. Managed by Amdocs Revenue Management collections module.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning Process; IFRS 9

attributes.name: fees_amount
attributes.description: Total regulatory fees, administrative fees, and surcharges applied to the invoice that are distinct from taxes. Includes items such as regulatory recovery fees, network access fees, and late payment fees.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Charge; FCC Regulatory Fee Schedule

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger (GL) account code to which this invoice's revenue is posted in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Enables financial reporting, revenue assurance reconciliation, and audit trail between billing and accounting systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Module; IFRS 15; GAAP

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable invoice reference number issued to the customer. Printed on the billing statement and used for customer service inquiries and payment references. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management invoicing module.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the invoice. Drives collections workflows, dunning processes, and revenue recognition in Amdocs Revenue Management. Valid states: draft (being prepared), issued (sent to customer), paid (fully settled), disputed (customer raised dispute), written_off (deemed uncollectable), cancelled (voided before issuance).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document State; IFRS 15

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice by its business purpose. Standard: regular periodic billing; Final: issued upon account closure; Interim: mid-cycle billing; Credit Note: net credit to customer; Debit Note: additional charge; Pro Forma: estimate before final billing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document Type; IFRS 15

attributes.name: is_disputed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is currently under a customer billing dispute. True when a dispute has been raised and is pending resolution. Used to flag invoices for collections hold and dispute management workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: is_paperless
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted into paperless billing for this invoice. True when delivery_channel is email or portal. Used for sustainability reporting and paper bill fee waiver logic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Preference; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the invoice was dispatched to the customer via the configured delivery channel. Distinct from bill_date (the billing date) and created_timestamp (record creation). Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance on bill delivery timeliness.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules; SLA Compliance

attributes.name: late_payment_fee
attributes.description: Fee assessed on this invoice for late payment of a prior invoice, per the terms and conditions of the customer's service agreement. Included in fees_amount but tracked separately for fee revenue reporting and customer dispute management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Charge; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or remarks associated with the invoice, entered by billing operations staff. May include reasons for manual adjustments, special billing arrangements, or customer communication notes. Not displayed on the customer-facing bill.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; Internal Billing Operations Policy

attributes.name: outstanding_amount
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this invoice, calculated as total_amount_due minus paid_amount. Used for accounts receivable aging, collections prioritization, and MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the customer against this specific invoice to date. Used to calculate the outstanding balance and determine if the invoice is fully or partially settled.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment; IFRS 9

attributes.name: paid_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the invoice was fully settled and transitioned to paid status. Null for unpaid or partially paid invoices. Used for days-sales-outstanding (DSO) calculation and payment behavior analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment; IFRS 9; Revenue Assurance

attributes.name: paper_bill_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged to the customer for receiving a paper invoice by mail, where applicable. Zero or null for customers enrolled in paperless billing. Supports paperless billing adoption tracking and fee revenue reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Charge; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or method associated with this invoice for settlement. Auto_pay: automatic charge to stored payment method; Direct_debit: bank pull; Credit_card: card charge; Bank_transfer: wire/ACH; Cash: in-store payment. Drives collections and dunning strategy.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Method; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from the bill_date within which payment is due, as defined by the customer's billing account payment terms (e.g., 14, 21, 30 days). Used to calculate due_date and trigger dunning workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Account; IFRS 15

attributes.name: payments_received_amount
attributes.description: Total payments and credits received from the customer since the last invoice, applied against the previous balance. Reduces the amount owed on the current statement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment; IFRS 9

attributes.name: previous_balance_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding balance carried forward from the prior billing cycle before any new charges or payments are applied. Represents the opening balance on the current invoice statement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which revenue from this invoice is recognized in the general ledger per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 revenue recognition standards. May differ from bill_date for deferred or advance billing scenarios.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Finance Module

attributes.name: source_invoice_ref
attributes.description: The native invoice identifier from the originating source system (Amdocs or Comverse ONE) before transformation into the enterprise data lakehouse. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational billing system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Lineage; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that generated this invoice. Amdocs Revenue Management for postpaid billing; Comverse ONE for prepaid balance settlement invoices; Manual for adjustments entered directly by billing operations teams.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Lineage; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to the invoice including all applicable federal, state, local, and regulatory taxes and surcharges (e.g., USF, E911, sales tax). Calculated by the tax engine within Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Tax; FCC Universal Service Fund Rules; IRS Tax Regulations

attributes.name: tax_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is exempt from standard tax charges on this invoice. True for government entities, non-profit organizations, or customers with valid tax exemption certificates on file.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations; TM Forum SID GB922 - Tax Exemption

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate
attributes.description: The reference number of the tax exemption certificate on file for the customer, when tax_exempt is True. Required for audit compliance and tax authority reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations; State Tax Authority Requirements

attributes.name: total_amount_due
attributes.description: The net total amount the customer must pay, calculated as previous_balance_amount minus payments_received_amount plus current_charges_amount plus adjustments_amount plus tax_amount plus fees_amount. This is the authoritative amount printed on the customer-facing billing statement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document; IFRS 15; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this invoice record was last modified in the source billing system. Tracks the most recent update for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922 - Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5

products.name: invoice_line
products.description: Individual charge or credit line item on a customer invoice. Captures service type, charge description, rated quantity, unit rate, charge amount, tax code, tax amount, discount applied, charge period start/end, and originating CDR or event reference. Enables itemized bill presentation and dispute resolution at the line level. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management rating engine.
products.reference: TM Forum SID BillItem / Amdocs Charge Line

attributes.name: invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual invoice line item within the Amdocs Revenue Management system. Serves as the primary key for the invoice_line data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain

attributes.name: addon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.addon. Business justification: Invoice lines for addon charges must reference the addon product for addon revenue reporting, attach rate analysis, addon profitability tracking, and product portfolio optimization.

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to an active or resolved billing dispute record associated with this invoice line item. Populated when a customer has raised a dispute against this specific charge. Enables dispute-to-line traceability for collections and customer service operations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; eTOM Process Framework; Salesforce CRM Case Management

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Invoice lines must reference the catalog item being billed for revenue recognition by product, regulatory reporting, margin analysis, and product performance dashboards. Essential for commercial produ

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this invoice line. Enables customer-level billing analytics, ARPU calculation, and dispute resolution traceability.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Domain; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: fiber_cable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fiber_cable. Business justification: Wholesale customers are billed for fiber lease by cable segment. Required for wholesale fiber lease billing, dark fiber revenue recognition, and infrastructure monetization.

attributes.name: inventory_cpe_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cpe_asset. Business justification: Invoice lines for equipment rental, installation fees, damage charges, or replacement fees must reference the specific CPE asset (modem, router, set-top box). Required for itemized equipment billing a

attributes.name: inventory_spectrum_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.spectrum_allocation. Business justification: For wholesale spectrum sharing, invoice lines must reference the spectrum allocation. Required for spectrum sharing revenue billing, MVNO billing, and infrastructure sharing agreements.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header-detail relationship between the invoice and its constituent charge or credit lines.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: iptv_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.iptv_channel. Business justification: Pay-per-view channel charges billed as individual line items. Necessary for PPV event billing, channel revenue tracking, and reconciliation with content licensing agreements in telco operations.

attributes.name: msisdn_range_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.msisdn_range. Business justification: Number porting fees, premium number charges, or vanity number fees must reference the MSISDN range. Required for number-related billing, regulatory fee allocation, and premium number revenue tracking.

attributes.name: offering_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.offering. Business justification: Invoice lines should reference the offering sold (commercial package) for sales performance tracking, commission calculation, offer-level revenue reporting, and promotional campaign effectiveness anal

attributes.name: ont_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.ont_asset. Business justification: Fiber service invoice lines for ONT installation, rental, or equipment charges must reference the specific ONT. Required for fiber equipment billing, asset tracking, and customer service reconciliatio

attributes.name: original_line_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice line item that this adjustment, credit, or reversal line corrects or offsets. Populated only for adjustment and reversal lines to maintain the audit chain between original charges and their corrections. Enables complete billing history reconstruction.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_package. Business justification: Monthly recurring charges for content packages (HBO, sports bundles) appear as invoice lines. Required for subscription billing, revenue allocation, and package performance analysis in telecommunicati

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Individual line items may be partner-specific (roaming charges, wholesale usage). Required for detailed partner revenue attribution, line-level dispute resolution, and granular settlement reconciliati

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Line-level rating and charging pipelines require traceability for dispute resolution, re-rating scenarios, and usage validation. Critical for identifying which ETL run produced specific charges when c

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Invoice line detail is required for tariff compliance filings and universal service fund (USF) contribution calculations. Real business process: USF reporting requires service-type revenue breakdowns

attributes.name: spec_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product or service catalog item that generated this charge or credit line. Links to the Netcracker Product Catalog to identify the specific product offering (e.g., 5G NR data plan, VoLTE bundle, FTTH broadband).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Product Domain; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service subscription or agreement that originated this charge. Links to the customer's active service contract for wireless, broadband, IPTV, or other telecom services.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Service Domain; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: tap_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.tap_record. Business justification: Retail invoice lines for roaming services must trace to originating TAP records for customer dispute investigation and retail-to-wholesale charge reconciliation—required for proving charge validity to

attributes.name: vod_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.vod_asset. Business justification: VOD rentals and purchases generate invoice line items with asset-specific charges. Essential for VOD revenue recognition, dispute resolution, and content performance reporting in telco billing systems

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for any billing adjustment or credit applied to this line item. Examples include billing error corrections, goodwill credits, SLA breach credits, or dispute resolutions. Populated only when charge_type is 'adjustment' or 'credit'. Used for revenue assurance and dispute analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; eTOM Process Framework; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: The billing cycle identifier to which this invoice line belongs, as defined in Amdocs Revenue Management. Identifies the specific monthly or periodic billing run that generated this line item. Used for billing cycle reconciliation and MRR period alignment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cdr_reference
attributes.description: The originating CDR (Call Detail Record) or usage event reference identifier that generated this charge line. Links the billed charge back to the raw network usage event for revenue assurance, dispute resolution, and audit purposes. Sourced from the Amdocs mediation layer.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297 CDR Specification; TM Forum SID GB922 - Usage Domain; GSMA NRTRDE

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: High-level service category to which this charge belongs, enabling revenue segmentation and MRR/ARPU reporting by service type. Maps to the telecom service taxonomy used in Amdocs Revenue Management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|data|sms|roaming|equipment|interconnect|content|broadband|iptv|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Product Domain; GSMA IOT Guidelines

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the charge or credit line item as it appears on the customer's itemized bill. Examples include 'Monthly 5G Unlimited Plan', 'International Roaming Data - Zone A', 'Late Payment Fee', or 'Loyalty Discount Credit'. Used for bill presentment and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules

attributes.name: charge_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period covered by this charge line item. For recurring charges, this is the last day of the service period. For usage charges, this is the end of the usage aggregation window. Used alongside charge_period_start for proration and revenue recognition period allocation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: charge_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period covered by this charge line item. For recurring charges, this is the first day of the service period. For usage charges, this is the start of the usage aggregation window. Essential for proration calculations and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge or credit line item indicating its billing nature. Recurring charges apply each billing cycle (e.g., monthly plan fee), one_time charges are non-recurring (e.g., activation fee), usage charges are consumption-based (e.g., CDR-rated calls/data), adjustments correct prior billing errors, credits reduce the customer's balance, and tax lines represent applicable tax amounts.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with the business unit or service line responsible for this charge. Used for internal cost allocation, OPEX/CAPEX reporting, and profitability analysis by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID GB922 - Enterprise Domain

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this invoice line record was first created in the Amdocs Revenue Management system and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Provides the audit trail creation timestamp for data governance and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this line item (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing for international customers and roaming scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GSMA NRTRDE; ITU-T

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of any discount applied to this line item, including promotional discounts, loyalty discounts, bundle discounts, or negotiated contract discounts. A positive value reduces the net charge. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management discount engine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: discount_code
attributes.description: The promotional or contractual discount code applied to this line item. References the specific discount offer or loyalty program that generated the discount_amount. Used for discount effectiveness analysis and revenue leakage detection in revenue assurance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code to which this charge line is posted in SAP S/4HANA for financial reporting. Maps the billing line to the appropriate revenue, tax, or adjustment account in the chart of accounts. Required for financial close and regulatory financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Finance Domain

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The pre-discount, pre-tax charge amount for this line item, calculated as rated_quantity multiplied by unit_rate for usage charges, or the flat recurring/one-time fee for non-usage charges. Represents the full list price before any adjustments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_prorated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge line has been prorated to reflect a partial billing period. True when the customer activated, deactivated, or changed a service mid-cycle, resulting in a partial-period charge. Used for billing accuracy validation and customer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge is a recurring Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) component. True for subscription-based charges that appear each billing cycle (e.g., monthly plan fees, equipment rental). Used for MRR reporting and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is subject to taxation. False for tax-exempt charges such as certain government or non-profit customer lines, or for line items that are themselves tax charges. Used by the Amdocs tax engine and for regulatory tax reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund Rules; BEREC; Ofcom; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this line item within the parent invoice. Used for itemized bill presentation, dispute resolution, and maintaining consistent line ordering across billing cycles.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this invoice line item. Active lines are valid billed charges. Disputed lines are under customer dispute investigation. Adjusted lines have been corrected. Cancelled lines have been voided. Reversed lines have been credited back. Written_off lines have been deemed uncollectable.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The charge amount after applying discounts but before tax. Calculated as gross_amount minus discount_amount. Represents the taxable base for this line item and is the primary amount used for revenue recognition per IFRS 15.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules

attributes.name: prepaid_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge line originated from a prepaid account managed by Comverse ONE real-time rating and balance management, as opposed to a postpaid account managed by Amdocs Revenue Management. Drives different revenue recognition and reporting treatment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Comverse ONE; IFRS 15

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the rated_quantity field. Specifies the dimension in which consumption is expressed (e.g., minutes for voice, MB/GB for data, SMS for messaging). Essential for correct interpretation of the rated quantity in billing analytics and dispute resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: minutes|seconds|MB|GB|TB|SMS|units|events|days|months — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Usage Domain; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: rated_quantity
attributes.description: The metered or rated quantity of consumption that forms the basis for this charge. Represents units consumed such as minutes of voice calls, megabytes of data, number of SMS messages, or number of pay-per-view events. Sourced from the Amdocs rating engine after processing CDRs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Usage Domain; 3GPP TS 32.297 CDR Specification

attributes.name: rating_plan_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the tariff or rating plan applied by the Amdocs rating engine to compute the charge for this line item. Enables traceability of the pricing logic used and supports revenue assurance validation against the product catalog.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: rating_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the Amdocs rating engine processed and rated this charge. Provides an audit trail for the rating event and is used to reconcile rated charges against CDR processing windows in revenue assurance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management; 3GPP TS 32.297

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_code
attributes.description: The revenue recognition classification code assigned to this line item per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 performance obligation mapping. Determines how and when revenue from this charge is recognized in the general ledger. Used by SAP S/4HANA finance integration for revenue accounting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: roaming_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge was incurred while the customer was roaming on a visited network outside their home network. True for roaming charges subject to GSMA TAP/NRTRDE inter-operator settlement and IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) pricing.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); GSMA NRTRDE; BEREC Roaming Regulation

attributes.name: service_identifier
attributes.description: The specific service instance identifier associated with this charge, such as the MSISDN (mobile number), IMSI, broadband circuit ID, or IPTV subscriber ID. Enables line-level traceability to the specific service that generated the charge.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003; TM Forum SID GB922 - Service Domain; GSMA

attributes.name: source_system_line_ref
attributes.description: The native line item identifier from the originating source system (Amdocs Revenue Management or Comverse ONE) before surrogate key assignment in the Databricks Silver Layer. Enables lineage tracing back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of tax assessed on this line item, calculated by applying the tax_rate to the net_amount. Includes all applicable taxes and regulatory surcharges (e.g., federal excise tax, state sales tax, USF contributions, E911 fees). Required for regulatory tax reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund Rules; BEREC; Ofcom; IFRS 15

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or tax type code applied to this line item, as determined by the Amdocs tax engine. Examples include federal excise tax codes, state sales tax codes, USF (Universal Service Fund) surcharge codes, or VAT codes for international customers. Maps to the applicable tax authority.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund Rules; ITU-T; ISO 3166; BEREC; Ofcom

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%) applied to the net_amount to compute the tax_amount for this line item. Sourced from the tax jurisdiction configuration in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund Rules; BEREC; Ofcom; ISO 3166

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: The final billed amount for this line item inclusive of all taxes and after all discounts. Calculated as net_amount plus tax_amount. This is the amount that contributes to the invoice total and the customer's payable balance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; FCC Truth-in-Billing Rules

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit price applied to the rated quantity to compute the gross charge amount. Sourced from the Amdocs rating engine's tariff tables. For example, the per-minute rate for international calls or the per-GB rate for data overage charges.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this invoice line record was last modified, such as when a dispute status changed, an adjustment was applied, or a reversal was processed. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: visited_network_code
attributes.description: The Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) code of the visited operator's network where roaming usage was consumed. Composed of MCC (Mobile Country Code) and MNC (Mobile Network Code). Required for GSMA TAP inter-operator settlement and roaming revenue reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003

products.name: payment
products.description: Record of a financial payment received from or applied to a customer billing account. Captures payment date, amount, payment method (credit card, direct debit, bank transfer, cash, voucher), payment channel (IVR, web, agent, auto-pay), authorization code, transaction reference, applied invoice references, and payment status (pending, cleared, reversed, failed). SSOT for all inbound monetary receipts. Sourced from Amdocs Collections module.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Payment / Amdocs Payment

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment record in the billing system. Primary key for the payment data product. Sourced from Amdocs Collections module.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer billing account against which this payment is applied. Links the payment to the account in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingAccount entity

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to an active billing dispute record associated with this payment. Populated when the payment is under investigation or linked to a customer dispute. Null for undisputed payments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — BillingDispute entity; FCC Consumer Complaint Handling

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise payments originate from corporate treasury systems with corporate account references for cash application, AR reconciliation, and consolidated payment allocation across multi-site accounts.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service or collections agent who processed or recorded this payment on behalf of the customer. Null for self-service and automated payments. Used for agent performance and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Collections Agent Workflow

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary invoice this payment is applied against. A payment may partially or fully settle an invoice. Null for unapplied or advance payments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — CustomerBill entity

attributes.name: original_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment record that this record reverses, refunds, or adjusts. Enables chargeback and reversal lineage tracing. Null for original (non-derived) payments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15 Revenue Reversal

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Payments from partners (MVNOs paying wholesale bills, roaming settlement payments). Required for partner payment tracking, accounts receivable management, and settlement payment reconciliation in tele

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to an instalment or payment arrangement plan under which this payment was made. Null for standard one-off payments. Used to track compliance with payment arrangement agreements in collections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — PaymentPlan entity; Amdocs Collections

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Business justification: Payments settle regulatory fines and penalties. Real business process: compliance teams track penalty payments for closure verification, financial reporting, and audit trail. Payment records provide p

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount of the payment as submitted by the customer or payment processor, before any adjustments or fees. Expressed in the billing currency. Core field for revenue reconciliation and MRR reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the payment amount that has been successfully applied to outstanding invoice balances or account credits. May differ from payment_amount if partially applied or pending allocation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric authorization or approval code returned by the payment gateway or card network upon successful transaction authorization. Used for dispute resolution, chargeback processing, and reconciliation with payment processors.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3; ISO 8583 Financial Transaction Message Standard

attributes.name: bank_account_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the bank account number used for direct debit or bank transfer payments. Stored as a masked identifier for verification. Null for non-bank payment methods.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; GDPR Article 5 — Data Minimisation

attributes.name: bank_routing_code
attributes.description: Bank routing number (ABA/ACH in the US) or sort code (UK) or BIC/SWIFT code for international transfers, identifying the financial institution for direct debit and bank transfer payments. Null for non-bank payment methods.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules; SEPA Payment Scheme; ISO 9362 BIC/SWIFT

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount converted to the company's functional (base) currency using the exchange_rate at the time of payment. Used for consolidated financial reporting and revenue recognition in the base currency.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing cycle period that this payment is intended to cover. Used alongside billing_period_start for MRR attribution and period-based revenue recognition.

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing cycle period that this payment is intended to cover. Used for MRR attribution and period-based revenue recognition.

attributes.name: card_last_four
attributes.description: Last four digits of the payment card number used for the transaction. Stored as a masked identifier for customer service verification and reconciliation. Full card number is never stored per PCI DSS requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Requirement 3.3 — Sensitive Authentication Data protection

attributes.name: card_type
attributes.description: Card network brand for credit or debit card payments (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex). Null for non-card payment methods. Used for interchange fee analysis and payment mix reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; ISO 7812 Card Identification

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The customer-facing interface or touchpoint through which the payment was submitted. Distinct from payment_method (instrument). Values: ivr (Interactive Voice Response), web (self-service portal), mobile_app, agent (call centre or retail agent), auto_pay (recurring automated), retail_store, kiosk. Used for channel analytics and cost-to-collect reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ivr|web|mobile_app|agent|auto_pay|retail_store|kiosk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Collections channel taxonomy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment record was first created in the source system (Amdocs Collections). Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency billing environments and international roaming settlement.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Numeric dunning escalation level associated with this payment attempt within the collections dunning cycle (e.g., 0 = no dunning, 1 = first reminder, 2 = second notice, 3 = final notice). Used by Amdocs Collections dunning engine to track collection escalation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — DunningProcess; Amdocs Collections Dunning Module

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount from the transaction currency to the billing base currency at the time of payment. Relevant for international customers and roaming settlement. 1.0 for same-currency transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 9 Foreign Currency Transactions; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: gateway
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the external payment gateway or processor that handled the transaction (e.g., Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, WorldPay, internal BSS gateway). Used for reconciliation, gateway performance monitoring, and fee analysis.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: is_auto_pay
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment was collected automatically via a recurring auto-pay mandate (True) or was manually initiated by the customer or agent (False). Used for auto-pay adoption analytics and churn risk modelling.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; NACHA ACH Recurring Payment Rules

attributes.name: is_partial_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment covers only a portion of the total outstanding balance (True) or fully settles the billed amount (False). Used in collections and dunning workflows to identify accounts with partial payment arrangements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Collections Module

attributes.name: net_received_amount
attributes.description: Net amount received after deducting payment processing fees from the gross payment_amount. Represents the actual funds credited to the telco's account. Used for cash flow reporting and revenue assurance.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922; Revenue Assurance best practices

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by a collections agent or system regarding this payment. May include special handling instructions, customer communication summaries, or exception details. Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Collections

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the payment was received or initiated by the customer. This is the principal business event date used for revenue recognition, aging analysis, and MRR reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to make the payment. Distinguishes the type of payment instrument: credit_card, direct_debit (ACH/SEPA), bank_transfer (wire), cash, voucher (prepaid/gift), or digital_wallet (e.g., PayPal, Apple Pay). Critical for payment processing routing and fraud analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; PCI DSS v4.0; GSMA Payment Guidelines

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment transaction. 'pending' — received but not yet confirmed; 'cleared' — funds confirmed; 'reversed' — payment reversed/chargeback; 'failed' — transaction declined or errored; 'refunded' — amount returned to customer; 'disputed' — under dispute investigation. Drives collections and dunning workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Payment.status; Amdocs Collections lifecycle

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment by its business purpose: standard (regular bill payment), advance (payment before bill issuance), deposit (security deposit), refund (return of funds to customer), reversal (cancellation of a prior payment), adjustment (billing correction). Drives accounting treatment and revenue recognition.

attributes.name: processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the payment gateway or processor for handling this transaction. Deducted from the gross payment amount to derive net received funds. Used for payment cost analysis and OPEX reporting.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the payment transaction was received and recorded in the Amdocs Collections system. Used for real-time reconciliation and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this payment transaction. Used by customers and agents to track and reconcile payments. Sourced from Amdocs Collections module.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Payment.paymentId (external reference)

attributes.name: reversal_reason
