attributes.description: Business reason code or description explaining why a payment was reversed or charged back (e.g., insufficient_funds, duplicate_payment, customer_dispute, fraud, bank_error). Populated only when payment_status is 'reversed' or 'failed'.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; NACHA Return Reason Codes; ISO 20022

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment reversal or chargeback was processed. Null for non-reversed payments. Used for collections workflow timing and dispute SLA tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; PCI DSS v4.0 Chargeback Management

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment funds were actually settled and confirmed by the bank or payment processor. May differ from payment_date for card and bank transfer payments due to clearing cycles. Used for cash flow and revenue recognition reporting.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this payment record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking. Primary sources are Amdocs Collections and Comverse ONE for prepaid.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Lineage

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the external payment gateway, bank, or payment processor. Used to cross-reference and reconcile payments with third-party payment systems and bank statements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; ISO 8583; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the payment amount not yet allocated to any invoice or charge. Represents an overpayment credit or advance payment held on the billing account pending future allocation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment record in the source system. Tracks status changes, reversals, and adjustments for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date from which the payment is considered valid for interest and balance calculations. Used in financial accounting and bank reconciliation. May differ from payment_date and settlement_date.

attributes.name: voucher_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code of the prepaid voucher or gift card redeemed as payment. Applicable only when payment_method is 'voucher'. Used for voucher reconciliation and prepaid balance management in Comverse ONE.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Comverse ONE Prepaid Voucher Management

products.name: rated_event
products.description: Processed and priced usage event produced by the real-time or batch rating engine from raw CDRs, IPDRs, or partner usage feeds. Captures event type (voice, SMS, data, roaming, content, IoT), originating network event reference, subscriber MSISDN/IMSI, serving network (home/visited PLMN for roaming), service identifier, rated volume/duration, applied rate plan and tier, charge amount, discount amount, tax amount, rating timestamp, and rating status (rated, re-rated, disputed, written-off). Supports both domestic and roaming usage with inter-operator settlement attributes for visited network events. Bridges raw usage (CDR domain) and financial charges on invoices. Sourced from Amdocs Rating engine and Comverse ONE real-time rating.
products.reference: TM Forum SID RatedUsage / Amdocs Rated CDR

attributes.name: rated_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each rated usage event record in the billing silver layer. Generated by the Amdocs Rating engine or Comverse ONE real-time rating pipeline upon successful rating of a raw CDR, IPDR, or partner usage feed.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain

attributes.name: addon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.addon. Business justification: Usage events may consume addon allowances (data packs, international calling, roaming). Required for accurate addon usage tracking, quota enforcement, overage billing, and addon product performance an

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account under which this rated event is charged. Links the usage event to the customer financial account for invoice aggregation and ARPU/MRR reporting in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Account; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: The billing period (formatted as YYYY-MM) to which this rated event is allocated for invoicing. Determines which invoice cycle aggregates this charge. Used for MRR reporting, revenue recognition, and billing cycle reconciliation in Amdocs.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Cycle; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Rated usage events must link to the catalog item whose allowances and rating rules apply. Essential for usage analytics by product, fair use policy enforcement, and product design optimization.

attributes.name: cdr_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating raw CDR, IPDR, or partner usage feed record from which this rated event was produced. Bridges the CDR domain to the billing/financial domain and enables traceability back to the network event.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297 - CDR File Format; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: cell_id
attributes.description: The network cell or base station identifier (e.g., eNodeB/gNB cell ID) where the subscriber was served during this event. Used for network-level usage analytics, RAN capacity planning, and geographic revenue reporting. Sourced from CDR network element data.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297; 3GPP TS 38.401 (5G NR gNB); Ericsson Network Manager RAN

attributes.name: coverage_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.coverage_area. Business justification: Usage events occur within specific coverage areas; critical for roaming settlement calculations, network performance correlation with billing disputes, coverage quality analysis, and inter-operator ch

attributes.name: fiber_cable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.fiber_cable. Business justification: For wholesale/carrier billing, usage events on leased fiber must reference the cable segment. Required for wholesale fiber usage billing, capacity planning, and inter-carrier settlement.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice on which this rated event charge appears. Populated after invoice generation; null for events not yet invoiced or for prepaid events settled via balance deduction.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Invoice; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing

attributes.name: lawful_intercept_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.lawful_intercept_order. Business justification: Rated events (CDRs) are delivered to law enforcement under lawful intercept orders. Real business process: LEA requests require CDR extraction with chain of custody tracking. Compliance teams link del

attributes.name: managed_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.managed_service. Business justification: Usage events (data consumption, API calls, voice minutes) must link to managed service instances for capacity planning, SLA performance measurement, usage-based billing validation, and service-specifi

attributes.name: original_rated_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original rated event record that this record supersedes or corrects. Populated for re-rated or reversed events to maintain the audit chain. Enables before/after comparison for revenue assurance and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Event Correction; Amdocs Revenue Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Roaming events and wholesale usage must track originating/terminating partner network. Required for roaming event settlement, wholesale usage billing, inter-operator charging, and TAP/RAP file reconci

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Usage rating pipelines must be tracked for re-rating workflows, interconnect settlement reconciliation, and roaming dispute resolution. Enables identification of which rating engine run processed spec

attributes.name: rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate plan applied during rating of this event. Determines the pricing tiers, bundle allowances, and charging rules used to compute the charge amount.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Product Offering Price; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating

attributes.name: serving_location_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.location_site. Business justification: Events are served by specific cell sites; essential for site-level revenue attribution, capacity planning ROI analysis, interconnect settlement by site, and correlating billing disputes with site outa

attributes.name: sim_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sim_stock. Business justification: Usage events (calls, SMS, data sessions) are generated by specific SIM cards. Rating engines need SIM-to-event linkage for fraud detection, roaming reconciliation, and SIM swap validation. Critical fo

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active subscriber service subscription (rate plan contract) under which this usage event is rated. Determines applicable rate plan, bundles, and allowances in Amdocs and Comverse ONE.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Service Subscription; 3GPP TS 32.240

attributes.name: tap_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.tap_record. Business justification: Roaming CDRs rated in billing must reference source TAP records for wholesale settlement reconciliation, dispute resolution, and revenue assurance audits—critical for matching retail charges to wholes

attributes.name: access_point_name
attributes.description: The APN used by the subscriber for data sessions, identifying the packet data network gateway and service context (e.g., internet, enterprise VPN, IMS). Used for data service classification, QoS policy application, and DPI-based rating.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003 APN; 3GPP TS 32.251 PS Charging; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: bundle_consumed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rated event was charged against an included bundle allowance (True) or rated as an out-of-bundle/overage charge (False). Used to track bundle utilization, identify overage revenue, and support customer usage analytics.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Bundle Management; TM Forum SID GB922; Comverse ONE Balance Management

attributes.name: called_party_number
attributes.description: The destination number (B-party) dialed or messaged by the subscriber for voice calls and SMS events. Used for inter-operator settlement, fraud analysis, and regulatory lawful intercept compliance. Classified as confidential PII.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.250; ITU-T E.164; CALEA; ETSI LI Standards

attributes.name: charge_amount
attributes.description: The gross charge amount applied to this rated event before discounts and taxes, in the billing currency. Computed by the rating engine based on the applicable rate plan tier and rated volume/duration. Core financial field for revenue recognition and invoice line generation.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Rating; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the charge associated with this rated event. 'usage' = consumption-based charge; 'recurring' = periodic subscription charge; 'one_time' = activation/setup fee; 'adjustment' = billing correction; 'reversal' = credit/reversal of a prior charge. Used for revenue categorization and GL posting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Applied Customer Billing Rate; Amdocs Revenue Management; IFRS 15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rated event record was first persisted in the Databricks silver layer. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and pipeline monitoring. Distinct from rating_timestamp (when rated) and event_start_timestamp (when the event occurred).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the charge, discount, and tax amounts are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Essential for multi-currency billing environments and inter-operator settlement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; ITU-T D.150; GSMA TAP3 IOT

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The total discount amount applied to this rated event (promotional, loyalty, bundle, or contractual discounts) in the billing currency. Reduces the gross charge to arrive at the net charge. Used for discount analytics and revenue assurance.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Rating; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of the billing dispute or inter-operator dispute case associated with this rated event, if applicable. Populated when rating_status = 'disputed'. Links to the dispute management workflow in Amdocs or ServiceNow ITSM for resolution tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; Amdocs Revenue Management; GSMA TAP3 Dispute

attributes.name: event_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the origination direction of the usage event. MO (Mobile Originated) = subscriber initiated the call/session; MT (Mobile Terminated) = subscriber received the call/session. Relevant for voice and SMS rating and inter-operator settlement.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.250 CS Domain Charging; GSMA TAP3

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the usage event concluded (e.g., call release time, data session termination). Used to compute event duration and for billing cycle boundary determination.

attributes.name: event_sequence_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier assigned by the rating engine or source OSS/BSS system to uniquely identify this rated event within a billing cycle or batch. Used for reconciliation, dispute resolution, and inter-operator settlement references.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA NRTRDE; TAP3 IOT

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the usage event began (e.g., call answer time, data session start, SMS submission time). This is the principal real-world event time used for billing cycle allocation, time-of-day rating, and CDR correlation.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T Q.825

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the usage event by service type. Drives rating logic selection and reporting segmentation. Examples: voice (MO/MT calls), SMS, data (packet sessions), roaming (visited network), content (OTT/IPTV), IoT (machine-to-machine). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|sms|data|roaming|content|iot|mms|video — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240 Charging Architecture; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: home_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Public Land Mobile Network (Home PLMN)
attributes.description: The MCC+MNC code identifying the subscriber's home network operator (HPLMN). Used to determine domestic vs. roaming status and to apply correct inter-operator tariffs (IOT) for roaming settlement via GSMA TAP/NRTRDE.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003; ITU-T E.212; GSMA TAP3; GSMA NRTRDE

attributes.name: imei
attributes.description: The IMEI of the device used during this usage event. Used for device-level analytics, fraud detection (stolen device usage), and regulatory reporting. Classified as confidential device identifier.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA IMEI Database; FCC Regulations

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The IMSI uniquely identifying the SIM/subscriber on the network. Used for roaming settlement, fraud detection, and subscriber authentication correlation. Classified as restricted PII as it uniquely identifies a subscriber.

attributes.name: inter_operator_charge
attributes.description: The inter-operator tariff (IOT) charge amount payable to or receivable from the visited network operator for roaming events, in the settlement currency. Populated only for roaming events (is_roaming = true). Used for GSMA TAP/NRTRDE wholesale settlement and interconnect accounting.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3; GSMA NRTRDE; ITU-T D.150 IOT; TM Forum SID GB922 Interconnect

attributes.name: is_roaming
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this usage event occurred while the subscriber was roaming on a visited network (VPLMN). True = roaming event subject to inter-operator settlement; False = domestic event. Drives roaming-specific rating rules and GSMA TAP/NRTRDE processing.

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The subscriber's MSISDN (phone number in E.164 format) associated with this usage event. Primary subscriber identifier for rating, billing, and inter-operator settlement. Classified as restricted PII as it directly identifies an individual subscriber.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.003; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: net_charge_amount
attributes.description: The final net charge amount for this rated event after applying discounts and taxes (charge_amount - discount_amount + tax_amount) in the billing currency. This is the amount posted to the customer invoice and used for revenue recognition and ARPU calculation.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: network_technology
attributes.description: The radio access or network technology used to deliver the service for this event (e.g., 4G LTE, 5G NR, VoLTE, FTTH/GPON). Used for technology-based revenue analytics, network capacity planning, and QoS reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 2G|3G|4G_LTE|5G_NR|VoLTE|VoIP|WiFi|FTTH|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.501 (5G NR); 3GPP TS 36.300 (LTE); ITU-T G.984 (GPON); ETSI

attributes.name: rated_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The billable duration of the usage event in seconds as determined by the rating engine after applying rounding rules (e.g., per-second, per-minute rounding). Applicable for voice and video call events. May differ from raw CDR duration due to rating rounding rules.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.250; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: rated_unit_count
attributes.description: The number of billable units consumed in this event as determined by the rating engine. For SMS: number of message segments; for content: number of items; for IoT: number of transactions. Complements rated_duration_seconds and rated_volume_bytes for non-time/non-data event types.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: rated_volume_bytes
attributes.description: The billable data volume in bytes as determined by the rating engine after applying any volume rounding or threshold rules. Applicable for data, roaming data, and IoT events. Used for bundle consumption tracking and overage charge calculation.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.251 PS Domain Charging; Amdocs Revenue Management; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: rating_engine
attributes.description: Identifies the rating system that processed and priced this event. 'amdocs' = Amdocs Revenue Management batch/real-time rating; 'comverse_one' = Comverse ONE prepaid real-time rating; 'partner_feed' = rated by a partner/MVNO; 'manual' = manually rated adjustment. Used for data lineage and revenue assurance.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: rating_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event was rated in real-time (online charging, e.g., Comverse ONE prepaid), batch mode (Amdocs post-processing), or offline (delayed/manual). Affects revenue recognition timing and prepaid balance deduction sequencing.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240 Online/Offline Charging; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: rating_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rated event within the billing workflow. 'rated' = successfully priced; 're_rated' = repriced after correction; 'disputed' = under customer or inter-operator dispute; 'written_off' = revenue written off; 'pending' = awaiting rating completion; 'rejected' = failed rating validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rated|re_rated|disputed|written_off|pending|rejected — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Event State; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: rating_tier
attributes.description: The specific pricing tier or band within the rate plan applied to this event (e.g., TIER_1_BUNDLE, TIER_2_OVERAGE, PEAK, OFF_PEAK, ROAM_ZONE_A). Indicates which step of a tiered or time-of-day pricing structure was used. Critical for revenue assurance and rate plan analytics.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Tiers; TM Forum SID GB922 - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: rating_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the rating engine (Amdocs or Comverse ONE) processed and priced this usage event. Distinct from the event start/end timestamps. Used for rating pipeline SLA monitoring, re-rating audit trails, and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Engine; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: re_rating_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this event was re-rated (e.g., rate plan correction, tariff update, CDR amendment, dispute resolution). Populated only when rating_status = 're_rated'. Essential for revenue assurance audit trails.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Re-Rating; TM Forum SID GB922; Revenue Assurance Best Practices

attributes.name: roaming_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the roaming event occurred. Populated only when is_roaming = true. Used for roaming revenue reporting, IOT application, and regulatory compliance with visited country regulations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GSMA TAP3; ITU-T E.212

attributes.name: service_identifier
attributes.description: The specific service or product code from the Netcracker Service Catalog that this usage event is associated with (e.g., VOICE_DOMESTIC, DATA_4G, SMS_INTL, ROAM_DATA_EU). Used to apply service-specific rating rules and bundle consumption tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Service Specification; Netcracker OSS/BSS Service Catalog

attributes.name: serving_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Serving Public Land Mobile Network (Serving PLMN / Visited PLMN)
attributes.description: The MCC+MNC code of the network that served the subscriber during this event. For domestic events equals the home PLMN; for roaming events identifies the visited network (VPLMN). Critical for inter-operator settlement and roaming IOT application.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003; ITU-T E.212; GSMA TAP3; GSMA NRTRDE

attributes.name: tap_file_reference
attributes.description: The GSMA TAP3 file identifier referencing the inter-operator roaming data exchange file from which this roaming rated event was sourced. Used for roaming settlement reconciliation, dispute management, and NRTRDE compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA NRTRDE; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount levied on this rated event in the billing currency (e.g., VAT, GST, USF, E911 surcharges). Computed based on applicable tax jurisdiction rules. Required for tax reporting, regulatory compliance, and invoice accuracy.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Tax Engine; FCC USF Regulations; ETSI; ITU-T D.150; IFRS 15

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rated event record was last modified in the silver layer (e.g., after re-rating, dispute resolution, or status update). Used for change tracking, incremental processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail

products.name: billing_charge
products.description: Individual monetary charge applied to a billing account outside of usage rating — including recurring monthly fees, one-time activation fees, equipment charges, late payment fees, and manually applied charges. Captures charge type, charge category, amount, tax class, effective date, charge period, originating product/service reference, and charge status. Distinct from rated_event (usage-based) and invoice_line (bill presentation). Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management.
products.reference: TM Forum SID AppliedCustomerBillingRate / Amdocs Charge

attributes.name: billing_charge_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual monetary charge record within the billing domain. Serves as the primary key for the charge entity in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain

attributes.name: addon_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.addon. Business justification: Addon charges (recurring, one-time, usage-based) must link to addon definition for billing validation, addon revenue attribution, dispute resolution, and addon product performance measurement.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account to which this charge is applied. Links the charge to the customer's financial account in Amdocs Revenue Management for invoice consolidation and MRR/ARPU reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Account

attributes.name: billing_approved_by_agent_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or authorized agent who approved this charge when approval_status is 'approved'. Null for system-generated or not_required charges. Supports SOX compliance and internal audit requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; SOX Compliance; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: billing_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing cycle in which this charge was generated and processed. Links the charge to the specific monthly or periodic billing run in Amdocs Revenue Management for cycle-level reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Cycle; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cpe_asset. Business justification: One-time charges for equipment installation, damage, replacement, or early termination must link to the specific CPE asset. Essential for equipment damage billing, warranty claim processing, and asset

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscribed product or service instance that originated this charge (e.g., a specific mobile plan, broadband subscription, or equipment). Links charge to the Product and Service Catalog in Netcracker OSS/BSS.

attributes.name: vod_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.vod_asset. Business justification: One-time VOD charges tracked in charge management before invoicing. Required for charge approval workflows, revenue recognition timing, and content-specific charge dispute resolution in telecommunicat

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for charges requiring authorization before posting, particularly manual adjustments and credits above threshold amounts. not_required for system-generated charges; pending_approval, approved, or rejected for manual charges requiring supervisor sign-off.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the charge was approved by an authorized agent or supervisor. Null for system-generated charges or those not requiring approval. Supports audit trail and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; SOX Compliance; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: charge_category
attributes.description: High-level business category grouping charges for revenue reporting and GL account mapping: service (subscription/plan fees), equipment (CPE/device), penalty (late fees, breach), tax (regulatory levies), discount (promotional credits), surcharge (regulatory recovery fees), interconnect (IOT/wholesale). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: service|equipment|penalty|tax|discount|surcharge|interconnect — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Category; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: charge_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the charge as it appears on the customer's bill and in customer service interactions. Examples: 'Monthly Unlimited Plan Fee', 'iPhone 15 Equipment Charge', 'Late Payment Penalty'. Sourced from Amdocs charge specification.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Specification; FCC Truth-in-Billing

attributes.name: charge_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the charge as displayed on customer bills and used in dispute resolution and customer service interactions within Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Charge Reference

attributes.name: charge_source
attributes.description: Originating system that generated or triggered this charge: amdocs (Amdocs Revenue Management automated billing), comverse (Comverse ONE prepaid/real-time charging), manual (agent-applied via CRM), order_management (Oracle OSM order fulfillment), product_catalog (Netcracker catalog-driven), crm (Salesforce CRM agent action).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Source System; eTOM

attributes.name: charge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the charge within the billing workflow: pending (created, not yet billed), active (approved for billing), invoiced (included on an invoice), disputed (under customer dispute), waived (forgiven without reversal), cancelled (voided before invoicing), reversed (credited back after invoicing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|active|invoiced|disputed|waived|cancelled|reversed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Lifecycle; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge by its billing nature: recurring (monthly service fee), one_time (single occurrence), activation (service provisioning fee), equipment (CPE/device charge), late_payment (penalty fee), adjustment (credit or debit correction), or manual (agent-applied charge). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recurring|one_time|activation|equipment|late_payment|adjustment|manual — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Specification; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code identifying the organizational unit responsible for this charge for internal financial allocation and OPEX reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; Internal Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this charge record was first created in the billing system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, Silver layer ingestion tracking, and compliance with ISO/IEC 27001 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the charge amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing for international and roaming scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of any promotional, loyalty, or contractual discount applied to reduce the gross charge amount. Negative value reduces the net charge. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management discount engine.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Applied Discount; eTOM Billing Management

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning escalation level for unpaid charges, ranging from 0 (no dunning) to the maximum configured level (e.g., 4 = final notice before collections). Managed by the Amdocs Revenue Management dunning engine for collections workflow.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections

attributes.name: dunning_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent dunning action taken on this charge (e.g., reminder notice sent, suspension warning issued). Null if dunning_level is 0. Used to track collections escalation timeline.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the charge becomes effective and is recognized as a financial obligation on the billing account. Used for revenue recognition alignment per IFRS 15 and for billing cycle proration calculations.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Date

attributes.name: external_reference_number
attributes.description: External or cross-system reference identifier for this charge, such as a partner billing reference, wholesale interconnect settlement reference (TAP/IOT), or regulatory reporting reference number. Supports reconciliation with partner and regulatory systems.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code to which this charge is posted for financial reporting, EBITDA calculation, and revenue recognition. Maps charge categories to the chart of accounts for CAPEX/OPEX classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 15; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Pre-tax, pre-discount gross monetary value of the charge in the billing currency. Represents the base charge amount before any tax calculation or promotional discount is applied. Used as the basis for revenue recognition and MRR reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Amount; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_prorated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this charge has been prorated to reflect a partial billing period (e.g., mid-cycle activation or cancellation). True when the charge amount has been adjusted proportionally to the number of days in the service period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Proration; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: mrr_contribution
attributes.description: The portion of this charge that contributes to Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) calculations. For recurring charges, this equals the normalized monthly gross amount. Zero for one-time charges. Used in MRR/ARPU reporting and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Revenue Management; MRR Industry Standard

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final billable amount after applying discounts and adding taxes: net_amount = gross_amount - discount_amount + tax_amount. This is the amount posted to the customer's billing account and reflected on the invoice line.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Net Amount; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment for this charge must be received to avoid late payment penalties and dunning escalation. Derived from the billing cycle due date and any applicable grace period configured in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Due Date; FCC Truth-in-Billing

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this charge. Together with charge_period_start, defines the service period for which the recurring or prorated charge applies. Null for one-time charges with no period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Period; IFRS 15

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this charge. Applicable for recurring charges (e.g., monthly plan fee covering 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-31). Used for proration and revenue period matching.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Period; IFRS 15

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Decimal factor applied to the full-period charge to derive the prorated amount (e.g., 0.516129 for 16 days out of 31). Null when is_prorated is False. Used for revenue assurance validation of prorated charges.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Proration; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason or trigger for the charge (e.g., NEW_ACTIVATION, PLAN_UPGRADE, EQUIPMENT_PURCHASE, LATE_PAYMENT, MANUAL_CREDIT, PRORATION). Used for revenue assurance analysis and dispute management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Reason; eTOM Billing Management

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which revenue from this charge is recognized in the financial statements per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 performance obligation satisfaction criteria. May differ from effective_date for multi-period or bundled service charges.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_system_charge_code
attributes.description: The native charge identifier as recorded in the originating operational system (Amdocs Revenue Management or Comverse ONE). Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and support of revenue assurance processes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Source System Reference; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax levied on this charge, including VAT, GST, USF (Universal Service Fund), and other regulatory surcharges as determined by the tax class and jurisdiction. Calculated by the Amdocs tax engine per FCC and ITU regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Tax; FCC Universal Service Fund; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: tax_class
attributes.description: Tax classification of the charge that determines the applicable tax treatment and rate. Drives the Amdocs tax engine calculation: taxable (standard rate), exempt (no tax), zero_rated (0% VAT/GST), reduced_rate (preferential rate), regulatory_surcharge (FCC/NTIA mandated levies).
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory Reporting; ITU-T; ETSI; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: Effective tax rate percentage applied to this charge at the time of billing, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%). Captured for audit and revenue assurance purposes as rates may change over time.
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory Reporting; NTIA; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this charge record was last modified in the billing system. Tracks status changes, amount adjustments, and dispute updates. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Trail; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this charge was waived (charge_status = 'waived'). Examples: 'Customer goodwill gesture', 'Service outage credit', 'Regulatory compliance'. Required for revenue assurance audit when charges are forgiven.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Charge Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Credit or debit adjustment applied to a billing account, serving as SSOT for all account balance corrections including internal adjustments and customer-facing credit note documents. Captures adjustment type (credit/debit), document type (internal adjustment or customer-facing credit note), reason code, amount, tax impact, tax reversal amount, credit note number and issue date (when document type is credit note), approving agent, approval date, reference dispute or ticket ID, reference invoice, credited amount breakdown, and adjustment status (pending, approved, applied, reversed, expired). Covers goodwill credits, SLA breach compensation, dispute resolutions, overbilling corrections, returned equipment credits, and service outage compensation. When document type is credit note, serves as the formal financial document issued to the customer. Sourced from Amdocs Revenue Management adjustments module.
products.reference: TM Forum SID BillingAdjustment / Amdocs Adjustment

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the billing adjustment record. Primary key for the adjustment data product in the Amdocs Revenue Management adjustments module.

attributes.name: billing_account_id

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Billing adjustments related to partner disputes or settlement corrections. Required for partner dispute resolution, settlement reconciliation, and partner-specific billing corrections in telecommunica

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Adjustment processing pipelines must be traceable for compliance reporting, revenue leakage analysis, and audit trail requirements. Critical for identifying which batch process applied credits or debi

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Real business process: penalty settlements require proof of customer restitu

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Contract-related adjustments for SLA violations, pricing corrections, and service level failures require contract reference for audit trails, revenue recognition adjustments, legal compliance, and con

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.vod_asset. Business justification: Manual billing adjustments for VOD transaction errors or goodwill credits. Required for VOD billing correction workflows, audit trails, and content-specific adjustment reporting in telco billing.

attributes.description: Business category classifying the nature of the adjustment for reporting, revenue assurance, and analytics purposes. attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number for the adjustment. Used in customer communications, dispute correspondence, and financial reconciliation. Format: ADJ- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the adjustment. Pending: awaiting approval. Approved: authorized but not yet applied to the account. Applied: posted to the billing account. Reversed: previously applied adjustment that has been undone. Expired: approved adjustment that was not applied within the validity window.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment Lifecycle; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adjustment increases (credit) or decreases (debit) the customer's account balance. A credit reduces the amount owed; a debit increases it.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment Type; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: applied_date
attributes.description: Date on which the adjustment was posted and applied to the billing account balance. Populated when adjustment_status transitions to 'applied'.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the adjustment was formally approved by the authorizing agent. Supports approval audit trails and SLA compliance for dispute resolution timelines.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Revenue Assurance; ISO/IEC 27001; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: approval_threshold_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adjustment amount exceeded the standard agent approval threshold, requiring escalated authorization. Supports revenue assurance controls and fraud prevention.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Revenue Assurance; ISO/IEC 27001; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period to which this adjustment relates. Used alongside billing_period_start for period-accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Period; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period to which this adjustment relates. Used for period-accurate revenue recognition, MRR reporting, and financial close processes.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Period; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code associated with this adjustment for internal financial allocation and OPEX reporting purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Module; TM Forum eTOM - Financial Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adjustment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922 - Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: credit_note_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the credit note was formally issued to the customer. Populated only when document_type is 'credit_note'. Determines the financial period for revenue recognition and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; TM Forum SID GB922 - Credit Note

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: Formal reference number of the customer-facing credit note document. Populated only when document_type is 'credit_note'. Used in customer communications, accounts receivable reconciliation, and regulatory financial reporting. Format: CN- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Credit Note; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credited_onetime_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the net adjustment amount attributable to one-time charges such as activation fees, equipment charges, or installation fees.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - One-Time Charge; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credited_recurring_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the net adjustment amount attributable to recurring subscription or plan charges (e.g., monthly plan fees, MRR components). Supports MRR impact analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Recurring Charge; Amdocs Revenue Management; MRR Reporting

attributes.name: credited_usage_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the net adjustment amount attributable to usage charges (e.g., voice, data, SMS). Supports breakdown of credited amounts by charge type for revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Usage Charge; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this adjustment record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing environments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: document_type

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the adjustment takes effect on the billing account. Determines the billing period impacted and is used for revenue recognition period alignment.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which an approved but unapplied adjustment expires and can no longer be applied to the billing account. Supports dunning and collections workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment Validity; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which this adjustment is posted for financial accounting purposes. Supports SAP S/4HANA integration and revenue recognition journal entries.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Finance Module; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The pre-tax gross amount of the adjustment before tax impact is applied. Positive value for credits; negative value for debits. Used in revenue recognition and MRR reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment Amount

attributes.name: is_customer_visible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment is visible to the customer on their invoice or self-service portal. Internal adjustments may not be customer-facing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Document Visibility; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total net amount of the adjustment including gross amount, tax amount, and tax reversal. Represents the actual financial impact posted to the billing account. Used for revenue assurance and ARPU impact reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments entered by the agent or system regarding this adjustment. Captures supplementary context not covered by structured fields.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for the adjustment. Examples include: GOODWILL, SLA_BREACH, OVERBILLING, DISPUTE_RESOLUTION, EQUIPMENT_RETURN, SERVICE_OUTAGE, BILLING_ERROR. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GOODWILL|SLA_BREACH|OVERBILLING|DISPUTE_RESOLUTION|EQUIPMENT_RETURN|SERVICE_OUTAGE|BILLING_ERROR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Adjustment Reason; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the specific reason for the adjustment, supplementing the reason_code with contextual details such as the nature of the SLA breach, outage duration, or billing discrepancy.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: requires_manager_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment requires manager-level approval due to amount thresholds, category sensitivity, or policy rules. Drives approval workflow routing in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Revenue Assurance; Amdocs Revenue Management Approval Workflow

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the adjustment amount was recognized in the financial statements under IFRS 15. Populated when revenue_recognition_flag is true.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance Module

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment has been recognized in the financial revenue recognition process under IFRS 15. Supports financial close and revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; TM Forum SID GB922 - Revenue Management

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously applied adjustment was reversed. Populated when adjustment_status transitions to 'reversed'. Used for revenue assurance and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment Reversal; IFRS 15

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason why a previously applied adjustment was reversed. Populated when adjustment_status is 'reversed'. Supports revenue assurance and audit compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: source_reference_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this adjustment record in the originating source system (e.g., Amdocs internal adjustment ID, Comverse ONE transaction reference). Supports cross-system reconciliation and data lineage.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Data Management; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this adjustment. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across BSS platforms.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - BSS Architecture; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component of the adjustment, representing the tax impact associated with the gross adjustment amount. May be positive (credit) or negative (debit) depending on adjustment_type.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; FCC Tax Reporting Requirements; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: tax_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment is exempt from tax calculation. Applicable for certain goodwill credits or adjustments on tax-exempt accounts.
attributes.references: FCC Tax Reporting Requirements; NTIA; Amdocs Revenue Management Tax Module

attributes.name: tax_reversal_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax reversed as part of this adjustment, applicable when the original invoice tax must be partially or fully reversed. Distinct from tax_amount which represents new tax applied to the adjustment.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; FCC Tax Reporting; Amdocs Revenue Management Tax Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this adjustment record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922 - Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5

products.name: billing_dispute
products.description: Formal record of a customer-initiated billing dispute against a charge, invoice, or rated event. Captures dispute date, disputed amount, dispute reason, supporting evidence references, assigned resolution agent, resolution date, resolution outcome (upheld, partially upheld, rejected), credit issued, and dispute status lifecycle (open, under review, resolved, escalated). Enables dispute management workflow and regulatory compliance tracking.
products.reference: TM Forum SID BillingDispute / Amdocs Dispute

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the billing dispute record. Primary key for the dispute entity in the Amdocs Revenue Management system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the billing account against which the dispute has been raised. A customer may have multiple billing accounts (e.g., consumer vs. business lines).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Account; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_charge_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific charge or rated event being disputed. Nullable when the dispute covers an entire invoice rather than a single line item.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Applied Customer Billing Rate; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Module

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated customer service case in Salesforce CRM Case Management or ServiceNow ITSM, enabling end-to-end dispute-to-case traceability.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; ServiceNow ITSM Incident Management

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise disputes require corporate account context for executive escalation workflows, relationship health scoring, churn risk assessment, and corporate-level dispute trend analysis. B2B dispute ma

attributes.name: customer_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Disputes are raised by specific authorized contacts (account holders, authorized users, corporate account managers). Tracking who raised dispute is critical for authorization validation, communication

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the billing resolution agent or team member currently assigned to investigate and resolve the dispute. Links to the workforce/employee master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Case Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Dispute Workflow; TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Role

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.content_package. Business justification: Disputes over package features, channel availability, or billing errors. Essential for package dispute management, trend analysis, and service improvement in telecommunications operations.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Billing disputes involving partners (roaming charge disputes, wholesale billing disputes). Required for partner dispute management, settlement dispute resolution, and inter-operator dispute tracking i

attributes.name: previous_dispute_billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the earlier dispute record if this is a repeat or re-opened dispute. Enables dispute lineage tracking and repeat-dispute root-cause analysis. Nullable for first-time disputes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Business justification: Disputes can trigger regulatory penalties (systematic billing errors, cramming violations) or result from penalty-mandated remediation. Real business process: FCC/FTC penalties for billing accuracy vi

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Billing disputes often reference contract terms for SLA violations, pricing disagreements, and service level failures; contract_id is essential for dispute resolution, legal documentation, and contrac

attributes.name: settlement_dispute_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.settlement_dispute. Business justification: Customer billing disputes for roaming charges often trigger or relate to wholesale settlement disputes with roaming partners—essential for coordinated dispute resolution and determining liability betw

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer subscription or service agreement to which the disputed charge is associated. Links to the subscription/service master record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Facing Service; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: svc_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to service.svc_instance. Business justification: Disputes reference specific service instances for usage validation, roaming charge verification, and service quality claims. Essential for CDR audit trails, network performance correlation, and regula

attributes.name: vod_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.vod_asset. Business justification: Customers dispute VOD charges for content not delivered or quality issues. Required for VOD dispute tracking, root cause analysis, and content provider accountability in telco customer care.

attributes.name: approved_credit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary credit amount approved and issued to the customer as the resolution outcome. May be less than, equal to, or zero relative to the disputed amount depending on the resolution decision (upheld, partially upheld, rejected).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Applied Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing cycle to which the disputed charge belongs. Used alongside billing_period_start to scope the dispute to a specific invoice period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Cycle; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Module

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing cycle to which the disputed charge belongs. Enables period-specific dispute analysis and reconciliation against invoice billing cycles.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Cycle; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Module

attributes.name: cdr_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific Call Detail Record (CDR) or usage event record that is the subject of the dispute. Enables direct linkage between the dispute and the rated usage event in the mediation/rating system.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297 - CDR File Format; GSMA NRTRDE; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Module

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer submitted the billing dispute. Used for channel analytics, agent routing, and omnichannel experience reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ivr|web_portal|mobile_app|retail_store|call_center|email|chat|written_correspondence — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Channel; TM Forum eTOM Process 2.3.3 - Customer Interface Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the dispute record was first created in the data platform. Distinct from raised_timestamp which captures the business event time. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922 - Root Entity; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: Human-readable credit note reference number generated by Amdocs Revenue Management when a credit is issued as the dispute resolution outcome. Used for customer communication and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Applied Billing Adjustment; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing Module; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the disputed and credit amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing environments for international and wholesale customers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922 - Money

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Market segment of the customer raising the dispute. Drives SLA targets, resolution authority thresholds, and regulatory reporting categorization. MVNO refers to Mobile Virtual Network Operator partners.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Segment; GSMA MVNO Guidelines; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: dispute_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable reference number assigned to the dispute at creation. Used in customer communications, agent workflows, and regulatory correspondence. Format: DSP- followed by 10 digits.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework - Revenue Assurance; Amdocs Revenue Management Dispute Module

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing dispute. Drives workflow routing in Amdocs and Salesforce CRM. Valid states: open (newly raised), under_review (agent investigating), escalated (referred to senior team or regulator), resolved (outcome determined), closed (credit/adjustment applied and confirmed), withdrawn (customer retracted the dispute).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6 - Manage Billing Disputes; FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the billing dispute. Drives routing rules and SLA targets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: charge_error|service_not_received|unauthorized_charge|roaming_dispute|early_termination_fee|late_payment_fee|promotional_credit_missing|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute Type; GSMA NRTRDE Dispute Classification

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount the customer is disputing, expressed in the billing currency. Represents the full value under contention before any partial resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Money; ISO 4217 Currency Standard; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute has been escalated beyond the first-line resolution team (e.g., to a senior billing specialist, legal team, or external regulator such as FCC or Ofcom). True = escalated.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6; FCC Consumer Complaint Handling; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Tier to which the dispute has been escalated. tier_1: first-line agent; tier_2: senior billing specialist; tier_3: billing management/legal; regulatory: external regulator (FCC, Ofcom, BEREC).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6; FCC Consumer Complaint Handling; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative or coded reason explaining why the dispute was escalated. Populated only when escalation_flag is True. Examples: SLA breach, high-value dispute, regulatory complaint, repeat dispute.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6; Amdocs Revenue Management Escalation Workflow

attributes.name: evidence_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to supporting evidence documents (e.g., CDR extracts, call recordings, usage reports, screenshots) stored in the document management system. Supports dispute investigation and audit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to the dispute for workflow queue management. Determined by factors such as disputed amount, customer segment (e.g., enterprise vs. consumer), SLA proximity, and regulatory complaint status.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6; Amdocs Revenue Management Dispute Workflow; Salesforce CRM Case Priority

attributes.name: raised_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer formally raised the billing dispute. Used for SLA measurement, regulatory reporting, and aging analysis. Distinct from the system record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines; TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations

attributes.name: raised_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the dispute was formally submitted by the customer. Used for exact SLA clock-start calculations and audit trail.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; Amdocs Revenue Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the specific reason for the dispute as defined in the Amdocs Revenue Management reason code catalog. Used for root-cause analytics and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Amdocs Revenue Management Dispute Reason Catalog; TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the customer or agent describing the reason for the dispute. Captured at intake and used for agent context and NLP-based dispute analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: regulatory_complaint_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute has been formally lodged with or referred to a regulatory body (e.g., FCC, Ofcom, BEREC). True = regulatory complaint filed. Triggers mandatory regulatory reporting workflows.
attributes.references: FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations; BEREC Guidelines on Regulatory Reporting; NTIA

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the regulatory body (e.g., FCC complaint ID, Ofcom case reference) when the dispute has been escalated to a regulator. Nullable when regulatory_complaint_flag is False.
attributes.references: FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: repeat_dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dispute is a repeat submission by the same customer for the same or similar charge within a defined lookback window. True = repeat dispute. Used for churn risk analysis and root-cause remediation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6; Amdocs Revenue Management; CSAT/NPS Analytics

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dispute was formally resolved and an outcome was communicated to the customer. Used for SLA compliance reporting and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations; BEREC Guidelines on Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Agent-authored narrative summarizing the investigation findings, evidence reviewed, and rationale for the resolution outcome. Retained for audit, regulatory inspection, and quality assurance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final decision on the billing dispute. upheld: full credit issued; partially_upheld: partial credit issued; rejected: no credit, charge stands; withdrawn: customer retracted before resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6 - Manage Billing Disputes; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Consumer Complaint Handling

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the dispute resolution was finalized in the system. Used for exact SLA elapsed-time calculations and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute; Amdocs Revenue Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of telecommunications service to which the disputed charge relates. Enables service-level dispute analytics and product-specific resolution routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile_voice|mobile_data|fixed_broadband|fiber_ftth|iptv|voip|roaming|sms|mms|wholesale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Service; 3GPP Service Classification; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: sla_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute resolution exceeded the SLA due date without resolution. True = SLA was breached. Used for regulatory compliance reporting and agent performance management.
attributes.references: FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations; TM Forum eTOM Process 1.4.6

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the dispute must be resolved per the applicable SLA or regulatory requirement (e.g., FCC mandates, Ofcom billing dispute resolution timelines). Calculated from raised_date plus the applicable SLA window.
attributes.references: FCC Consumer Complaint Handling Guidelines; Ofcom Billing Dispute Regulations; BEREC Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922 - SLA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the dispute record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and cross-system reconciliation. Values: amdocs (Amdocs Revenue Management), salesforce (Salesforce CRM), comverse (Comverse ONE), servicenow (ServiceNow ITSM), manual (manually entered).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Source; ISO/IEC 27001; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the dispute record. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922 - Root Entity; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

products.name: dunning_event
products.description: Record of a dunning action taken against a delinquent billing account as part of the collections workflow. Captures dunning level (1st notice, 2nd notice, suspension warning, suspension, termination), action date, outstanding balance at time of action, communication channel used (SMS, email, letter, IVR), agent reference, response received, and next scheduled dunning action. Sourced from Amdocs Collections dunning engine.
products.reference: Amdocs Dunning Action / TM Forum SID CollectionAction

attributes.name: dunning_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dunning action record within the Amdocs Collections dunning engine. Primary key for the dunning_event data product in the billing domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Management

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delinquent billing account against which this dunning action was raised. Links to the billing account master in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Account; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing dispute case raised in response to this dunning action. Populated when customer_response_code is DISPUTE_RAISED. Links to the dispute management workflow in Salesforce CRM or ServiceNow ITSM.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Dispute Management; Salesforce CRM Case Management; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise collections follow corporate account hierarchies with specialized dunning profiles, executive escalation paths, and relationship-based hold strategies. Corporate account link required for T

attributes.name: dunning_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dunning policy/profile configuration that governs the escalation rules, timing intervals, and communication templates applied to this account segment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Policy; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections agent or automated system user who executed or supervised this dunning action. Populated for agent-assisted dunning steps; may reference a system agent ID for fully automated actions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary outstanding invoice that triggered this dunning action. A single dunning event may relate to the oldest or highest-value unpaid invoice on the account.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Invoice; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing Module

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to a formal payment arrangement or instalment plan agreed with the customer as an outcome of this dunning action. Links to the payment arrangement entity in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: previous_dunning_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding dunning event on the same billing account in the current collections cycle. Enables traversal of the dunning escalation chain for audit and analytics purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: subscriber_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.subscriber. Business justification: Dunning actions execute subscriber-level service controls (suspension, barring, termination) not just account-level notifications. Subscriber-specific dunning enables granular service restriction (bar

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which this dunning action was executed by the Amdocs Collections dunning engine. This is the principal real-world event time for the dunning event, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Management; ISO 8601

attributes.name: agent_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the collections agent during or after the dunning interaction. Captures context not covered by structured fields, such as customer circumstances or negotiation details.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: collections_cycle_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying which collections cycle this dunning event belongs to for the billing account. Resets to 1 at the start of each new collections cycle following account resolution. Enables multi-cycle delinquency pattern analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: collections_queue
