attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The gross pre-tax credit amount to be applied to the customer's account, expressed in the billing currency. Represents the principal financial value of the credit note before tax reversal. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for revenue reversal reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Billing Transparency Rules

attributes.name: credit_category
attributes.description: The billing charge category being credited. Identifies whether the credit relates to recurring service charges, usage-based charges (CDR-level), equipment fees, tax adjustments, interconnect/wholesale charges, or roaming charges. Supports revenue assurance and MRR impact analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable unique identifier for the credit note as printed on the customer-facing financial document. Assigned by Amdocs Revenue Management upon issuance. Used for customer correspondence, dispute tracking, and audit trails.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: credit_note_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credit note. 'issued' = generated and sent to customer; 'applied' = fully offset against an invoice or balance; 'partially_applied' = partially consumed; 'expired' = validity period lapsed without full application; 'cancelled' = withdrawn before application; 'voided' = reversed post-issuance for error correction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: issued|applied|partially_applied|expired|cancelled|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: credit_note_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit note by its business nature. 'financial' = billing error correction; 'commercial' = commercial dispute resolution; 'regulatory' = mandated by FCC/Ofcom/BEREC regulatory ruling; 'goodwill' = customer retention gesture; 'equipment_return' = CPE/ONT/OLT equipment return credit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; FCC Regulations; Ofcom Regulations; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this credit note (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency billing environments and international roaming credit scenarios.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 15

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the credit note document was delivered to the customer. Supports omnichannel customer communication tracking and digital delivery compliance requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Interaction; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the credit note document was delivered to the customer via the specified delivery channel. Used for customer communication audit trails and regulatory compliance with billing notification requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Interaction; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Ofcom Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the credit note becomes effective for application against the customer's account balance or future invoices. May differ from issue_date when backdated credits are applied for service outage periods.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the credit note can no longer be applied to the customer's account. Nullable for credits with no expiry. Used for dunning management and aged credit reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which the credit note reversal is posted. Enables financial reconciliation between the billing system (Amdocs) and the ERP (SAP S/4HANA) for period-close and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 15; SOX Section 302/404; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: is_regulatory_mandated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credit note was issued as a result of a regulatory mandate from FCC, Ofcom, BEREC, or other governing body. True = regulatory-mandated credit; False = commercially or operationally initiated. Used for regulatory reporting and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FCC Regulations; Ofcom Regulations; BEREC Guidelines; NTIA; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the credit note was formally issued to the customer. This is the principal business event date printed on the credit note document and used for revenue recognition reversal under IFRS 15.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to the credit note record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED marker for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration of the service outage in minutes, used as the basis for calculating SLA-based credit amounts. Derived from outage start and end timestamps but stored explicitly for audit and regulatory reporting to FCC/Ofcom.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; SLA Management; FCC Network Outage Reporting; Ofcom Regulations

attributes.name: outage_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the service outage or degradation was resolved. Together with outage_start_timestamp, defines the outage duration used to calculate the credit amount for SLA breach compensation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Network Domain; SLA Management; Nokia NetAct; Ericsson Network Manager

attributes.name: outage_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the service outage or degradation began, for credits issued due to SLA breaches or network outages. Nullable — populated only for outage-related credit notes. Links to NOC incident records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Network Domain; SLA Management; Nokia NetAct; Ericsson Network Manager

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for issuing the credit note. Examples include: OVERBILLING, SVC_OUTAGE, EQUIP_RETURN, DISPUTE_RESOLUTION, GOODWILL, RATE_ERROR, PROMO_ADJUSTMENT. Drives revenue assurance analytics and root cause reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OVERBILLING|SVC_OUTAGE|EQUIP_RETURN|DISPUTE_RESOLUTION|GOODWILL|RATE_ERROR|PROMO_ADJUSTMENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Billing Transparency Rules

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the reason for issuing the credit note, providing additional context beyond the reason_code. Populated by billing agents or automated systems in Amdocs Revenue Management. Used for customer communication and audit documentation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: The specific regulatory ruling, order number, or compliance reference that mandated this credit note. Nullable — populated only when is_regulatory_mandated is True. Required for FCC/Ofcom regulatory reporting submissions.
attributes.references: FCC Regulations; Ofcom Regulations; BEREC Guidelines; NTIA; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: remaining_credit_amount
attributes.description: The unapplied balance of the credit note (total_credit_amount minus applied_amount). Represents the credit still available for future application. Used for credit liability reporting and customer account balance management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM format) in which the revenue reversal from this credit note is recognized under IFRS 15 / ASC 606. Used by SAP S/4HANA Finance for general ledger posting and period-close reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_reference_number
attributes.description: The native identifier of this credit note in the originating source system (e.g., Amdocs internal credit note ID, Comverse ONE transaction reference). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational BSS/CRM systems.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this credit note. 'amdocs' = Amdocs Revenue Management (postpaid billing); 'comverse_one' = Comverse ONE (prepaid balance management); 'salesforce' = Salesforce CRM (dispute-driven); 'servicenow' = ServiceNow ITSM (incident-driven); 'manual' = manually entered by billing agent.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE; Salesforce CRM; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or tax type code applied to the credit note for tax reversal calculation. Aligns with the tax code on the original invoice. Used for tax authority reporting and VAT/GST compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The geographic tax jurisdiction (e.g., state, country, municipality) applicable to the tax reversal on this credit note. Required for multi-jurisdiction tax compliance reporting to federal, state, and local tax authorities.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Regulations; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; FCC Universal Service Fund; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: tax_reversal_amount
attributes.description: The tax component reversed as part of this credit note, corresponding to the tax originally charged on the credited amount. Enables accurate tax liability adjustments and compliance with tax authority reporting requirements.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; IRS Tax Regulations; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total credit amount inclusive of tax reversal (credit_amount + tax_reversal_amount). This is the net financial value credited to the customer's account and the figure printed on the customer-facing credit note document.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management; FCC Billing Transparency Rules

products.name: write_off
products.description: Record of a bad debt write-off action on an uncollectable outstanding balance after dunning exhaustion. Captures write-off date, written-off amount, original invoice references, aging bucket at write-off (30/60/90/120+ days), write-off reason (bankruptcy, deceased, uncontactable, fraud, statute of limitations), approving authority, recovery agency assignment, recovery amount received, tax write-back amount, and write-off status (pending approval, approved, sent-to-agency, recovered, partially recovered, closed). Supports revenue assurance, bad debt provisioning, and regulatory reporting on uncollectable accounts. Sourced from Amdocs Collections.
products.reference: Amdocs Write-Off / TM Forum SID DebtWriteOff

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the write-off record in the Amdocs Collections system. Primary key for the write_off data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Bill Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: Write-offs are material financial decisions requiring documented approval chain for bad debt management and SOX compliance. Distinct from processing employee. Replaces denormalized approving_authority

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated billing dispute record if the written-off balance was subject to a formal dispute. Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (subscriber or business entity) whose outstanding balance is being written off. Links to the customer master record in Salesforce CRM / Amdocs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party; Salesforce CRM Customer 360

attributes.name: dunning_case_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dunning case that was exhausted prior to initiating the write-off. Confirms that all collection attempts were made before write-off approval.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Dunning; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice that generated the uncollectable outstanding balance subject to write-off. Links to the invoice master in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Bill; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing Module

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Write-offs create GL postings for bad debt expense and AR reduction. Finance must link journal entries to write-off events for allowance for doubtful accounts reconciliation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: recovery_agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party debt recovery agency to which the written-off account has been assigned for collection. Populated when write_off_status transitions to sent_to_agency.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.sales_contract. Business justification: Write-offs of contract-related receivables require contract reference for revenue recognition reversal, legal documentation, contract performance analysis, and early termination financial impact asses

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.work_order. Business justification: Uncollectible amounts stemming from unresolved service delivery disputes (customer refuses payment due to installation defects, repeated outages) require work order attribution to determine contractor

attributes.name: agency_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the written-off account was formally assigned to the third-party recovery agency. Marks the start of the external collection process.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: agency_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the third-party recovery agency to track this write-off case within their own system. Used for reconciliation between Amdocs Collections and the agency.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: Receivables aging classification of the outstanding balance at the time of write-off, indicating how long the debt has been overdue (30, 60, 90, or 120+ days). Used for bad debt provisioning and revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Bad Debt Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount of the outstanding balance being written off, expressed in the account billing currency. Represents the full uncollectable debt before any partial recovery deductions.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Bad Debt Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated approving authority. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and separation of duties verification.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: approval_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number or ticket ID from the approval workflow (e.g., ServiceNow change/approval record) authorizing the write-off. Supports audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; ServiceNow ITSM; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: billing_segment
attributes.description: Customer billing segment classification at the time of write-off (e.g., consumer, SMB, enterprise, wholesale, MVNO). Enables segmented bad debt analysis and ARPU/MRR impact reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA Guidelines

attributes.name: collection_attempts_count
attributes.description: Total number of collection contact attempts made against the account prior to write-off (calls, letters, emails, SMS). Evidences due diligence for regulatory and audit purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center to which the bad debt expense is allocated. Enables departmental P&L reporting and OPEX tracking for the collections function.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum eTOM; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the write-off record was first created and persisted in the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the write-off amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across international telecommunications markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Exact number of calendar days the outstanding balance has been overdue at the time of write-off. Provides precise aging data beyond the bucket classification for analytics and provisioning models.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the written-off balance was subject to a customer dispute at any point during the collections process. Relevant for regulatory reporting and revenue assurance investigations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: dunning_stage_at_writeoff
attributes.description: The final dunning stage reached before the write-off was initiated (e.g., Final Notice, Legal Warning, Pre-Legal). Confirms exhaustion of the dunning process and supports regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA General Ledger account code to which the write-off amount is posted (e.g., bad debt expense account). Required for financial reporting, revenue assurance, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the original invoice that generated the uncollectable balance. Used for aging calculation, statute of limitations assessment, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing Module

attributes.name: legal_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether legal proceedings were initiated against the customer prior to or concurrent with the write-off. Relevant for compliance, regulatory reporting, and recovery strategy.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Consumer Protection Rules; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: legal_case_reference
attributes.description: External legal case or court reference number associated with legal proceedings against the customer. Populated only when legal_action_flag is True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Consumer Protection Rules

attributes.name: outstanding_balance_at_writeoff
attributes.description: Total overdue balance on the account at the time the write-off was initiated, which may include multiple invoices, late fees, and interest charges. May differ from write_off_amount if only a partial balance is written off.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: provision_amount
attributes.description: Amount previously provisioned for this debt under the expected credit loss (ECL) model prior to the actual write-off. Used to reconcile the provision account in SAP S/4HANA Finance and assess provisioning accuracy.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason code explaining why the outstanding balance is deemed uncollectable and eligible for write-off. Drives regulatory reporting, bad debt provisioning, and fraud analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bankruptcy|deceased|uncontactable|fraud|statute_of_limitations|other — promote to reference product if additional reason codes are required]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; FCC Bad Debt Reporting Guidelines; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or supporting detail for the write-off reason code. May include case reference numbers, legal citations, or collector observations from Amdocs Collections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount recovered from the customer or recovery agency against the written-off balance. Populated when write_off_status is recovered or partially_recovered. Used for revenue assurance and bad debt recovery reporting.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Bad Debt Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery amount was received and posted back to the account. Used for revenue recognition reversal and bad debt recovery analytics.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off record must be included in regulatory bad debt reporting submissions to bodies such as the FCC, Ofcom, or BEREC. Drives automated regulatory report generation.
attributes.references: FCC Bad Debt Reporting Guidelines; Ofcom (UK) Reporting Requirements; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of telecommunications service associated with the written-off balance (e.g., mobile, broadband, fiber/FTTH, IPTV, VoIP). Supports product-level bad debt analytics and revenue assurance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile|broadband|fiber|iptv|voip|fixed_line|enterprise_data — promote to reference product if additional service types are required]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum TAM; ETSI Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the write-off record was sourced (Amdocs Collections, Comverse ONE for prepaid, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of the write-off record in the originating operational system (e.g., Amdocs Collections internal write-off ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the source system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal right to pursue collection of the debt expires under applicable jurisdiction law. Used to trigger write-off when statute_of_limitations is the write_off_reason.
attributes.references: FCC Regulatory Guidelines; NTIA; Ofcom (UK); BEREC; Applicable Jurisdiction Civil Law

attributes.name: tax_write_back_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) reclaimed or reversed as a result of the write-off. Reported to tax authorities and reflected in SAP S/4HANA Finance for tax compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA Finance; FCC Regulatory Reporting; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the write-off record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security; TM Forum SID GB922; Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX)

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the bad debt write-off action was formally executed and posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Represents the principal business event date for revenue recognition and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; FCC Bad Debt Reporting Guidelines

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the write-off transaction as assigned by Amdocs Collections. Used in correspondence with recovery agencies, auditors, and regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Bill Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the write-off record within the Amdocs Collections workflow. Drives downstream actions such as agency assignment, tax write-back, and revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Party Bill Management; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: write_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the write-off transaction was created and committed in the Amdocs Collections system. Used for audit trail and intraday reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a payment to one or more invoices or charges it settles. Captures allocation amount per invoice, allocation date, allocation method (oldest-first, proportional, specific-invoice, dispute-hold), remaining unapplied balance, over-payment handling (credit balance, refund), and allocation status (allocated, reversed, pending-review). Enables accurate accounts receivable aging, partial payment tracking, and unallocated cash management. Required for financial close and AR reconciliation. Sourced from Amdocs Collections.
products.reference: Amdocs Payment Allocation / TM Forum SID PaymentApplication

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment allocation record in the Amdocs Collections module. Serves as the primary key for the payment_allocation data product in the billing domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain

attributes.name: adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to a billing adjustment record that is being settled or applied through this allocation. Populated when allocation_type = 'adjustment' or 'credit_memo'. Links to the adjustment entity in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer billing account against which the payment and invoice are recorded. Supports AR aging and account-level reconciliation in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Customer Account Domain

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to an active or resolved billing dispute associated with this allocation. Populated when allocation_method = 'dispute_hold' or allocation_type = 'dispute_settlement'. Links to the dispute management record in Amdocs or Salesforce CRM Case Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; FCC Consumer Complaint Regulations

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections agent or automated process that performed or approved this allocation. Populated for manual allocations or collector-override scenarios. Supports workforce performance reporting in collections operations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice being settled by this allocation. A single payment may generate multiple allocation records, each referencing a distinct invoice in the accounts receivable ledger.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Payment allocations trigger GL postings for cash application to AR. Finance traces journal entries to allocation events for cash reconciliation, unapplied cash tracking, and revenue recognition timing

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payment record from which this allocation originates. Links the allocation back to the specific payment transaction in Amdocs Revenue Management Collections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Payment allocation pipelines require lineage for cash application accuracy validation, DSO reporting, and dunning process effectiveness analysis. Enables identification of which auto-allocation run ap

attributes.name: reversed_allocation_payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original payment_allocation_id that this record reverses. Populated only when allocation_type = 'reversal'. Enables full reversal chain traceability in the AR ledger.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 9

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that has been applied to the referenced invoice or charge in this allocation record. Core financial field for AR reconciliation and partial payment tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 9; ASC 310

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the payment was formally allocated to the invoice or charge. Used as the key date for AR aging buckets, financial close, and revenue recognition reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 15; ASC 606

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The business rule or strategy used to determine how the payment is distributed across invoices or charges. 'oldest_first' applies payment to the most aged invoice first (standard dunning); 'proportional' distributes across all open invoices by balance ratio; 'specific_invoice' applies to a customer-designated invoice; 'dispute_hold' suspends allocation pending dispute resolution; 'newest_first' applies to the most recent invoice; 'manual' indicates a collector override. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oldest_first|proportional|specific_invoice|dispute_hold|newest_first|manual — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this allocation record as generated by Amdocs Collections. Used in customer correspondence, dispute resolution, and financial audit trails.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation record. 'allocated' indicates the amount has been successfully applied to the invoice; 'reversed' indicates a prior allocation was undone; 'pending_review' indicates the allocation is under dispute or manual review; 'partially_allocated' indicates only a portion of the payment has been applied; 'cancelled' indicates the allocation was voided; 'on_hold' indicates a dispute-hold is in effect. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: allocated|reversed|pending_review|partially_allocated|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 9

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the allocation transaction was processed in Amdocs Collections. Distinct from allocation_date; used for intraday reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; ISO 8601

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the allocation transaction. 'standard' is a normal payment-to-invoice application; 'reversal' undoes a prior allocation; 'adjustment' applies a billing adjustment; 'dispute_settlement' closes a disputed amount; 'write_off' applies a bad debt write-off; 'credit_memo' applies a credit note. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|reversal|adjustment|dispute_settlement|write_off|credit_memo — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 9; ASC 310

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing cycle covered by the invoice being settled. Used alongside billing_period_start for period-accurate MRR reporting and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; ASC 606

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing cycle covered by the invoice being settled. Enables MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) period attribution and revenue recognition alignment per IFRS 15 / ASC 606.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 15; ASC 606

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with the business unit responsible for the billing account. Used for internal financial reporting, OPEX allocation, and segment-level revenue reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID GB922 - Enterprise Domain

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment allocation record was first created in the system. Mandatory audit field for the Silver layer data product. Conforms to ISO 8601 timestamp format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Management Domain

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this allocation record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing environments in global telecommunications operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the invoice was past its due date at the time this allocation was applied. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for AR aging analysis, collections performance reporting, and dunning effectiveness measurement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; ASC 310

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The dunning escalation level of the invoice at the time this allocation was applied (e.g., 0 = not in dunning, 1 = first reminder, 2 = second notice, 3 = final notice, 4 = collections agency). Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for collections effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code to which this allocation is posted in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Enables AR sub-ledger to GL reconciliation and financial close reporting. Follows the chart of accounts defined in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 9; ASC 310; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: invoice_balance_after
attributes.description: The remaining outstanding balance on the invoice immediately after this allocation was applied. A zero value indicates the invoice is fully settled; a positive value indicates a partial payment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 9

attributes.name: invoice_balance_before
attributes.description: The outstanding balance on the invoice immediately prior to this allocation being applied. Enables audit trail of how each allocation reduced the invoice balance and supports dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Billing Domain; IFRS 9

attributes.name: is_auto_allocated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation was performed automatically by the Amdocs Collections engine (True) or was manually applied by a collections agent (False). Supports operational analytics on automation rates and manual intervention tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: is_partial_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation represents a partial settlement of the referenced invoice (True) or a full settlement (False). Key flag for AR aging, dunning workflow, and collections prioritization.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; ASC 310

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the allocated_amount that corresponds to late payment fees or penalty charges applied to the invoice. Tracked separately for fee revenue reporting and customer dispute management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; FCC Consumer Regulations; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by a collections agent or automated process to provide additional context for this allocation. Examples include dispute resolution notes, manual override justifications, or special handling instructions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: The amount by which the payment exceeds the total invoice balance, resulting in a credit or refund. Populated when the payment amount is greater than the invoice due amount. Zero if no overpayment exists.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 15

attributes.name: overpayment_handling
attributes.description: Defines how any overpayment amount is to be processed. 'credit_balance' retains the excess as a credit on the account; 'refund' triggers a refund transaction back to the customer; 'apply_to_next' carries the credit forward to the next billing cycle; 'write_off' writes off the overpayment per policy; 'pending' indicates the handling decision is awaiting approval.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 15; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the allocated_amount that corresponds to the base service charges (excluding taxes and fees). Supports revenue recognition, MRR reporting, and ARPU calculation by isolating the core service revenue component.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; ASC 606; TM Forum SID GB922 - Revenue Assurance Domain

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the allocated amount is recognized as revenue in the financial ledger per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 performance obligation satisfaction criteria. May differ from allocation_date for deferred revenue scenarios.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; ASC 606; TM Forum SID GB922 - Revenue Assurance Domain

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why a previously applied allocation was reversed. Populated only when allocation_type = 'reversal'. Examples include: returned payment, duplicate allocation, incorrect invoice reference, customer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Collections Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this allocation record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between BSS systems, and Silver layer audit requirements. Primary sources are Amdocs Revenue Management Collections and Comverse ONE for prepaid scenarios.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Management Domain; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: source_system_allocation_code
attributes.description: The native allocation identifier as recorded in the originating source system (Amdocs Collections or Comverse ONE). Preserved for end-to-end traceability and reconciliation between the Silver lakehouse layer and the operational BSS system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Management Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the allocated_amount that corresponds to taxes (VAT, GST, or applicable local taxes) included in the invoice. Required for tax reporting, VAT reconciliation, and regulatory compliance with FCC and international tax authorities.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; FCC Regulatory Reporting; ITU-T; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: unapplied_balance
attributes.description: The portion of the original payment that remains unallocated after this allocation record is processed. Critical for unallocated cash management and financial close reporting in Amdocs Collections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 - Payment Domain; IFRS 9; ASC 310

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment allocation record was most recently modified. Updated on every status change, reversal, or correction. Mandatory audit field for the Silver layer data product.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922 - Data Management Domain

products.name: contract_billing_arrangement
products.description: This association product represents the billing arrangement between a sales contract and one or more billing accounts. In telecommunications, enterprise contracts often span multiple billing accounts (subsidiaries, cost centers, departments), and a single billing account can receive charges from multiple active service contracts (mobile, broadband, TV). Each record captures the contract-specific billing configuration including payment terms overrides, consolidated billing flags, arrangement effective dates, and billing status for that specific contract-account pairing.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications operations, a single billing account frequently receives charges from multiple active service contracts (e.g., mobile, broadband, TV services purchased at different times), and enterprise sales contracts routinely span multiple billing accounts across subsidiaries, cost centers, or departmental structures. Billing operations actively manage these arrangements with contract-specific configurations for payment terms, consolidated billing flags, split billing percentages, and invoice formats that exist only in the context of each contract-account pairing.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

products.name: billing_subscription
products.description: This association product represents the subscription contract between a billing account and a content package. It captures the lifecycle of a customer's subscription to a specific content offering, including activation dates, renewal terms, promotional pricing, and subscription status. Each record links one billing account to one content package with attributes that exist only in the context of this subscription relationship.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications operations, billing accounts subscribe to multiple content packages simultaneously (e.g., a customer may have HBO, Sports Pack, and Kids Bundle on the same account), and each content package is subscribed by thousands of billing accounts. The subscription itself is a managed business entity with its own lifecycle: customers activate subscriptions, modify renewal terms, apply promotional codes, and cancel subscriptions. This is the core content subscription model in telecom.

products.name: rate_plan_content_package
products.description: This association product represents the commercial bundling relationship between rate plans and content packages in the telecommunications product catalog. It captures the specific pricing, promotional terms, and commitment requirements that apply when a particular content package is offered as part of a specific rate plan. Each record links one rate plan to one content package with pricing and promotional attributes that exist only in the context of this specific bundle configuration.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications, rate plans (e.g., Unlimited Family, Prepaid Basic, Enterprise Data) are commercial pricing structures that can include multiple content packages (Sports Bundle, Entertainment Pack, Kids Plus), and each content package is made available across multiple rate plans with varying pricing terms. The business actively manages these bundle configurations, tracking promotional rates, bundle discounts, and commitment periods specific to each rate-plan-package combination. This is an operational product catalog management activity, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: corporate_rate_plan_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between rate_plan and corporate_account. It captures the negotiated pricing agreements between enterprise customers and the telco, including custom discounts, commitment terms, and contract-specific pricing overrides. Each record links one rate_plan to one corporate_account with attributes that exist only in the context of this negotiated commercial relationship. Sourced from enterprise contract management and billing systems.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications B2B operations, corporate accounts negotiate multiple rate plans simultaneously (voice, data, international, IoT) across different service types, sites, and business units. Conversely, standard enterprise rate plans (e.g., 'Enterprise Data Tier 2') are offered to multiple corporate accounts with account-specific negotiated discounts, commitment terms, and contract periods. The business actively manages these agreements as commercial contracts with lifecycle states, renewal processes, and compliance tracking.

products.name: ipdr_record
products.description: IP Detail Record and Deep Packet Inspection consolidated usage record — the single authoritative source for all IP flow-level and application-layer traffic data from DPI probes, BNG/BRAS systems, and inline inspection nodes. Captures subscriber IP/identifier, destination IP/domain, DPI probe node, protocol, detected application (Netflix, YouTube, WhatsApp, etc.), application category, traffic direction, bytes in/out, flow start/end, DSCP marking, QoS policy applied, zero-rating eligibility flag, throttle action, and policy enforcement action. Serves as the unified record for traffic analytics, content billing, zero-rating validation, application-aware policy enforcement, fair-use throttling evidence, lawful intercept feeds, and network planning. Replaces legacy separate IPDR and DPI session stores with a single SSOT.

products.name: mediation_event
products.description: Mediation layer processing lifecycle record tracking each raw usage event from network collection through normalization, enrichment, duplicate detection, validation, rejection handling, and delivery to downstream rating engines. Captures source network element, collection timestamp, raw record reference, mediation node ID, processing status (collected, normalized, enriched, validated, rated, rejected, reprocessed), rejection reason code and category (duplicate, missing mandatory field, format error, out-of-sequence, future-dated, unknown subscriber, invalid IMSI), retry count, retry eligibility flag, manual review queue assignment, resolution outcome (auto-corrected, manually resolved, permanently rejected, written off), reprocessing history, and downstream system delivery confirmation with acknowledgement timestamp. This is the single authoritative record for ALL mediation outcomes including rejections — no separate rejection entity exists. Critical for revenue assurance gap detection, mediation SLA monitoring, and regulatory audit trails demonstrating usage processing completeness.

products.name: balance
products.description: Real-time subscriber usage balance and bundle consumption tracking record — the single authoritative source for current-state balance snapshots AND event-level consumption/deduction history across all bundle types. Tracks voice minutes, SMS units, data bytes (national/roaming/zero-rated), content credits, and add-on bundle balances. Captures balance at period start, consumed units per bundle instance, remaining units, overage flag/units, throttle threshold and status, bundle instance reference, bundle expiry date, last consumption event timestamp, per-event deduction history with full granularity, throttle trigger actions, and bundle lifecycle state. Sourced from real-time charging systems (OCS/Comverse ONE) and batch rating engines. Serves as the authoritative record for real-time balance queries, bundle consumption audit, prepaid top-up reconciliation, historical consumption analysis, and per-bundle allowance tracking. Consolidates both snapshot and transactional consumption views — no separate bundle consumption entity exists.
products.reference: Comverse ONE Balance Management / 3GPP Gy Interface

products.name: aggregated_usage

products.name: fiber_cable
products.description: Master record for fiber optic cable segments and conduit/duct infrastructure in the outside plant (OSP). Cable attributes: cable type (single-mode/multi-mode/ribbon), fiber count, sheath type, route length, attenuation measurements, splice point references, and strand-level capacity summary. Conduit/duct attributes: duct ID, material type, inner diameter, route segment, total length, fill ratio, associated cable IDs, installation date, and ownership (owned/leased/municipal). Common attributes: route geometry (GPS coordinates), installation date, deployment method (burial/aerial/conduit), ownership type (owned/leased/IRU/municipal), and route segment identification. SSOT for all physical fiber plant and duct infrastructure inventory supporting OSP capacity planning and fiber rollout project management.

products.name: ip_address_pool
products.description: Master record for logical network resource pools and their individual assignments. Covers IP address pools (IPv4/IPv6 subnets, CGNAT ranges), VLAN/VXLAN segment pools, and individual resource assignment transactions. Pool-level attributes: CIDR block, VLAN range, encapsulation type (802.1Q/QinQ/VXLAN/EVPN), allocation policy, associated BNG/BRAS or leaf switch, service type segmentation (residential/enterprise/wholesale/management/voice), utilization tracking, and maximum capacity. Assignment-level attributes: assigned IP or VLAN, assignment type (static/dynamic/DHCP), assignment start/end timestamps, lease duration, assigned-to entity (subscriber/CPE/network node), and release reason. SSOT for all logical network resource inventory and assignment lifecycle supporting broadband provisioning, enterprise VPN, IMS voice, and wholesale services. Managed via Netcracker.

products.name: asset_lifecycle_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing all lifecycle state transitions, audit events, and inventory reconciliation activities for physical inventory assets (CPE, ONT, OLT, network equipment, fiber plant, spare parts). Event types: procurement, deployment, swap, repair, decommission, write-off, physical-audit, cycle-count, and reconciliation. Core attributes: event timestamp, previous/new asset state, triggering work order or order reference, technician, location change. For audit/reconciliation events: audit date, stocking location or asset category audited, auditor name, expected vs actual count, variance quantity, variance reason, and reconciliation action taken (write-off/adjustment/investigation). SSOT for full asset lifecycle audit trail and inventory accuracy reporting per TM Forum eTOM asset management process, SAP S/4HANA asset management, and regulatory compliance requirements.

products.name: fiber_lease
products.description: This association product represents the commercial lease contract between fiber_cable infrastructure assets and interconnect_carrier partners. It captures IRU (Indefeasible Right of Use) agreements, dark fiber leases, and capacity allocation arrangements where telecommunications operators lease fiber infrastructure to/from carriers. Each record links one fiber_cable segment to one interconnect_carrier with lease terms, pricing, capacity allocation, SLA commitments, and maintenance responsibility assignments that exist only in the context of this commercial relationship.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications wholesale operations, fiber infrastructure lease agreements represent true many-to-many commercial relationships. A single fiber cable route can have segments leased to multiple carriers simultaneously (e.g., Carrier A leases fibers 1-12, Carrier B leases fibers 13-24 on the same cable), and each carrier leases multiple cable segments across different geographic routes to build their network footprint. These are actively managed commercial contracts with lease terms, pricing, capacity allocation, SLA commitments, and maintenance responsibilities that belong to the relationship, not to either the cable asset or the carrier entity alone.

products.name: service_equipment_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment relationship between network equipment and managed enterprise services. It captures which equipment instances (routers, switches, SD-WAN appliances) are allocated to deliver specific managed service instances, including redundancy roles, traffic distribution, and lifecycle dates. Each record links one network equipment asset to one managed service with attributes that exist only in the context of this service delivery assignment.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications service delivery, managed enterprise services (SD-WAN, MPLS VPN, UCaaS) routinely require multiple network equipment instances for redundancy and load balancing—primary and backup routers, active-active PE router pairs, or SD-WAN appliance clusters. Conversely, shared network infrastructure such as MPLS PE routers and metro Ethernet switches simultaneously serve multiple enterprise service instances. The business actively manages these assignments, tracking which equipment delivers which service, in what role (primary/backup), with what traffic split, and for what time period.

products.name: colocation
products.description: This association product represents the colocation contract between pop_facility and partner. It captures the physical hosting arrangement where partner equipment is housed within a telecommunications facility. Each record links one pop_facility to one partner with attributes that exist only in the context of this colocation relationship: rack space allocation, power allocation, access rights, and financial terms.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications operations, POP facilities routinely host equipment from multiple partners (tower companies, content providers, MVNO partners, interconnect carriers) through colocation agreements, and each partner typically maintains equipment presence across multiple facilities for geographic redundancy and network reach. Colocation is a recognized operational business process managed by facility operations teams who allocate rack space, power budgets, and access rights on a per-partner-per-facility basis, with distinct financial terms and SLAs for each arrangement.

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: equipment_covered

attributes.name: escalation_contact_name

attributes.name: escalation_contact_phone

attributes.name: external_reference_code

attributes.name: geographic_coverage

attributes.name: is_multi_site

attributes.name: service_category

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: total_sites_covered

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

domains.name: interconnect
domains.description: SSOT for inter-operator settlement and wholesale traffic exchange — IOT tariff tables, TAP file processing, roaming agreements, transit traffic records, peering arrangements, NRTRDE near-real-time roaming data, and financial settlement with domestic and international carriers.
domains.references: GSMA NRTRDE / TAP3 / ITU-T E.164 / IOT Framework

products.name: carrier_agreement
products.description: Master record of bilateral or multilateral commercial agreements between Telecommunication and domestic/international operators covering roaming, wholesale, and MVNO relationships. Captures agreement type (IOT, CAMEL, LTE, 5G NR, MVNO hosting, national roaming, wholesale broadband, capacity resale), counterparty carrier reference, effective dates, covered services (voice, SMS, data, VoLTE, VoNR), discount structures, TAP file exchange obligations, NRTRDE requirements, minimum volume commitments and true-up terms, revenue share terms, SLA references, and agreement status. SSOT for all inter-operator commercial relationship governance.
products.reference: GSMA PRD AA.12 / TM Forum SID RoamingAgreement

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for carrier_agreement

attributes.name: administrative_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.administrative_region. Business justification: Roaming agreements are governed by jurisdiction-specific regulations and dispute resolution mechanisms. Has governing_law_country_code but regulatory compliance, tax treatment, and legal enforcement r

attributes.name: commercial_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee responsible for managing and renewing this carrier agreement. Typically the Wholesale or Interconnect Account Manager. Used for escalation and renewal workflow routing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA HCM

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Roaming agreements are signed by specific legal entities. Financial consolidation, regulatory filings, and intercompany settlement reporting require tracking which company code owns each agreement. Cr

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Wholesale and MVNO agreements are commercial contracts with enterprise customers. Business need: tracking which enterprise account holds the roaming/interconnect agreement for billing, SLA management,

attributes.name: counterparty_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the domestic or international operator that is the counterparty to this agreement. Links to the carrier/partner master record in the interconnect domain.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rate table applicable to this agreement. The IOT table defines per-unit wholesale rates for voice (per minute), SMS (per message), and data (per MB/GB) exchanged between operators.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: network_qos_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.qos_profile. Business justification: Roaming and interconnect agreements specify QoS requirements (latency, jitter, packet loss) that must be enforced by network QoS profiles. Required for SLA compliance verification and service assuranc

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Roaming agreements with MVNO/reseller partners (not traditional carriers) require partner_id link. Business process: MVNO roaming agreement lifecycle management, partner contract tracking, consolidate

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Roaming/interconnect agreements must comply with specific regulatory obligations (FCC Part 64, international settlement policies, GDPR). Tracks which obligation each agreement satisfies for audit trai

attributes.name: sla_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Service Level Agreement (SLA) record governing quality of service commitments under this carrier agreement, including network availability, latency, and fault resolution targets.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ETSI TS 102 250; ITU-T G.1000

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive commercial name of the carrier agreement (e.g., 'Roaming IOT Agreement – Carrier X 2024'). Used for display in BSS portals and settlement reports.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the bilateral or multilateral carrier agreement. Used in correspondence, TAP file headers, and inter-operator settlement documents. Maps to the contract reference in Amdocs Revenue Management and Netcracker OSS/BSS.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the carrier agreement. DRAFT = under negotiation; ACTIVE = commercially live and binding; SUSPENDED = temporarily halted by mutual or unilateral action; TERMINATED = permanently ended; EXPIRED = reached end date without renewal; PENDING_APPROVAL = awaiting regulatory or internal sign-off.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier agreement by commercial relationship type. IOT = Inter-Operator Tariff roaming; CAMEL = Customised Applications for Mobile networks Enhanced Logic; MVNO_HOSTING = Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) hosting arrangement; NATIONAL_ROAMING = domestic network sharing; WHOLESALE_BROADBAND = wholesale broadband resale; CAPACITY_RESALE = bandwidth/capacity resale; TRANSIT = transit traffic routing; PEERING = direct traffic exchange. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: IOT|CAMEL|MVNO_HOSTING|NATIONAL_ROAMING|WHOLESALE_BROADBAND|CAPACITY_RESALE|TRANSIT|PEERING — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13; 3GPP TS 22.101

attributes.name: agreement_version
attributes.description: Version number of the agreement document (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Incremented when amendments are executed. Enables tracking of agreement evolution and ensures the correct rate tables are applied for each version period.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments executed against this agreement since its original signing. Provides a quick indicator of agreement complexity and negotiation history.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement automatically renews upon reaching its effective_until_date without requiring a new signed instrument. True = auto-renews; False = requires explicit renewal action.

attributes.name: covered_services
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of telecommunication services covered under this agreement (e.g., VOICE, SMS, DATA, VOLTE, VONR, MMS, CAMEL_GPRS). Governs which service types are eligible for IOT settlement and TAP file exchange. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VOICE|SMS|DATA|VOLTE|VONR|MMS|CAMEL_GPRS|USSD — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.101; GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier agreement record was first created in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: data_protection_addendum_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a data protection addendum (DPA) is attached to this agreement, governing the processing of subscriber personal data exchanged between operators in compliance with GDPR or equivalent regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28; ISO/IEC 27001; BEREC Guidelines on Roaming

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to standard IOT rates when discount_type is PERCENTAGE or VOLUME_TIERED. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Null when discount_type is FLAT_RATE or NONE.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Type of discount structure applied to IOT rates under this agreement. FLAT_RATE = fixed per-unit reduction; VOLUME_TIERED = discount scales with traffic volume; PERCENTAGE = percentage reduction off standard IOT; NEGOTIATED_RATE = bespoke bilaterally agreed rate; NONE = standard IOT applies.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism
attributes.description: Contractually agreed mechanism for resolving financial or operational disputes arising under this agreement. GSMA_MEDIATION refers to the GSMA Billing and Accounting Dispute Resolution process.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the carrier agreement becomes commercially binding and operationally active. Governs the start of IOT tariff applicability, TAP file exchange obligations, and NRTRDE reporting requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the carrier agreement ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended agreements. When populated, triggers renewal workflow and settlement true-up processing in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: fraud_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement includes specific fraud prevention obligations such as NRTRDE, SIM box detection cooperation, or GSMA Fraud Information Gathering System (FIGS) participation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11; GSMA PRD IR.82; ITU-T E.408

attributes.name: governing_law_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction whose laws govern this agreement (e.g., GBR for English law, USA for US law). Relevant for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: interconnect_agreement_ref
attributes.description: External reference number or document identifier for the physical signed agreement document, as stored in the document management system or SAP S/4HANA contract repository. Enables traceability to the legal instrument.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA Contract Management

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agreement was last formally reviewed by the commercial team for rate competitiveness, volume performance, and compliance. Supports the agreement lifecycle management process.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: min_volume_commitment_units
attributes.description: Minimum traffic volume committed by one or both parties under this agreement, expressed in the unit defined by min_volume_unit (e.g., minutes, MB, messages). Triggers true-up billing if actual volume falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: min_volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum volume commitment (min_volume_commitment_units). MINUTES = voice traffic; MEGABYTES/GIGABYTES = data traffic; MESSAGES = SMS/MMS; ERLANGS = traffic intensity for capacity agreements.

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: Radio access network generation(s) covered by this agreement. 2G = GSM/GPRS/EDGE; 3G = UMTS/HSPA; 4G_LTE = Long-Term Evolution (LTE); 5G_NR = 5G New Radio (NR); ALL = all generations. Determines applicable IOT tariff tables and NRTRDE reporting scope.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.101; GSMA PRD IR.21; ETSI TS 122 101

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this agreement. Triggers workflow notifications to the commercial owner and finance team in advance of the review.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate the agreement. Governs the termination workflow in contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: nrtrde_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement requires Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) reporting per GSMA PRD FS.11. NRTRDE enables fraud detection by providing near-real-time CDR visibility to the home operator.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: nrtrde_transmission_window_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Transmission Window (Hours)
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours within which NRTRDE files must be transmitted to the home operator after the roaming CDR is generated. Standard GSMA requirement is 4 hours; some bilateral agreements specify tighter windows.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of each automatic renewal cycle when auto_renewal_flag is True. Null when auto-renewal is not applicable.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of gross revenue shared with the counterparty operator under MVNO hosting, content, or wholesale broadband agreements. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 20.00 = 20%). Null for pure IOT/TAP agreements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: roaming_direction
attributes.description: Direction of roaming traffic covered by this agreement. INBOUND = foreign subscribers roaming on Telecommunication's network; OUTBOUND = Telecommunication's subscribers roaming on the counterparty's network; BILATERAL = both directions.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for financial settlement under this agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Governs currency conversion in Amdocs Revenue Management inter-operator billing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD AA.13; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: settlement_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial settlement is performed between the parties under this agreement. Governs the billing cycle in Amdocs Revenue Management inter-operator invoicing.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which all parties executed the agreement. May precede the effective_from_date during a transition or notice period. Used for legal and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this agreement record was sourced. AMDOCS = Amdocs Revenue Management; NETCRACKER = Netcracker OSS/BSS; SALESFORCE = Salesforce CRM; SAP = SAP S/4HANA; MANUAL = manually entered.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: tap_file_exchange_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) File Exchange Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement mandates Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) file exchange for roaming CDR settlement. True = TAP files must be exchanged per GSMA PRD TD.57 specifications.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: tap_version
attributes.description: Version of the GSMA Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) standard used for CDR file exchange under this agreement. Governs file format and field mapping in the TAP processing pipeline.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which the agreement was terminated, if applicable. Distinct from effective_until_date which is the planned end; this captures early or unilateral termination events.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: true_up_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which minimum volume commitment true-up calculations are performed. If actual traffic falls below min_volume_commitment_units within the period, a shortfall charge is raised in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier agreement record was last modified in the data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922

products.name: carrier
products.description: Master registry of all domestic and international carriers, transit operators, MVNOs, and wholesale partners with whom Telecommunication has interconnect, roaming, or settlement relationships. Captures carrier code (TADIG, MCCMNC, carrier ID), carrier name, country, carrier type (MNO, MVNO, transit, IXC, LEC, ISP), regulatory identifiers, NOC contact details, clearinghouse affiliations, and operational status. Central reference entity for all interconnect domain relationships — every agreement, invoice, TAP file, and traffic record references this registry.
products.reference: GSMA TADIG / ITU-T E.212 MCCMNC

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each carrier record in the interconnect carrier master registry. Primary key for all interconnect domain relationships.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party entity

attributes.name: administrative_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.administrative_region. Business justification: Carriers operate under specific regulatory jurisdictions. Regulatory compliance reporting, spectrum licensing, and dispute resolution require tracking the administrative region beyond country_code. Es

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Regional carriers and MVNOs are both interconnect partners AND enterprise customers buying wholesale services. Business need: unified customer view for cross-selling, consolidated billing, and relatio

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Many interconnect carriers are also business partners (MVNOs, wholesale customers, resellers). Business process: Unified partner relationship management, consolidated billing across interconnect and p

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Primary regulatory or licence identifier assigned to the carrier by its national telecommunications regulator (e.g., FCC Registration Number, Ofcom licence number, NTIA identifier). Used for regulatory reporting and compliance verification.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR; Ofcom Communications Act 2003; NTIA; BEREC

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Full legal or trading name of the carrier, transit operator, MVNO, or wholesale partner as registered with the relevant regulatory authority. Used as the primary human-readable identifier across all interconnect domain products.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 Party; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: carrier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier relationship. Active indicates live traffic exchange; suspended indicates temporary halt pending dispute or non-payment; terminated indicates the relationship has ended; pending indicates onboarding in progress; inactive indicates dormant with no current traffic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 PartyRole lifecycle; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier by network ownership and service role: MNO (Mobile Network Operator), MVNO (Mobile Virtual Network Operator), transit (transit/wholesale carrier), IXC (Interexchange Carrier), LEC (Local Exchange Carrier), ISP (Internet Service Provider). Drives applicable tariff tables, settlement rules, and regulatory reporting.
