attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 69; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: clearinghouse_carrier_code
attributes.description: Carrier identifier assigned by the clearinghouse (e.g., Syniverse or BICS carrier code) used for TAP file routing, NRTRDE submission, and financial settlement matching within the clearinghouse platform.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: clearinghouse_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial and data clearinghouse through which TAP file exchange and inter-operator financial settlement is processed for this carrier (e.g., HSCSD, Syniverse, BICS). Required for TAP file routing and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: commercial_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address for the carrier's commercial or wholesale account management team. Used for agreement negotiations, invoice disputes, and settlement correspondence.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the carrier's primary country of registration and network operation. Used for geographic segmentation, IOT tariff lookup, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD SE.13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier record was first created in the interconnect carrier master registry. Audit trail field conforming to ISO 8601 extended format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding settlement balance (in settlement currency) permitted for this carrier before traffic suspension or escalation is triggered. Used for wholesale credit risk management and revenue assurance controls.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA PRD BA.12; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: data_roaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether GPRS/LTE/5G NR data roaming is active with this carrier. When true, data CDRs from this carrier's subscribers are processed through the TAP/NRTRDE pipeline and rated against the applicable IOT data tariff.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; 3GPP TS 23.060; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: fcc_registration_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit FCC Registration Number (FRN) assigned to US-based carriers by the Federal Communications Commission. Required for FCC regulatory filings, Form 499 reporting, and USAC fund contributions tracking.

attributes.name: five_g_roaming_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: 5G New Radio (5G NR) Roaming Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether 5G NR (New Radio) roaming is active with this carrier. Requires 5G roaming agreement, SEPP (Security Edge Protection Proxy) interconnect, and N32 interface configuration per 3GPP TS 33.501.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 33.501; GSMA PRD NG.113; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: fraud_risk_level
attributes.description: Fraud risk classification for this carrier based on historical NRTRDE anomalies, grey route incidents, and GSMA FASG (Fraud and Security Group) advisories. Drives real-time fraud monitoring thresholds and NRTRDE file frequency.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 (FASG); GSMA PRD TD.32; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: interconnect_agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of interconnect arrangement with this carrier: direct (direct circuit interconnect), transit (traffic routed via a third-party transit carrier), peering (IP or voice peering arrangement), wholesale (wholesale traffic purchase/sale), none (no active interconnect).
attributes.references: FCC Part 69; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: iot_tariff_group
attributes.description: IOT tariff group classification assigned to this carrier, used to look up applicable Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rates for roaming settlement. Aligns with GSMA IOT rate tables and bilateral agreement terms. Drives rating of inbound and outbound roaming CDRs.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 (IOT); GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: ir21_last_updated_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: GSMA IR.21 Profile Last Updated Date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier's GSMA IR.21 roaming information profile was last updated in the GSMA RAEX (Roaming Agreement Exchange) system. Stale IR.21 data can cause roaming activation failures.

attributes.name: ir21_profile_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: GSMA IR.21 Roaming Information Profile Version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the carrier's GSMA IR.21 roaming information document on file. IR.21 contains network configuration data required for roaming service activation including IMSI ranges, supported services, and signalling parameters.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this carrier record in the interconnect carrier master registry. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_tap_file_received_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently received TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file from this carrier. Used to monitor TAP file exchange health and detect stale or missing files that may indicate a processing issue or carrier-side problem.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: last_tap_file_sent_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently sent TAP file to this carrier. Used to monitor outbound TAP file exchange health and ensure timely delivery within GSMA-mandated submission windows.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: lte_roaming_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether LTE (4G) data roaming is active with this carrier. Distinct from VoLTE; covers data-only LTE roaming sessions rated and settled via TAP3 or DIAMETER-based online charging.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.88; 3GPP TS 23.401; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: Three-digit ITU-assigned Mobile Country Code (MCC) identifying the country of the carrier's home network. Combined with MNC to form the full PLMN identifier used in roaming and signalling.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD SE.13

attributes.name: mnc
attributes.description: Two- or three-digit ITU-assigned Mobile Network Code (MNC) identifying the carrier's specific network within its country. Combined with MCC to form the PLMN identifier used in HLR/HSS, roaming agreements, and CDR processing.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD SE.13

attributes.name: noc_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the carrier's Network Operations Center (NOC) used for fault escalation, outage notifications, and interconnect incident management. Operational contact for network-layer issues.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; ISO/IEC 27001; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: noc_phone
attributes.description: 24/7 phone number for the carrier's Network Operations Center (NOC) in E.164 international format. Used for real-time fault escalation, SLA breach notification, and interconnect outage coordination.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: nrtrde_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier participates in NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) for near-real-time roaming fraud detection and usage monitoring. When true, NRTRDE files must be exchanged within the GSMA-mandated 4-hour window.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.32 (NRTRDE); GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier was formally onboarded into Telecommunication's interconnect systems including OSS/BSS provisioning, TAP file pipeline configuration, and clearinghouse registration. Distinct from relationship_start_date which may precede system activation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; Oracle Communications OSM; Netcracker OSS/BSS

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment must be received from or made to this carrier. Standard values are 30, 45, or 60 days. Used by Amdocs Revenue Management for collections and dunning scheduling.

attributes.name: preferred_interconnect_route
attributes.description: Preferred routing method for interconnect traffic to/from this carrier: direct (direct circuit), via_transit (through a transit carrier), via_iplc (International Private Leased Circuit), via_mpls (MPLS backbone), via_sdwan (SD-WAN overlay). Used by NOC for traffic engineering.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; ITU-T G.805; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region grouping for the carrier (e.g., APAC, EMEA, AMER, LATAM). Used for regional traffic analysis, IOT tariff banding, and wholesale reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: APAC|EMEA|AMER|LATAM|MEA|CEUR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: relationship_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial and operational relationship with this carrier was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for active ongoing relationships. Used for agreement expiry tracking and traffic wind-down planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commercial and operational relationship with this carrier was formally established. Marks the beginning of the carrier's lifecycle in the interconnect registry and the effective date of the first agreement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_type
attributes.description: Type of roaming agreement in place with this carrier: bilateral (direct two-way roaming), multilateral (via GSMA or regional body), MVNO_host (carrier hosts an MVNO), transit_only (transit traffic only, no retail roaming), none (no roaming, interconnect only).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13; TM Forum SID; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for financial settlement with this carrier (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determines the currency in which TAP invoices, IOT charges, and interconnect invoices are denominated and paid.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD BA.12; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: settlement_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency of financial settlement with this carrier for interconnect and roaming charges. Determines the billing and reconciliation schedule in Amdocs Revenue Management and the clearinghouse.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or commonly used trading name of the carrier, used in operational reports, dashboards, and TAP file processing where space is constrained.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier assigned to this carrier relationship, determining priority of fault resolution, MTTR targets, and escalation paths. Platinum and gold tiers receive 24/7 NOC support with sub-4-hour MTTR commitments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: sms_interconnect_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether SMS (Short Message Service) interconnect is active with this carrier. Drives SMS CDR routing, A2P/P2P SMS settlement, and grey route detection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; 3GPP TS 23.040; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this carrier record was sourced: NETCRACKER (Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite), AMDOCS (Amdocs Revenue Management), ORACLE_OSM (Oracle Communications OSM), MANUAL (manually entered). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: spid
attributes.description: Four-digit Service Provider Identifier (SPID) assigned by the North American Numbering Plan Administrator (NANPA) or local number portability administrator. Used for MNP (Mobile Number Portability) routing and LNP database queries.

attributes.name: tadig_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
attributes.description: Five-character GSMA-assigned TADIG code uniquely identifying the carrier for TAP file exchange and inter-operator roaming settlement. Mandatory for all MNO and MVNO roaming partners. Used as the primary key in TAP file headers and NRTRDE records.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: tap_version
attributes.description: TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file format version supported by this carrier for roaming CDR exchange. Determines the file structure and encoding used when generating or receiving TAP files. Critical for TAP file processing pipeline configuration.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 (TAP3); GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: voice_interconnect_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether voice traffic (PSTN/VoIP/VoLTE) interconnect is active with this carrier. Drives CDR routing, rating, and settlement processing for voice traffic.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.228

attributes.name: volte_roaming_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Voice over LTE (VoLTE) Roaming Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether VoLTE (Voice over LTE) roaming via IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem) is active with this carrier. Requires bilateral IMS interconnect configuration and specific IR.92/IR.94 profile exchange.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.92; GSMA PRD IR.94; 3GPP TS 24.229

products.name: iot_tariff
products.description: Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rate table defining the wholesale rates charged between operators for roaming voice, SMS, and data services. Captures tariff version, effective period, service type, destination zone, IOT rate, currency, TAP decimal places, and GSMA rate group. Used for TAP file rating and settlement invoice generation. SSOT for IOT pricing.
products.reference: GSMA PRD TD.13 IOT / TM Forum SID InterOperatorTariff

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the IOT tariff record in the interconnect domain. Serves as the SSOT identifier for wholesale rate lookup during TAP file rating and settlement invoice generation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business authority (person, team, or system) that approved this IOT tariff record for production use. Required for internal governance and audit compliance in the interconnect settlement process.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this IOT tariff record was formally approved for production use. Part of the tariff lifecycle audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: charging_interval_seconds
attributes.description: The billing increment in seconds used for voice service IOT charge calculation. For example, a value of 60 means charges are calculated per full minute; a value of 1 means per-second billing. Applicable only for voice service types.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this IOT tariff record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and compliance purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the IOT rate is denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, SDR). GSMA IOT rates are typically denominated in EUR or IMF Special Drawing Rights (SDR). Used for settlement invoice currency conversion and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: destination_zone_code
attributes.description: The GSMA-defined or operator-defined destination zone code to which this IOT rate applies. Zones group countries or network destinations for wholesale tariff banding. Used in TAP file rating to match usage records to the correct IOT rate.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: destination_zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the destination zone (e.g., 'Zone 1 - EU', 'Zone 2 - Rest of World'). Used in settlement reports, finance dashboards, and operator billing correspondence.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated discount percentage applied to the standard IOT rate under a bilateral roaming agreement. Expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.1500 = 15% discount). Null if no discount applies. Used in settlement invoice calculation to derive the effective net rate.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.12; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this IOT tariff version becomes binding and applicable for wholesale roaming charge rating. Aligns with the GSMA IOT effective date published in the inter-operator tariff notification.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: effective_rate
attributes.description: The net IOT rate after applying any negotiated discount_percentage to the standard iot_rate. Stored as a pre-computed field to support high-volume TAP file rating performance. Expressed in the tariff currency per rate_unit.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this IOT tariff version ceases to be applicable. Null indicates an open-ended tariff with no defined expiry. Used to enforce correct rate selection during TAP file rating for a given usage date.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the IOT rate from currency_code to settlement_currency_code for settlement invoice generation. Sourced from the agreed exchange rate mechanism defined in the bilateral roaming agreement (e.g., ECB rate, fixed contractual rate).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.12; ISO 4217; ECB Exchange Rate Reference

attributes.name: gsma_rate_group
attributes.description: The GSMA-defined rate group classification for this IOT tariff entry. Rate groups are published in the GSMA IOT rate tables and used to categorise wholesale rates for settlement and benchmarking purposes. Examples: RG1, RG2, RG3 for voice; DG1, DG2 for data.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: home_network_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Network Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Code
attributes.description: The GSMA-assigned PLMN code (MCC+MNC) of the home operator network for which this IOT tariff is applicable. Enables multi-PLMN operators to maintain separate IOT rate tables per home network entity.
attributes.references: GSMA PLMN List; ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003

attributes.name: initial_duration_seconds
attributes.description: The initial billing period in seconds for voice calls, which may be charged at a different rate or as a flat fee before the standard per-interval rate applies. Common in IOT tariffs where the first 30 or 60 seconds are charged as a connection fee.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA IOT Specification

attributes.name: initial_rate
attributes.description: The IOT rate applied during the initial_duration_seconds period of a voice call, if different from the standard iot_rate. Null if no differentiated initial rate applies. Expressed in the tariff currency.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: inter_operator_tariff_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IOT tariff by commercial arrangement type. 'standard' for GSMA-published rates, 'preferential' for bilaterally negotiated lower rates, 'reciprocal' for symmetric bilateral agreements, 'benchmark' for reference rates used in dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA PRD AA.12; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: iot_publication_date
attributes.description: The date on which this IOT tariff was officially published by the GSMA or notified by the visited operator. Used for audit trail and to verify compliance with GSMA notification lead-time requirements prior to the effective_from_date.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: iot_rate
attributes.description: The wholesale IOT rate charged by the visited operator to the home operator for the specified service type and destination zone. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. For voice: rate per minute; for SMS: rate per message; for data: rate per kilobyte or megabyte as defined by rate_unit. This is the principal quantitative fact of the IOT tariff record.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: The minimum wholesale charge applicable per usage event under this IOT tariff, expressed in the tariff currency. Ensures a floor charge is applied even for very short calls or minimal data usage. Used in TAP file rating to enforce minimum billing thresholds.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: notification_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier of the official GSMA or bilateral operator notification document that introduced or amended this IOT tariff. Provides an audit trail linking the tariff record to the formal inter-operator communication.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: nrtrde_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether usage records rated under this IOT tariff are subject to NRTRDE near-real-time roaming data exchange reporting to the home operator. True for operators with NRTRDE obligations under GSMA PRD TD.57. Used for fraud detection and real-time roaming cost monitoring.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 NRTRDE; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: peak_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IOT tariff applies to peak, off-peak, or flat (time-independent) usage periods. Some bilateral roaming agreements differentiate IOT rates by time-of-day. 'flat' indicates no time-of-day differentiation.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the IOT rate. Defines the denominator for the iot_rate value. 'per_minute' for voice, 'per_message' for SMS/MMS, 'per_kb' or 'per_mb' for data, 'per_event' for supplementary services. Required for correct TAP file charge calculation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA IOT Specification

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or exceptions associated with this IOT tariff record. Used by the interconnect team to document bilateral negotiation context, GSMA waiver references, or rate dispute notes.

attributes.name: roaming_agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inter-operator roaming agreement under which this IOT tariff applies. 'bilateral' for direct operator-to-operator agreements, 'multilateral' for GSMA-governed multi-party agreements, 'hub' for roaming hub-mediated arrangements, 'mvno' for MVNO wholesale agreements, 'transit' for transit traffic arrangements.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA PRD AA.12; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: The rounding method applied to calculated IOT charges during TAP file rating. Governs how fractional charge amounts are rounded to the precision defined by tap_decimal_places. Ensures consistent charge calculation between home and visited operators.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA BA.12 TAP Data Dictionary

attributes.name: service_subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification of the roaming service within the service_type. Examples: MOC (Mobile Originated Call), MTC (Mobile Terminated Call), MO-SMS, MT-SMS, GPRS, VoLTE, 5G NR data. Used for detailed IOT rate differentiation and TAP file reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: moc|mtc|mo_sms|mt_sms|gprs|volte|5g_nr|mms_mo|mms_mt|supplementary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; 3GPP TS 32.240; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The category of roaming service to which this IOT rate applies. Drives the rating engine selection logic in TAP file processing. Values align with GSMA TAP3 service type codes: voice (MOC/MTC), SMS (MO/MT), data (GPRS/LTE/5G), MMS, and supplementary services.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; 3GPP TS 32.240; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for the actual financial settlement between operators, which may differ from the IOT rate currency_code. For example, IOT rates may be denominated in EUR but settled in USD per bilateral agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD AA.12; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or record identifier of this IOT tariff in the originating operational system (e.g., Amdocs Revenue Management tariff ID, Netcracker OSS catalogue ID). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this IOT tariff record was sourced or ingested (e.g., 'AMDOCS_RM', 'NETCRACKER_OSS', 'GSMA_PORTAL'). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: tap_decimal_places
attributes.description: The number of decimal places used to express the IOT rate in TAP file records, as defined by the GSMA TAP3 specification. Governs the precision of charge amounts encoded in TAP files exchanged between operators. Typically 5 for most currencies.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA BA.12 TAP Data Dictionary

attributes.name: tap_file_type
attributes.description: The GSMA file exchange format type for which this IOT tariff is applicable. TAP3 for standard roaming settlement files, NRTRDE for Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange files used for fraud detection, RAP for Returned Account Procedure files handling billing disputes.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57 NRTRDE; GSMA PRD RAP Specification

attributes.name: tariff_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this IOT tariff entry within the GSMA/operator tariff catalogue. Used as the business key in TAP file references and inter-operator correspondence.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Rate Group Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: tariff_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the IOT tariff entry, used in settlement reports, operator portals, and finance reconciliation dashboards.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA IOT Specification

attributes.name: tariff_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the IOT tariff record. Controls whether the tariff is eligible for use in TAP file rating and settlement invoice generation. 'superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced this record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA IOT Specification

attributes.name: tariff_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the IOT tariff record, enabling tracking of rate changes over time. Incremented each time the tariff is revised. Used to ensure TAP file rating applies the correct rate version.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: tax_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IOT rate is inclusive of applicable taxes (True) or exclusive of taxes (False). Relevant for operators in jurisdictions where VAT or GST applies to wholesale roaming charges. Impacts settlement invoice tax treatment.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification; ETSI EN 301 908; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this IOT tariff record was most recently modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: visited_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the visited network where the roaming subscriber consumed the service. Used to map usage to the correct IOT tariff zone and for regulatory reporting of international roaming charges.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GSMA TAP3 Specification; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: visited_network_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Visited Network Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Code
attributes.description: The GSMA-assigned Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) code (MCC+MNC) of the visited operator network. Used to uniquely identify the roaming partner network for IOT rate lookup and TAP file routing.
attributes.references: GSMA PLMN List; ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003

products.name: tap_file
products.description: Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) file header and control record representing a batch of roaming CDRs exchanged between operators via the TAP3 protocol. Captures TAP file sequence number, sender/recipient TADIG codes, file creation timestamp, TAP version, total records, total charge amount, currency, file status (created, sent, acknowledged, rejected, disputed, resubmitted), clearinghouse reference, submission/receipt timestamps, validation error summary, processing outcome, and reconciliation status against clearinghouse statements. SSOT for TAP batch lifecycle management including clearinghouse exchange tracking and error handling.
products.reference: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 / NRTRDE TD.32

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the TAP file record in the interconnect settlement system. Primary key for the tap_file data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.carrier_agreement. Business justification: TAP file currently references roaming agreement via string roaming_agreement_reference. Normalizing to carrier_agreement enables proper settlement tracking, tariff validation, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: MVNO and wholesale scenarios where TAP files contain usage by enterprise customer's subscribers. Business need: attributing roaming usage to enterprise accounts for billing reconciliation, revenue ass

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: TAP file processing is performed by specific operational teams (roaming operations, clearing house teams). Operational cost allocation and efficiency tracking require knowing which cost center process

attributes.name: sender_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: TAP file sender is currently denormalized via sender_tadig_code. Normalizing to interconnect_carrier provides authoritative carrier master reference and eliminates redundant country_code. The FK will

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the recipient operator or clearinghouse issued a formal acknowledgement (RAP or positive ACK) for this TAP file. Marks the completion of the file exchange lifecycle for settlement purposes.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA RAP Specification TD.32

attributes.name: clearinghouse_name
attributes.description: The name of the inter-operator clearinghouse or data exchange hub through which this TAP file was routed (e.g., Syniverse, BICS, GSMA Clearing House). Identifies the intermediary responsible for file routing, validation, and settlement statement generation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA Clearing House Procedures

attributes.name: clearinghouse_reference
attributes.description: The unique reference number assigned by the inter-operator clearinghouse (e.g., GSMA Clearing House, Syniverse, BICS) upon receipt of this TAP file. Used for end-to-end traceability, dispute resolution, and reconciliation against clearinghouse settlement statements.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA Clearing House Procedures

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this TAP file record was first captured in the interconnect settlement data platform (Silver layer). Audit trail field for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: data_period_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the latest CDR event contained within this TAP file, representing the end of the usage data period covered by the batch. Used alongside data_period_start_timestamp for gap detection and completeness validation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA PRD TD.32

attributes.name: data_period_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the earliest CDR event contained within this TAP file, representing the start of the usage data period covered by the batch. Used for period-based reconciliation, billing cycle alignment, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA PRD TD.32

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of any commercial dispute raised against this TAP file by the recipient operator or clearinghouse. Populated when file_status is 'disputed'. Links to the dispute management workflow for IOT charge challenges and resolution tracking.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the TAP file settlement currency to the home operator's local accounting currency at the time of settlement. Used for financial reporting, revenue assurance, and EBITDA calculations in multi-currency environments.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance Module

attributes.name: file_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the TAP file was generated by the sending operator's mediation or billing system (Amdocs Revenue Management). Represents the principal business event time for the file batch. Used for timeliness SLA measurement per GSMA NRTRDE and TAP submission deadlines.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA NRTRDE Specification

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: The physical size of the TAP file in bytes as received from the sender or clearinghouse. Used for transmission integrity checks, storage capacity planning, and anomaly detection (unusually large or small files may indicate encoding errors).

attributes.name: file_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the TAP file within the inter-operator settlement workflow. Transitions: created → sent → acknowledged (clean acceptance) or rejected (validation failure) → disputed (commercial challenge) or resubmitted (corrected re-send). Drives settlement reconciliation and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: file_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of inter-operator data exchange file: TAP (standard Transferred Account Procedure batch), NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange for fraud detection), RAP (Returned Account Procedure for rejected records), or STOP (Stop file halting processing). Determines processing pipeline and settlement treatment.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA NRTRDE Specification PRD TD.32

attributes.name: iot_tariff_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) schedule applied to rate the CDRs in this TAP file. Ensures the correct tariff table is used for settlement validation and dispute resolution when tariff changes occur mid-period.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT Specification PRD BA.12; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: is_test_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TAP file is a test/simulation file (True) or a live production file (False) carrying real roaming charges. Test files must be excluded from financial settlement calculations and revenue reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA PRD TD.32

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: The predominant radio access network technology type of the CDRs contained in this TAP file (e.g., LTE, 5G NR, VoLTE). Used for technology-segmented roaming analytics, IOT tariff differentiation, and network capacity planning.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297; GSMA TAP3 TD.57; ETSI TS 132 297

attributes.name: nrtrde_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Reference
attributes.description: The reference identifier linking this TAP file to its corresponding NRTRDE near-real-time roaming data exchange record. NRTRDE files are transmitted within 4 hours of call completion for fraud detection; this reference enables correlation between the NRTRDE early notification and the final TAP settlement file.
attributes.references: GSMA NRTRDE Specification PRD TD.32; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: original_sequence_number
attributes.description: For resubmitted TAP files, the sequence number of the original file that this resubmission replaces. Enables lineage tracing from corrected files back to the original rejected batch. Null for first-time submissions.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA RAP Specification TD.32

attributes.name: processing_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the TAP file processing pipeline within the operator's BSS/OSS systems (Amdocs Revenue Management, Netcracker OSS/BSS). Indicates whether all CDRs were successfully rated and posted to settlement accounts, partially processed, or failed. Drives exception management workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; GSMA TAP3 TD.57; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: rap_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of the RAP (Returned Account Procedure) file generated in response to validation failures in this TAP file. Links the TAP file to its corresponding rejection notification for dispute tracking and resubmission management.
attributes.references: GSMA RAP Specification TD.32; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the TAP file was received and acknowledged at the clearinghouse or by the recipient operator. Used to calculate transit latency and confirm delivery within bilateral SLA windows.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA PRD TD.32

attributes.name: recipient_country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the recipient operator's home country. Used for bilateral traffic analysis, regulatory reporting, and determining applicable IOT tariff zones and settlement currency conventions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GSMA TAP3 TD.57; ITU-T E.212

attributes.name: recipient_tadig_code
attributes.description: The five-character TADIG code identifying the receiving (home) network operator to whom this TAP file is addressed. Determines routing through the clearinghouse and the settlement counterparty for IOT charges.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: The reconciliation state of this TAP file against the clearinghouse settlement statement. Tracks whether the file's declared charges match the clearinghouse-confirmed amounts. Discrepancies trigger revenue assurance investigations. Used for MRR and ARPU reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; GSMA Clearing House Procedures; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: The number of times this TAP file has been resubmitted after rejection or dispute. A value greater than zero indicates the file has been corrected and resent. Used for operator performance monitoring and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA RAP Specification TD.32

attributes.name: roaming_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TAP file represents inbound roaming (foreign subscribers using our network — we are the visited operator and sender) or outbound roaming (our subscribers using a foreign network — we are the home operator and recipient). Critical for revenue assurance and IOT settlement accounting.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; TM Forum eTOM; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: The sequential file number assigned by the sending operator to uniquely identify this TAP file within the bilateral exchange. Follows GSMA TAP3 five-digit sequence numbering convention (00001–99999, wrapping). Used for duplicate detection and gap analysis in file receipt tracking.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification TD.57; ITU-T E.212

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the TAP file charges are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Governs the currency for clearinghouse settlement and financial reconciliation between operators.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: settlement_statement_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of the clearinghouse settlement statement that includes charges from this TAP file. Links the TAP file batch to the financial settlement document used for inter-operator payment and accounting entries in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: GSMA Clearing House Procedures; SAP S/4HANA Finance Module; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system of record that generated or ingested this TAP file record (e.g., Amdocs Revenue Management, Comverse ONE, Netcracker OSS/BSS). Used for data lineage tracking and issue triage in the Silver layer.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the TAP file was submitted to the clearinghouse or directly to the recipient operator. Used to measure compliance with GSMA TAP submission timeliness requirements (typically within 36 hours of the last CDR in the file).
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA PRD TD.32

attributes.name: tap_version
attributes.description: The TAP3 protocol release version used to encode this file (e.g., TAP3R10, TAP3R12). Governs the ASN.1 schema and field set applicable to the file. Critical for parser selection during file ingestion and validation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification TD.57; ETSI TS 132 297

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax component included in the TAP file charge amount, as declared in the file header. Applicable in jurisdictions where VAT or withholding tax applies to inter-operator roaming settlements. Used for financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA PRD BA.12; FCC Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: total_cdr_count
attributes.description: The total number of Call Detail Records (CDRs) contained within this TAP file as declared in the file header. Used for completeness validation against the actual parsed record count and for settlement volume reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: total_charge_amount
attributes.description: The gross total Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) charge amount declared in the TAP file header, representing the sum of all roaming charges for CDRs in this batch. Expressed in the settlement currency. Used as the primary financial control total for clearinghouse reconciliation and operator settlement.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA IOT Specification PRD BA.12

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this TAP file record was most recently modified in the interconnect settlement data platform. Tracks status transitions, validation updates, and reconciliation changes.

attributes.name: validation_error_count
attributes.description: The total number of validation errors identified during TAP file parsing and structural/business rule validation. A non-zero value triggers RAP (Returned Account Procedure) generation. Used for quality monitoring and operator performance tracking.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA RAP Specification

attributes.name: validation_error_summary
attributes.description: A structured summary of the validation errors encountered during TAP file processing, including error codes and descriptions as defined in the GSMA TAP3 specification. Supports root cause analysis, operator dispute resolution, and resubmission guidance.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; GSMA RAP Specification TD.32

products.name: tap_record
products.description: Individual roaming usage record (CDR) within a TAP3 file, representing a single billable roaming event (MOC, MTC, GPRS, SMS-MO, SMS-MT) for a visiting subscriber. Captures TAP record sequence, call type, IMSI, MSISDN, visited network TADIG, home network TADIG, service start timestamp, duration/volume, charged amount, IOT rate applied, and record status. Line-item detail supporting TAP file settlement.
products.reference: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 Record

attributes.name: tap_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual TAP roaming usage record (CDR) within the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the tap_record data product.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); TM Forum SID

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral roaming agreement governing this inter-operator traffic exchange, linking to the applicable IOT tariff and settlement terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: cell_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the radio cell or base station where the roaming subscriber was served during this event, as reported by the visited network. Used for geographic traffic analysis and network capacity planning.

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.iot_tariff. Business justification: TAP record has iot_rate_applied and iot_rate_unit but no FK to the tariff definition. Normalizing to iot_tariff enables proper rate validation and audit trail. Note: iot_rate_applied and iot_rate_unit

attributes.name: ont_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.ont_asset. Business justification: Fixed-wireless access (FWA) and fiber-to-home roaming scenarios (emerging in 5G) require tracking which ONT device generated roaming traffic for revenue assurance, fraud detection, and device-level us

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: TAP record processing is an ETL pipeline operation. Linking each record to its processing pipeline run enables data lineage tracking, reprocessing workflows, and root cause analysis when TAP file reco

attributes.name: privacy_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_consent. Business justification: TAP records contain subscriber usage data (IMSI, MSISDN) subject to privacy consent under GDPR/CPNI. Links usage record to consent for data processing verification and privacy audit trails.

attributes.name: rap_file_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.rap_file. Business justification: TAP record currently references RAP file via string rap_file_reference. Normalizing to rap_file enables proper rejection tracking and resubmission workflow. The FK will be populated when TAP record is

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent TAP3 file batch from which this individual roaming CDR was extracted. Supports file-level reconciliation and settlement tracing.

attributes.name: visited_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: TAP record visited carrier is denormalized via visited_network_tadig and visited_country_code. Normalizing to interconnect_carrier eliminates redundancy and provides authoritative carrier master refer

attributes.name: call_event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billable roaming event captured in this TAP record. MOC=Mobile Originated Call, MTC=Mobile Terminated Call, GPRS=data session, SMS_MO/MT=Short Message Service originated/terminated, MMS_MO/MT=Multimedia Message Service. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MOC|MTC|GPRS|SMS_MO|SMS_MT|MMS_MO|MMS_MT — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: called_number
attributes.description: E.164 telephone number of the called party (B-number) for MOC voice events. Used for traffic analysis, fraud detection (e.g., IRSF detection), and regulatory reporting. Null for MTC, GPRS, and messaging events.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — CalledNumber; FCC 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: charge_type
attributes.description: Classification of the charge category applied to this roaming event (e.g., AIRTIME for standard voice/data, ROAMING_SURCHARGE for additional roaming fees, INTERCONNECT for transit charges). Used for revenue assurance and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12 (IOT); TM Forum SID; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: charged_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount charged to the home network operator for this individual roaming event, expressed in the settlement currency. Calculated by the visited network by applying the applicable IOT rate to the consumed duration or volume.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — ChargeInformation.chargeAmount; GSMA PRD BA.12 (IOT)

attributes.name: data_volume_downlink_kb
attributes.description: Volume of data transmitted from the network to the subscriber's device (downlink) during a GPRS/data session, measured in kilobytes. Null for non-data call event types.

attributes.name: data_volume_uplink_kb
attributes.description: Volume of data transmitted from the subscriber's device to the network (uplink) during a GPRS/data session, measured in kilobytes. Null for non-data call event types.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for the called party in MOC voice events. Used for international traffic analysis and IOT tariff zone classification.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount applied to the gross charged amount for this roaming event as per the bilateral roaming agreement or special IOT discount arrangement. Reduces the net settlement obligation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — DiscountInformation; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the voice call or data session in seconds as recorded by the visited network. Zero for instantaneous events (SMS/MMS). Used for IOT charge calculation and traffic analytics.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert the settlement currency amount to the home network's functional accounting currency at the time of TAP file processing. Used for financial reporting and revenue assurance reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance module

attributes.name: fraud_indicator
attributes.description: Flag set to True when this TAP record has been identified as potentially fraudulent by the fraud management system (e.g., IRSF, SIM cloning, abnormal roaming patterns). Triggers investigation workflow in the Revenue Assurance domain.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 (Fraud Information Gathering System); GSMA PRD IR.82; FCC Anti-Fraud Regulations

attributes.name: home_currency_amount
attributes.description: Charged amount converted to the home network operator's functional accounting currency using the exchange_rate. Used for financial reporting, EBITDA calculation, and MRR/revenue recognition in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12; SAP S/4HANA Finance; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: home_network_tadig
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Network Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
attributes.description: 5-character GSMA TADIG code identifying the home network operator (HPMN) to which the roaming subscriber belongs and to whom the TAP file is addressed for settlement.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; GSMA PRD TD.57; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: imei
attributes.description: 15-digit unique identifier of the mobile device used by the roaming subscriber during this call event. Used for fraud detection, device analytics, and GSMA equipment identity register checks.

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: 15-digit globally unique identifier assigned to the visiting subscriber's SIM card, comprising MCC+MNC+MSIN. Used to identify the roaming subscriber for settlement and fraud detection. Classified as restricted PII as it uniquely identifies an individual subscriber.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: iot_rate_applied
attributes.description: The specific IOT unit rate applied by the visited network to calculate the charged amount for this roaming event (e.g., rate per minute for voice, rate per KB for data). Sourced from the applicable IOT tariff table in effect at the time of service.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12 (Inter-Operator Tariff); GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57)

attributes.name: iot_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the IOT rate applied to this roaming event (e.g., PER_MINUTE for voice calls, PER_KB or PER_MB for data sessions, PER_MESSAGE for SMS/MMS).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12 (Inter-Operator Tariff); GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent modification to this TAP record in the Silver Layer (e.g., status change from PENDING to ACCEPTED, fraud flag update, RAP reference population). Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: location_area_code
attributes.description: Location Area Code (LAC) or Tracking Area Code (TAC) identifying the geographic area within the visited network where the roaming subscriber was registered during this event.

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The E.164 telephone number of the visiting roaming subscriber. Used for call routing, subscriber identification, and customer-facing settlement records. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: network_access_technology
attributes.description: Radio access technology used by the visiting subscriber during this roaming event (e.g., 2G/GSM, 3G/UMTS, 4G LTE, 5G NR). Relevant for IOT tariff differentiation and network analytics.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 29.274; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); ETSI TS 132 250

attributes.name: nrtrde_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this roaming CDR was also transmitted via the NRTRDE near-real-time roaming data exchange mechanism (within 4 hours of the call event) in addition to the standard TAP3 file. Used for fraud detection and real-time roaming cost monitoring.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82 (NRTRDE); GSMA PRD FS.11

attributes.name: nrtrde_transmission_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Transmission Timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this CDR was transmitted via the NRTRDE mechanism to the home network. Null if nrtrde_flag is False. Used to verify compliance with the GSMA 4-hour NRTRDE transmission SLA.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82 (NRTRDE); GSMA PRD FS.11

attributes.name: partial_record_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this TAP record represents a partial CDR (e.g., a long-duration data session split across multiple records by the visited network). True=partial record requiring reassembly; False=complete single record.

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current processing and settlement lifecycle status of this TAP roaming record. ACCEPTED=validated and accepted for settlement; REJECTED=failed TAP validation; DISPUTED=under inter-operator dispute; PENDING=awaiting validation; SETTLED=financially settled.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GSMA PRD BA.12; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: GSMA-standard error/rejection code assigned when a TAP record fails validation (record_status = REJECTED). Codes are defined in GSMA TD.57 Annex and indicate the specific validation rule that was violated (e.g., missing mandatory field, invalid IMSI format, timestamp out of range).
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — Annex; GSMA PRD TD.60 (RAP)

attributes.name: roaming_type
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of roaming from the perspective of the home network operator. INBOUND=a subscriber from another network is roaming on our network (we are the VPMN); OUTBOUND=our subscriber is roaming on another network (we are the HPMN).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57)

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this CDR within its parent TAP3 file, as assigned by the visited network operator. Used for ordering, gap detection, and duplicate identification during TAP file processing.

attributes.name: service_code
attributes.description: 3GPP teleservice or bearer service code identifying the specific service used during this roaming event (e.g., 11=telephony, 22=SMS, 41=data circuit async). Maps to the TAP3 BasicServiceUsed element.

attributes.name: service_end_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp marking the exact moment the billable roaming event ended (call release for voice, session close for GPRS). Null for instantaneous events such as SMS/MMS.

attributes.name: service_start_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp marking the exact moment the billable roaming event began (call answer time for voice, session start for GPRS, message submission for SMS/MMS). Principal business event time per TAP3 specification.

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the inter-operator settlement charge for this TAP record is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determined by the bilateral roaming agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — TapCurrency; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: Calendar month (YYYY-MM format) to which this TAP record is assigned for inter-operator financial settlement. Determines the billing cycle for IOT invoice generation between the visited and home network operators.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.12 (IOT Settlement); GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this TAP record was ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer (e.g., Amdocs Revenue Management TAP processing module, Comverse ONE, NRTRDE hub, or industry clearinghouse). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management; Comverse ONE

attributes.name: tap_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: UTC timestamp when this TAP record was first created and written to the Databricks Silver Layer during TAP file ingestion and parsing. Audit trail for data lineage and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID; GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57)

attributes.name: tap_file_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential file number assigned by the visited network operator to the TAP3 file containing this record. Together with visited_network_tadig and home_network_tadig, uniquely identifies the source TAP file for audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: tap_spec_version
attributes.description: Version of the GSMA TAP3 specification used to encode this roaming record (e.g., TAP3R12). Required for correct parsing, validation, and backward-compatibility handling during TAP file processing.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax or levy amount applicable to this roaming event as specified in the TAP record, if any. Included per TAP3 TaxInformation element where the visited network applies local taxation to wholesale charges.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57) — TaxInformation; ITU-T D.98

products.name: nrtrde_record
products.description: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) event record providing early visibility into roaming usage within 4 hours of service delivery per GSMA BA.40 standard. Captures NRTRDE sequence, IMSI, MSISDN, visited TADIG, home TADIG, service type (voice, SMS, data), usage timestamp, volume/duration, estimated charge, high-usage indicator, and transmission latency. Used by interconnect operations for early revenue assurance on inbound/outbound roaming traffic and for triggering fraud alerts to the assurance domain when thresholds are breached. SSOT for pre-TAP roaming visibility.
products.reference: GSMA PRD TD.32 NRTRDE

attributes.name: nrtrde_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Record ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each NRTRDE event record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral roaming agreement governing this traffic exchange between the visited and home operators. Determines applicable Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rates and settlement terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.12 Roaming Agreement; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: cell_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the radio cell in the visited network where the roaming subscriber was served. Used for network-level fraud detection (e.g., impossible travel analysis) and geographic usage pattern analysis.

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.iot_tariff. Business justification: NRTRDE record currently references IOT tariff via string iot_tariff_code. Normalizing to iot_tariff enables proper rate validation and settlement tracking. The FK will be populated during NRTRDE proce

attributes.name: ont_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.ont_asset. Business justification: Near-real-time roaming data exchange for FWA services must link to specific ONT assets for immediate fraud alerts and high-usage threshold monitoring. Critical for real-time revenue assurance on fixed

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: NRTRDE records are ingested via ETL pipelines. This link supports data quality monitoring, SLA breach analysis (transmission latency), and reprocessing workflows when NRTRDE validation fails or reconc

attributes.name: privacy_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_consent. Business justification: NRTRDE records contain near-real-time subscriber data requiring consent for processing and sharing with roaming partners. Essential for consent validation in real-time data exchange and GDPR complianc

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TAP file that this NRTRDE record will ultimately reconcile against during post-event settlement. Links pre-TAP roaming visibility to the formal TAP billing cycle.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.57 TAP3 Standard; GSMA BA.40

attributes.name: visited_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: NRTRDE record visited carrier is denormalized via visited_tadig, visited_plmn_id, visited_country_code. Normalizing to interconnect_carrier eliminates redundancy and provides authoritative carrier mas

attributes.name: apn
attributes.description: Access Point Name used by the roaming subscriber for the data session, identifying the packet data network gateway and service type (e.g., internet, IMS, enterprise VPN). Applicable for DATA record types. Used for data service classification and IOT tariff selection.

attributes.name: batch_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the NRTRDE transmission batch (file) from the visited operator, used to detect missing batches and ensure complete data receipt. Increments with each new file transmission per GSMA BA.40 batch numbering rules.

attributes.name: call_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the voice call or supplementary service event in seconds, as reported by the visited network. Applicable for VOICE and SUPPLEMENTARY record types. Used for IOT charge calculation and revenue assurance validation.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; GSMA TD.57 TAP3; 3GPP TS 32.250

attributes.name: charge_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the estimated IOT charge is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency settlement reconciliation between international operators.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA BA.40; GSMA PRD AA.14

attributes.name: charge_variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between the estimated IOT charge in this NRTRDE record and the final charge confirmed in the reconciled TAP file. Populated after TAP reconciliation. Positive value indicates NRTRDE overestimated; negative indicates underestimation. Used for revenue assurance leakage analysis.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; GSMA TD.57 TAP3; TM Forum Revenue Assurance Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when this NRTRDE record was first ingested and created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Audit trail field for data lineage and processing SLA measurement.
attributes.references: TM Forum Data Management Guidelines; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: data_volume_downlink_kb
attributes.description: Volume of data transmitted from the network to the roaming subscriber's device (downlink) in kilobytes during a GPRS/data session. Applicable for DATA record types. Used for IOT data charge calculation.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; GSMA TD.57 TAP3; 3GPP TS 32.251

attributes.name: data_volume_uplink_kb
attributes.description: Volume of data transmitted from the roaming subscriber's device to the network (uplink) in kilobytes during a GPRS/data session. Applicable for DATA record types. Used for IOT data charge calculation.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; GSMA TD.57 TAP3; 3GPP TS 32.251

attributes.name: dialed_number
attributes.description: The destination number dialed by the roaming subscriber for voice calls (B-party number in E.164 format). Applicable for MOC record types. Used for fraud detection (e.g., premium rate number abuse, international revenue share fraud) and traffic analysis.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 32.250; GSMA PRD FS.11

attributes.name: estimated_charge_amount
attributes.description: Estimated wholesale charge for this roaming event calculated by the visited network using the applicable IOT tariff at time of NRTRDE transmission. This is a pre-settlement estimate; the final charge is confirmed in the TAP file. Used for early revenue assurance and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; GSMA PRD AA.14 IOT; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: Calendar date (UTC) on which the roaming service event occurred, derived from service_start_timestamp. Used as a partition key in the Silver layer lakehouse for efficient time-range queries and daily revenue assurance reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; TM Forum Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: fraud_alert_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating that this NRTRDE record has triggered a fraud alert to the Revenue Assurance domain based on anomalous usage patterns (e.g., impossible travel, velocity breach, SIM cloning signatures). True = fraud alert raised; False = no alert.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 Fraud Information Gathering System (FIGS); GSMA BA.40

attributes.name: high_usage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag set by the visited network indicating that this subscriber's cumulative roaming usage has exceeded a predefined high-usage threshold, triggering potential fraud alert or credit limit notification to the home operator per GSMA BA.40 high-usage detection rules.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40 NRTRDE Standard; GSMA PRD FS.11 Fraud

attributes.name: home_tadig
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Network Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
attributes.description: 5-character GSMA TADIG code identifying the subscriber's home network operator. Used to route NRTRDE records to the correct home PLMN for revenue assurance and fraud detection.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; GSMA BA.40; ITU-T E.212

attributes.name: imei
attributes.description: 15-digit unique identifier of the mobile device used during the roaming event. Used for device-level fraud detection (e.g., blacklisted IMEI, IMEI/IMSI mismatch indicating SIM cloning) and equipment analytics.
attributes.references: GSMA IMEI Database; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD FS.11

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: 15-digit globally unique identifier assigned to the subscriber's SIM card, used to identify the roaming subscriber across visited and home networks. Classified as restricted PII as it directly identifies an individual subscriber.

attributes.name: location_area_code
attributes.description: Location Area Code identifying the geographic area within the visited network where the roaming event occurred. Used alongside Cell ID for subscriber location tracking and fraud detection in the interconnect domain.

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The subscriber's mobile phone number in E.164 format, representing the dialable number associated with the roaming event. Classified as restricted PII as it directly identifies an individual.

attributes.name: network_technology
attributes.description: Radio access technology generation used to deliver the roaming service. Values: 2G (GSM/GPRS/EDGE), 3G (UMTS/HSPA), 4G_LTE (Long-Term Evolution), 5G_NR (5G New Radio), WIFI (Wi-Fi calling/VoWiFi). Impacts IOT tariff applicability and fraud pattern analysis.

attributes.name: nrtrde_version
attributes.description: Version of the GSMA BA.40 NRTRDE standard used to generate this record (e.g., 2.0, 3.0). Required for backward-compatible processing as operators may transmit records under different standard versions during migration periods.

attributes.name: processing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the NRTRDE record within the interconnect operations processing pipeline. RECEIVED=ingested from visited network; VALIDATED=passed format/content checks; ENRICHED=IOT tariff and agreement data applied; RECONCILED=matched to TAP file; REJECTED=failed validation; DISPUTED=charge under dispute.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; TM Forum eTOM Process Framework

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Specific CDR record type classifying the direction and nature of the roaming event. MOC=Mobile Originated Call, MTC=Mobile Terminated Call, GPRS=data session, SMS_MO=outbound SMS, SMS_MT=inbound SMS. Aligns with TAP3 record type taxonomy.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.57 TAP3; 3GPP TS 32.250; GSMA BA.40

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason a NRTRDE record was rejected during validation processing (e.g., invalid IMSI format, unknown TADIG, missing mandatory field, duplicate sequence number). Populated only when processing_status = REJECTED. Aligns with GSMA TAP error code taxonomy.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.57 TAP3 Error Codes; GSMA BA.40

attributes.name: roaming_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this roaming event is inbound (foreign subscriber roaming on our network — we are the visited operator) or outbound (our subscriber roaming on a foreign network — we are the home operator). Determines revenue assurance treatment and settlement flow.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; GSMA PRD AA.12; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to the NRTRDE record within a transmission batch, used to detect gaps, duplicates, and ordering issues during inter-operator exchange per GSMA BA.40.

attributes.name: service_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when the roaming service event concluded. For voice calls this is call release time; for data sessions this is PDP context deactivation. Used to derive call/session duration and validate against usage volume.

attributes.name: service_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when the roaming service event began — the principal real-world event time. For voice calls this is call answer time; for data sessions this is PDP context activation; for SMS this is submission time. Core field for NRTRDE 4-hour transmission SLA compliance measurement per GSMA BA.40.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Category of telecommunications service consumed during the roaming event. Drives IOT tariff selection, usage volume interpretation, and revenue assurance thresholds. Values: VOICE (voice call), SMS (short message), DATA (packet data), MMS (multimedia message), SUPPLEMENTARY (supplementary services).
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40; 3GPP TS 32.250; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: sla_breach_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this NRTRDE record was transmitted outside the GSMA BA.40 4-hour SLA window (transmission_latency_minutes > 240). True = SLA breached; False = within SLA. Used for inter-operator SLA performance reporting and penalty calculation.

attributes.name: source_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the NRTRDE transmission file from which this record was extracted, following GSMA BA.40 file naming conventions. Used for batch traceability, reprocessing, and audit trail in the interconnect operations pipeline.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.40 NRTRDE Standard; TM Forum Data Lineage

attributes.name: tap_reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of reconciliation between this NRTRDE pre-TAP record and the corresponding TAP3 billing record. PENDING=TAP file not yet received; MATCHED=successfully reconciled; UNMATCHED=no corresponding TAP record found; PARTIAL=partial match with charge discrepancy. Critical for revenue assurance.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.57 TAP3; GSMA BA.40; TM Forum Revenue Assurance

attributes.name: transmission_latency_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes between service_start_timestamp and transmission_timestamp. Measures compliance with the GSMA BA.40 4-hour (240-minute) near-real-time transmission SLA. Records exceeding 240 minutes are flagged for SLA breach reporting.

attributes.name: transmission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when the NRTRDE record was transmitted by the visited network to the home network. Used to calculate transmission latency against the GSMA BA.40 4-hour SLA requirement from service delivery.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (UTC) when this NRTRDE record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse, such as after TAP reconciliation, status update, or fraud flag enrichment. Audit trail field for data lineage.
attributes.references: TM Forum Data Management Guidelines; ISO/IEC 27001

products.name: transit_traffic_record
products.description: Record of transit voice and data traffic routed through Telecommunication's network on behalf of third-party carriers (transit/hubbing). Captures transit record ID, originating carrier, terminating carrier, ingress POP, egress POP, traffic type (voice, SMS, data), start timestamp, duration/volume, transit rate applied, billed amount, and settlement status. Supports wholesale transit billing and capacity planning.
products.reference: TM Forum SID TransitTrafficRecord / eTOM 1.4.6

attributes.name: transit_traffic_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each transit traffic record in the Telecommunications wholesale interconnect system. Primary key for the transit_traffic_record data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Interconnect & Wholesale Domain

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral or multilateral roaming or transit agreement under which this traffic was carried. Links to the governing commercial agreement for tariff and settlement terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21 — Roaming Database; TM Forum SID GB922 — Agreement Domain

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Transit traffic generates revenue/expense postings to specific GL accounts. Supports accrual accounting for non-invoiced transit services and revenue assurance reconciliation. Critical for financial c

attributes.name: invoice_id
