attributes.description: Reference to the wholesale settlement invoice on which this transit traffic record was billed. Links the traffic record to the financial invoice for reconciliation and dispute management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing Module

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.iot_tariff. Business justification: Transit traffic record currently references IOT tariff via string iot_rate_code. Normalizing to iot_tariff enables proper rate validation and settlement tracking. The FK will be populated during trans

attributes.name: original_record_transit_traffic_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original transit_traffic_record_id when this record is a correction, reversal, or reprocessed version of a prior record. Null for original records. Supports audit trail and settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure)

attributes.name: originating_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier entity that originated the transit traffic and handed it off to Telecommunications network for transit routing. Used for wholesale billing and IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) application.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) Guidelines

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Transit traffic CDRs are processed via rating pipelines. Linking to pipeline_run enables late CDR tracking, reprocessing of disputed records, and data lineage for revenue assurance audits when settlem

attributes.name: primary_transit_pop_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the POP (Point of Presence) or network node where the transit traffic entered the Telecommunications network from the originating carrier. Critical for capacity planning and interconnect cost allocation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Domain; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: primary_transit_terminating_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier entity that receives the transit traffic from Telecommunications network for final delivery to the end destination. Used for wholesale settlement and capacity planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) Guidelines

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file in which this transit traffic record was included for inter-operator exchange. Used for TAP file reconciliation, NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) matching, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 File Format; GSMA PRD TD.57 — TAP File Specification

attributes.name: transmission_link_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.transmission_link. Business justification: Transit traffic records must track which transmission links carried the traffic for network utilization analysis, capacity planning, and cost allocation. Operations teams use this for link dimensionin

attributes.name: billing_period
attributes.description: The calendar month billing period (YYYY-MM format) to which this transit traffic record is assigned for wholesale settlement and invoice generation. Used for period-based aggregation in Amdocs Revenue Management and MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Billing Module

attributes.name: call_completion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transit call or session was successfully completed (True) or failed/unanswered (False). Used for answer seizure ratio (ASR) KPI calculation, QoS (Quality of Service) monitoring, and wholesale SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.425 — Traffic Measurement; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) Guidelines

attributes.name: call_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the transit traffic session or call was terminated. Used in conjunction with call_start_timestamp to derive duration for voice and signaling traffic billing.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297 — CDR (Call Detail Record) File Format; GSMA TAP3 File Format

attributes.name: call_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the transit traffic session or call began, as recorded at the ingress POP. This is the principal real-world event timestamp used for CDR (Call Detail Record) rating, IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) application, and TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file generation.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297 — CDR (Call Detail Record) File Format; GSMA TAP3 File Format

attributes.name: cdr_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this CDR (Call Detail Record) or transit traffic record was sourced. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across OSS/BSS systems. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: amdocs|netcracker|comverse|ericsson|nokia|mediation|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM (Enhanced Telecom Operations Map) — Operations Support Systems; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this transit traffic record was first created or ingested into the Telecommunications data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance monitoring for CDR (Call Detail Record) processing timeliness.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Audit Trail; ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management

attributes.name: data_volume_kb
attributes.description: Total volume of data traffic transited through the Telecommunications network in kilobytes. Used for per-KB or per-MB IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) rate application for data and MMS transit traffic. Null for voice and SMS traffic types.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.251 — Packet Switched (PS) Domain CDR; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Wholesale discount or credit applied to the gross billed amount for this transit record, per the terms of the interconnect or transit agreement. May reflect volume discounts, promotional rates, or contractual adjustments.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; GSMA IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) Guidelines

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any active or historical inter-carrier dispute associated with this transit traffic record. Populated when settlement_status is 'disputed'. Used for dispute tracking and resolution in wholesale operations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; GSMA PRD TD.32 — Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the transit voice or signaling session in seconds. Used for per-second or per-minute IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) rate application and wholesale billing calculations. Null for non-voice traffic types.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297; GSMA TAP3 File Format; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transit traffic record has been identified as potentially fraudulent (True) by fraud management systems, including IRSF (International Revenue Share Fraud) detection. Triggers investigation and potential blocking in the SOC (Security Operations Center).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 — Fraud Management; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Anti-Fraud Regulations

attributes.name: gross_billed_amount
attributes.description: The gross wholesale amount billed for this transit traffic record before any adjustments, discounts, or credits. Computed as transit_rate_applied multiplied by the applicable volume or duration. Used in Amdocs Revenue Management for invoice generation and settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: late_cdr_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CDR (Call Detail Record) was received after the standard TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) file submission deadline (True) or within the normal processing window (False). Late CDRs may require special handling in settlement and may be subject to GSMA late submission penalties.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 — TAP File Specification; GSMA PRD IR.71 — NRTRDE

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount payable for this transit traffic record after applying all discounts and adjustments. Equals gross_billed_amount minus discount_amount. Used as the authoritative financial figure for inter-carrier settlement and revenue assurance reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: nrtrde_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Sequence number assigned to this record within the NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) data stream. Enables near-real-time fraud detection and roaming usage monitoring per GSMA PRD IR.71 requirements.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.71 — NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) Specification

attributes.name: originating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country from which the transit traffic originated. Used for international settlement rate determination, IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) zone classification, and regulatory reporting to FCC and ITU.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; GSMA IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) Guidelines

attributes.name: originating_number
attributes.description: The calling line identity (CLI) or originating MSISDN/number from which the transit traffic was generated. Stored for CDR (Call Detail Record) reconciliation, fraud detection, and regulatory lawful intercept compliance. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR Article 4 and FCC CPNI regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FCC 47 CFR Part 64 — CPNI (Customer Proprietary Network Information); 3GPP TS 32.297

attributes.name: protocol_type
attributes.description: The signaling protocol used to establish and manage the transit traffic session. Relevant for network operations, fault management, and interconnect compatibility assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ss7|sigtran|sip|isup|h323|diameter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ITU-T Q.761 — ISUP; IETF RFC 3261 — SIP; 3GPP TS 29.002 — MAP; ETSI EN 300 356

attributes.name: rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure to which the transit_rate_applied corresponds. Defines how the rate is applied to the traffic volume or duration to compute the billed amount (e.g., per_minute for voice, per_kb for data, per_message for SMS).

attributes.name: rated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this transit traffic record was rated by the billing/rating engine (Amdocs Revenue Management or Comverse ONE). Distinct from the call start timestamp; used for rating latency monitoring and billing cycle management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Billing Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Module

attributes.name: record_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this transit traffic record, used in inter-carrier settlement communications, dispute resolution, and wholesale billing reconciliation. Corresponds to the CDR (Call Detail Record) sequence number or transit record identifier exchanged between carriers.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure) File Format; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: release_cause_code
attributes.description: The ITU-T Q.850 or SIP response code indicating the reason for call or session termination. Used for quality analysis, failed call identification, and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance monitoring in wholesale transit services.
attributes.references: ITU-T Q.850 — Cause Values; IETF RFC 3326 — SIP Reason Header; 3GPP TS 24.008

attributes.name: reprocessed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transit traffic record has been reprocessed or re-rated (True) due to a correction, dispute resolution, or system error. Used for audit trail and to prevent double-billing in wholesale settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: revenue_assurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transit traffic record has been flagged by the revenue assurance process for investigation (True) or has passed revenue assurance controls (False). Supports leakage detection and financial integrity in wholesale billing.
attributes.references: TM Forum GB941 — Revenue Assurance Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The network routing number or trunk group identifier used to route this transit traffic through the Telecommunications network. Used for capacity planning, route optimization, and interconnect cost allocation.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Domain; Ericsson Network Manager Transport Management

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the transit traffic settlement amounts (gross, discount, net) are denominated. Supports multi-currency wholesale settlement with international carriers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the transit traffic record within the wholesale financial settlement workflow. Drives downstream billing, dispute management, and revenue assurance processes in Amdocs Revenue Management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Domain; GSMA TAP (Transferred Account Procedure)

attributes.name: sms_count
attributes.description: Number of SMS messages included in this transit traffic record. Applicable when traffic_type is 'sms'. Used for per-message IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) rate application in wholesale SMS hubbing arrangements.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.270 — SMS CDR; GSMA TAP3 File Format

attributes.name: terminating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country to which the transit traffic was destined. Used for international settlement rate determination, IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) zone classification, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; GSMA IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) Guidelines

attributes.name: terminating_number
attributes.description: The called party number or terminating MSISDN/E.164 number to which the transit traffic was routed. Used for CDR (Call Detail Record) reconciliation, number portability (MNP) validation, and regulatory compliance. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR Article 4 and FCC CPNI regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FCC 47 CFR Part 64 — CPNI; ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 32.297

attributes.name: traffic_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the directional flow of the transit traffic relative to the Telecommunications network: inbound (entering for termination), outbound (exiting for origination), or transit (passing through for hubbing).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T Q.850

attributes.name: traffic_type
attributes.description: Classification of the transit traffic by service type. Determines applicable IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) rate table and settlement methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|sms|data|mms|signaling|roaming_voice|roaming_data — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.297 — CDR (Call Detail Record) File Format; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: transit_rate_applied
attributes.description: The per-unit wholesale transit rate applied to this record at the time of rating, expressed in the settlement currency. Represents the IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) unit price used to compute the billed amount. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity of carrier pricing.
attributes.references: GSMA IOT (Inter-Operator Tariff) Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Module

attributes.name: trunk_group_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical or logical trunk group over which this transit traffic was carried between the ingress and egress POPs. Used for network capacity planning, congestion analysis, and interconnect infrastructure management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Resource Domain; Nokia NetAct Network Management; Ericsson Network Manager

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this transit traffic record was last modified, such as when settlement_status changed or a dispute was raised. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and downstream incremental processing in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Audit Trail; ISO/IEC 27001 — Information Security Management

products.name: peering_arrangement
products.description: Master record of IP peering and voice interconnect peering arrangements with other carriers, ISPs, and content delivery networks. Captures peering type (public IXP, private PNI, settlement-free, paid, partial), peering point location (IXP name, POP, data center), agreed traffic ratios and balance thresholds, bandwidth commitments, BGP session parameters, effective/expiry dates, SLA references, and arrangement status. Distinct from carrier_agreement — peering arrangements are technical/operational agreements governing traffic exchange mechanics, often managed by network operations separately from commercial roaming/wholesale contracts.
products.reference: TM Forum SID PeeringAgreement / IETF RFC 7908

attributes.name: peering_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the peering arrangement record in the interconnect domain. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT.

attributes.name: location_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.location_site. Business justification: Peering arrangements occur at physical exchange points (IXPs, data centers). Site link required for facility access coordination, port provisioning, cross-connect management, and physical capacity pla

attributes.name: peer_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: Peering arrangement peer is currently denormalized via peer_carrier_name. Normalizing to interconnect_carrier provides authoritative carrier master reference with full carrier attributes (TADIG, MCC/M

attributes.name: technical_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: Peering arrangements require technical ownership by network engineers responsible for BGP configuration, capacity planning, and SLA monitoring—distinct from commercial ownership. This supports NOC esc

attributes.name: arrangement_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the peering arrangement (e.g., PEER-2024-NYC-001). Used in operational communications, NOC dashboards, and inter-carrier correspondence.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: arrangement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name for the peering arrangement (e.g., 'Equinix NY4 Private Peering with AS64512'). Used in reporting and NOC tooling.

attributes.name: arrangement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes capturing special conditions, negotiation history, technical exceptions, or contextual information about this peering arrangement not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: arrangement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the peering arrangement. draft = under negotiation; pending_approval = awaiting internal or regulatory sign-off; active = live and carrying traffic; suspended = temporarily halted; terminated = permanently ended; expired = passed effective end date without renewal.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this peering arrangement automatically renews upon expiry without requiring explicit renegotiation. True = auto-renews; False = requires manual renewal action before expiry_date.

attributes.name: availability_target_pct
attributes.description: Agreed minimum uptime percentage for the peering session as specified in the SLA (e.g., 99.9900 = 99.99%). Used for SLA compliance reporting and penalty calculation.
attributes.references: ITU-T Y.1541; TM Forum SID GB922; ETSI

attributes.name: bgp_session_type
attributes.description: Type of BGP session established for this peering arrangement. ebgp = External BGP (standard inter-AS peering); ibgp = Internal BGP (used in route-reflector scenarios); ebgp_multihop = eBGP session across multiple IP hops.

attributes.name: committed_bandwidth_mbps
attributes.description: Minimum guaranteed bandwidth in megabits per second (Mbps) committed under this peering arrangement. Used for capacity planning, SLA enforcement, and billing in paid peering scenarios.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34; ITU-T Y.1541

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this peering arrangement record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field supporting data governance and lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the peering arrangement becomes operationally binding and traffic exchange may commence. Aligns with BGP session activation date.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the peering arrangement is scheduled to expire. Null for open-ended arrangements. Used for renewal alerting and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: ip_version
attributes.description: IP protocol version(s) supported by this peering session. ipv4 = IPv4 only; ipv6 = IPv6 only; dual_stack = both IPv4 and IPv6 sessions active. Drives network engineering and capacity planning.

attributes.name: ixp_name
attributes.description: Name of the Internet Exchange Point (IXP) where public peering occurs (e.g., Equinix IX, DE-CIX, AMS-IX, LINX). Null for private PNI arrangements. Used for peering point inventory and cost allocation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.34; Euro-IX; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this peering arrangement was last formally reviewed by network operations or commercial teams for traffic balance, SLA compliance, and commercial terms adequacy.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: latency_target_ms
attributes.description: Maximum agreed one-way network latency in milliseconds (ms) for traffic traversing this peering arrangement as defined in the SLA. Used for QoS monitoring and SLA breach detection.
attributes.references: ITU-T Y.1541; ETSI EN 319 401; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: max_bandwidth_mbps
attributes.description: Maximum allowable bandwidth in megabits per second (Mbps) for this peering arrangement before traffic shaping or penalties apply. Defines the upper capacity envelope for the interconnect port.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T Y.1541

attributes.name: md5_auth_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether MD5 TCP authentication is enabled on the BGP session for this peering arrangement to prevent session hijacking. True = MD5 authentication active; False = no MD5 authentication.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this peering arrangement. Used to drive review workflow scheduling in NOC and commercial operations.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: noc_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the peer carrier's Network Operations Center (NOC) for operational escalations, fault notifications, and maintenance coordination. Classified confidential as organizational contact data.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: noc_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the peer carrier's Network Operations Center (NOC) for 24/7 operational escalations and incident coordination. Classified confidential as organizational contact data.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: our_asn
attributes.description: BGP Autonomous System Number (ASN) of this carrier's routing domain used in this peering session. Required when the carrier operates multiple ASNs across different network segments.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 4271; IETF RFC 6793; ARIN; RIPE NCC

attributes.name: our_bgp_ip_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: Our Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) IP Address
attributes.description: IP address of this carrier's BGP router used to establish the peering session with the counterparty. May be IPv4 or IPv6. Classified confidential as it reveals internal network topology.

attributes.name: packet_loss_target_pct
attributes.description: Maximum agreed packet loss percentage for traffic on this peering arrangement as defined in the SLA (e.g., 0.0100 = 0.01%). Used for QoS (Quality of Service) performance monitoring.
attributes.references: ITU-T Y.1541; ETSI EN 319 401; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: peer_asn
attributes.description: BGP Autonomous System Number (ASN) of the peering counterparty as assigned by a Regional Internet Registry (ARIN, RIPE, APNIC). Uniquely identifies the peer's routing domain. Range: 1–4294967295 (32-bit ASN per RFC 6793).
attributes.references: IETF RFC 4271; IETF RFC 6793; ARIN; RIPE NCC

attributes.name: peer_bgp_ip_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: Peer Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) IP Address
attributes.description: IP address of the counterparty's BGP router used to establish the peering session. May be IPv4 or IPv6. Classified confidential as it reveals network topology details.

attributes.name: peering_type
attributes.description: Classification of the peering arrangement by commercial and technical model. public_ixp = peering via a public Internet Exchange Point; private_pni = Private Network Interconnect (dedicated cross-connect); settlement_free = no financial settlement between parties; paid = one or both parties pay for traffic exchange; partial = selective prefix exchange rather than full table.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.34; IETF RFC 7948; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: port_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical or logical interconnect port used for this peering arrangement (e.g., switch/port designation from the IXP or PNI cross-connect). Links to network inventory management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: port_speed_gbps
attributes.description: Physical port speed in gigabits per second (Gbps) of the interconnect port used for this peering arrangement (e.g., 1.000, 10.000, 100.000). Used for capacity planning and utilization reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 802.3; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T G.709

attributes.name: prefix_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of BGP route prefixes this carrier will accept from the peer. Exceeding this limit triggers a BGP session reset or route filtering. Critical for route table stability and security.

attributes.name: ratio_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Allowable percentage deviation from the agreed traffic ratio before the arrangement is considered out of balance and subject to review or financial settlement. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 20.00 = ±20%).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.34; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before expiry_date that a renewal notice must be issued to the peer carrier. Used to trigger automated renewal workflow alerts in the NOC and commercial teams.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: rpki_validation_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) Validation Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) route origin validation is enforced on BGP announcements received from this peer. True = RPKI validation active; False = not enforced. Supports FCC routing security mandates.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 6811; FCC BGP Security; NIST SP 800-189

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code used for financial settlement in paid peering arrangements (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for settlement-free arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: settlement_rate
attributes.description: Agreed per-unit financial rate applied to traffic exchange in paid peering arrangements (e.g., rate per Mbps or per GB). Expressed in the settlement_currency. Business-confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34; ISO 4217

attributes.name: settlement_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the settlement rate (e.g., per_mbps = per megabit per second of committed bandwidth; per_gb = per gigabyte of traffic; flat_monthly = fixed monthly fee regardless of volume).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: sla_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this peering arrangement to the applicable Service Level Agreement (SLA) document governing latency, packet loss, availability, and jitter commitments. Used for SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T Y.1541; ETSI EN 319 401

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating operational system record for this peering arrangement (e.g., Netcracker OSS/BSS resource inventory record ID or Nokia NetAct configuration management object ID). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Suite

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of calendar days' written notice required to terminate this peering arrangement. Contractual obligation that governs decommissioning timelines.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34

attributes.name: traffic_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether traffic flows in both directions (bilateral), only from this carrier to the peer (unilateral), or whether the peer provides transit routing (transit). Drives settlement and capacity planning.
attributes.references: IETF RFC 7948; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: traffic_ratio_inbound
attributes.description: Agreed inbound traffic ratio component used to calculate the traffic balance ratio (e.g., 1.0 in a 1:1 ratio). Settlement-free peering typically requires ratios within a defined tolerance band (e.g., 1:2 or 2:1).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.34; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: traffic_ratio_outbound
attributes.description: Agreed outbound traffic ratio component used to calculate the traffic balance ratio (e.g., 2.0 in a 1:2 ratio). Imbalance beyond the agreed threshold may trigger renegotiation or conversion to paid peering.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.34; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this peering arrangement record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922; GDPR Article 5

products.name: settlement_invoice
products.description: Financial settlement invoice raised between Telecommunication and an interconnect carrier for a billing period, covering roaming (TAP), transit, termination, and origination charges. Captures invoice number, billing period, carrier reference, invoice type (payable/receivable), gross amount, disputed amount, net payable, currency, due date, and payment status. SSOT for inter-carrier financial settlement documents.
products.reference: GSMA PRD BA.08 / TM Forum SID SettlementInvoice

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the inter-carrier settlement invoice record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the settlement_invoice data product.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Invoice Entity

attributes.name: administrative_region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.administrative_region. Business justification: Settlement invoices require jurisdiction-specific tax treatment, regulatory reporting, and revenue recognition rules. Has carrier_country_code but tax compliance, statutory reporting, and audit trails

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral roaming or interconnect agreement under which this settlement invoice is raised. Governs applicable Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rates and settlement terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922 — Agreement

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the interconnect carrier (domestic or international) that is the counterparty to this settlement invoice. Links to the carrier/partner master record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Party Role; GSMA TAP3 Carrier Reference

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Wholesale billing where settlement invoices are issued to enterprise customers operating as MVNOs or resellers. Business need: linking interconnect settlement to enterprise billing accounts for paymen

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Settlement invoices post to specific GL accounts (interconnect revenue/expense accounts). Monthly financial close, P&L reporting, and audit trails require this link. Already has gl_account_code which

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Interconnect settlement invoices may be issued to/from partners (MVNOs, wholesale customers) in addition to carriers. Business process: Partner billing reconciliation, revenue share settlement, consol

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Settlement invoices are generated by batch billing pipelines. This link provides audit trail for invoice generation, supports dispute resolution by identifying which pipeline run produced disputed inv

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: Settlement invoices in carrier billing operations require preparation by finance analysts who validate TAP/NRTRDE records, calculate amounts, and reconcile with agreements. This tracks accountability

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.tap_file. Business justification: Settlement invoice currently references TAP file via string tap_file_reference. Normalizing to tap_file enables proper traceability from invoice back to source CDR batch, supporting dispute resolution

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or employee identifier of the person who formally approved this settlement invoice for payment or issuance. Required for financial controls, audit trail, and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 — Internal Controls; ISO/IEC 27001 — Access Control; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the settlement invoice was formally approved. Provides an audit trail for the approval workflow and supports financial controls compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO/IEC 27001; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the billing period covered by this settlement invoice. Defines the upper boundary of traffic and charges included. Must be greater than or equal to billing_period_start_date.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — BillingPeriod; TM Forum SID GB922 — TimePeriod

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the billing period covered by this settlement invoice. Together with billing_period_end_date, defines the window of traffic and charges included. Aligns with the TAP file billing cycle or contractual settlement period.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — BillingPeriod; TM Forum SID GB922 — TimePeriod

attributes.name: carrier_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the counterparty carrier's home country. Used for geographic segmentation of inter-carrier settlement volumes, regulatory reporting, and IOT tariff zone determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: carrier_reference_number
attributes.description: The invoice or settlement reference number assigned by the counterparty carrier. Used for cross-referencing and reconciliation between Telecommunication's internal invoice number and the carrier's own settlement document identifier.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Carrier Invoice Reference; TM Forum SID GB922 — ExternalIdentifier

attributes.name: carrier_tadig_code
attributes.description: The GSMA TADIG (Transferred Account Data Interchange Group) five-character code uniquely identifying the counterparty carrier's network. Used in TAP file processing, NRTRDE exchange, and inter-operator settlement identification.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code to which the settlement invoice charges are allocated. Used for internal financial reporting, OPEX/CAPEX tracking, and interconnect cost management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance — Cost Center; TM Forum SID GB922 — FinancialAccount

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this settlement invoice record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.creationDate; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this invoice are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Determined by the bilateral roaming or interconnect agreement. Critical for multi-currency settlement reconciliation and FX conversion.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GSMA PRD BA.08 — Settlement Currency; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason for disputing this invoice. Common reasons include tariff misapplication, CDR count discrepancy, TAP file rejection, duplicate billing, or IOT rate disagreement. Populated when dispute_reference is set.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Dispute Reason Codes; TM Forum SID GB922 — Dispute.reason

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: The formal dispute case reference number raised against this invoice, if applicable. Populated when invoice_status is 'disputed'. Links to the dispute management workflow in ServiceNow ITSM or the carrier dispute management system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Dispute.disputeNumber; GSMA PRD BA.08 Dispute Resolution; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the gross amount that is currently under formal dispute by either party. Populated when invoice_status is 'disputed'. Net payable is calculated excluding this amount until dispute resolution. Tracked for financial reporting and carrier dispute management.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.disputedAmount; GSMA PRD BA.08 Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which payment must be received or remitted. Calculated from invoice_date plus the payment terms defined in the roaming or interconnect agreement. Used for overdue tracking and dunning escalation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Settlement Payment Terms; TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paymentDueDate

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the invoice currency to Telecommunication's functional/reporting currency (e.g., USD to local currency) at the time of invoice generation or settlement. Required for multi-currency financial reporting and revenue assurance reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD BA.08 — FX Conversion; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Currency Translation

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net_payable_amount converted to Telecommunication's functional currency using the exchange_rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting, EBITDA calculation, and revenue assurance analytics.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Currency Translation; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for Telecommunication's functional/reporting currency into which the invoice amounts are converted using exchange_rate. Enables consolidated financial reporting across multi-currency carrier settlements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount of all charges included in this settlement invoice before any disputes, credits, or adjustments are applied. Expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the sum of all traffic charges, IOT-rated usage, and applicable surcharges.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.amount; GSMA PRD BA.08 IOT Settlement; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the settlement invoice was formally issued and transmitted to the counterparty carrier. This is the principal business event date for the invoice lifecycle and triggers the payment due date calculation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.invoiceDate; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoicing Module

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable invoice reference number assigned by Amdocs Revenue Management at invoice generation. Used in all carrier-to-carrier correspondence, dispute resolution, and financial reconciliation. Conforms to the operator's invoice numbering scheme.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.invoiceNumber; Amdocs Revenue Management Invoice Module

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement invoice within the inter-carrier settlement workflow. Transitions from 'draft' through 'issued', 'acknowledged', optionally 'disputed', to 'settled' or 'cancelled'. 'overdue' is set when payment due date has passed without settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|acknowledged|disputed|settled|cancelled|overdue — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.status; GSMA PRD BA.08 Settlement Procedures

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classifies the direction and nature of the settlement invoice. 'payable' indicates Telecommunication owes the carrier; 'receivable' indicates the carrier owes Telecommunication; 'credit_note' and 'debit_note' represent adjustments to prior invoices; 'adjustment' covers miscellaneous corrections.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.invoiceType; GSMA TAP3 IOT Settlement

attributes.name: iot_tariff_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) table applied when rating the traffic charges on this invoice. Ensures auditability of the tariff applied and supports dispute resolution when tariff versions change mid-period.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 IOT; ITU-T D.150 — Accounting Rate; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: The net amount due for payment after subtracting disputed_amount and applying any approved credits or adjustments from the gross_amount plus tax_amount. This is the actionable settlement figure used for payment processing and financial ledger posting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.netAmount; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections Module; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: netting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is subject to bilateral netting against a corresponding payable or receivable invoice with the same carrier for the same billing period. When True, the net_payable_amount reflects the netted position. Supports cash flow optimization in carrier settlement.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Bilateral Netting; TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: netting_invoice_reference
attributes.description: The invoice_number of the offsetting invoice used in bilateral netting. Populated only when netting_flag is True. Enables traceability of the netting pair for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Bilateral Netting; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Netting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, comments, or annotations related to this settlement invoice. Used by the interconnect settlement team to record special handling instructions, dispute context, or carrier communication summaries.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Note; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: nrtrde_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the NRTRDE data exchange associated with this invoice. NRTRDE provides near-real-time roaming CDR data used for fraud detection and early settlement validation prior to TAP file processing. Null for non-roaming invoices.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.32 NRTRDE; GSMA PRD BA.08

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: The total amount actually received or remitted against this settlement invoice to date. Used to calculate outstanding balance and confirm full or partial settlement. Updated upon payment confirmation from the treasury or accounts payable/receivable system.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paidAmount; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections; SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which full or final payment was received or remitted for this settlement invoice. Null until payment is confirmed. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation and settlement cycle analytics.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paymentDate; SAP S/4HANA Finance — Accounts Payable/Receivable

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used to settle this invoice. 'wire_transfer' and 'swift' are standard for international carrier settlements; 'netting' applies when bilateral payable and receivable invoices are offset; 'cheque' and 'direct_debit' for domestic arrangements.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD BA.08 — Settlement Payment Method; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SWIFT gpi Standards

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the settlement invoice. 'unpaid' indicates no payment received; 'partial' indicates partial payment; 'paid' indicates full settlement; 'overpaid' indicates excess payment requiring refund; 'written_off' indicates the amount has been written off after failed collection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.paymentStatus; Amdocs Revenue Management Collections; SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this settlement invoice record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking. Primary source is Amdocs Revenue Management; SAP S/4HANA for financial postings.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — DataSource; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applicable to this settlement invoice, including withholding tax, VAT, or other applicable levies as per the bilateral agreement and jurisdictional requirements. May be zero for tax-exempt inter-operator settlements.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice.taxAmount; ITU-T D.150; OECD BEPS Framework

attributes.name: total_cdr_count
attributes.description: The total number of Call Detail Records (CDRs) included in this settlement invoice. Used for volume reconciliation against TAP files and NRTRDE data. Discrepancies between CDR counts and billed amounts are a primary trigger for disputes.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — RecordCount; GSMA PRD TD.32 NRTRDE; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: total_data_volume_mb
attributes.description: Total data volume in megabytes (MB) covered by this settlement invoice. Used for data roaming and interconnect data charge reconciliation. Applicable to roaming TAP, interconnect_data, and wholesale invoice types.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — DataVolume; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolume

attributes.name: total_sms_count
attributes.description: Total number of SMS messages included in this settlement invoice. Used for SMS interconnect charge reconciliation and IOT tariff validation. Applicable to roaming TAP and SMS termination/origination invoice types.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — SMS Records; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: total_usage_minutes
attributes.description: Aggregate voice usage duration in minutes covered by this settlement invoice. Used for traffic volume analysis, IOT tariff validation, and inter-carrier settlement reconciliation. Applicable primarily to voice termination, origination, and roaming invoices.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3 — Duration; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageVolume

attributes.name: traffic_type
attributes.description: Categorises the type of inter-carrier traffic covered by this invoice. 'roaming_tap' covers outbound/inbound roaming settled via Transferred Account Procedure (TAP); 'transit' covers traffic transiting through Telecommunication's network; 'termination' and 'origination' cover voice/SMS termination and origination charges; 'interconnect_data' covers data interconnect; 'wholesale' covers wholesale capacity arrangements.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 TAP3; ITU-T Q.1741; TM Forum SID GB922 — UsageType

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this settlement invoice record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Entity.lastUpdate; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

products.name: settlement_invoice_line
products.description: Line-item detail of a settlement invoice, breaking down charges by service type, traffic category, or TAP file reference. Captures line sequence, service category (voice termination, SMS, data roaming, transit), traffic volume, unit rate, gross charge, discount applied, tax amount, and net charge. Enables granular reconciliation of inter-carrier settlement invoices.
products.reference: TM Forum SID SettlementInvoiceLine

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each settlement invoice line item within the interconnect domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Invoice Line

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral or multilateral roaming agreement under which this settlement line item is charged. Links to the governing inter-operator agreement.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922 — Agreement

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Individual invoice lines post to different GL accounts based on service type and traffic direction. Revenue recognition by service category and financial reporting require this link. Replaces denormal

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) rate table entry applied to this settlement line item for pricing voice, SMS, or data roaming traffic.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Invoice line items are created by rating/billing pipelines. This link enables detailed lineage for revenue assurance, supports root cause analysis when line-level disputes occur, and tracks which pipe

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent settlement invoice header to which this line item belongs. Establishes the header/detail relationship for inter-carrier settlement invoices.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Settlement Invoice; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the TAP file from which this settlement line item was derived. Enables traceability from invoice line back to the originating TAP3 data exchange file.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary adjustment applied to this settlement line item following dispute resolution or TAP file error correction. Positive values increase the charge; negative values reduce it.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Adjustment Amount; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for any adjustment applied to this settlement line item (e.g., TAP file error correction, rate dispute resolution, volume reconciliation difference). Populated when line_status is 'adjusted'.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — Error Code; TM Forum SID GB922 — Adjustment

attributes.name: call_event_count
attributes.description: Number of individual Call Detail Records (CDRs) or usage events aggregated into this settlement line item. Used for reconciliation against TAP file record counts.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — CDR Count; 3GPP TS 32.297

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center code to which this settlement line item is allocated for internal financial reporting and OPEX tracking of interconnect and wholesale costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Cost Center Accounting; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this settlement invoice line record was first created in the system (Amdocs Revenue Management). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Audit Trail; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination country for this settlement line item. Used for transit traffic routing analysis and regulatory reporting to FCC/Ofcom/BEREC.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; ITU-T E.164; FCC International Settlement Rules

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary discount applied to this settlement line item per the terms of the roaming or wholesale agreement (e.g., volume discount, bilateral discount, promotional rate reduction).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Discount; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage rate of the discount applied to the gross charge for this settlement line item, as stipulated in the inter-operator agreement or IOT tariff schedule.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Discount; GSMA PRD AA.13

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any active or resolved dispute raised against this settlement line item. Populated when line_status is 'disputed' or 'adjusted'. Links to the dispute management process.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Dispute; GSMA PRD BA.12 — Dispute Resolution

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the rate_currency_code to the settlement_currency_code for this line item. Sourced from the agreed exchange rate mechanism in the roaming agreement.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff; ISO 4217; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: gross_charge_amount
attributes.description: The total gross charge for this settlement line item before any discounts, adjustments, or taxes are applied. Calculated as traffic_volume multiplied by unit_rate.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line Amount; GSMA PRD BA.12; IFRS 15

attributes.name: home_network_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Network Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Code
attributes.description: The PLMN code (MCC+MNC) of the home network operator for roaming traffic on this settlement line. Used to identify the subscriber's home network in TAP3 and NRTRDE processing.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212 — PLMN Identification; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this settlement invoice line record. Tracks adjustments, dispute resolutions, and status changes for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Audit Trail; ISO/IEC 27001 — Audit Logging

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of this settlement invoice line item, providing additional context about the service, traffic type, or special billing arrangement for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line Description

attributes.name: line_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference code for this settlement invoice line, used in dispute correspondence and reconciliation with the counterpart carrier.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD BA.12 — Settlement

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this line item within the parent settlement invoice. Used for display ordering and reconciliation referencing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this settlement invoice line item. Tracks progression from draft through issuance, acceptance, dispute resolution, adjustment, and final settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|issued|accepted|disputed|adjusted|settled|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line State; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: net_charge_amount
attributes.description: The final net charge for this settlement line item after applying discounts and taxes. Represents the actual amount payable/receivable for this line in the inter-carrier settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line Net Amount; GSMA PRD BA.12; IFRS 15

attributes.name: nrtrde_file_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) File Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the NRTRDE file associated with this settlement line, enabling near-real-time roaming fraud detection cross-referencing and reconciliation against TAP-settled charges.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 — NRTRDE; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

attributes.name: originating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the originating country for this settlement line item. Used for inbound roaming analysis and bilateral traffic balance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 — Country Codes; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: partner_operator_code
attributes.description: GSMA TADIG (Transferred Account Data Interchange Group) code identifying the partner/counterpart operator for this settlement line. Used for carrier identification in TAP file processing and IOT settlement.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: partner_operator_name
attributes.description: Full legal or trading name of the partner operator (carrier, MVNO, or transit provider) associated with this settlement line item.
attributes.references: GSMA TADIG Code Registry; TM Forum SID GB922 — Party

attributes.name: rap_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Return Account Procedure (RAP) file if this settlement line was returned or rejected during TAP processing. Enables tracking of rejected CDRs and their financial impact.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — RAP; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: rate_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit_rate. May differ from the settlement_currency_code when rate tables are maintained in SDR (Special Drawing Rights) or a reference currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff

attributes.name: revenue_assurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this settlement line item has been flagged by the revenue assurance process for further investigation (e.g., volume anomaly, rate mismatch, missing TAP records).
attributes.references: TM Forum GB941 — Revenue Assurance; TM Forum eTOM — Revenue Assurance Management

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the telecommunications service type for this settlement line item. Drives IOT tariff selection and financial reporting by service type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice_termination|sms|data_roaming|transit|mms|supplementary_service|iptv|voip|content — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — Service Category; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: service_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the billing period or traffic window covered by this settlement invoice line item. Together with service_period_start, defines the chargeable period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: service_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the billing period or traffic window covered by this settlement invoice line item. Defines the temporal scope for traffic volume and charge calculation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Invoice Line; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the settlement amounts (gross, discount, tax, net) are expressed for this line item. Typically agreed in the bilateral roaming agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GSMA PRD BA.12; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: tap_sequence_number
attributes.description: The TAP file sequence number assigned by the sending operator, used to uniquely identify the TAP batch within the GSMA data exchange framework and to detect missing or duplicate TAP files.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — File Sequence Number; GSMA PRD BA.12

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to this settlement line item, including withholding tax, VAT, or other applicable levies as required by the jurisdictions of the settling parties.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Tax; IFRS 15; ITU-T D.150 — Accounting Rates

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code identifying the type of tax applied (e.g., VAT, withholding tax, GST) as configured in the billing system (Amdocs Revenue Management) for inter-carrier settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Tax; SAP S/4HANA Tax Code; IFRS 15

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate (as a percentage) used to calculate the tax_amount for this settlement line item. Determined by the tax jurisdiction and service type.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922 — Tax Rate; IFRS 15; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: traffic_category
attributes.description: Classification of the traffic flow direction and type for this settlement line. Distinguishes inbound roaming (MVNO/visited network charges), outbound roaming, transit traffic, and wholesale termination for revenue assurance and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum eTOM — Interconnect Management; FCC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: traffic_volume
attributes.description: Total quantity of traffic units (calls, messages, data bytes, or events) included in this settlement line item. The unit of measure is defined by traffic_volume_unit.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57 — Call Event Detail; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: traffic_volume_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the traffic_volume field. Varies by service category: seconds/minutes for voice, messages for SMS/MMS, kilobytes/megabytes/gigabytes for data roaming. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seconds|minutes|messages|kilobytes|megabytes|gigabytes|events — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 TD.57; ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 32.297

attributes.name: unit_rate
attributes.description: The IOT or wholesale rate applied per unit of traffic volume for this settlement line item. Expressed in the settlement currency. Commercially sensitive inter-carrier pricing.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD AA.13 — IOT Tariff; TM Forum SID GB922 — Price

attributes.name: visited_network_plmn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Visited Network Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) Code
attributes.description: The PLMN code (MCC+MNC) of the visited network where the roaming service was consumed. Used in TAP3 reconciliation and IOT tariff application for inbound/outbound roaming settlement.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212 — PLMN Identification; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA TAP3 TD.57

products.name: settlement_dispute
products.description: Record of a formal dispute raised against a settlement invoice or TAP file charge between Telecommunication and a carrier. Captures dispute reference, disputed invoice or TAP file, dispute type (rate error, volume discrepancy, duplicate record, missing record), disputed amount, supporting evidence reference, dispute status (open, under review, resolved, escalated), resolution amount, and resolution date.
products.reference: GSMA PRD BA.08 Dispute Management / TM Forum SID Dispute

attributes.name: settlement_dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the settlement dispute record in the interconnect domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: assigned_analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: Interconnect disputes are manually investigated by revenue assurance analysts who validate TAP records, compare against IOT tariffs, and negotiate with carrier partners. Tracking the assigned analyst

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral roaming or interconnect agreement under which the disputed settlement invoice or TAP file was generated.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the domestic or international carrier (counterparty) against whom the dispute is raised. Aligns with the PARTY_REFERENCE canonical category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP/NRTRDE

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Disputes are managed by specific operational teams (interconnect operations, revenue assurance). Cost allocation, resource planning, and operational efficiency tracking require knowing which cost cent

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IOT tariff table entry that Telecommunication believes should have been applied to the disputed charges. Central to rate_error and iot_mismatch dispute types.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; GSMA IOT Specification

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Interconnect settlement disputes may involve partners (MVNOs, wholesale customers) not just carriers. Business process: Partner dispute resolution workflow, escalation management, consolidated partner

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Dispute records are created/updated via dispute management pipelines. This link supports audit trail for dispute lifecycle tracking, enables data quality monitoring of dispute processing, and tracks w

attributes.name: rap_file_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.rap_file. Business justification: Settlement dispute may originate from RAP file rejections. Adding FK to rap_file enables proper traceability from dispute back to rejection event, supporting dispute resolution workflow. The FK will b

attributes.name: regulatory_penalty_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_penalty. Business justification: Settlement disputes that escalate or involve regulatory violations may result in penalties (late settlement, fraudulent billing). Tracks penalty linkage for dispute escalation management and financial

attributes.name: settlement_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inter-operator settlement invoice that is the subject of this dispute. Null when the dispute is raised directly against a TAP file rather than a consolidated invoice.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: tap_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific TAP file whose charges are disputed. Null when the dispute is raised at the consolidated invoice level rather than at the individual TAP file level.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: trouble_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to assurance.trouble_ticket. Business justification: Settlement disputes requiring technical investigation (TAP file discrepancies, rating errors, network issues) generate trouble tickets. Critical for dispute resolution workflow linking commercial and

attributes.name: accepted_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the original invoice or TAP file charge that Telecommunication accepts as valid and agrees to pay. The difference between the invoiced amount and the disputed amount. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category (adjustment component).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: carrier_response_date
attributes.description: Date on which the counterparty carrier formally responded to the dispute notification. Used to measure SLA compliance and track negotiation progress.

attributes.name: carrier_response_notes
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the carrier's formal response to the dispute, including their position, counter-evidence references, and proposed resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: credit_note_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit note issued by the carrier as part of the dispute resolution. Populated when resolution_type is credit_note or partial_credit.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: dispute_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the dispute: financial (monetary discrepancy), technical (CDR or TAP file format/content issue), or contractual (disagreement on agreement terms or IOT applicability).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: dispute_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature of the dispute, the specific charges contested, and the business justification for the claim. Authored by the settlement analyst at the time of dispute creation.

attributes.name: dispute_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether Telecommunication is the disputing party (outbound — Telecommunication raises dispute against carrier) or the receiving party (inbound — carrier raises dispute against Telecommunication).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this dispute at the time of creation. Used in all carrier-to-carrier correspondence and regulatory filings. Format: DSP-YYYY-NNNNNN. Aligns with BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER canonical category.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the settlement dispute. Drives workflow routing in the BSS settlement module. Aligns with LIFECYCLE_STATUS canonical category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_review|escalated|resolved|withdrawn|closed — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM Process Framework; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the root cause of the dispute. Rate error indicates an incorrect Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) was applied; volume_discrepancy indicates a mismatch in CDR counts; duplicate_record indicates a charge appears more than once in the TAP file; missing_record indicates expected CDRs are absent; currency_conversion indicates an FX rate dispute; iot_mismatch indicates the applied IOT does not match the agreed tariff table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_error|volume_discrepancy|duplicate_record|missing_record|currency_conversion|iot_mismatch — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount being disputed by Telecommunication, expressed in the settlement currency. Represents the full value of the contested charges before any agreed adjustments. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: disputed_amount_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the disputed amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency inter-operator settlement environments. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.

attributes.name: disputed_cdr_count
attributes.description: Number of individual Call Detail Records (CDRs) included in the dispute. Relevant for volume_discrepancy, duplicate_record, and missing_record dispute types.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dispute was escalated to senior management or a formal inter-carrier arbitration body. Null if the dispute has not been escalated.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for escalation, such as failure to respond within SLA, disagreement on IOT applicability, or significant financial exposure.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: evidence_reference
attributes.description: Document management or object storage reference (e.g., S3 path, ServiceNow attachment ID) pointing to supporting evidence submitted with the dispute, such as CDR extracts, TAP file dumps, or IOT tariff documentation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ServiceNow ITSM

attributes.name: interconnect_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interconnect arrangement under which the disputed charges arose: bilateral roaming, transit traffic, peering, wholesale voice, or wholesale data. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bilateral_roaming|transit|peering|wholesale_voice|wholesale_data — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Total amount as stated on the original settlement invoice or TAP file that is the subject of this dispute. Provides the baseline for calculating the disputed and accepted portions.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: is_sla_breached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has failed to respond or resolve the dispute within the contractually agreed SLA timeframe. True when current date exceeds sla_resolution_due_date and dispute_status is not resolved or closed.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the dispute record, including status transitions, amount updates, or evidence additions. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED canonical category.

attributes.name: nrtrde_file_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) File Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the NRTRDE file associated with the disputed roaming charges. Enables near-real-time reconciliation of roaming CDRs against TAP file charges as per GSMA NRTRDE specification.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the dispute based on financial exposure and SLA urgency. Drives workflow queue ordering in the BSS settlement module.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: raised_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the formal dispute was raised by Telecommunication against the carrier. Aligns with BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP canonical category (date-precision sufficient for settlement SLA tracking).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: raised_timestamp
