attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the dispute record was first created in the BSS settlement system. Provides sub-day precision for SLA measurement and audit trail. Aligns with RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any regulatory filing or complaint submitted to a governing body (e.g., FCC, Ofcom, BEREC) in connection with this dispute. Null if no regulatory filing has been made.

attributes.name: resolution_amount
attributes.description: Final agreed monetary amount to be credited, refunded, or adjusted as the outcome of the dispute resolution. Populated only when dispute_status is resolved or closed. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category (net total).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dispute was formally resolved and agreed between Telecommunication and the carrier. Null while dispute_status is open, under_review, or escalated.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the agreed resolution outcome, including the rationale for the resolution amount and any corrective actions agreed between the carriers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the dispute was resolved: credit_note (carrier issues a credit), partial_credit (partial adjustment agreed), full_acceptance (Telecommunication accepts the original charge), withdrawal (dispute withdrawn by Telecommunication), arbitration_award (resolved via formal arbitration).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: settlement_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing or settlement period covered by the disputed invoice or TAP file.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: settlement_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing or settlement period covered by the disputed invoice or TAP file. Used to correlate disputes with specific traffic periods and IOT tariff versions.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD IR.82

attributes.name: sla_resolution_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Due Date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the dispute must be fully resolved as defined in the inter-operator agreement SLA terms. Used for SLA breach monitoring and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: sla_response_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Due Date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the carrier must respond to the dispute as defined in the roaming or interconnect agreement SLA terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.82; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this dispute record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: source_system_dispute_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this dispute record in the originating operational system (e.g., Amdocs case number, Netcracker dispute ID). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.

attributes.name: tap_sequence_number
attributes.description: TAP file sequence number as defined in the GSMA TAP3 specification, identifying the specific TAP batch within the carrier exchange. Used to trace disputed charges back to the originating TAP file.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: traffic_type
attributes.description: Type of telecommunications traffic associated with the disputed charges. Determines which IOT tariff schedule and settlement rules apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voice|data|sms|mms|roaming|transit|wholesale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification; 3GPP TS 32.297; TM Forum SID GB922

products.name: rate
products.description: Wholesale interconnect termination and origination rate schedule defining per-minute or per-event charges for domestic and international voice, SMS, and data traffic exchanged at interconnect points. Captures rate type (termination, origination, transit), destination prefix/number range, peak/off-peak/weekend rate tiers, effective/expiry dates, currency, regulatory reference (FCC access charges, Ofcom FAMR, EU Roam-Like-At-Home caps), and rate status. Distinct from IOT tariffs which cover roaming wholesale rates — this product covers domestic interconnect and international termination rates governed by regulatory frameworks.
products.reference: FCC Access Charge / Ofcom MTAS / ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each interconnect rate record in the wholesale rate schedule. Primary key for the interconnect_rate data product.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral carrier agreement or roaming agreement under which this rate applies. Links the rate to its governing commercial contract.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: network_qos_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.qos_profile. Business justification: Interconnect rates often vary by QoS class (e.g., premium voice vs. best-effort data). Tariff design requires linking rate structures to network QoS profiles for accurate billing and service different

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: Rate table updates are loaded via ETL pipelines. This link supports audit requirements (which pipeline run loaded each rate version), enables rollback workflows when incorrect rates are loaded, and tr

attributes.name: superseded_by_rate_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer rate record that replaced this one when rate_status is 'superseded'. Enables forward navigation of the rate version chain for audit and dispute resolution purposes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the commercial or regulatory manager who approved this rate for activation. Required for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance in wholesale rate management.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum SID GB922; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this rate was formally approved for activation. Part of the rate lifecycle audit trail required for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: basis
attributes.description: Structural basis on which the rate is calculated: flat (single rate regardless of volume), tiered (rate changes at volume thresholds), volume_discount (discounted rate applied retroactively above threshold), or distance_based (rate varies by geographic distance between interconnect points). Determines the rating algorithm applied.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Engine

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this rate record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the interconnect rates are denominated and settlement is conducted (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Must align with the settlement currency defined in the governing carrier agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA TAP3 Specification; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code identifying the destination country for international termination or transit rates (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for international settlement and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; FCC International Settlement Policy

attributes.name: destination_prefix
attributes.description: E.164 dialled number prefix or number range (e.g., '+1202', '+44207') to which this rate applies. Enables prefix-based rate lookup during CDR rating and settlement. May represent a country code, area code, or specific number block.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this interconnect rate becomes effective and applicable for CDR rating and settlement calculations. Inclusive start boundary of the rate validity period.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this interconnect rate ceases to be effective (exclusive end boundary). Null indicates an open-ended rate with no scheduled expiry. Used to enforce rate versioning and prevent application of expired rates.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021

attributes.name: interconnect_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific Point of Presence (POP) or interconnect gateway at which traffic is exchanged under this rate. Rates may vary by interconnect point due to transport cost differences. Aligns with network inventory records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory; ITU-T Q.700

attributes.name: iot_tariff_class
attributes.description: IOT tariff classification code as defined by GSMA inter-operator tariff tables, applicable when this rate is used for roaming wholesale settlement. Maps to the GSMA IOT rate category (e.g., IOT-A, IOT-B, IOT-C) for NRTRDE and TAP file processing.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TAP3 Specification; GSMA NRTRDE Specification

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this rate record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: mcc
attributes.description: ITU-assigned three-digit Mobile Country Code (MCC) identifying the country of the counterparty mobile network. Used in roaming rate lookup and NRTRDE/TAP file processing to match rates to visited network operator records.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: minimum_call_duration_sec
attributes.description: Minimum billable call duration in seconds applied during rating. Calls shorter than this threshold are billed at this minimum (e.g., 30-second minimum billing). Common in wholesale voice interconnect agreements to prevent micro-call gaming.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: mnc
attributes.description: Two or three-digit Mobile Network Code (MNC) identifying the specific mobile network operator within the MCC country. Combined with MCC forms the PLMN identifier used in roaming rate resolution and TAP file matching.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: Mobile or fixed network generation standard to which this rate applies (e.g., 2G, 3G, 4G LTE, 5G NR, VoLTE, VoIP). Rates may differ by network generation due to technology-specific interconnect costs and regulatory frameworks.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for commercial or operational annotations related to this rate (e.g., special negotiation conditions, dispute history notes, regulatory waiver references). Not used in automated rating; for human reference only.

attributes.name: nrtrde_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate is subject to NRTRDE (Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange) reporting obligations. When true, CDRs rated under this rate must be transmitted to the counterparty within the NRTRDE transmission window for fraud prevention purposes.
attributes.references: GSMA NRTRDE Specification (PRD IR.21); GSMA PRD FS.11

attributes.name: off_peak_rate
attributes.description: Per-unit wholesale charge applied during off-peak hours (typically evenings and nights on weekdays). Lower than peak rate to reflect reduced network demand. Expressed in settlement currency per billing unit.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: originating_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the traffic originates. Required for international transit and termination rates to distinguish bilateral from multilateral routing scenarios and apply correct regulatory frameworks.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; FCC International Settlement Policy

attributes.name: peak_end_time
attributes.description: Local time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) at which the peak rate period ends each weekday. Defines the upper boundary of the peak window for CDR rating tier selection.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Engine Configuration

attributes.name: peak_rate
attributes.description: Per-unit wholesale charge applied during peak hours (typically business hours on weekdays). Expressed in the settlement currency per billing unit (e.g., per minute for voice, per event for SMS, per MB for data). This is the principal quantitative rate value for the resource.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021; EU Regulation 531/2012 (Roam-Like-At-Home); TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: peak_start_time
attributes.description: Local time (HH:MM, 24-hour format) at which the peak rate period begins each weekday. Used by the rating engine to determine which rate tier applies to a given CDR based on call start time.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating Engine Configuration

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this rate entry within the wholesale rate schedule. Used in TAP file references and inter-operator billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the rate entry (e.g., 'US Domestic Voice Termination Peak', 'EU Roam-Like-At-Home SMS'). Used in rate schedule documentation and commercial negotiations.

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate record: active (currently in force for rating), pending (approved but not yet effective), superseded (replaced by a newer rate version), expired (past effective period), or withdrawn (cancelled before activation). Controls whether the rate is used in CDR rating and settlement.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rate Table Lifecycle

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate by traffic direction and role: termination (delivering traffic to destination network), origination (collecting traffic from originating network), transit (passing traffic through an intermediate network), transit_international (cross-border transit), or access (local loop access charge). Governs regulatory framework applicability.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51 Access Charge Rules; Ofcom FAMR; BEREC Guidelines on Interconnection

attributes.name: regulatory_cap_rate
attributes.description: Maximum rate permitted by the applicable regulatory framework for this service type and destination (e.g., EU RLAH wholesale voice cap of €0.032/min, Ofcom FAMR charge control ceiling). The actual rate must not exceed this cap. Used for compliance validation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 531/2012 (RLAH); Ofcom FAMR 2021; FCC Part 51; BEREC BoR (22) 137

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or citation of the specific regulatory instrument governing this rate (e.g., 'FCC Part 51 Access Charges', 'Ofcom FAMR 2021 Charge Control', 'EU Regulation 531/2012 RLAH Cap', 'BEREC Roaming Guidelines'). Enables compliance traceability and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021; EU Regulation 531/2012; BEREC BoR (22) 137; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: rounding_increment_sec
attributes.description: Duration increment in seconds to which call durations are rounded up for billing purposes (e.g., 6-second or 60-second rounding). Directly impacts settlement amounts and must align with the counterparty carrier agreement terms.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Part 51

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of telecommunications service to which this rate applies: voice (per-minute voice call termination/origination), sms (short message service per-event), data (per-kilobyte or per-megabyte data transit), mms (multimedia messaging), or premium_sms (premium-rate short message service). Determines the billing unit and regulatory regime.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this rate was ingested (e.g., 'Amdocs Revenue Management', 'Netcracker OSS/BSS', 'Manual Upload'). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between source systems and the lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tap_rate_category
attributes.description: TAP file rate category code as defined in the GSMA Transferred Account Procedure (TAP3) specification. Maps this rate to the correct TAP record type for inter-operator roaming settlement file generation and validation.
attributes.references: GSMA TAP3 Specification (TD.57); GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') used to interpret peak/off-peak/weekend time boundaries for this rate. Ensures correct tier selection across geographic regions and daylight saving transitions.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: traffic_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate applies to inbound traffic (received from the counterparty carrier), outbound traffic (sent to the counterparty carrier), or bilateral (symmetric rate applicable in both directions). Critical for settlement calculation and IOT tariff alignment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA TAP3 Specification

attributes.name: unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure against which the rate is applied for billing purposes: per_minute or per_second for voice, per_event for SMS/MMS, per_mb/per_kb/per_gb for data. Determines how CDR volumes are multiplied by the rate to produce settlement charges.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 32.240; GSMA TAP3 Specification; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this rate record, incremented each time the rate is amended. Enables rate history tracking and ensures the correct version is applied to CDRs within a given effective period. Version 1 is the initial rate.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rate Versioning

attributes.name: volume_tier_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum traffic volume (in the rate_unit) at which a tiered or volume-discount rate becomes applicable. Null for flat-rate structures. Used by the rating engine to select the correct rate tier based on cumulative monthly traffic volumes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: weekend_rate
attributes.description: Per-unit wholesale charge applied during weekend periods (Saturday and Sunday). May differ from both peak and off-peak weekday rates. Expressed in settlement currency per billing unit.
attributes.references: FCC Part 51; Ofcom FAMR 2021; TM Forum SID GB922

products.name: mnp_transaction
products.description: Mobile Number Portability (MNP) transaction record capturing each port-in or port-out event for a subscriber number between Telecommunication and another operator. Captures MSISDN, donor network TADIG/carrier reference, recipient network reference, port type (port-in/port-out), request timestamp, porting window, completion timestamp, MNP status (pending, validated, completed, rejected, cancelled), rejection reason, regulatory reference number, and routing number update status. SSOT for inter-operator number portability execution within the interconnect domain.
products.reference: GSMA PRD SE.13 MNP / FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: mnp_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Mobile Number Portability (MNP) transaction record in the interconnect domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inter-operator carrier agreement governing the MNP transaction between Telecommunication and the counterparty operator.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Enterprise customers porting number blocks during office relocations or provider changes. Business need: tracking which enterprise account initiated bulk porting requests for service continuity, billi

attributes.name: donor_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: MNP transaction donor carrier is heavily denormalized with donor_tadig_code, donor_carrier_name, donor_mcc, donor_mnc. Normalizing to interconnect_carrier eliminates all redundancy and provides author

attributes.name: hlr_network_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.element. Business justification: Mobile number portability requires HLR/HSS updates to redirect routing. Operations must track which HLR/HSS network element processed each port for audit, troubleshooting, and regulatory compliance. R

attributes.name: mnp_compliance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.mnp_compliance. Business justification: Each porting transaction generates a compliance record tracking SLA adherence, authorization verification, regulatory notification. Essential for porting compliance monitoring, regulatory reporting, a

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: MNP transactions are processed via porting pipelines. This link enables SLA monitoring (porting duration tracking), supports reprocessing of failed ports, and provides audit trail for regulatory compl

attributes.name: recipient_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to partner.partner. Business justification: Number portability transactions often involve partner networks (MVNOs) as recipient operators. Business process: MNP coordination with partner operators, regulatory compliance reporting, partner opera

attributes.name: authorisation_code
attributes.description: The Port Authorisation Code (PAC) or equivalent subscriber-provided authorisation token used to validate the subscriber's consent for the port-out. Mandatory in many regulatory frameworks (e.g., Ofcom PAC regime, FCC subscriber verification). Null for port-in transactions where PAC is consumed by the gaining operator.
attributes.references: Ofcom General Conditions C8; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: batch_file_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the batch file or TAP/NRTRDE file submission in which this MNP transaction was included for inter-operator exchange or regulatory reporting. Supports reconciliation with interconnect file processing workflows.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57 (TAP3); GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the MNP request was cancelled. Populated only when port_status = 'cancelled'. Common reasons include subscriber withdrawal, duplicate request cancellation, or operator-initiated cancellation.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the number portability transfer was successfully completed and the MSISDN became active on the recipient network. Null if the port has not yet completed.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which the MNP transaction is executed. Determines the applicable regulatory framework (FCC, Ofcom, BEREC NRA, etc.) and porting timeline obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ITU-T E.164; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MNP transaction record was first created in the system of record (Oracle Communications Order and Service Management / Netcracker OSS). Audit trail field for data lineage.

attributes.name: fraud_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the fraud prevention check performed on the MNP request. 'not_checked' — fraud screening not yet performed; 'passed' — no fraud indicators detected; 'flagged' — suspicious activity detected, under review; 'blocked' — request blocked due to confirmed fraud. Supports GSMA fraud prevention guidelines.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11; GSMA PRD IR.85; ISO/IEC 27001; FCC 47 CFR Part 64

attributes.name: hlr_hss_update_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Home Location Register / Home Subscriber Server (HLR/HSS) Update Status
attributes.description: Status of the HLR (2G/3G) or HSS/UDM (4G/5G) subscriber profile update triggered by the MNP transaction. 'pending' — update not yet sent; 'completed' — subscriber profile successfully updated; 'failed' — update failed, requiring manual intervention.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; 3GPP TS 29.272; Ericsson Network Manager; Nokia NetAct

attributes.name: iccid
attributes.description: The Integrated Circuit Card Identifier of the SIM card associated with the MSISDN at the time of the porting request. Captured to support SIM swap validation and fraud prevention during the MNP process.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.118; 3GPP TS 22.042; GSMA SGP.02; ISO/IEC 7812

attributes.name: imsi
attributes.description: The International Mobile Subscriber Identity associated with the subscriber's SIM at the time of the porting request. Used for HLR/HSS deprovisioning on port-out and provisioning on port-in. Constitutes PII as it uniquely identifies a subscriber.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.212; 3GPP TS 23.003; GSMA PRD IR.21; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: inter_operator_charge_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether an inter-operator charge (IOT) is applicable for this MNP transaction under the governing carrier agreement. True = charge applies and will be raised in settlement; False = no charge applicable (e.g., regulatory zero-rating or waiver).
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D-Series Recommendations

attributes.name: msisdn
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mobile Station International Subscriber Directory Number (MSISDN)
attributes.description: The full E.164-formatted mobile phone number being ported. This is the subscriber's publicly dialable number and constitutes PII as it directly identifies an individual subscriber.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.003; GDPR Article 4; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: The radio access network generation (2G/3G/4G/5G) on which the subscriber's service is provisioned at the time of the MNP transaction. Relevant for HLR vs HSS/UDM routing update determination and network-specific porting procedures.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.011; 3GPP TS 23.116; ETSI; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: npac_order_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Number Portability Administration Centre (NPAC) Order ID
attributes.description: The order identifier assigned by the Number Portability Administration Centre (NPAC) or equivalent national clearinghouse system (e.g., Syniverse, CODA) for this porting transaction. Used for cross-system reconciliation and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85; NTIA

attributes.name: number_range_owner
attributes.description: The operator or entity that holds the ITU/national regulatory authority allocation of the number range (NXX or equivalent) containing the ported MSISDN. May differ from the donor operator in MVNO or wholesale scenarios.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom National Telephone Numbering Plan; NTIA

attributes.name: order_management_ref
attributes.description: The order reference number from Oracle Communications Order and Service Management (OSM) or Netcracker OSS/BSS that orchestrated the service fulfillment actions associated with this MNP transaction (e.g., HLR/HSS update, service deprovisioning/provisioning).
attributes.references: Oracle Communications OSM; TM Forum eTOM; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: port_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this MNP porting request by the Number Portability Administration Centre (NPAC) or equivalent national clearinghouse. Used for cross-operator tracking and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: port_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MNP transaction. 'pending' — request received and awaiting validation; 'validated' — subscriber eligibility confirmed; 'completed' — number successfully ported; 'rejected' — request denied (see rejection_reason); 'cancelled' — request withdrawn before completion.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; TM Forum SID GB922; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: port_type
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the number portability event from Telecommunication's perspective. 'port_in' means the subscriber is moving their number to Telecommunication from another operator (donor). 'port_out' means the subscriber is leaving Telecommunication to another operator (recipient).
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: porting_duration_hours
attributes.description: The elapsed time in hours between request_timestamp and completion_timestamp. Used for SLA compliance monitoring against regulatory maximum porting time mandates (e.g., FCC 1-business-day rule, Ofcom 1-working-day rule). Null if port not yet completed.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: porting_window_end
attributes.description: The scheduled end date and time of the porting window. If the port is not completed within this window, the transaction may expire or require rescheduling per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; 3GPP TS 23.116

attributes.name: porting_window_start
attributes.description: The scheduled start date and time of the porting window during which the number transfer is authorised to execute. Regulatory frameworks (e.g., FCC, Ofcom) mandate specific porting windows.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; 3GPP TS 23.116

attributes.name: recipient_carrier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the recipient (gaining) operator. Complements recipient_tadig_code for reporting and business user readability.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: recipient_tadig_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recipient Network Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
attributes.description: The GSMA TADIG code identifying the recipient (gaining) operator network to which the MSISDN is being ported. Complements donor_tadig_code to fully describe the inter-operator porting pair.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.21; GSMA TADIG Code Registry; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: regulatory_deadline
attributes.description: The latest permissible timestamp by which the MNP transaction must be completed under applicable regulatory rules (e.g., FCC 1-business-day, Ofcom 1-working-day). Used for SLA breach detection and regulatory compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; NTIA

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: The official reference number assigned by the national regulatory authority (e.g., FCC, Ofcom, BEREC member NRA) or Number Portability Administration Centre (NPAC) for this porting transaction. Required for regulatory audit and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; NTIA

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardised code indicating why the MNP request was rejected. Common codes include: MSISDN_NOT_FOUND, OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, ACTIVE_CONTRACT, INVALID_ACCOUNT_HOLDER, DUPLICATE_REQUEST, REGULATORY_HOLD. Populated only when port_status = 'rejected'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSISDN_NOT_FOUND|OUTSTANDING_BALANCE|ACTIVE_CONTRACT|INVALID_ACCOUNT_HOLDER|DUPLICATE_REQUEST|REGULATORY_HOLD|FRAUD_SUSPECTED|TECHNICAL_ERROR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: rejection_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the rejection reason, providing additional context beyond the rejection_reason_code. Populated only when port_status = 'rejected'. Used for dispute resolution and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the MNP porting request was formally submitted by the subscriber or the gaining operator. This is the principal business event timestamp marking the start of the porting lifecycle.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; FCC 47 CFR Part 52; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of times this MNP transaction has been retried following a failure or rejection. Used for operational monitoring, SLA tracking, and identifying systemic porting issues with specific operators.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: The routing number (RN) assigned to the ported MSISDN in the Number Portability database, used by all operators to correctly route calls and SMS to the ported number on the recipient network. Aligned with ITU-T E.164 routing principles.
attributes.references: ITU-T E.164; 3GPP TS 23.116; GSMA PRD IR.85; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: routing_number_update_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the routing number in the Number Portability database and HLR/HSS/UDM has been successfully updated following port completion. 'pending' — update queued; 'updated' — successfully propagated; 'failed' — update error requiring intervention; 'not_required' — no routing change needed.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.116; 3GPP TS 23.003; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscriber service type associated with the porting MSISDN. Determines applicable porting rules, timelines, and regulatory obligations. 'mvno' indicates the subscriber is on a Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) arrangement.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 22.011; TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.85; FCC 47 CFR Part 52

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount charged or credited between Telecommunication and the counterparty operator for this MNP transaction under the applicable inter-operator tariff (IOT). Expressed in the settlement currency defined in the carrier agreement. Null if inter_operator_charge_applicable = False.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T D-Series Recommendations

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the currency in which the inter-operator settlement amount for this MNP transaction is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Must align with the settlement currency in the governing carrier agreement.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA PRD IR.85; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MNP transaction exceeded the regulatory or contractual maximum porting time SLA. True = SLA breached; False = within SLA. Used for regulatory compliance reporting and inter-operator dispute management.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC MNP Guidelines; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this MNP transaction record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across BSS/OSS platforms.

attributes.name: subscriber_account_number
attributes.description: The account number of the subscriber in Telecommunication's BSS (Amdocs Revenue Management / Salesforce CRM) associated with the MSISDN being ported. Used to link the MNP event to the subscriber's billing and service records.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: subscriber_consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber's explicit consent for the number port has been verified and recorded, as required by regulatory frameworks. True = consent confirmed; False = consent not yet verified or verification failed. Critical for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 52; Ofcom General Conditions C8; GDPR Article 7; BEREC MNP Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MNP transaction record was most recently modified in the system of record. Used for change tracking, SLA monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing.

products.name: poi
products.description: Point of Interconnect (POI) master record defining the physical or logical handoff points between Telecommunication's network and a carrier's network. Captures POI ID, POI name, location (city, exchange, data center), interconnect type (TDM, IP/SIP, MPLS), connected carrier reference, trunk group reference, regulatory designation, capacity, and operational status. SSOT for interconnect topology.
products.reference: ITU-T Q.50 / TM Forum SID NetworkInterconnectPoint

attributes.name: poi_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Point of Interconnect (POI) master record. Primary key for the interconnect_poi entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capital_project. Business justification: New POIs or POI upgrades are delivered through capital projects. Project accounting, budget tracking, and capex settlement to assets require this link. Real business process: tracking which capex proj

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier interconnect or roaming agreement governing the commercial and technical terms for this POI. Links to the interconnect.carrier_agreement SSOT.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or operator whose network connects at this POI. Links to the carrier/partner master record for the interconnecting operator.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: enterprise_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.site. Business justification: Physical interconnection points located at enterprise customer sites (on-net buildings, colocation facilities). Business need: tracking which enterprise site hosts interconnect infrastructure for capa

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Points of interconnect involve capitalized infrastructure (routers, switches, transmission equipment). Asset management, depreciation calculation, and capex tracking require linking POIs to their unde

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Inter-Operator Tariff (IOT) table applicable for traffic exchanged at this POI. IOT rates govern the financial settlement between operators for roaming and interconnect traffic.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.32 (IOT); TM Forum SID GB922; Amdocs Revenue Management Rating

attributes.name: location_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.location_site. Business justification: Points of interconnection are physical facilities requiring site access management, maintenance coordination, and capacity planning. Currently references data_center_name and city as text; structured

attributes.name: mpls_tunnel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.mpls_tunnel. Business justification: Carrier interconnect traffic is often routed via MPLS tunnels for QoS and traffic engineering. Network operations must track which MPLS tunnels serve each POI for SLA enforcement, traffic steering, an

attributes.name: nms_element_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding network element in the Network Management System (NMS) — Nokia NetAct or Ericsson Network Manager — that monitors this POI. Enables correlation between the business POI record and real-time network telemetry.
attributes.references: Nokia NetAct Configuration Management; Ericsson Network Manager; TM Forum eTOM GB921

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the network engineer or technical account manager who owns and is accountable for this POI configuration. Used for escalation routing and change approval workflows.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management

attributes.name: peering_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.peering_arrangement. Business justification: Point of Interconnect (POI) represents physical/logical handoff points that may be associated with specific peering arrangements. Adding FK to peering_arrangement links infrastructure to commercial ag

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: POI configuration data is loaded via network inventory pipelines. This link supports change tracking for capacity planning, enables audit of POI configuration changes, and tracks which pipeline run up

attributes.name: redundant_poi_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the backup or redundant POI that provides failover capacity for this POI. Null if no redundant POI is designated. Used in network resilience and failover planning.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.841; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: responsible_technician_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.technician. Business justification: Telecommunications POIs require assigned technicians for maintenance, fault resolution, capacity upgrades, and emergency response. Business process: POI maintenance scheduling, SLA compliance tracking

attributes.name: sla_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Service Level Agreement (SLA) defining performance commitments (availability, latency, packet loss) for this POI. Used for SLA monitoring and breach reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T Y.1541; ETSI EN 302 217

attributes.name: spectrum_license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.spectrum_license. Business justification: Points of interconnection operate on licensed spectrum; POI must reference the license authorizing its frequency use. Required for spectrum compliance verification, license utilization tracking, and i

attributes.name: transmission_link_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.transmission_link. Business justification: Interconnect points of interconnection physically terminate on transmission links. Operations teams need to track which transmission infrastructure serves each POI for capacity planning, fault isolati

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this POI was first activated and began carrying live traffic. Used for asset age tracking, depreciation scheduling, and regulatory reporting of interconnect history.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: bandwidth_mbps
attributes.description: Total provisioned bandwidth capacity at this POI in megabits per second (Mbps). Applicable primarily for IP/SIP, MPLS, and Ethernet interconnect types. Used for traffic engineering and QoS planning.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.826; ETSI EN 302 217; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: clli_code
attributes.description: Telcordia/iconectiv Common Language Location Identifier (CLLI) code for the network element or building where this POI is located. Industry-standard 11-character code used in OSS provisioning and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: Telcordia GR-485-CORE (CLLI); FCC 47 CFR Part 51; Oracle Communications Order and Service Management

attributes.name: cmdb_ci_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Configuration Management Database (CMDB) Configuration Item (CI) ID
attributes.description: ServiceNow CMDB Configuration Item (CI) identifier for this POI. Enables linking the POI business record to ITSM incident, change, and problem management workflows.
attributes.references: ServiceNow ITSM CMDB; ISO/IEC 20000-1; TM Forum eTOM GB921

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country where the POI is physically located (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable regulatory framework and IOT tariff jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this POI record was first created in the system of record (Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory). Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; ServiceNow CMDB

attributes.name: data_center_name
attributes.description: Name of the data center or colocation facility hosting the POI for IP-based or MPLS interconnects (e.g., 'Equinix NY5', 'CyrusOne Dallas'). Applicable for IP/SIP and MPLS interconnect types.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which this POI was or is scheduled to be permanently decommissioned and removed from service. Null if the POI is still active. Used for lifecycle management and capacity reclamation planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; SAP S/4HANA Asset Management

attributes.name: exchange_name
attributes.description: Name of the telephone exchange, central office, or network exchange facility where the POI is physically housed (e.g., 'Manhattan Central Office', 'Chicago Exchange 5'). Used in OSS topology mapping.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Nokia NetAct Configuration Management

attributes.name: interconnect_type
attributes.description: Technology type of the interconnect at this POI. TDM = Time Division Multiplexing (legacy PSTN); IP_SIP = IP-based Session Initiation Protocol; MPLS = Multiprotocol Label Switching; ETHERNET = Layer 2 Ethernet handoff; FIBER = direct fiber interconnect.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.805; ETSI EN 300 175; 3GPP TS 23.002; TM Forum SID GB922

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Traffic jurisdiction classification for this POI. INTERSTATE = traffic crossing state lines (FCC jurisdiction); INTRASTATE = within-state traffic (state PUC jurisdiction); INTERNATIONAL = cross-border traffic; LOCAL = local exchange traffic. Determines applicable tariff and regulatory regime.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 51 and Part 69; ITU-T D.150; BEREC Guidelines

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical or logical audit of this POI, verifying that the as-built configuration matches the system of record. Required for regulatory compliance and CMDB accuracy.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001; TM Forum eTOM GB921; ServiceNow CMDB

attributes.name: maintenance_window
attributes.description: Scheduled maintenance window for this POI expressed as a cron-style or free-text schedule (e.g., 'SUN 02:00-04:00 UTC'). Used by NOC for planned outage coordination and change management.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM GB921; ServiceNow ITSM Change Management; Nokia NetAct

attributes.name: network_generation
attributes.description: Mobile or fixed network generation supported at this POI. Determines applicable technical standards, QoS parameters, and IOT tariff applicability. 5G NR = 5G New Radio; LTE = Long-Term Evolution.
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 23.002; ITU-T IMT-2020; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: noc_contact
attributes.description: Contact details (name, phone, or email) for the Network Operations Center (NOC) team responsible for monitoring and managing this POI. Used for fault escalation and incident coordination.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM GB921; Nokia NetAct Fault Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or remarks about this POI, including special configuration details, known limitations, or historical context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle state of the POI. ACTIVE = in-service and carrying traffic; PROVISIONING = being set up; SUSPENDED = temporarily halted; DECOMMISSIONED = permanently retired from service.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM GB921; Nokia NetAct Configuration Management; ServiceNow CMDB

attributes.name: peering_type
attributes.description: Classification of the peering arrangement at this POI. PUBLIC = via internet exchange point (IXP); PRIVATE = direct bilateral peering; BILATERAL = two-party agreement; MULTILATERAL = multi-party peering fabric. Applicable for IP peering POIs.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; GSMA PRD IR.34; IETF RFC 7948

attributes.name: poi_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the POI by traffic scope. DOMESTIC = national carrier interconnect; INTERNATIONAL = cross-border carrier handoff; TRANSIT = pass-through traffic routing; PEERING = bilateral traffic exchange; WHOLESALE = MVNO or reseller interconnect.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC 47 CFR Part 51; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: poi_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the POI, used in regulatory filings, carrier agreements, and OSS/BSS systems. Unique across all interconnect points. Sourced from Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; FCC Interconnection Rules 47 CFR Part 51

attributes.name: poi_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the POI, typically referencing the exchange location or data center (e.g., 'NYC-Manhattan-Equinix-POI-01'). Used in operational dashboards and carrier communications.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: pop_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Point of Presence (POP) network node associated with this POI. A POP is the physical network access location; multiple POIs may share a POP. Used in network topology and routing tables.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Netcracker OSS/BSS Resource Inventory

attributes.name: protocol_standard
attributes.description: Signaling or routing protocol standard used at this POI. SIP = Session Initiation Protocol; H.323 = ITU multimedia protocol; SS7 = Signaling System 7 (PSTN); ISUP = ISDN User Part; SIGTRAN = SS7 over IP; BGP = Border Gateway Protocol; LDP = Label Distribution Protocol (MPLS).
attributes.references: ITU-T Q.761; IETF RFC 3261 (SIP); ETSI EN 300 356; 3GPP TS 29.165

attributes.name: redundancy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this POI has a redundant or backup interconnect path configured (True = redundant path exists; False = single path, no redundancy). Critical for SLA risk assessment and network resilience planning.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.841; TM Forum SID GB922; ETSI EN 302 217

attributes.name: regulatory_designation
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the POI as determined by applicable telecommunications authority (e.g., FCC, Ofcom, BEREC). Determines whether interconnect rates are tariff-regulated or commercially negotiated. Critical for compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 51; Ofcom General Conditions; BEREC Guidelines; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number assigned by the telecommunications regulator (e.g., FCC, Ofcom) for this POI or its associated interconnect authorization. Used in regulatory filings and compliance audits.
attributes.references: FCC 47 CFR Part 51; Ofcom General Conditions; NTIA

attributes.name: total_capacity_circuits
attributes.description: Total provisioned circuit capacity at this POI expressed as number of circuits (DS0 equivalents for TDM, or logical channels for IP). Principal quantitative measure of the POI resource. Used for capacity planning and SLA enforcement.
attributes.references: ITU-T G.703; TM Forum SID GB922; Ericsson Network Manager Transport Management

attributes.name: traffic_direction
attributes.description: Permitted traffic flow direction at this POI. INBOUND = traffic received from the connected carrier; OUTBOUND = traffic sent to the connected carrier; BIDIRECTIONAL = traffic flows in both directions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ITU-T E.164; GSMA PRD IR.21

attributes.name: trunk_group_code
attributes.description: Reference to the trunk group associated with this POI. A trunk group is a logical bundle of circuits or channels provisioned at this interconnect point for traffic routing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Ericsson Network Manager Transport Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this POI record. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; ISO/IEC 27001; ServiceNow CMDB

attributes.name: used_capacity_circuits
attributes.description: Number of circuits currently in active use at this POI. Used to calculate utilization percentage for capacity management, congestion alerting, and expansion planning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID GB922; Nokia NetAct Performance Management

products.name: rap_file
products.description: Return of Accounting Procedure (RAP) file record representing a formal rejection of TAP records returned by the recipient operator to the sender. Captures RAP file ID, originating TAP file reference, sender TADIG, recipient TADIG, RAP file type (GSMA standard), rejected record count, total rejected value, rejection reason codes, RAP status, and resubmission reference. Manages the TAP rejection and correction lifecycle.
products.reference: GSMA PRD TD.32 RAP / TD.57 TAP3

attributes.name: rap_file_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return of Accounting Procedure (RAP) File ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the RAP file record in the interconnect settlement system. Primary key for the rap_file data product.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bilateral roaming agreement under which the rejected TAP records were exchanged. Links the RAP file to the governing commercial and technical terms for the inter-operator relationship.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.08; TM Forum SID; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: iot_tariff_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IOT tariff table applicable to the rejected TAP records. Used to validate whether the rejection relates to tariff mismatches and to recalculate correct charges upon resubmission.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.08; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: pipeline_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.pipeline_run. Business justification: RAP file processing is an ETL workflow. This link enables monitoring of rejection file handling, supports resubmission workflows when TAP files are rejected, and provides audit trail for dispute resol

attributes.name: primary_rap_resubmission_tap_file_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resubmission Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) File ID
attributes.description: Reference to the corrected TAP file resubmitted by the sender after processing this RAP rejection. Tracks the correction lifecycle and links the original rejection to its resolution.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32; GSMA BA.08; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: sender_carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnect.interconnect_carrier. Business justification: RAP file sender is denormalized via sender_tadig. Normalizing to interconnect_carrier provides authoritative carrier master reference. The FK will be populated at RAP file creation when sender is know

attributes.name: source_tap_file_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) File ID
attributes.description: Reference to the originating TAP file whose records are being rejected in this RAP file. Links the RAP rejection back to the specific TAP file that contained the erroneous records.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA BA.08; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the recipient operator formally acknowledged receipt and acceptance of this RAP file. Required for GSMA bilateral exchange compliance and settlement audit.

attributes.name: clearing_house_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the GSMA-accredited data clearing house (DCH) or billing clearing house (BCH) that processed or routed this RAP file between operators (e.g., SYNIVERSE, HROAMING). Required for multi-lateral settlement audit.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA BA.08; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RAP file was generated by the sending operator's settlement system. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this RAP file record.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; GSMA BA.08

attributes.name: dispute_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of any formal inter-operator dispute raised in connection with this RAP file rejection. Links the RAP record to the dispute management workflow in the BSS settlement system.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.08; TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the rejected charge amounts from the TAP file currency to the settlement currency at the time of RAP file generation. Required for multi-currency settlement reconciliation.

attributes.name: file_checksum
attributes.description: Cryptographic checksum (e.g., MD5 or SHA-256 hash) of the RAP file used to verify file integrity during transmission and ingestion. Supports non-repudiation and data quality assurance.

attributes.name: file_size_bytes
attributes.description: Physical size of the RAP file in bytes as received from the clearing house or sender operator. Used for file integrity validation and transmission monitoring.

attributes.name: nrtrde_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Near Real-Time Roaming Data Exchange (NRTRDE) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rejected TAP records were originally subject to NRTRDE near-real-time roaming data exchange obligations. True if NRTRDE-governed records are included, enabling fraud and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD FS.11 NRTRDE; GSMA BA.08; 3GPP TS 32.298

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the settlement operations team regarding this RAP file, such as root-cause analysis findings, escalation context, or correction instructions communicated to the counterparty operator.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: primary_rejection_code
attributes.description: GSMA-standard primary rejection reason code identifying the main cause for TAP record rejection in this RAP file (e.g., '12' for missing mandatory field, '15' for invalid IMSI). Sourced from GSMA TD.32 rejection code table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — GSMA TD.32 defines 50+ rejection codes]
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RAP file was fully processed and the rejected TAP records were actioned in the settlement system. Supports audit trail and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32; Amdocs Revenue Management; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: rap_file_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return of Accounting Procedure (RAP) File Type
attributes.description: GSMA-defined RAP file type code indicating the direction and nature of the rejection. HOMERJE = home operator rejecting visitor records; VISRJE = visited operator rejecting home records; ACK variants are acknowledgements; SYSERR = system error file. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HOMERJE|VISRJE|HOMERJE-ACK|VISRJE-ACK|SYSERR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: rap_release_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return of Accounting Procedure (RAP) Release Version
attributes.description: GSMA RAP release version within the specification version, providing finer-grained versioning of the RAP file format used for this exchange.

attributes.name: rap_spec_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return of Accounting Procedure (RAP) Specification Version
attributes.description: GSMA RAP specification version number used to encode this RAP file (e.g., '04' for RAP version 4). Governs the file structure and rejection code set applicable to this record.

attributes.name: rap_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return of Accounting Procedure (RAP) File Status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the RAP file within the inter-operator settlement workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through validation, processing, acknowledgement, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|validated|processed|acknowledged|disputed|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; TM Forum eTOM; Amdocs Revenue Management

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the RAP file was received and ingested by the recipient operator's settlement system. Used for SLA compliance tracking and NRTRDE window monitoring.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32; GSMA PRD BA.08; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: recipient_tadig
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recipient Transferred Account Data Interchange Group (TADIG) Code
attributes.description: GSMA TADIG code of the operator receiving this RAP file (the operator whose TAP records are being rejected). Identifies the counterparty in the bilateral exchange.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; GSMA TADIG Registry; GSMA BA.08

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RAP file record was first inserted into the Silver layer data product. Audit trail field for data lineage and lakehouse ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this RAP file record was last modified in the Silver layer data product. Supports change data capture and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: rejected_record_count
attributes.description: Total number of TAP CDR records rejected in this RAP file. Core settlement metric used to reconcile the volume of rejected usage records against the originating TAP file.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; GSMA BA.08

attributes.name: rejection_category
attributes.description: GSMA-defined severity classification of the rejection: fatal (entire TAP file rejected), severe (significant errors requiring correction), or minor (non-critical errors). Determines the correction and resubmission workflow.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: rejection_code_list
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of all GSMA rejection reason codes present across the rejected records in this RAP file. Provides a summary of all error types encountered, enabling root-cause analysis and TAP file correction prioritization.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; GSMA PRD TD.57

attributes.name: resubmission_deadline_date
attributes.description: Contractual or GSMA-mandated deadline by which the sender must resubmit corrected TAP records following this RAP rejection. Used for SLA monitoring and dispute escalation triggers.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.08; GSMA TD.32; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: resubmission_status
attributes.description: Current status of the TAP file resubmission process following this RAP rejection. Tracks whether the sender has corrected and resubmitted the rejected records, or if the rejection is under dispute or has been waived.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32; GSMA BA.08; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: roaming_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the rejected TAP records relate to inbound roamers (foreign subscribers using the home network) or outbound roamers (home subscribers using a foreign network). Determines the financial flow direction for settlement.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.08; GSMA PRD TD.57; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Return of Accounting Procedure (RAP) File Sequence Number
attributes.description: GSMA-standard five-digit sequence number assigned to this RAP file by the sender, used to uniquely identify the RAP file within a bilateral exchange pair. Follows GSMA TD.32 sequencing rules.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32 RAP Format Specification; GSMA BA.08

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Category of telecommunications service covered by the rejected TAP records (e.g., voice, data, SMS, MMS, supplementary services). Supports rejection analysis by service type for root-cause investigation.
attributes.references: GSMA PRD TD.57; 3GPP TS 22.001; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the rejected charge amounts are denominated for inter-operator settlement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Must align with the bilateral roaming agreement currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GSMA BA.08; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing/settlement period covered by the rejected TAP records in this RAP file. Used with settlement_period_start_date to bound the financial exposure of the rejection.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.08; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing/settlement period covered by the rejected TAP records in this RAP file. Aligns the rejection to the correct inter-operator settlement cycle.
attributes.references: GSMA BA.08; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: source_tap_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Source Transferred Account Procedure (TAP) File Sequence Number
attributes.description: The GSMA sequence number of the originating TAP file being rejected, as carried within the RAP file header. Enables direct correlation to the TAP file without requiring a system join.

attributes.name: tap_release_version
attributes.description: TAP release version of the originating TAP file being rejected, providing finer-grained versioning within the TAP specification version. Used for format validation during RAP processing.

attributes.name: tap_version
attributes.description: TAP specification version of the originating TAP file being rejected (e.g., '03' for TAP3). Required to validate that the RAP file is processed against the correct TAP format rules.

attributes.name: total_rejected_charge
attributes.description: Aggregate monetary value of all TAP records rejected in this RAP file, expressed in the settlement currency. Represents the gross financial exposure of the rejection batch for inter-operator settlement reconciliation.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32; GSMA BA.08; ITU-T D.150; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: total_tax_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Tax Value of Rejected Records
attributes.description: Aggregate tax component of the rejected TAP records included in this RAP file. Required for accurate financial settlement reconciliation and tax reporting between operators.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32; GSMA BA.08; ITU-T D.150

attributes.name: transfer_cutoff_timestamp
attributes.description: GSMA-mandated cutoff timestamp by which the RAP file must be transmitted to the recipient operator. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and GSMA bilateral agreement enforcement.
attributes.references: GSMA TD.32; GSMA BA.08; GSMA PRD TD.57

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: SSOT for field and technical workforce operations — technician scheduling, dispatch, route optimization, work order execution, skill/certification tracking, and mobile workforce coordination for network installation, maintenance, and repair. Managed via Granite Telecommunications WFM.
domains.references: TM Forum eTOM Workforce Management, TM Forum SID Resource

products.name: technician
products.description: Master record for field and technical workforce personnel with periodic performance evaluation history. Identity and employment: technician ID, name, employment status, home depot/zone assignment, employment type (full-time, contractor, MVNO partner), contact details, hire/termination dates, workforce classification (RAN, FTTH, GPON, CPE, splicing). Performance history: quarterly/annual review records with KPIs (first-time fix rate, MTTR, work orders/day, SLA compliance, CSAT, safety compliance, attendance), review period, reviewer (supervisor), overall rating, individual KPI scores, development goals, acknowledgement status, and improvement plan references. SSOT for individual workforce identity and performance within the workforce domain. Sourced from Granite Telecommunications WFM and SAP S/4HANA HCM.
products.reference: TM Forum SID — Party/Individual; eTOM 1.4 Workforce Management

attributes.name: technician_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the field or technical workforce personnel. Primary key for the technician master record.

attributes.name: analytical_model_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.analytical_model_registry. Business justification: Technician attrition prediction, skill gap forecasting, and productivity models are registered analytical assets. Telecommunications workforce planning uses ML models to predict technician churn risk

attributes.name: contractor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.contractor. Business justification: Technicians can be direct employees or contractor-provided workforce. The employment_type and workforce_classification fields indicate this distinction exists. Contractor-provided technicians need FK

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Technicians are assigned to cost centers for payroll allocation, overhead distribution, and workforce cost reporting - standard HR-finance integration for labor cost tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Human Resources system employee identifier. External business identifier used for payroll, benefits, and HR processes.

attributes.name: kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Technician performance metrics (first-time fix rate, MTTR, customer satisfaction score, safety compliance) are enterprise KPIs. Telecommunications workforce management requires linking individual tech

attributes.name: primary_corporate_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.corporate_account. Business justification: Dedicated technician assignment model for strategic enterprise accounts (Fortune 500, government, wholesale partners). Telcos assign senior techs to major accounts for relationship continuity, account

attributes.name: segment_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.segment_definition. Business justification: Workforce segmentation (high performers, flight risk, skill-based cohorts, union vs non-union) drives retention programs and development initiatives. Telecommunications HR analytics segments technicia

attributes.name: supervisor_technician_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the direct supervisor or field manager responsible for this technician's performance management and work assignment.

attributes.name: attendance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of scheduled work days attended. Used for reliability assessment and workforce planning.

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent background check or security clearance verification. Required for access to customer premises and sensitive network infrastructure.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Aggregate status of required industry certifications (e.g., fiber optic, electrical safety, tower climbing). Drives dispatch eligibility and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the technician master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: current_performance_rating
attributes.description: Most recent overall performance evaluation rating from the latest review cycle. Used for promotion decisions and workforce optimization.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Average customer satisfaction rating (0-100 scale) from post-service surveys. Key indicator of service quality and technician soft skills.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Customer Experience Management

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that provided this technician data: Granite Telecommunications Workforce Management (WFM), SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management (HCM), manual entry, or integration feed.

attributes.name: drug_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent drug screening test. Required for safety-sensitive positions and compliance with Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations for commercial drivers.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated emergency contact person for field safety incidents and urgent notifications.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the designated emergency contact for field safety incidents and urgent notifications.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment lifecycle status indicating availability for work assignment and dispatch.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment relationship: full-time employee, part-time employee, contractor, Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) partner technician, or temporary worker.

attributes.name: first_time_fix_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of work orders resolved on the first visit without requiring return trips. Key performance indicator (KPI) for technician efficiency and customer satisfaction.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Service Fulfillment KPI

attributes.name: home_depot_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the technician's assigned home depot or service center for reporting, equipment storage, and route optimization.

attributes.name: improvement_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician is currently on a formal performance improvement plan. Used for HR compliance and management escalation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any field in the technician master record. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance review. Used to schedule upcoming reviews and ensure compliance with review frequency policies.

attributes.name: mean_time_to_repair
attributes.description: Average time in minutes to complete repair work orders. Critical KPI for workforce productivity and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Service Assurance KPI

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal performance review. Drives manager notifications and review preparation workflows.

attributes.name: safety_compliance_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0-100) representing adherence to safety protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) usage, and incident-free work history. Critical for field workforce risk management.

attributes.name: service_zone
attributes.description: Geographic service zone or territory assignment for dispatch optimization and workload balancing.

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: Overall technical proficiency level used for work order assignment complexity matching and career progression tracking.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of work orders completed within committed SLA timeframes. Critical for customer satisfaction and penalty avoidance.

attributes.name: tools_kit_code
