attributes.description: Identifier of the standard tools and equipment kit assigned to the technician. Used for inventory tracking and maintenance scheduling.

attributes.name: training_hours_ytd
attributes.description: Total training and professional development hours completed in the current calendar year. Used for compliance reporting and skill development tracking.

attributes.name: union_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the technician is a member of a labor union. Affects scheduling rules, overtime policies, and grievance procedures.

attributes.name: vehicle_assigned
attributes.description: Identifier of the company vehicle or fleet unit assigned to this technician for field operations and equipment transport.

attributes.name: work_orders_per_day
attributes.description: Average number of work orders completed per working day. Productivity metric used for capacity planning and workload balancing.

attributes.name: workforce_classification
attributes.description: Technical specialization area: Radio Access Network (RAN), Fiber to the Home (FTTH), Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON), Customer Premises Equipment (CPE), fiber splicing, transport network, core network, or hybrid multi-skill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ran|ftth|gpon|cpe|splicing|transport|core|hybrid — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: skill
products.description: SSOT for the technical skill taxonomy and individual technician skill proficiency holdings. Catalog section: skill code, name, category (RAN, transport, access, CPE, safety), proficiency level definitions (trainee/competent/expert), prerequisite skills, and validity period — e.g., fiber splicing, 5G NR RAN commissioning, GPON/OLT configuration, VoLTE IMS troubleshooting. Technician-skill section: which skills each technician holds, current proficiency level, assessment date, assessor, expiry date, recertification requirements, and active status. Enables skill-based dispatch matching in Granite WFM — ensures only appropriately skilled technicians are assigned to specialized work orders (e.g., only fiber-splicing-expert for trunk splice jobs). Sourced from Granite WFM skills module.
products.reference: TM Forum SID — ResourceSpecification/Skill; GSMA workforce competency framework

attributes.name: skill_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the technical skill in the workforce skill taxonomy. Primary key.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the external certification authority or vendor (e.g., Ericsson, Nokia, Fiber Optic Association, OSHA) if certification_required_flag is true.

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Official name of the required certification (e.g., Ericsson Certified RAN Expert, Nokia NetAct Administrator, FOA CFOT).

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal external certification is required to hold this skill (e.g., vendor certification for Ericsson RAN, Nokia NetAct, safety certifications).
attributes.references: TM Forum Workforce Management Best Practices

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the workforce administrator who created this skill record.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this skill record was first created in the Granite WFM skills module.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: dispatch_priority_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight used in Granite WFM dispatch algorithm to prioritize technicians with this skill for matching work orders (higher weight = higher priority).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this skill was deprecated or made obsolete. Null if skill is still active.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this skill became active in the workforce skill taxonomy and available for assignment.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment or system this skill applies to (e.g., RAN Base Station, OLT, ONT, BNG, BRAS, IMS Core, HSS, CPE Router).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the workforce administrator who last modified this skill record.

products.name: workforce_certification
products.description: SSOT for workforce qualifications, certifications, technician certification holdings, and training activity records. (1) Certification catalog: formal certifications and regulatory qualifications — OSHA safety, BICSI RCDD, Ericsson RAN certified, Nokia NetAct operator, FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License, NATE tower climbing, confined space entry — with issuing body, validity duration, renewal requirements, and regulatory mandate flag. (2) Technician-certification holdings: certificate number, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority, renewal status, compliance flag, and technician reference. (3) Training activities: course completions, delivery method (classroom/e-learning/OJT/vendor-led), provider, completion date, score/grade, pass/fail, CPD hours earned, and link to resulting certification. products.name: technician_schedule
products.description: SSOT for all technician time allocation, availability, and shift management. Encompasses: (1) Shift templates — standard shift patterns (day/evening/on-call/weekend rotation) with start/end times, duration, break rules, overtime eligibility, and applicable days. (2) Individual shift assignments — generated from templates, capturing shift type, assigned territory, depot, status (draft/published/confirmed/cancelled), and schedule change audit trail. (3) Overtime records — planned overtime (pre-approved for outage response, rollout surge) and emergency overtime (unplanned NOC callout), with hours, reason code, approving manager, pay classification (straight-time/time-and-a-half/double-time), and payroll period. (4) Leave/absence blocks — annual leave, sick leave, FMLA, training leave, emergency absence, with request/approval workflow, coverage plan (replacement technician), and impact on scheduled work orders. Includes planned vs. actual hours and payroll period references. Feeds dispatch optimization (Granite WFM) and SAP S/4HANA payroll.

products.name: work_order
products.description: Core transactional entity representing field work assignments dispatched to technicians, with activity-level execution detail and materials consumed. Header: work order number, type (install/repair/maintenance/survey), priority (P1–P4), customer reference, network element reference, site address, scheduled window, assigned technician, dispatch/arrival/completion times, resolution code, SLA target and breach flag, escalation flag. Activity lines: individual tasks performed (site survey, cable pull, fiber splice, ONT power-up, signal test, CPE config, safety check, customer sign-off) with sequence, activity type, technician performing, start/end timestamps, outcome (pass/fail/deferred), and notes. Material lines: parts consumed (fiber cable, connectors, ONT units, CPE devices, splice trays, patch panels) with material code, quantity planned vs. used, unit of measure, serial number (for serialized assets), source depot, and cost. SSOT for field work execution, MTTR analysis, first-time-fix tracking, and inventory consumption. Sourced from Oracle Communications OSM and Granite WFM.

products.name: route_plan
products.description: Transactional record of optimized daily route plans generated for technicians by Granite WFM route optimization engine, including ordered stop-level detail. Captures plan date, technician, depot start/end, and for each stop: sequence number, work order reference, site address, GPS coordinates, estimated/actual arrival and departure times, stop status (pending/arrived/completed/skipped), and inter-stop travel time. At plan level captures total estimated travel time, total distance (km/miles), optimization algorithm used (time-window, priority-weighted, fuel-optimized), plan status (draft/active/completed), and actual vs. planned deviation metrics. Supports OPEX reduction through fuel and time efficiency, real-time route tracking, and customer ETA updates.

products.name: team
products.description: Master record for field workforce teams and crew groupings with full membership roster. Team attributes: team code, name, type (installation crew, maintenance gang, emergency response, specialized squad), lead technician, assigned depot, service territory, headcount, active status, and specialization tags (fiber splicing, 5G NR rollout, GPON activation). products.name: technician_skill_proficiency
products.description: This association product represents the skill proficiency holdings between technician and skill. It captures the current and historical skill certifications, proficiency levels, and assessment records for each technician-skill combination. Each record links one technician to one skill with proficiency level, certification dates, assessment scores, and recertification tracking that exist only in the context of this relationship. This is the operational record used by Granite WFM dispatch algorithms to match work orders with appropriately skilled technicians.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications field operations, technicians hold multiple technical skills (fiber splicing, 5G RAN commissioning, GPON configuration, etc.) at varying proficiency levels, and each skill is held by multiple technicians across the workforce. The business actively manages this many-to-many relationship through Granite WFM's skills module, tracking proficiency levels, certification dates, assessment scores, and recertification requirements for each technician-skill combination. This operational data drives skill-based dispatch matching to ensure only appropriately qualified technicians are assigned to specialized work orders.

products.name: workforce_project_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between technician and capital_project. It captures the allocation of field and technical workforce personnel to capital expenditure projects for labor tracking, cost accounting, and resource utilization reporting. Each record links one technician to one capital_project with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship: assignment dates, role on project, hours allocated, labor rate, and assignment status.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications capital project execution, technicians are routinely assigned to multiple concurrent capital projects (e.g., a fiber specialist may work on both a FTTH deployment and a data center build in the same month), and each capital project requires multiple technicians with different specializations (RAN, FTTH, GPON, splicing). The business actively manages these assignments as operational records with specific dates, roles, hours, and labor rates for project cost accounting and workforce utilization reporting.

products.name: technician_kpi_target
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of KPI targets to individual technicians for specific measurement periods. It captures the planned performance expectations, baseline values, and incentive eligibility for each technician-KPI combination. Each record links one technician to one KPI target with period-specific target values and tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this performance management relationship.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications workforce management, technicians are assigned multiple KPI targets across different measurement periods and performance dimensions (first-time fix rate, customer satisfaction, safety compliance, productivity metrics). Each KPI target definition applies to multiple technicians based on their role, skill level, depot assignment, or service territory. The business actively manages these target assignments as part of performance management and MBO (Management by Objectives) processes, tracking baseline values, actual achievement, and incentive eligibility for each technician-KPI-period combination.

products.name: drm_policy
products.description: Defines Digital Rights Management policies AND geographic access control rules applied to protected content assets — the unified SSOT for all content protection and territorial restriction configuration. DRM coverage: system configuration (Widevine, PlayReady, FairPlay), protection levels (L1/L2/L3), allowed output types (HDMI, analog), offline download permissions, rental window duration, maximum simultaneous streams, device capability requirements (HDCP version), and watermarking requirements. Geographic restriction coverage: allowed/blocked territory codes per content asset, channel, or package; IP range restrictions; enforcement method (geo-IP, GPS, network-based); restriction type (allow-list vs. block-list); and effective date ranges for territorial licensing compliance. Policies are referenced by content assets, VOD rentals, entitlements, and content packages to enforce both playback protection and geographic availability across all delivery platforms.

products.name: entitlement
products.description: Unified SSOT for all content access entitlements granted to subscriber accounts — the single authoritative record of what content a subscriber can consume across ALL delivery platforms and access models. Covers: (1) Subscription-based access to channel lineups and VOD catalogs; (2) Transactional access via TVOD rentals and EST purchases; (3) OTT platform provisioning including Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max bundled access with full provisioning lifecycle (SSO token, API credential, provisioning status, last sync timestamp, OTT account identifier); (4) Promotional and complimentary grants. Captures subscriber account reference, entitlement type (subscription, rental, purchase, complimentary, OTT bundle), entitled content scope (package, catalog, individual title, channel lineup, OTT platform), OTT provisioning details, entitlement start and expiry dates, grant source (product bundle, promotion, manual override, migration), auto-renewal flag, and entitlement status. This is the ONLY entity to query for 'what can this subscriber access?' — no other entity in the domain claims entitlement authority.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the content entitlement. Active = subscriber can consume content; Suspended = temporarily disabled (e.g., payment issue); Expired = validity period ended; Cancelled = subscriber or system terminated; Pending Activation = granted but not yet effective.

attributes.name: entitlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the content access model. Subscription = recurring access to channel lineups or VOD catalogs; Rental = TVOD time-limited access; Purchase = EST permanent ownership; Complimentary = free promotional grant; OTT Bundle = bundled third-party OTT platform access (Netflix, Disney+, HBO Max); Promotional = campaign-driven temporary access.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the content entitlement expires and access is revoked. Nullable for perpetual entitlements (e.g., EST purchases) or open-ended subscriptions. For rentals, this is the rental period end date.

attributes.name: geographic_restriction_code
attributes.description: Code defining geographic or territorial restrictions on content access. May reference a country code, region code, or blackout zone. Examples: 'USA', 'EU', 'BLACKOUT_ZONE_5'. Nullable if no geographic restrictions apply.

attributes.name: grant_reference_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this entitlement to its originating source. May be a product order ID, promotion campaign ID, migration batch ID, or manual grant ticket number. Provides traceability to the business event that created the entitlement.

attributes.name: grant_source
attributes.description: Origin of the entitlement grant. Product Bundle = included in a purchased service plan; Promotion = marketing campaign grant; Manual Override = CSR or admin manual grant; Migration = transferred from legacy system; Loyalty Reward = earned through customer loyalty program; Partner Offer = granted via partner agreement.

attributes.name: hd_quality_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entitlement includes access to high-definition (HD) quality streams. True = HD available; False = standard definition only. May be tier-dependent.

attributes.name: last_access_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent content consumption event under this entitlement. Used to track engagement and identify dormant entitlements. Nullable if content has never been accessed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the entitlement record. Tracks changes to status, expiry dates, or other entitlement attributes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or context about the entitlement. Used by CSRs and operations teams for manual annotations.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: offline_viewing_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is permitted to download and view content offline under this entitlement. True = offline downloads enabled; False = streaming only. Subject to DRM policy and licensing terms.

attributes.name: ott_account_identifier
attributes.description: The subscriber's account identifier on the third-party OTT platform. Used for account linking and entitlement verification. Populated only for OTT bundle entitlements.

attributes.name: ott_api_credential
attributes.description: API credential or access key used by the telecommunications platform to manage the subscriber's OTT entitlement via partner API. Used for provisioning, status checks, and deprovisioning operations. Applicable only to OTT bundle entitlements.

attributes.name: ott_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the last successful synchronization with the OTT platform's entitlement API. Used to track data freshness and detect sync failures. Applicable only to OTT bundle entitlements.

attributes.name: ott_provisioning_status
attributes.description: Current provisioning state of the OTT platform entitlement. Pending = provisioning request submitted; Provisioned = account created on OTT platform; Active = subscriber can access; Suspended = temporarily disabled; Deprovisioned = access removed; Failed = provisioning error. Applicable only to OTT bundle entitlements.

attributes.name: ott_sso_token
attributes.description: Single sign-on authentication token used for seamless subscriber login to the OTT platform. Encrypted credential enabling passwordless access. Populated only for OTT bundle entitlements with SSO integration.

attributes.name: parental_control_pin_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parental Control Personal Identification Number (PIN) Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a parental control PIN is required to access the entitled content. True = PIN must be entered before viewing; False = no PIN required. Used to enforce age-appropriate content access.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking used to resolve conflicts when multiple overlapping entitlements exist for the same subscriber and content. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used by entitlement resolution engines.

attributes.name: revenue_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of revenue shared with the content provider or OTT partner for this entitlement. Used for financial settlement and revenue assurance. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15%).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Revenue Assurance Domain

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the content entitlement becomes effective and the subscriber gains access rights. Aligns with subscription activation, rental start, or promotional grant date.

attributes.name: suspended_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the entitlement was suspended. Nullable if entitlement has never been suspended. Used for lifecycle event tracking.

attributes.name: total_access_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of content access events (streams, downloads, views) under this entitlement since activation. Used for engagement analytics and usage-based billing.

attributes.name: uhd_4k_quality_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entitlement includes access to ultra-high-definition (UHD) 4K quality streams. True = 4K available; False = lower resolutions only. Premium tier feature.

products.name: vod_rental
products.description: Transactional record of individual VOD title rental or electronic sell-through (EST) purchase events by subscribers. Captures subscriber account, VOD asset rented/purchased, transaction type (rental vs. purchase), rental window start and expiry, purchase price, payment reference, viewing device, DRM policy applied, download permitted flag, and transaction status. Distinct from subscription entitlements — represents a one-time transactional content access event.
products.reference: TVOD Transaction / TM Forum SID Product Order

attributes.name: vod_rental_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the VOD rental or electronic sell-through transaction.

attributes.name: cpe_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.cpe_asset. Business justification: VOD rental transactions occur on specific CPE devices for billing reconciliation, device capability validation (4K/HDR support matching), and fraud detection. Operations need device-transaction linkag

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subscriber account that initiated the VOD rental or purchase transaction.

attributes.name: device_registration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the specific device used for the transaction, such as STB serial number, mobile device ID, or browser fingerprint.

attributes.name: drm_license_id
attributes.description: Unique DRM license identifier issued for this transaction, used to authorize content decryption and playback on authorized devices.

attributes.name: drm_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DRM policy applied to this VOD transaction, governing content protection, playback restrictions, and device authorization.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent order if the VOD transaction was part of a larger service order or bundle activation. Null for standalone transactions.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: External payment gateway or billing system reference identifier for the transaction, used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: privacy_consent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_consent. Business justification: VOD rentals process payment data and viewing history. VPPA (Video Privacy Protection Act) and GDPR require consent for collecting and processing video viewing records. Links transaction to authorizing

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: VOD rental transactions generate revenue attributed to specific profit centers (e.g., premium content division). Required for revenue reporting by business segment, performance measurement, and financ

attributes.name: revenue_analytics_kpi_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.revenue_analytics_kpi. Business justification: Rental transactions directly feed transactional revenue KPIs (TVOD revenue by content type, rental conversion rate, average transaction value) for financial reporting and content monetization analysis

attributes.name: vod_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VOD content asset (movie, episode, documentary) that was rented or purchased.

attributes.name: audio_language
attributes.description: Primary audio language selected for the VOD content, using ISO 639 language codes (e.g., en, es, fr).

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign that drove the VOD transaction, used for campaign performance tracking and attribution analysis.

attributes.name: cdn_node_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the CDN edge node or cache server that delivered the VOD content to the subscriber.

attributes.name: content_quality
attributes.description: Video quality tier purchased or rented by the subscriber (SD, HD, Full HD, 4K, 8K).

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: Age-based content rating assigned to the VOD asset (e.g., G, PG, PG-13, R, NC-17 for movies; TV-Y, TV-PG, TV-14, TV-MA for television). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: G|PG|PG-13|R|NC-17|TV-Y|TV-Y7|TV-G|TV-PG|TV-14|TV-MA — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Motion Picture Association (MPA), TV Parental Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VOD rental transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the transaction through promotional codes, loyalty programs, or special offers.

attributes.name: download_permitted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscriber is permitted to download the VOD content for offline viewing (true) or streaming-only access (false).

attributes.name: first_playback_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the subscriber first started playback of the rented or purchased VOD content. Null if content not yet viewed.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the geographic region where the transaction was initiated, used for content licensing and rights management.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous playback streams allowed for this VOD transaction across multiple devices.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VOD rental transaction record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: parental_control_pin_verified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Parental Control Personal Identification Number (PIN) Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental control PIN was successfully verified before allowing the transaction for age-restricted content (true) or not required (false).

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Payment instrument used for the VOD transaction (credit card, prepaid balance, carrier billing, etc.).

attributes.name: promotional_code
attributes.description: Promotional or discount code applied to the VOD transaction, if any, used for marketing campaign tracking and revenue attribution.

attributes.name: purchase_price
attributes.description: Total price paid by the subscriber for the VOD rental or purchase, before taxes and fees.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount refunded to the subscriber if the transaction was reversed or disputed. Null if no refund issued.

attributes.name: refund_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the refund (e.g., technical issue, customer dissatisfaction, billing error). Null if no refund issued.

attributes.name: refund_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was processed. Null if no refund issued.

attributes.name: rental_duration_hours
attributes.description: Duration of the rental viewing window in hours (e.g., 24, 48, 72 hours). Null for purchase transactions.

attributes.name: rental_window_expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rental viewing window expires and access to the content is revoked. Null for purchase transactions.

attributes.name: rental_window_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the rental viewing window begins, typically when the subscriber first starts playback.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the VOD transaction was initiated (web portal, mobile app, STB interface, IVR, call center, retail store, partner portal). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|stb|ivr|call_center|retail_store|partner_portal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: subtitle_language
attributes.description: Subtitle language selected for the VOD content, using ISO 639 language codes. Null if no subtitles selected.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the VOD transaction based on subscriber location and applicable tax regulations.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Total amount charged to the subscriber including purchase price, taxes, and any additional fees.

attributes.name: total_playback_count
attributes.description: Total number of times the subscriber has initiated playback of the VOD content during the rental window or after purchase.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique transaction number for the VOD rental or purchase event, used for customer service and billing inquiries.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VOD transaction indicating payment and entitlement state.

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VOD rental or purchase transaction was initiated by the subscriber.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of VOD transaction: rental (time-limited access), purchase (permanent ownership), or EST (electronic sell-through).

attributes.name: viewing_device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the subscriber to initiate the VOD rental or purchase (STB, smart TV, mobile, tablet, web browser, etc.). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stb|smart_tv|mobile|tablet|web|gaming_console|streaming_device — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: epg_schedule
products.description: Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) schedule data for IPTV linear channels, capturing the broadcast schedule of programmes per channel. Records channel reference, programme title, episode information, broadcast start and end times, programme genre, content rating, synopsis, series/season/episode identifiers, and catch-up availability flag. Enables guide display on STBs and OTT apps, and supports catch-up TV entitlement logic.
products.reference: EPG / Electronic Programme Guide Standard / DVB-SI

attributes.name: epg_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the EPG schedule entry. Primary key for the EPG schedule data product.

attributes.name: blackout_geo_boundary_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.geo_boundary. Business justification: Sports blackouts and regional programming restrictions are enforced using precise geographic boundaries. EPG systems use this for real-time content availability decisions. Essential for sports rights

attributes.name: drm_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DRM policy governing the usage rights and restrictions for this programme content. Controls playback, recording, and distribution permissions.

attributes.name: iptv_channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IPTV linear channel on which this programme is scheduled to broadcast.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the content provider or studio that owns the licensing rights for this programme. Used for content licensing management and revenue sharing calculations.

attributes.name: programme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the programme content asset being broadcast in this schedule slot.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: EPG data must comply with accessibility regulations (closed caption availability disclosure), emergency alert system integration, and content rating display requirements. Links schedule entry to regul

attributes.name: scheduler_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.employee. Business justification: EPG scheduling is a manual curation process where content operations staff plan broadcast schedules, resolve channel conflicts, coordinate with broadcasters, and manage last-minute changes. Essential

attributes.name: series_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the series to which this episode belongs. Used to group all episodes of a series for catch-up TV and series recording features.

attributes.name: audio_format
attributes.description: The audio encoding format used for the programme broadcast. Indicates the audio quality and surround sound capabilities.

attributes.name: audio_language
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of language codes (ISO 639-1) for available audio tracks. Used for multi-language broadcast support.

attributes.name: broadcast_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The scheduled end date and time when the programme finishes broadcasting on the linear channel. Used for EPG display and catch-up TV availability calculation.

attributes.name: broadcast_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The scheduled start date and time when the programme begins broadcasting on the linear channel. Used for EPG display and catch-up TV availability calculation.

attributes.name: cast_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of primary cast members appearing in the programme. Used for content search and discovery features.

attributes.name: catchup_available
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this programme is available for catch-up TV viewing after the live broadcast. True if catch-up is enabled, false otherwise. Used to control on-demand entitlement logic.

attributes.name: catchup_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the programme is no longer available for catch-up TV viewing. Determined by content licensing rights and catch-up window policies.

attributes.name: catchup_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the programme becomes available for catch-up TV viewing. Typically set to the broadcast end timestamp or shortly thereafter.

attributes.name: cdn_url
attributes.description: The content delivery network (CDN) URL endpoint from which the programme stream is delivered to customer premises equipment (CPE). Used for stream routing and CDN management.

attributes.name: closed_caption_available
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether closed captioning is available for this programme. True if closed captions are provided, false otherwise. Required for accessibility compliance.

attributes.name: content_rating
attributes.description: The age-appropriateness rating assigned to the programme content. Used for parental control enforcement and content filtering on customer premises equipment (CPE). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: G|PG|PG-13|R|NC-17|TV-Y|TV-Y7|TV-G|TV-PG|TV-14|TV-MA — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: director_name
attributes.description: The name of the director of the programme. Applicable primarily to movies and scripted content.

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration of the programme in minutes, calculated from broadcast start to end timestamps.

attributes.name: episode_number
attributes.description: The episode number within the season. Null for non-episodic content.

attributes.name: episode_title
attributes.description: The specific episode title for episodic content. Null for non-episodic programmes such as movies or one-off specials.

attributes.name: is_4k
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the programme is broadcast in 4K ultra high definition (UHD) quality. True if 4K, false otherwise.

attributes.name: is_hd
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the programme is broadcast in high definition (HD) quality. True if HD, false if standard definition.

attributes.name: is_live
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this programme is broadcast live in real-time. True for live events such as sports and news, false for pre-recorded content.

attributes.name: is_repeat
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this broadcast is a repeat of previously aired content. True if repeat, false if original broadcast.

attributes.name: original_air_date
attributes.description: The date when the programme was first broadcast or released. Used to distinguish original broadcasts from repeats.

attributes.name: parental_control_pin_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a parental control PIN is required to view this programme. True if PIN is required based on content rating and subscriber parental control settings.

attributes.name: production_year
attributes.description: The year in which the programme was originally produced or released.

attributes.name: programme_genre
attributes.description: The primary genre classification of the programme content. Used for content discovery, recommendation engines, and parental control filtering. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Drama|Comedy|News|Sports|Documentary|Reality|Children|Movies|Music|Lifestyle — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: programme_subgenre
attributes.description: The secondary or more specific genre classification providing additional content categorization granularity.

attributes.name: programme_title
attributes.description: The display title of the programme as shown in the EPG guide on set-top boxes (STBs) and over-the-top (OTT) applications.

attributes.name: recording_allowed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether subscribers are permitted to record this programme using digital video recorder (DVR) functionality. Controlled by content licensing rights and digital rights management (DRM) policies.

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: The current status of this EPG schedule entry in its lifecycle. Scheduled indicates future broadcast, Live indicates currently broadcasting, Completed indicates past broadcast, Cancelled indicates the broadcast was cancelled, Rescheduled indicates the broadcast time was changed.

attributes.name: season_number
attributes.description: The season number within the series. Null for non-episodic content.

attributes.name: subtitle_language
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of language codes (ISO 639-1) for available subtitle tracks. Used for accessibility and multi-language support.

attributes.name: synopsis_long
attributes.description: A detailed description of the programme content, typically 200-500 characters, displayed in expanded EPG views and programme detail screens.

attributes.name: synopsis_short
attributes.description: A brief summary of the programme content, typically 50-100 characters, displayed in compact EPG views on set-top boxes (STBs) and mobile applications.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this EPG schedule record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: package
products.description: Defines commercial content packages that bundle VOD catalogs, OTT platform access, and/or channel lineups into a marketable offering (e.g., 'Entertainment Pack', 'Sports & Movies Bundle', 'Kids Plus'). Captures package name, package type (SVOD bundle, add-on, base tier), included content scope, OTT platforms included, pricing tier reference, availability market, effective dates, and package status. Referenced by the product catalog domain for commercial offer composition.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Product Offering / Content Bundle

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the content package. Primary key.

attributes.name: ad_insertion_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to content.ad_insertion_policy. Business justification: Packages need to reference an ad insertion policy that defines how ads are inserted for that package. This creates a 1:N relationship (many packages can share one policy).

attributes.name: catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the product catalog entry in the product domain for commercial offer composition and bundling.

attributes.name: enterprise_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.segment. Business justification: Content packages are designed and priced differently for enterprise segments (hospitality package vs. healthcare package vs. retail digital signage) with segment-specific content rights, SLAs, and fea

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Content packages are product offerings sold by specific business segments. Revenue recognition, ARPU calculation, and profitability analysis require attribution to profit centers for management report

attributes.name: segment_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.segment_definition. Business justification: Content packages are designed for specific customer segments (sports enthusiasts, family viewers, youth demographic) and assigned in targeted marketing campaigns and tier-based subscription models.

attributes.name: ad_supported
attributes.description: Indicates whether this package includes advertising-supported content (True) or is ad-free (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for this content package: draft (under development), pending_approval (submitted for review), approved (ready for activation), rejected (not approved).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Lifecycle Status

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this content package was approved. Null if not yet approved. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who approved this content package for activation. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this package automatically renews at the end of each billing cycle (True) or requires manual renewal (False).

attributes.name: availability_market
attributes.description: Geographic market or region where this content package is available for sale. Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or market identifiers (e.g., 'USA,CAN,MEX' or 'NORTH_AMERICA').

attributes.name: cdn_delivery_profile
attributes.description: CDN delivery profile tier assigned to this package, determining streaming quality, bitrate, and network priority: standard (SD/HD), premium (HD/FHD), ultra_hd (4K/UHD), adaptive (dynamic quality adjustment).

attributes.name: channel_count
attributes.description: Total number of linear IPTV channels included in the package. Null if no channel lineup is included.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: channel_lineup_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this package includes a linear IPTV channel lineup (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: content_genre
attributes.description: Primary content genre or category focus of the package (e.g., Sports, Movies, Kids, Entertainment, News, Documentary). Comma-separated if multiple genres apply.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: content_licensing_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or territory for which content licensing rights have been secured for this package. May differ from availability_market due to licensing restrictions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: content_refresh_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which new content is added or refreshed in this package: daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, on_demand (ad-hoc updates).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: content_scope
attributes.description: Textual description of the content included in the package: VOD (Video on Demand) catalog titles, OTT (Over-The-Top) platform access, IPTV (Internet Protocol Television) channel lineups, and any content genre or category inclusions (e.g., 'All Sports channels, 200+ movies, Kids content library').

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this content package record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this content package record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monthly recurring charge (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: drm_policy_code
attributes.description: Reference code for the DRM policy governing content protection, encryption, and usage rights enforcement for this package (e.g., WIDEVINE_L1, FAIRPLAY_STD).

attributes.name: early_termination_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged if the subscriber cancels the package before the minimum commitment period ends. Null if no early termination fee applies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this content package is no longer available for new sales. Null for open-ended packages. Existing subscribers may retain access beyond this date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this content package becomes available for sale and provisioning to subscribers. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: hd_content_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this package includes HD (High Definition) quality content (True) or is limited to SD (Standard Definition) (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this content package record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this content package record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: marketing_campaign_code
attributes.description: Reference code linking this content package to a specific marketing campaign or promotional initiative. Null if not associated with a campaign.

attributes.name: max_concurrent_streams
attributes.description: Maximum number of simultaneous streams allowed per subscriber account for this package. Null if unlimited or not applicable.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: minimum_commitment_months
attributes.description: Minimum subscription commitment period in months required for this package. Null if no minimum commitment applies (month-to-month).

attributes.name: monthly_recurring_charge
attributes.description: Standard monthly recurring charge for this content package in the base currency. Null if pricing is usage-based or bundled without separate charge.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: offline_download_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether subscribers can download content for offline viewing (True) or streaming-only access (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Characteristic

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the content package used in product catalogs and billing systems (e.g., ENT_PACK_01, SPORTS_MOVIES_BUNDLE).

attributes.name: package_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the content package, including value proposition, target audience, and key features for marketing and sales enablement.

attributes.name: package_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the content package (e.g., Entertainment Pack, Sports & Movies Bundle, Kids Plus).

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the content package: active (available for sale), inactive (temporarily unavailable), pending (awaiting approval), deprecated (phasing out), sunset (end-of-life), pilot (trial phase).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Lifecycle Status

attributes.name: package_type
attributes.description: Classification of the content package indicating its commercial structure: base_tier (foundational offering), add_on (supplementary to base), premium_bundle (high-value curated bundle), svod_bundle (Subscription Video on Demand bundle), tvod_pack (Transactional Video on Demand pack), channel_pack (linear channel lineup).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Specification Type

attributes.name: parental_control_rating
attributes.description: Maximum content rating included in this package, used for parental control enforcement. Based on MPAA (Motion Picture Association of America) film ratings or TV Parental Guidelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: G|PG|PG-13|R|NC-17|TV-Y|TV-Y7|TV-G|TV-PG|TV-14|TV-MA — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: MPAA Film Ratings / TV Parental Guidelines

attributes.name: pricing_tier_reference
attributes.description: Reference code linking this content package to a pricing tier or rate plan in the billing system (e.g., TIER_BASIC, TIER_PREMIUM, TIER_FAMILY). Used for commercial offer composition.

Captures source content reference, ingestion request date, source file details, transcoding configuration (codec, resolution, bitrate, HDR format, ABR ladder), QA status, DRM packaging status, CDN publish status, job completion timestamp, and error details. Operational SSOT for content onboarding lifecycle including technical encoding specifications applied during processing.

products.name: rights_window

Enables automated content availability management aligned with studio distribution agreements.

products.name: ott_subscription
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between ott_platform and corporate_account. It captures the commercial and technical terms under which a corporate account subscribes to or integrates an OTT streaming platform as part of their enterprise service bundle. Each record links one ott_platform to one corporate_account with attributes that exist only in the context of this subscription relationship, including integration configuration, SSO settings, revenue sharing terms, and contract lifecycle dates.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications B2B operations, corporate accounts subscribe to multiple OTT streaming platforms as part of bundled enterprise service offerings (e.g., a hotel chain offering Netflix, Disney+, and HBO Max to guests; a corporate office providing streaming benefits to employees). Each OTT platform serves multiple corporate accounts with account-specific commercial terms, integration configurations, and contract dates. The business actively manages these subscriptions as operational entities with distinct SSO settings, provisioning modes, revenue share terms, and lifecycle states per account-platform pair.

products.name: lineup_channel_membership

products.name: package_territory_availability

products.name: performance_measurement
products.description: SSOT for time-series performance measurement records collected at the network-element layer from Nokia NetAct and Ericsson Network Manager across RAN, transport, and core domains. Captures infrastructure-level KPIs: RSRP, SINR, cell throughput, packet loss, latency, link utilization, node availability, and capacity metrics. Each record captures measurement object (cell/link/node/shelf/port), KPI name, measurement interval (15-min/1-hour/24-hour), raw value, threshold value, threshold breach flag, measurement source (OSS/EMS/NMS), collection timestamp, and source system. Serves as the unified network-element measurement store for availability computation, capacity planning, and threshold breach detection. Service-layer and bearer-level QoS measurements are owned by qos_measurement. Aligns with eTOM process 1.1.2 Performance Management.

attributes.name: sla_type

products.name: reconciliation_run
products.description: Master record of a revenue assurance reconciliation execution with embedded control definition and line-level discrepancy detail. Control layer captures: control name, control category (CDR completeness/rating accuracy/provisioning-billing alignment/interconnect settlement/prepaid balance integrity), control type (automated/manual/hybrid), execution frequency, source system monitored, target system compared, and detection rule description. Run header captures: run ID, reconciliation type (CDR-to-bill/inventory-to-provisioning/interconnect-TAP/prepaid-balance/CDR-completeness-audit), source system, target system, run timestamps, total records processed, matched/unmatched counts, expected vs received record counts, duplicate/missing/rejected record counts, discrepancy amount, run status, trigger method, CDR file references, mediation system reference, and assigned analyst. Detail layer captures: individual discrepancy records with discrepancy ID, discrepancy type (missing CDR/duplicate charge/rating mismatch/inventory gap/file gap), source and target record references, discrepancy amount, direction (over-charge/under-charge/unbilled), resolution status, resolution action, and resolved timestamp. Enables control framework management, summary-level reconciliation tracking, CDR completeness auditing, and drill-down to individual discrepancy items. Aligns with eTOM process 1.1.5 Revenue Assurance.
products.reference: TM Forum GB941 / Revenue Assurance Reconciliation

attributes.name: target_created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created the sales target record.

attributes.name: target_name

attributes.name: target_status

attributes.name: target_type

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: Numeric goal value for the target. For revenue targets, this is the monetary amount; for activations, the subscriber count; for ARPU, the per-user revenue amount; for churn saves, the retention count.

attributes.description: Performance threshold above which accelerated incentive rates apply (e.g., 120% attainment triggers 1.5x commission rate). Null if no accelerator applies.

attributes.name: threshold_minimum

attributes.name: product_interest

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: promotion
products.description: Master record for a sales promotion or incentive offer applicable during the sales process — device subsidies, free months, bundle discounts, port-in bonuses, BYOD credits, and enterprise volume discounts — with full redemption transaction tracking. Captures promotion code, type, eligible segments, eligible products, discount value/percentage, start/end dates, redemption limits, stacking rules, and individual redemption records (redemption date, quote/order/contract reference, applied discount value, redemption channel, applying rep/dealer, validation status). Distinct from billing-layer promotions — this is the sales-stage commercial offer. SSOT boundary: sales.promotion owns offers presented during the sales process; product domain owns catalog-level pricing rules and permanent price structures.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Promotion

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sales promotion or incentive offer. Primary key.

attributes.name: promotion_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or email of the user who last modified this promotion record. Used for change tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: target_catalog_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.catalog_item. Business justification: Promotions often target specific catalog items (e.g., "50% off iPhone 15 with unlimited plan"). This link is essential for promotion eligibility validation, redemption tracking, and measuring promotio

attributes.name: target_product_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_category. Business justification: Many promotions apply to entire product categories rather than individual SKUs (e.g., "20% off all broadband plans"). Enables category-level promotional campaign management, eligibility validation, an

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Role or title of the person/system authorized to approve redemption of this promotion (e.g., 'Sales Manager', 'Regional Director', 'Automated Credit Check System'). Null if approval_required_flag is False.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether redemption of this promotion requires manager or system approval before it can be applied to a quote or order. True = approval workflow required, False = auto-apply allowed.

attributes.name: auto_apply_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion should be automatically applied to eligible quotes and orders without requiring manual entry of the promotion code. True = auto-apply, False = manual code entry required.

attributes.name: budget_allocated
attributes.description: Total budget allocated for this promotion in the promotion's currency. Used to track financial exposure and prevent overspending. Null if no budget cap applies.

attributes.name: budget_consumed
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of budget consumed by redemptions of this promotion to date. Incremented with each redemption. Used to enforce budget_allocated cap and track Return on Investment (ROI).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for budget_allocated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null if budget_allocated is null.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: discount_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for fixed_amount discounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null for percentage or free_unit discount types.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the discount is applied: percentage (e.g., 20% off), fixed_amount (e.g., $50 off), free_unit (e.g., 3 months free service).

attributes.name: discount_value
attributes.description: Numeric value of the discount. Interpretation depends on discount_type: for percentage, this is the percentage (e.g., 20.00 for 20%); for fixed_amount, this is the currency amount (e.g., 50.00 for $50); for free_unit, this is the number of units (e.g., 3.00 for 3 months).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: eligible_customer_segment
attributes.description: Target customer segment eligible for this promotion: b2c_consumer (retail individual), b2b_smb (small/medium business), b2b_enterprise (large corporate), mvno_wholesale (Mobile Virtual Network Operator partners), all_segments (universal offer).

attributes.name: eligible_product_category
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories or SKU patterns eligible for this promotion (e.g., 'wireless_postpaid', 'fiber_internet', 'device_smartphone', 'all_products'). Used to constrain which products can receive the discount.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion expires and is no longer available for new redemptions. Null indicates an open-ended promotion.

attributes.name: exclusion_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product SKUs, customer IDs, or other identifiers explicitly excluded from this promotion. Used to enforce business rules and prevent unintended redemptions.

attributes.name: external_promotion_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this promotion in the source system (e.g., Salesforce Campaign ID, Netcracker Offering ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage.

attributes.name: geographic_eligibility
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions, states, or countries where this promotion is valid (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'CA,NY,TX', 'all_regions'). Used to enforce regional marketing campaigns and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this promotion record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: minimum_contract_term_months
attributes.description: Minimum service contract duration in months required to qualify for this promotion. For example, a device subsidy may require a 24-month commitment. Null if no minimum term applies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Term

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_amount
attributes.description: Minimum order or quote value required to qualify for this promotion. For example, enterprise volume discounts may require a $10,000 minimum. Null if no minimum applies.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for minimum_purchase_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null if minimum_purchase_amount is null.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal sales operations or marketing notes about this promotion. Not customer-facing. Used for operational guidance and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking used to determine which promotion to apply when multiple promotions are eligible and stacking is not allowed. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (e.g., 1 = highest priority).

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code used to identify and apply the promotion during the sales process. This is the code customers or sales reps enter to activate the offer.

attributes.name: promotion_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the promotion, including terms and conditions, eligibility criteria, and customer-facing messaging. Used for sales rep guidance and customer communication.

attributes.name: promotion_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the promotion (e.g., 'Summer Device Subsidy', 'Port-In Bonus Q1 2024', 'Enterprise Volume Discount Tier 3').

attributes.name: promotion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the promotion: draft (not yet live), active (available for redemption), suspended (temporarily paused), expired (end date passed), terminated (manually closed).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Lifecycle

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotion by incentive mechanism: device_subsidy (handset discount), free_months (service waiver), bundle_discount (multi-product discount), port_in_bonus (Mobile Number Portability incentive), byod_credit (Bring Your Own Device credit), volume_discount (enterprise bulk pricing).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Type

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: Current count of how many times this promotion has been redeemed. Incremented with each successful application. Used to enforce redemption_limit_total.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: redemption_limit_per_customer
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a single customer can redeem this promotion. Null indicates no per-customer cap. Prevents abuse and controls discount exposure.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: redemption_limit_total
attributes.description: Maximum number of times this promotion can be redeemed across all customers and transactions. Null indicates no cap. Used for limited-time or limited-quantity offers.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record where this promotion was originally created: salesforce_crm (Salesforce CRM opportunity/campaign), netcracker_catalog (Netcracker product catalog), manual_entry (direct data entry), marketing_automation (external marketing platform).

attributes.name: stacking_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion can be combined (stacked) with other promotions on the same quote or order. True = stackable, False = exclusive (cannot be combined).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: stacking_rule
attributes.description: Detailed business rule describing stacking behavior and constraints. For example: 'Can stack with device subsidies but not with other service discounts', 'Mutually exclusive with promotion codes PROMO2024*'. Null if stacking_allowed_flag is False.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when the promotion becomes active and available for redemption. Promotions cannot be applied before this date.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terms and Conditions Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL link to the full legal terms and conditions document for this promotion. Required for regulatory compliance and customer transparency.

Enables promotion utilization tracking and prevents over-redemption against defined limits.

attributes.description: The date and time when the promotion redemption was approved. Nullable if no approval was required or if still pending.

attributes.description: The number of months for which the promotion benefit applies. Nullable for one-time or unlimited duration promotions.

attributes.description: The date and time when this redemption record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: max_redemptions_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of times this promotion can be redeemed within the defined limit scope. Nullable for unlimited promotions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this promotion redemption. Used to capture additional context or special circumstances.

attributes.name: promotion_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotion benefit becomes active for the customer. May differ from redemption date for future-dated promotions.

attributes.name: promotion_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotion benefit expires or ends. Defines the duration of the promotional offer.

attributes.name: recurring_benefit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion provides a recurring benefit over multiple billing cycles. True for ongoing discounts, false for one-time discounts.

attributes.name: redemption_channel

attributes.name: redemption_code
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric code or voucher number entered or scanned by the customer or sales representative to activate the promotion.

attributes.name: redemption_count
attributes.description: The sequential count of this redemption within the applicable limit scope. Used to enforce maximum redemption limits.

attributes.name: redemption_date
attributes.description: The calendar date when the promotion was redeemed. Used for day-level reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: redemption_limit_type
attributes.description: The scope or level at which redemption limits are enforced for this promotion. Defines the boundary for usage tracking.

attributes.name: redemption_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the promotion was applied to the quote, order, or contract. Represents the business event time of redemption.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion redemption has been reversed or cancelled. True if the redemption was subsequently voided.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The business reason or explanation for reversing this promotion redemption. Nullable if redemption has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this promotion redemption was reversed. Nullable if redemption has not been reversed.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The category of telecommunications service to which the promotion applies. Enables service-line specific promotion tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobile|broadband|fiber|iptv|voip|enterprise|iot|wholesale — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that originated this redemption record. Indicates the system of record for this transaction.

attributes.name: validation_message
attributes.description: Detailed message or reason code explaining the validation outcome. Provides context for failed or pending validations.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation state of the promotion redemption. Indicates whether the redemption passed eligibility and fraud checks.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the promotion redemption was validated or when validation status was last updated.

products.name: channel_offering
products.description: This association product represents the commercial availability contract between offering and channel. It captures the go-to-market strategy execution by defining which offerings are sold through which channels, with channel-specific pricing overrides, inventory allocation, launch timing, and performance tracking. Each record links one offering to one channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this channel-offering relationship.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications go-to-market operations, offerings are distributed through multiple sales channels simultaneously (retail stores, online, telesales, dealers, MVNO partners), and each channel carries a portfolio of multiple offerings. The business actively manages these channel-offering assignments as operational entities with channel-specific attributes including launch timing, commission overrides, inventory allocation, training requirements, and performance tracking that cannot be stored on either the offering or channel entity alone.

products.name: channel_promotion_eligibility
products.description: This association product represents the configuration and management of promotion availability across sales channels. It captures which promotions are eligible for use in which channels, with channel-specific business rules, inventory limits, performance tracking, and effective date ranges. Each record links one promotion to one channel with attributes that exist only in the context of this channel-specific promotion configuration. This is an actively managed operational entity used by marketing operations and sales operations teams to control promotion distribution, track channel-level redemption performance, and enforce channel-specific terms.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications sales operations, promotions are actively configured for availability across multiple sales channels, and each channel offers multiple promotions simultaneously. Marketing operations and sales operations teams manage this as a distinct business process: they configure which promotions are available in which channels, set channel-specific inventory allocations, define channel-specific effective dates (for phased rollouts), establish channel-specific terms, and track redemption performance by channel. This is not a reference lookup or analytical correlation - it is an operational configuration entity that humans create, update, and monitor.

products.name: account_team_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the assignment of employees to B2B account plan teams in enterprise telecommunications sales. It captures the multi-person team structure required for complex enterprise account management, where each account plan requires multiple specialized roles (account executive, solutions architect, customer success manager, technical specialist) and each employee participates in multiple account plans simultaneously. Each record links one B2B account plan to one employee with role, assignment period, responsibility scope, and coverage allocation.. Existence Justification: In enterprise telecommunications sales, B2B account plans require multi-person teams with specialized roles (account executive, solutions architect, customer success manager, technical specialists). Each account plan has multiple team members assigned simultaneously, and each employee participates in multiple account plans concurrently. The business actively manages these assignments with role definitions, time allocation percentages, and assignment periods.

products.name: lawful_intercept_order
products.description: Authoritative record of lawful intercept orders received under CALEA (US), RIPA/IPA (UK), EU Data Retention Directive, and equivalent international mandates, including full delivery lifecycle. Captures court order reference, issuing authority, target identifier (MSISDN, IMSI, IP address, email), intercept type (content, metadata, both), activation/expiry dates, intercept status, handling officer, and chain-of-custody log. Includes all delivery records as line items: delivery timestamp, delivery method (secure FTP, physical media, network handoff via ETSI LI interfaces), data volume, delivery confirmation reference, receiving LEA officer, and delivery status. Strictly access-controlled as restricted data with need-to-know enforcement. SSOT for the complete lawful intercept lifecycle from order receipt through data delivery, confirmation, and closure.
