attributes.description: Date and time when the customer provided or modified the CPNI authorization. Critical for regulatory compliance and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Authorization Type
attributes.description: Type of CPNI authorization action: opt_in (customer grants consent), opt_out (customer denies consent), renewal (periodic reconfirmation), withdrawal (customer revokes prior consent), modification (scope change).

attributes.name: certification_period_year
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Certification Period Year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this authorization is included in the annual CPNI certification filing to the FCC. Format: YYYY.

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Consent Scope
attributes.description: Scope of CPNI usage authorized by the customer: marketing (promotional offers), service_enhancement (network optimization), third_party_sharing (partner disclosures), all_purposes (unrestricted), limited (specific use case only).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CPNI authorization record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_authentication_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify customer identity before accepting CPNI authorization, as required by FCC rules: password, PIN, biometric, security_question, two_factor, account_number, ssn_last_four, none (for written/signed forms). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: password|pin|biometric|security_question|two_factor|account_number|ssn_last_four|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: customer_notification_of_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether affected customers were notified of the CPNI breach. True if notified, False otherwise. Required for material breaches.

attributes.name: customer_notification_of_breach_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when affected customers were notified of the CPNI breach. Null if not notified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days this CPNI authorization record must be retained per regulatory requirements. Typically minimum 2 years (730 days) per FCC rules.

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device used to submit the authorization (e.g., mobile device ID, browser fingerprint). Used for security and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Authorization Effective Date
attributes.description: Date from which the CPNI authorization becomes active and enforceable. May differ from authorization_timestamp if customer specifies future effective date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Authorization Expiration Date
attributes.description: Date when the CPNI authorization expires and must be renewed. Nullable for indefinite authorizations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.

attributes.name: fcc_notification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Communications Commission (FCC) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FCC notification is required for this violation (True if 5000+ customers affected or other mandatory criteria met). False if no notification required or no violation.

attributes.name: fcc_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of FCC notification for CPNI violation: not_required (below threshold), pending (notification due), submitted (filed with FCC), acknowledged (FCC confirmed receipt), none (no violation).

attributes.name: fcc_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when FCC was notified of the CPNI violation. Must be within 7 business days of detection for breaches affecting 5000+ customers. Null if not applicable. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the customer submitted the CPNI authorization (for web/mobile channels). Used for fraud detection and audit trail. Supports IPv4 and IPv6.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this CPNI authorization record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and compliance verification. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether law enforcement (FBI, Secret Service, local authorities) was notified of the CPNI violation. True if notified, False otherwise.

attributes.name: law_enforcement_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when law enforcement was notified of the CPNI violation. Null if not notified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Authorization Notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special circumstances, or compliance officer comments related to this CPNI authorization or violation.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Channel used to send confirmation notification to customer: email, SMS, postal_mail, in_app, none (if no notification sent).

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a confirmation notification was sent to the customer after CPNI authorization was recorded. True if sent, False otherwise.

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when confirmation notification was sent to customer. Null if notification_sent_flag is False. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: remediation_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of remediation actions taken to address the CPNI violation and prevent recurrence. Includes technical, process, and policy changes. Null if no violation.

attributes.name: remediation_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all remediation actions for the CPNI violation were completed and verified. Null if remediation ongoing or no violation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: responsible_officer_name
attributes.description: Name of the corporate officer responsible for CPNI compliance oversight for this authorization record. Required for annual certification attestation.

attributes.name: responsible_officer_title
attributes.description: Corporate title of the officer responsible for CPNI compliance (e.g., Chief Compliance Officer, VP Legal, Chief Privacy Officer).

attributes.name: store_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the retail store location where the CPNI authorization was captured. Applicable only for retail_store channel.

attributes.name: violation_closure_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Violation Closure Status
attributes.description: Current status of the CPNI violation case: open (active incident), remediated (actions complete, awaiting verification), closed (fully resolved), under_investigation (root cause analysis ongoing), none (no violation).

attributes.name: violation_detection_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Violation Detection Method
attributes.description: Method by which the CPNI violation was detected: internal_audit, customer_complaint, system_alert, regulatory_inspection, third_party_report, none (if no violation).

attributes.name: violation_detection_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Violation Detection Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the CPNI violation was first detected. Null if no violation. Critical for FCC 7-business-day notification requirement. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: violation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Violation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization record is associated with a CPNI violation or breach incident. True if violation occurred, False otherwise.

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Proprietary Network Information (CPNI) Violation Type
attributes.description: Type of CPNI violation if violation_flag is True: unauthorized_disclosure (CPNI shared without consent), improper_access (internal unauthorized access), pretexting (fraudulent identity theft), inadequate_safeguards (security failure), none (no violation).

products.name: audit_finding
products.description: Transactional record of findings and associated remediation actions identified during internal or external compliance audits, including ISO/IEC 27001 surveillance audits, FCC compliance reviews, and internal control assessments. Captures finding type (non-conformity, observation, opportunity for improvement), severity, audit reference, affected control or obligation, finding description, root cause category, assigned remediation owner, remediation steps, target and actual completion dates, evidence of completion, verification status, and closure date. SSOT for the complete finding-to-remediation lifecycle.

products.name: data_breach_incident
products.description: Master record of personal data breach incidents covering the complete lifecycle from detection through regulatory notification, individual notification, and closure. products.name: coverage_obligation
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between a regulatory obligation and a specific coverage area. It captures obligation-specific compliance tracking for geographic coverage requirements including universal service obligations (USO), rural broadband mandates, franchise build-out commitments, and spectrum license coverage conditions. Each record links one regulatory obligation to one coverage area with compliance status, required vs. actual coverage metrics, assessment dates, and exemption status that exist only in the context of this specific obligation-area pairing.. Existence Justification: Telecommunications operators face multiple geographic coverage obligations from different regulatory authorities (FCC universal service obligations, state franchise build-out commitments, spectrum license coverage conditions, rural broadband mandates). Each regulatory obligation applies to multiple coverage areas across the operator's service territory, and each coverage area is simultaneously subject to multiple overlapping obligations. The business actively manages compliance on a per-obligation-per-area basis, tracking required vs. actual coverage percentages, assessment dates, compliance status, and remediation plans for each unique pairing.

products.name: account_obligation
products.description: This association product represents the compliance relationship between a corporate account and a regulatory obligation. It captures account-specific compliance tracking, assessment history, and responsibility assignment for each obligation applicable to each enterprise customer. Each record links one regulatory_obligation to one corporate_account with attributes that track the account's specific compliance posture, due dates, responsible officers, and exemption status for that particular obligation.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications regulatory compliance, each regulatory obligation (CALEA, GDPR, E911, spectrum license conditions, etc.) applies to multiple corporate accounts based on their service portfolio, jurisdictions served, and industry vertical. Conversely, each corporate account is subject to multiple regulatory obligations simultaneously. The compliance function actively manages this many-to-many relationship by tracking account-specific compliance status, assessment schedules, responsible officers, exemptions, and risk levels for each account-obligation pairing.

products.name: audit_rule_test
products.description: This association product represents the testing event between compliance_audit and dq_rule. It captures the execution and results of testing a specific data quality rule during a compliance audit engagement. Each record links one compliance_audit to one dq_rule with test execution metadata, pass/fail status, sample size, findings count, and auditor observations that exist only in the context of this audit-rule test relationship.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications compliance operations, auditors test multiple data quality rules during each audit engagement (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI-DSS, regulatory inspections), and each DQ rule is tested across multiple audits over time. The business actively manages audit rule testing as a distinct compliance activity, tracking test execution dates, pass/fail outcomes, sample sizes, findings counts, and auditor observations for each audit-rule combination to build regulatory evidence trails and demonstrate continuous compliance.

attributes.name: regulatory_obligation_id

attributes.name: assessment_frequency
attributes.description: How often the control is assessed for effectiveness.

attributes.name: assessment_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the latest assessment.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Higher‑level grouping of the control within the compliance framework.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Unique business code assigned to the control (e.g., ISO‑27001 control identifier).

attributes.name: compliance_framework

attributes.name: control_cost_usd

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the control record was initially captured.

attributes.name: document_url

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until

attributes.name: effectiveness_score

attributes.name: is_mandatory

attributes.name: last_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent assessment of the control.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the control.

attributes.name: next_assessment_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the upcoming assessment.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for the control.

attributes.name: owner_contact
attributes.description: Primary contact information (email or phone) for the control owner.

attributes.name: owner_department
attributes.description: Organizational unit that holds accountability for the control.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the control for remediation scheduling.

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Governing authority overseeing the compliance requirement.

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Description of actions required to address identified gaps.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk rating associated with the control based on impact and likelihood.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system or application where the control record was first created.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the control.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of the control based on its purpose.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the control record.

attributes.name: parent_control_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on control (parent_control_id)

attributes.name: annual_certification_id

attributes.name: attached_document_path

attributes.name: audit_date

attributes.name: audit_findings_summary
attributes.description: High‑level summary of audit observations and any non‑conformities.

attributes.name: auditor_name

attributes.name: certification_body

attributes.name: certification_level

attributes.name: certification_name

attributes.name: certification_number

attributes.name: certification_type

attributes.name: compliance_area
attributes.description: Business domain or regulatory area covered by the certification (e.g., privacy, spectrum, security).

attributes.name: compliance_requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the certification record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: is_mandatory

attributes.name: issuing_authority

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: renewal_date

attributes.name: renewal_status

attributes.name: status

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: prior_annual_certification_id

domains.name: finance
domains.description: SSOT for corporate financial management — general ledger, accounts payable, cost accounting, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, budgeting, financial planning, EBITDA analysis, ROI measurement, procurement, financial consolidation, and intercompany transactions. Managed via SAP S/4HANA Finance and Procurement modules.
domains.references: IFRS 15 (Revenue Recognition), GAAP, TM Forum eTOM Financial Management, SAP S/4HANA

products.name: general_ledger
products.description: SSOT for the corporate chart of accounts and GL account master data in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Each record represents a single GL account with its account number, description, account type (P&L, balance sheet, statistical), account group, controlling area assignment, currency settings, and tax category. Serves as the foundational reference for all financial postings, trial balance generation, and statutory/management reporting across the telecom enterprise. Does NOT store balances or postings — those reside in journal_entry.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA GL Account Master (SKA1/SKB1)

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account master record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - GL Account Master (SKA1/SKB1)

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts_id
attributes.description: Reference to the chart of accounts to which this GL account belongs. Supports multi-entity consolidation and statutory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Chart of Accounts (SKA1-KTOPL)

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the company code for which this GL account is configured. Enables company-specific account properties and local statutory reporting.

attributes.name: controlling_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlling area for management accounting and cost center assignment. Links financial accounting to cost accounting for OPEX and CAPEX tracking.

attributes.name: cost_element_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost element in controlling (CO) module. Links GL account to cost accounting for CAPEX/OPEX tracking and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: functional_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the functional area for segment reporting and cost-of-sales accounting. Enables classification by business function (e.g., network operations, sales, administration).

attributes.name: house_bank_id
attributes.description: Reference to the house bank associated with this GL account for cash management and bank reconciliation. Applicable to bank clearing accounts.

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: Account group code that controls field status, number range assignment, and screen layout for the GL account. Defines account behavior and validation rules.

attributes.name: account_name_long
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the GL account providing complete business context and purpose of the account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - GL Account Master (SKA1-TXT50)

attributes.name: account_name_short
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account, typically 20-40 characters, used in reports and user interfaces for quick identification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - GL Account Master (SKA1-TXT20)

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account. Active accounts accept postings; inactive accounts are retained for historical reporting; blocked accounts prevent new postings; pending closure accounts are scheduled for deactivation.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the account into balance sheet (asset, liability, equity) or profit and loss (revenue, expense) categories, or statistical for non-financial tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Account Type (SKA1-XBILK); IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Alternative or legacy account number used for mapping to external systems, prior chart of accounts, or regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_account_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification for balance sheet accounts into current vs. fixed assets, current vs. long-term liabilities, and equity for liquidity analysis and financial ratio calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Balance Sheet Account Type; IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: cash_flow_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account are relevant for cash flow statement generation. True includes transactions in operating, investing, or financing cash flow categories.
attributes.references: IAS 7 - Statement of Cash Flows; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created this GL account master record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this GL account master record was created in the system. Supports audit trail and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account's local currency. Determines currency in which balances are maintained and reported.

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: Field status group code that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during posting transactions to this account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Field Status Group (SKB1-FSTAG)

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: Financial statement line item code to which this GL account maps for balance sheet and income statement reporting. Enables automated financial statement generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - FS Item (SKA1-BILKT); IFRS; US GAAP

attributes.name: gl_account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number in the chart of accounts. Typically 6-10 digit numeric code used as the business identifier for all financial postings and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - GL Account Master (SKA1-SAKNR); ISO 20022

attributes.name: inflation_key
attributes.description: Inflation index key used for inflation-adjusted reporting in hyperinflationary economies. Enables IAS 29 compliance for financial statement restatement.
attributes.references: IAS 29 - Financial Reporting in Hyperinflationary Economies; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: interest_indicator
attributes.description: Interest calculation indicator code that determines whether and how interest is calculated on balances in this account (e.g., for customer deposits, vendor payables).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this GL account master record was last modified. Tracks change history for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items are stored and can be displayed for this account. True enables drill-down to transaction-level detail; false stores only balances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Line Item Display (SKB1-XINTB)

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is active for this account. True enables tracking of open and cleared items for accounts requiring item-level reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Open Item Management (SKB1-XOPVW)

attributes.name: planning_level
attributes.description: Planning level code indicating the granularity at which budget planning and forecasting is performed for this account (e.g., cost center, profit center, segment).

attributes.name: posting_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account are blocked. True prevents any new transactions from being posted to the account.

attributes.name: profit_center_update_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether profit center is a mandatory field for postings to this account. True enforces profit center assignment for segment profitability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Profit Center Update (SKB1-XPCTB)

attributes.name: profit_loss_account_type
attributes.description: Classification for P&L accounts distinguishing between primary costs (direct), secondary costs (allocated), revenue, and other categories for cost accounting and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - P&L Account Type (SKA1-GVTYP)

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account for subledgers (accounts receivable, accounts payable, asset accounting). True if subledger postings automatically update this GL account.

attributes.name: sample_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a sample or template account used for training or testing purposes. True excludes account from production reporting.

attributes.name: segment_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is relevant for segment reporting under IFRS 8. True includes account balances in segment-level financial statements.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 - Operating Segments; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Default sort key code that determines the assignment number format for postings to this account (e.g., by posting date, document number, or custom logic).

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax category code indicating whether the account is subject to input tax, output tax, or is tax-exempt. Controls automatic tax calculation on postings.

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: Tolerance group code that defines permissible payment differences, cash discount limits, and exchange rate variances for postings to this account.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account is valid and available for posting transactions. Supports time-dependent account configuration.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this GL account is valid. Null indicates the account is valid indefinitely. Used for account lifecycle management and historical reporting.

attributes.name: valuation_group
attributes.description: Valuation group code used for foreign currency valuation and mark-to-market adjustments. Determines valuation method for balance sheet accounts.
attributes.references: IAS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA Finance

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: SSOT for all financial postings to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA). Captures document header (posting date, fiscal period, document type, company code, currency, reference, posting user) and individual line items (GL account, debit/credit amount in transaction/local currency, cost center, profit center, WBS element, tax code, assignment field). Each entry is the atomic unit of financial accounting covering CAPEX activations, OPEX accruals, intercompany settlements, revenue recognition, and period-end adjustments. Supports trial balance generation, P&L/balance sheet reporting, and EBITDA decomposition.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA BKPF (Accounting Document Header)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry product.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Journal entry is posted to a legal entity. N:1 relationship (many journal entries per company). The company_code_id FK will link to company_code.company_code_id. The existing company_code STRING attri

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry may be assigned to a cost center for cost tracking. N:1 relationship (many journal entries per cost center). The cost_center_id FK will link to cost_center.cost_center_id. The existing c

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entry may be assigned to a profit center for profitability analysis. N:1 relationship (many journal entries per profit center). The profit_center_id FK will link to profit_center.profit_center

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-text field used for additional reference information such as invoice numbers, purchase order numbers, or payment references. Supports reconciliation and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The reference date from which payment due dates and cash discount periods are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business segment or division for cross-company code reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements by business line (e.g., wireless, broadband, enterprise services).

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry line item was cleared through payment, reconciliation, or offsetting entry. Used for accounts receivable, accounts payable, and balance sheet reconciliation.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The accounting document number that cleared this journal entry line item. Links the original entry to its settlement or reconciliation document.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The organizational unit representing the legal entity for which financial statements are prepared. Identifies the company within the SAP S/4HANA system.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The organizational unit responsible for the costs or revenues recorded in the journal entry. Used for internal management accounting, OPEX tracking, and departmental P&L analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry record was first created in the SAP S/4HANA system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the journal entry line item is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental accounting classification for double-entry bookkeeping and trial balance generation.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the original business transaction or source document that triggered the journal entry. May differ from posting date for backdated or delayed entries.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA. This is the business identifier for the journal entry used in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification code that categorizes the journal entry by its business purpose (e.g., invoice, payment, accrual, reversal, CAPEX activation, intercompany settlement). Determines posting rules and account determination logic.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due based on payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting and accounts payable/receivable aging analysis.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date when the journal entry was physically entered into the SAP S/4HANA system by the user. Used for audit trail and data entry tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the journal entry was posted. Supports monthly and quarterly financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the journal entry was posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing processes.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry by business function (e.g., sales, marketing, network operations, customer service, administration). Used for functional cost analysis and EBITDA reporting by function.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which the journal entry line item is posted. Represents the chart of accounts classification for financial statement line items (assets, liabilities, equity, revenue, expenses).

attributes.name: group_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the journal entry line item translated into the corporate group's reporting currency. Used for consolidated financial reporting and group-wide analytics.

attributes.name: group_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the corporate group's reporting currency. Used for consolidated financial statements and group-level EBITDA analysis.

attributes.name: intercompany_partner
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transactions. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: The internal order number used to collect costs for specific activities, campaigns, or short-term projects. Supports detailed cost tracking for OPEX initiatives and overhead allocation.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: The ledger classification for parallel accounting scenarios (e.g., local GAAP, IFRS, tax ledger). Supports multiple accounting principles within the Universal Journal.

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the journal entry line item translated into the company code's local currency. Used for statutory financial statements and local GAAP reporting.

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the company code's local currency. Used for legal entity financial statements and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the journal entry record was last modified in the SAP S/4HANA system. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining due date calculation and cash discount conditions. Used for accounts payable and accounts receivable management.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the principal business event timestamp that determines the fiscal period assignment and financial statement impact.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit code that controls whether a line item is a debit or credit and determines the account type (GL, customer, vendor, asset). Standard SAP posting keys include 40 (debit GL), 50 (credit GL), 01 (debit customer), 11 (credit customer), 31 (debit vendor), 21 (credit vendor).

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Posted indicates the entry is final and impacts the general ledger; parked indicates a draft entry pending approval; cleared indicates the entry has been reconciled; reversed indicates the entry has been reversed.

attributes.name: posting_user
attributes.description: The SAP user ID of the person who posted the journal entry. Used for audit trail, segregation of duties monitoring, and user activity tracking.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: The organizational unit for which separate profit and loss statements are prepared. Enables segment reporting and business unit performance analysis for EBITDA decomposition.

attributes.name: reference_key
attributes.description: Additional reference field for external document numbers, contract references, or cross-system identifiers. Used for traceability to source systems and external documents.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous posting. True if the entry reverses a prior transaction, false otherwise. Used for accrual reversals and error corrections.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for the reversal (e.g., error correction, accrual reversal, period-end adjustment). Supports audit requirements and financial control processes.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The accounting document number of the original journal entry that is being reversed by this entry. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Maintains audit trail for reversals.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: The reportable segment for external financial reporting under IFRS 8 or ASC 280. Supports segment disclosure requirements for regulatory filings with FCC and SEC.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount in the transaction currency. Represents sales tax, VAT, GST, or other indirect taxes associated with the journal entry.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction and rate code applied to the journal entry line item. Determines tax calculation for sales tax, VAT, GST, or other indirect taxes.

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the journal entry line item providing business context and explanation. Used for audit documentation and financial statement notes.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount of the journal entry line item in the transaction currency. Represents the original business transaction value before currency translation.

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the original transaction was denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The project or investment program identifier for CAPEX tracking. Links journal entries to capital projects for asset under construction accounting and project cost management.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual line item within a journal entry posting, representing a debit or credit to a specific GL account, cost center, profit center, or WBS element. Captures amount in transaction and local currency, tax code, assignment field, and controlling object references. Essential for granular P&L and balance sheet analysis, EBITDA decomposition, and CAPEX/OPEX classification in the telecom finance domain.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA BSEG (Accounting Document Segment)

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for granular financial transaction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Document Line Item

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry line may be assigned to a cost center for detailed cost tracking. N:1 relationship (many line items per cost center). The cost_center_id FK will link to cost_center.cost_center_id. The e

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Journal entry line posts to a specific GL account. N:1 relationship (many line items per GL account). The general_ledger_id FK will link to general_ledger.general_ledger_id. The existing gl_account_co

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header document. Links this line to the overall posting transaction.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entry line may be assigned to a profit center for detailed profitability analysis. N:1 relationship (many line items per profit center). The profit_center_id FK will link to profit_center.prof

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item converted to the local reporting currency of the legal entity. Used for statutory reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency
attributes.description: The monetary amount of this line item in the original transaction currency. Used for multi-currency operations and foreign exchange tracking.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Fixed asset number for asset-related postings. Links journal entries to network infrastructure assets, CAPEX investments, and depreciation schedules.

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: Sub-asset number for detailed asset component tracking. Enables granular depreciation and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: Free-text assignment field for additional reference information such as invoice numbers, contract IDs, or project phases. Enhances traceability and audit trail.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation. Determines due date for accounts payable and receivable items.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area classification for cross-company code reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this line item was cleared. Indicates when an open item was settled or matched.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing transaction if this line item has been cleared. Used for accounts payable/receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system account that created this journal entry line. Supports audit and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry line record was created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_code
attributes.description: Customer account number for accounts receivable line items. Links revenue postings to customer master data and ARPU analysis.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area for cost-of-sales accounting and functional P&L reporting. Distinguishes between operations, sales, administration, and R&D costs.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which this line item is posted. Core dimension for P&L and balance sheet classification.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Internal order used for tracking specific cost collection objects such as maintenance orders, marketing campaigns, or overhead allocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system account that last modified this journal entry line. Maintains change history for compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry line was last modified. Tracks changes for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry document. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Line Item Sequencing

attributes.name: line_item_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this line item. Tracks lifecycle from initial posting through clearing or blocking.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local reporting currency. Typically the functional currency of the operating entity.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Material master number for inventory and procurement postings. Links financial transactions to physical goods and CPE inventory.

attributes.name: partner_profit_center_code
attributes.description: Partner profit center for intercompany and internal transfer pricing postings. Enables elimination entries and internal revenue tracking.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms key defining the due date calculation and cash discount conditions for this line item.

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: Two-digit posting key that controls the account type, debit/credit indicator, and field status for this line item. Core SAP configuration element.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Posting Key Configuration

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity posted in this line item for quantity-based accounts. Supports inventory valuation and material consumption tracking.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number such as vendor invoice number, customer billing document, or bank statement reference. Links financial posting to source document.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is a reversal of a previous posting. Used for error correction and period-end adjustments.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original posting that this line item reverses. Maintains audit trail for corrections.

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: The controlling area to which this cost center belongs. Controlling area is the highest organizational unit in SAP CO.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate costs from this cost center to other cost objects (e.g., direct assignment, activity-based costing, percentage allocation).

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by functional category. Determines how costs are allocated and reported.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies the cost center within the controlling area. Used in financial reporting and budget allocation.

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Extended textual description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities within the organization.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: The full descriptive name of the cost center (e.g., 'Network Operations Center', 'RAN Engineering', 'Customer Care - Tier 1').

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers can accept postings; inactive and blocked cannot.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Type classification indicating whether the cost center is operational (OPEX), capital (CAPEX), shared service, overhead, or revenue-generating.

attributes.name: cost_element_group_code
attributes.description: Default cost element group for categorizing the types of costs posted to this cost center (e.g., personnel, materials, services).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the cost center is domiciled for regulatory and tax reporting.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this cost center record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which this cost center's budget and actuals are denominated.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Department code within the organizational structure to which this cost center belongs.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting (e.g., Operations, Sales, Administration).

attributes.name: group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the cost center group for aggregated reporting and analysis (e.g., all NOC cost centers, all engineering cost centers).

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: The level of this cost center in the organizational hierarchy (1 = top level, increasing for nested levels).

attributes.name: is_locked_for_posting
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost center is locked for new cost postings (true = locked, false = open for postings).

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical cost center used for reporting purposes only, without actual cost postings (true = statistical, false = real).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this cost center record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cost center record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this cost center.

attributes.name: planning_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the planning group responsible for budget planning and forecasting for this cost center.

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center to which this cost center is assigned for internal profitability analysis and management accounting.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center is valid and can accept cost postings.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this cost center is valid. Null indicates no end date (open-ended validity).

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The variance between budgeted and actual costs (budget minus actual). Positive indicates under-budget, negative indicates over-budget.

attributes.name: responsible_employee_id

attributes.name: vendor_id

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation

attributes.name: acquisition_value
attributes.description: Original cost or fair value of the fixed asset at acquisition, including purchase price, installation costs, and directly attributable costs. Recorded in functional currency.

attributes.name: asset_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the asset for financial reporting. Distinguishes between tangible assets, intangible assets, and right-of-use assets under IFRS 16.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the fixed asset including make, model, specifications, and purpose. Used for asset identification and inventory management.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the fixed asset. Unique asset tag or serial number used for physical identification and tracking across the organization.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. Determines whether depreciation is active and whether the asset is available for operational use.

attributes.name: asset_sub_number
attributes.description: Sub-asset identifier for components or modules within a main asset. Used for tracking individual parts of complex network equipment.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was placed in service and capitalized on the balance sheet. Depreciation begins from this date. May differ from acquisition date for assets under construction.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixed asset record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the asset's acquisition value and financial amounts. Used for multi-currency consolidation.

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: Valuation view or ledger for which depreciation is calculated. Supports parallel accounting for different reporting standards (IFRS, GAAP, tax).

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to allocate the cost of the asset over its useful life. Determines the pattern of depreciation expense recognition.

attributes.name: disposal_value
attributes.description: Proceeds received from the sale or disposal of the retired asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal.

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: Write-down amount recognized when the asset's recoverable amount falls below its carrying value. Reflects economic obsolescence or damage.

attributes.name: impairment_date
attributes.description: Date when the impairment loss was recognized. Marks the adjustment to the asset's carrying value.

attributes.name: is_leased
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is leased rather than owned. True for right-of-use assets under IFRS 16 lease accounting.

attributes.name: last_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory verification of the asset. Used for asset reconciliation and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lease_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the lease agreement if the asset is leased. Links to lease contract master data for IFRS 16 compliance.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the equipment manufacturer or original equipment manufacturer (OEM). Used for warranty claims and spare parts sourcing.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's model or part number for the asset. Used for technical specifications, compatibility, and replacement planning.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the fixed asset record. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fixed asset record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the fixed asset calculated as acquisition value minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the asset's value on the balance sheet.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was retired from service or disposed. Marks the end of the asset's useful life and depreciation schedule.

attributes.name: revaluation_amount
attributes.description: Adjustment to the asset's carrying value based on fair value revaluation. Used when applying the revaluation model under IFRS.

attributes.name: revaluation_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset was revalued to fair value. Marks the adjustment to the asset's carrying value under the revaluation model.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's unique serial number for the physical asset. Used for warranty tracking, maintenance, and asset verification.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected economic useful life of the asset in years. Used to calculate annual depreciation expense. Determined by asset class and regulatory guidelines.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer's warranty coverage ends. Used for maintenance planning and extended warranty decisions.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the fixed asset record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.purchase_order. Business justification: Asset acquisition transaction may reference a purchase order for procurement tracking. N:1 relationship (many asset transactions can reference one PO). The purchase_order_id FK will link to purchase_o

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification code grouping assets with similar characteristics, depreciation methods, and useful lives. Examples include buildings, network infrastructure, vehicles, IT equipment. Determines default depreciation parameters and account assignments.

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: Sub-asset identifier used when a main asset is divided into multiple components for separate depreciation tracking. Enables component-based accounting for complex assets such as buildings with separately depreciable components (structure, HVAC, elevators).

attributes.name: asset_value_date
attributes.description: The effective date from which the asset transaction impacts depreciation calculations and asset valuation. attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character organizational unit identifier representing the legal entity or subsidiary within which the asset transaction is recorded. Used for financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The organizational unit responsible for the asset and its associated costs. Used for internal cost allocation, OPEX tracking, and management reporting. Links asset transactions to operational responsibility centers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the asset transaction record was first created in the financial system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and transaction sequencing. Distinct from transaction_date which represents the business event date.

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: Two-digit code identifying the valuation view for the asset transaction. Area 01 typically represents book depreciation for financial reporting; area 15 represents tax depreciation; area 20 represents cost accounting depreciation. Enables parallel valuation for different reporting purposes.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique accounting document identifier generated by the financial system. Provides audit trail linkage to the source financial document and general ledger posting. Used for reconciliation and compliance verification.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code classifying the accounting document category. Examples include AA for asset posting, SA for general ledger document, KR for vendor invoice. Controls number ranges and posting rules.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The financial reporting year in which the transaction is recorded. Four-digit year value used for period assignment and financial statement aggregation.

attributes.name: gain_loss_amount
attributes.description: The calculated gain or loss on asset disposal, computed as retirement proceeds minus net book value. Positive values represent gains; negative values represent losses. Posted to income statement and impacts EBITDA calculation.
attributes.references: IAS 16 Gain or Loss on Disposal

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which the asset transaction is posted. For acquisitions, typically an asset account; for depreciation, an accumulated depreciation or expense account; for retirements, a gain/loss account. Ensures proper financial statement classification.

attributes.name: internal_order
attributes.description: Internal order number used for tracking costs related to specific initiatives, maintenance activities, or short-term projects. Enables cost collection for asset-related activities before capitalization or for OPEX expense tracking.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor invoice number associated with the asset acquisition. Provides linkage to accounts payable and enables reconciliation between asset register and financial payables. Used for audit verification.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when the asset transaction record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and identifying recent adjustments. Updated whenever transaction attributes are changed.

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The transaction amount converted to the company code local currency using the exchange rate effective on the transaction date. Used for statutory financial reporting and consolidation.

attributes.name: offset_account
attributes.description: The contra general ledger account for double-entry bookkeeping. For asset acquisitions, typically accounts payable or cash; for depreciation, accumulated depreciation; for retirements, asset clearing account. Completes the accounting entry pair.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period date when the transaction was posted to the general ledger. Used for period closing and financial statement preparation. May differ from transaction date due to timing of accounting entries.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period number within the fiscal year when the transaction was posted. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods, with additional special periods (13-16) for year-end adjustments and closing entries.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: The business segment or profit-responsible unit to which the asset is assigned. Used for segment reporting, EBITDA analysis, and profitability evaluation. Enables financial performance measurement by business line.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The physical quantity of assets involved in the transaction. Used for assets managed in quantity units such as vehicles, network equipment units, or infrastructure components. Enables unit-based asset tracking and partial retirement processing.

attributes.name: reference_document
attributes.description: External reference number linking the asset transaction to source documents such as purchase orders, vendor invoices, project completion reports, or disposal authorizations. Provides audit trail to supporting documentation.

attributes.name: reference_key
attributes.description: Three-character code classifying the type of reference document. Examples include PO for purchase order, INV for invoice, PRJ for project. Used for categorizing transaction source documentation.

attributes.name: retirement_proceeds
attributes.description: The cash or fair value received from disposal of the asset. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal by comparing to net book value. Populated for sale and trade-in retirement transactions.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Classification of why the asset was retired or disposed. Sale represents disposal with proceeds; scrap represents disposal without value; donation represents charitable transfer; theft represents involuntary loss; obsolescence represents technological replacement; transfer represents movement to another entity. Used for asset lifecycle analysis and disposal reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this transaction reverses a previous asset transaction. True when the transaction is a correction or cancellation of an earlier posting. Used for audit trail and error correction tracking.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The original document number being reversed by this transaction. Populated when reversal_indicator is true. Provides linkage between reversal and original transaction for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the asset transaction in the company code currency. For acquisitions, represents capitalized cost; for retirements, represents net book value disposed; for depreciation, represents periodic expense; for revaluations, represents adjustment amount. Positive values increase asset value; negative values decrease asset value.

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the transaction amount is denominated. Used for foreign currency translation and multi-currency reporting.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the asset transaction occurred or became effective. This is the value date for financial reporting and represents when the economic event took place, distinct from the posting date when it was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: transaction_text
attributes.description: Free-form descriptive text providing additional context about the asset transaction. May include details such as asset description, reason for transaction, approval references, or special handling notes. Used for documentation and audit support.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the asset accounting movement. Acquisition represents capitalization of new assets or additions; retirement represents disposal or scrapping; transfer represents movement between asset classes or cost centers; depreciation represents periodic value reduction; revaluation represents fair value adjustment; write_down represents impairment loss recognition.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The measurement unit for the transaction quantity. Examples include EA for each, KM for kilometers, MT for metric tons. Standardized to ISO unit codes where applicable.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Project structure element identifier for CAPEX projects. Links asset acquisitions to capital investment projects for project accounting, budget tracking, and ROI analysis. Used when assets are capitalized from project activities.

products.name: budget_plan
products.description: SSOT for annual and multi-year financial budgets in SAP S/4HANA Financial Planning — plan-level metadata and granular line-item allocations. Captures budget header (planning horizon, version, approval status, variance thresholds) and line-level detail (GL account, cost center, profit center, fiscal period, planned amount, CAPEX/OPEX category, actuals-to-budget variance). Covers OPEX budgets (network operations, workforce, marketing, G&A) and CAPEX budgets (network build, IT systems, spectrum). Enables budget monitoring, commitment tracking, and financial planning accuracy assessment across telecom business units.

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget plan record. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_code_id
