attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budget plan may be assigned to a cost center for budget management. N:1 relationship (many budget plans per cost center). The cost_center_id FK will link to cost_center.cost_center_id. The existing co

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Budget plan may be assigned to a profit center for profitability planning. N:1 relationship (many budget plans per profit center). The profit_center_id FK will link to profit_center.profit_center_id.

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.service_territory. Business justification: Operating budgets are allocated to service territories for regional cost control, resource planning, and market-level financial targets. Essential for territory budget allocation, variance analysis, r

attributes.name: target_kpi_definition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.kpi_definition. Business justification: Budgets are set to achieve specific KPI targets (subscriber growth, churn reduction, ARPU improvement). Telecommunications planning links budget plans to strategic KPIs for goal alignment, variance tr

attributes.name: actual_to_date_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual expenditure posted against this budget plan as of the last update. Used for budget vs. actuals variance analysis.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Formal approval state: pending (awaiting decision), approved (fully authorized), rejected (not authorized), conditional (approved with constraints or conditions).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Approval Workflow Status

attributes.name: available_budget_amount
attributes.description: Remaining available budget calculated as total_planned_amount minus actual_to_date_amount minus committed_amount.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: Primary expenditure classification: CAPEX (Capital Expenditure for network build, IT systems, spectrum acquisition), OPEX (Operational Expenditure for network operations, workforce, marketing, G&A), or mixed (plan contains both CAPEX and OPEX line items).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Financial Management ABE; SAP S/4HANA Finance - Expenditure Type

attributes.name: budget_control_level
attributes.description: Enforcement level for budget overruns: advisory (informational only), warning (alert but allow), blocking (prevent transactions exceeding budget).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Control Profile

attributes.name: budget_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager or executive responsible for managing and executing this budget plan.

attributes.name: budget_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget plan: draft (in preparation), submitted (awaiting approval), under_review (being evaluated), approved (authorized for execution), rejected (not approved), active (in execution), closed (planning period ended), superseded (replaced by newer version). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|active|closed|superseded — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary business unit or division responsible for this budget plan (e.g., Network Operations, Consumer Wireless, Enterprise Services).

attributes.name: commitment_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchase order commitments and encumbrances are tracked against this budget plan for funds availability checking.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total committed funds (purchase orders, contracts) not yet expensed but encumbered against this budget plan.

attributes.name: consolidation_level
attributes.description: Level of financial consolidation for this budget plan: entity (single legal entity), business_unit (operational unit), division (multiple business units), corporate (enterprise-wide).

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP controlling area for cost and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the budget plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget plan (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Primary fiscal year for which this budget plan is prepared (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Primary General Ledger account code for budget classification (e.g., network maintenance, marketing expense, capital equipment). May be aggregated at plan header level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - GL Account Master

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget plan includes intercompany transactions requiring elimination during consolidation.

attributes.name: is_baseline
attributes.description: Indicates whether this version is the baseline (original approved) budget used for variance analysis. Only one version per plan should be marked as baseline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Baseline Version Flag

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the budget plan record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the budget plan record was last updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the budget plan, including assumptions, constraints, and special considerations.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the budget plan (e.g., 'FY2024 Network CAPEX Budget', '2024 Marketing OPEX Plan').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Planning Description

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the budget plan, formatted as BP-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is fiscal year and NNNN is sequence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Planning Document Number

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget plan by planning horizon and purpose: annual (single fiscal year), multi_year (strategic multi-year plan), quarterly (short-term operational), project_based (specific initiative), rolling_forecast (continuous planning), supplemental (mid-year adjustment).

attributes.name: planning_horizon_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the budget planning period (typically end of fiscal year or project completion).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Period To

attributes.name: planning_horizon_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the budget planning period (typically beginning of fiscal year or project start).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Period From

attributes.name: planning_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to develop the budget: top_down (executive-driven allocation), bottom_up (department-driven aggregation), zero_based (justify all expenses from zero), incremental (prior year plus adjustment), activity_based (cost driver based).

attributes.name: reforecast_amount
attributes.description: Updated forecast amount based on year-to-date actuals and revised projections. Used for mid-year budget adjustments and EBITDA reforecasting.

attributes.name: reforecast_date
attributes.description: Date when the reforecast amount was last updated.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this budget plan originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, BPC, Hyperion).

attributes.name: total_planned_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount across all line items in the plan, in the plan currency. Sum of all budget line allocations.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Budget variance calculated as actual_to_date_amount minus total_planned_amount. Positive indicates overspend, negative indicates underspend.

attributes.name: variance_percent
attributes.description: Budget variance as a percentage of planned amount: (actual_to_date_amount / total_planned_amount - 1) * 100.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Variance Percentage

attributes.name: variance_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Absolute variance threshold in plan currency. Variances exceeding this amount trigger alerts or require explanation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Control Tolerance

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable variance threshold as a percentage of planned amount. Variances exceeding this threshold trigger alerts or require explanation (e.g., 10.00 means ±10%).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Budget Control Tolerance

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the budget plan. Increments with each revision (1=original, 2=first revision, etc.). Supports budget reforecasting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: version_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget version: original (initial approved budget), revised (formal amendment), forecast (updated projection), actual (actuals loaded for comparison).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the budget plan record.

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Individual line item within a budget plan, representing the planned financial allocation for a specific GL account, cost center, profit center, and fiscal period combination. Captures planned amount, currency, budget category (CAPEX/OPEX), version, and actuals-to-budget variance. Enables granular budget monitoring, commitment tracking, and financial planning accuracy assessment across telecom business units.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA Budget Line Item

attributes.name: budget_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the budget line item. Primary key for the budget line entity.

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent budget plan that contains this line item. Links the line to the overall budget structure.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budget line is allocated to a cost center for detailed budget tracking. N:1 relationship (many budget lines per cost center). The cost_center_id FK will link to cost_center.cost_center_id. The existin

attributes.name: general_ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.general_ledger. Business justification: Budget line is allocated to a GL account for financial planning. N:1 relationship (many budget lines per GL account). The general_ledger_id FK will link to general_ledger.general_ledger_id. The existi

attributes.name: primary_budget_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or manager responsible for this budget line. Establishes accountability for budget execution and variance management.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Budget line is allocated to a profit center for detailed profitability planning. N:1 relationship (many budget lines per profit center). The profit_center_id FK will link to profit_center.profit_cente

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual expenditure or revenue recorded against this budget line. Used for variance analysis and budget monitoring.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which the budget amount was allocated to this line. Indicates whether it was directly assigned, allocated from a pool, distributed across multiple lines, or transferred from another budget.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this budget line was formally approved by the authorized approver. Marks the transition from draft to approved status.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: Classification of the budget line as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX), Operational Expenditure (OPEX), Revenue, or Other. Critical for financial planning and EBITDA analysis in telecommunications.

attributes.name: budget_control_level
attributes.description: Level of budget control enforcement for this line. Advisory allows overspending with notification, Warning requires justification, Blocking prevents transactions that exceed the budget.

attributes.name: budget_line_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the purpose and scope of this budget line item. Provides business context for the allocation.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget line. Indicates whether the line is in planning, approved for use, actively monitored, locked from changes, closed for the period, or cancelled.

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget line by planning horizon or purpose. Distinguishes between regular periodic budgets and special allocations.

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the budget plan. Enables tracking of multiple budget scenarios (e.g., original, revised, forecast) for comparison and planning accuracy assessment.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or division responsible for this budget line. Enables budget tracking across organizational segments in the telecommunications enterprise.

attributes.name: carryforward_amount
attributes.description: Amount of unused budget carried forward from the previous fiscal period. Represents budget authority transferred from prior period allocations.

attributes.name: carryforward_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused budget from this line can be carried forward to the next fiscal period. True if carryforward is allowed, False if budget expires at period end.

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The amount committed through purchase orders or contracts but not yet spent. Represents financial obligations that will impact the budget.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget line record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for budget planning timeline.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the planned amount. Indicates the currency in which the budget is denominated.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date until which this budget line remains effective. After this date, no further commitments or spending are allowed against this line.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this budget line becomes effective and available for commitment and spending. Supports phased budget releases.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for which this budget line applies. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this budget line is planned. Represents the annual financial planning period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Code representing the functional area (e.g., Network Operations, Customer Service, Marketing) to which this budget line belongs. Supports functional cost analysis.

attributes.name: fund_code
attributes.description: Fund or grant identifier if this budget line is financed from a specific funding source. Relevant for government-funded projects or earmarked capital allocations.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code for which this budget line is allocated. Represents the financial account classification in the chart of accounts.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget line record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, justifications, or special instructions related to this budget line. Captures business context not represented in structured fields.

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted financial amount allocated for this line item. Represents the planned expenditure or revenue for the specified GL account, cost center, and fiscal period combination.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Project identifier if this budget line is allocated to a specific capital or operational project. Enables project-based budget tracking for network expansion, system implementations, etc.

attributes.name: reduction_amount
attributes.description: Amount by which the original budget was reduced through budget cuts or reallocations. Tracks mid-period budget decreases.

attributes.name: supplemental_amount
attributes.description: Additional budget amount added to the original planned amount through supplemental budget requests or adjustments. Tracks mid-period budget increases.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between planned amount and actual amount (planned minus actual). Positive values indicate under-spending, negative values indicate over-spending.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the planned amount. Calculated as (variance_amount / planned_amount) * 100. Enables normalized comparison across budget lines of different magnitudes.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element code for project-related budget lines. Provides hierarchical project structure for detailed budget planning and control.

products.name: vendor_invoice
products.description: SSOT for the accounts payable lifecycle in SAP S/4HANA — from invoice receipt through payment execution. Covers vendor invoices for network equipment (Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei), fiber contractors, IT software licenses, interconnect settlements, and facility leases. Captures invoice header (vendor ID, invoice date, due date, gross/tax amounts, payment terms, three-way match status) and payment execution details (payment date, method, bank account, clearing reference, cash discount). Supports AP aging analysis, payment run management, cash flow forecasting, and vendor relationship management for the telecom enterprise.
products.reference: SAP FI-AP Vendor Invoice (RBKP/RSEG)

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor invoice record. Primary key for the vendor invoice entity.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.managed_service. Business justification: Vendor invoices for third-party services (cloud connectivity, MPLS, equipment maintenance) are allocated to specific managed service instances for cost tracking and margin analysis.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.purchase_order. Business justification: Vendor invoice references a purchase order for 3-way match verification (PO-GR-IR). N:1 relationship (many invoices can reference one PO, though typically 1:1). The purchase_order_id FK will link to p

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor who issued the invoice. Links to the vendor master data for network equipment suppliers (Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei), fiber contractors, IT software vendors, interconnect carriers, and facility lessors.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was approved for payment. Used for approval cycle time analysis and payment processing workflow management.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The fixed asset number if the invoice is for CAPEX and creates or adds value to a capital asset. Used for asset capitalization, depreciation tracking, and asset lifecycle management.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The reference date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date, depending on payment term configuration. Used to determine the due date and cash discount date.

attributes.name: cash_discount_amount
attributes.description: The discount amount taken for early payment according to the payment terms (e.g., 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Reduces the net payment amount and improves working capital efficiency.

attributes.name: cash_discount_date
attributes.description: The last date on which the cash discount can be taken. Used for payment run optimization to maximize early payment discounts and reduce procurement costs.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The financial document number that clears the open invoice item in accounts payable. Links the invoice to the payment document for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and invoice processing cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Used for multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment must be made to the vendor according to the payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting, payment run scheduling, and aging bucket classification.

attributes.name: expense_category
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice as capital expenditure (CAPEX) for long-term assets like network equipment and infrastructure, or operational expenditure (OPEX) for recurring costs like software licenses, interconnect settlements, and facility leases. Critical for financial planning, ROI measurement, and EBITDA calculation.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for monthly financial reporting, period-over-period analysis, and management accounting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for financial period reporting, year-over-year analysis, and fiscal year-end closing processes.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which the invoice expense is posted. Determines the financial statement line item for P&L reporting, CAPEX/OPEX classification, and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: The goods receipt document number confirming physical receipt of materials or completion of services. Part of the three-way match process to validate invoice accuracy before payment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Materials Management - Goods Receipt

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount before tax. Represents the sum of all line items for goods and services provided by the vendor.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor issued the invoice. This is the business event date used for accounting period assignment, aging analysis, and payment term calculation.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services covered by the invoice. Provides business context for the invoice purpose, such as network equipment purchase, fiber installation services, software license renewal, interconnect settlement, or facility lease payment.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number provided by the vendor. This is the business identifier used for vendor communication, payment reconciliation, and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor invoice in the accounts payable workflow. Draft invoices are being prepared, pending approval invoices await authorization, approved invoices are ready for posting, posted invoices are recorded in the general ledger, paid invoices have been settled, cancelled invoices are voided, disputed invoices have unresolved issues, and on-hold invoices are temporarily suspended from payment processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|paid|cancelled|disputed|on_hold — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. Standard invoices are for goods/services received, credit memos reduce amounts owed, debit memos increase amounts owed, prepayment invoices are advance payments, recurring invoices are for subscription services, and milestone invoices are for project-based deliverables.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the invoice record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The total invoice amount including tax. This is the amount payable to the vendor and represents the cash outflow for accounts payable and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the invoice is blocked from payment processing. True if the invoice is on hold due to disputes, missing approvals, or compliance issues. False if the invoice is eligible for payment.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description explaining why the invoice is blocked from payment. Common reasons include pending approval, disputed charges, missing documentation, or vendor compliance issues.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date the payment was executed to the vendor. Used for cash flow analysis, payment performance tracking, and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to settle the invoice. Wire transfer for international payments, ACH for domestic electronic payments, check for paper-based payments, credit card for small purchases, EFT for direct bank transfers, and virtual card for secure one-time payments.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The unique reference number assigned to the payment transaction. Used for bank reconciliation, payment tracking, and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The contractual payment terms agreed with the vendor, typically expressed as net days or discount terms (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Defines the due date calculation and cash discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Payment Terms Master

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger. This determines the fiscal period for financial reporting and EBITDA analysis.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: The project or work breakdown structure (WBS) element to which the invoice is assigned. Used for project-based cost tracking, milestone billing validation, and capital project management for network expansion and infrastructure deployment.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount applied to the invoice, including sales tax, value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice has been successfully matched against the purchase order and goods receipt. Matched invoices pass all validation checks, unmatched invoices have discrepancies, partial matches have some lines matched, variance within tolerance has acceptable differences, and variance exceeds tolerance requires manual review.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account
attributes.description: The bank account number to which payment should be remitted. Used for electronic payment processing and vendor master data validation.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the vendor payment as required by tax regulations. Reduces the net payment to the vendor and is remitted to tax authorities on behalf of the vendor.

products.name: vendor_payment
products.description: Accounts payable payment transaction recording the actual disbursement to a vendor from the telecom enterprise's bank accounts. Captures payment date, payment method (ACH, wire, check), bank account, payment amount, currency, exchange rate, clearing document reference, and cash discount taken. Links to vendor invoices cleared by the payment. Supports cash flow management, payment run reconciliation, and treasury operations.

attributes.name: vendor_payment_id

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: net_payment_amount

attributes.name: payment_amount

attributes.name: payment_approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the payment transaction. Indicates whether the payment is pending approval, approved, or rejected per internal controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Payment Approval Workflow

attributes.name: payment_batch_number
attributes.description: Batch number assigned by the payment processor for grouped payments. Used for payment reconciliation and bank statement matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Payment Batch Processing

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the payment was blocked for review or approval. Used for payment control and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for why the payment was blocked. Provides context for payment holds and exceptions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Payment Block Reasons

attributes.name: payment_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount. Indicates the currency in which the payment was made (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was executed and funds were disbursed from the telecom enterprise bank account. Principal business event timestamp for cash flow management and treasury operations.

attributes.name: payment_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or memo for the payment transaction. Provides additional context about the payment purpose or special instructions.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: Externally visible payment document number assigned by the financial system. Used for payment tracking, reconciliation, and audit trails.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method used to disburse payment to the vendor. Indicates the payment instrument or mechanism (ACH, wire transfer, check, EFT, credit card, direct debit).

attributes.name: payment_processor_name
attributes.description: Name of the payment processor or bank that executed the payment. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number provided by the bank or payment processor. Used for payment tracking and reconciliation with bank statements.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Indicates whether the payment is pending, processed, cleared, cancelled, failed, or reversed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Payment Status Management

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: Payment term code that governed this payment. Indicates the agreed payment terms with the vendor (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was posted to the general ledger. Used for financial reporting and period assignment.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was reversed. Used for audit trails and financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment has been reversed. Used for payment correction and error handling.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for why the payment was reversed. Provides context for payment corrections and exceptions.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Withholding tax amount deducted from the payment per tax regulations. Represents tax withheld at source and remitted to tax authorities.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515 - Withholding of Tax on Nonresident Aliens

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: SSOT for procurement purchase orders in SAP MM/S/4HANA — document header and line-item detail. Covers network hardware (RAN, GPON, CPE), professional services, software licenses, and operational supplies. Captures header attributes (PO type, vendor, plant, purchasing organization, total value, approval status, GR/IR status) and line-level detail (material/service, quantity, unit price, delivery schedule, account assignment to cost center/WBS/asset, commitment value). SSOT for procurement commitment tracking, CAPEX/OPEX spend control, and three-way match processing.
products.reference: SAP MM Purchase Order (EKKO/EKPO)

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order. Primary key.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.company_code

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Purchase order may be charged to a cost center for expense tracking. N:1 relationship (many POs per cost center). The cost_center_id FK will link to cost_center.cost_center_id. The existing cost_cente

attributes.name: enterprise_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.site. Business justification: Site-specific procurement (CPE, installation services, cabling) is tracked via purchase orders linked to sites for site-level cost management and installation project tracking.

attributes.name: location_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.location_site. Business justification: Equipment and materials purchase orders for site builds/upgrades reference target sites for delivery coordination and cost tracking. Required for procurement-to-site matching, goods receipt verificati

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor from whom goods or services are being procured. Links to vendor master data for payment terms, contact information, and performance history.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase order was approved. Used for procurement cycle time analysis and audit compliance.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for the purchase order. Tracks whether the PO requires approval and its current state in the approval chain.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the purchase order. Captured for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Fixed asset number for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) capitalization. Used when procuring network equipment (Optical Line Terminal (OLT), Broadband Network Gateway (BNG), Customer Premises Equipment (CPE)) that will be capitalized as assets.

attributes.name: collective_number
attributes.description: Grouping identifier for related purchase orders processed together in a procurement campaign or bulk order scenario.

attributes.name: commitment_value
attributes.description: Encumbered budget amount for this purchase order. Used for budget control and funds management to prevent overspending.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract or framework agreement under which this purchase order is issued. Used for contract compliance and spend aggregation.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center for account assignment and Operational Expenditure (OPEX) tracking. Ten-character alphanumeric code representing the organizational unit bearing the cost.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and procurement cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this purchase order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Requested or scheduled date for goods receipt or service completion. Used for supply chain planning and Service Level Agreement (SLA) tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number for financial posting. Ten-digit numeric code representing the expense or asset account in the chart of accounts.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether goods receipt posting is required for this purchase order. True for material procurement, false for service-only orders.

attributes.name: gr_based_invoice_verification
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice verification is based on goods receipt rather than purchase order. When true, invoice must match GR quantity and value.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for shipping, insurance, and customs (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named place or port specified in the Incoterms clause (e.g., FOB Shanghai, DDP New York).

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice verification is required for this purchase order. Used in three-way match processing (PO, GR, IR).

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the purchase order record. Captured for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_value
attributes.description: Net monetary value after applying discounts and before taxes. Used for vendor payment calculation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional comments or notes regarding the purchase order. Free-text field for internal communication and special conditions.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions (e.g., net 30, 2/10 net 30). Four-character code from vendor master or negotiated terms.

attributes.name: plant
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where goods will be received or services will be rendered. Four-character code representing warehouse, distribution center, Network Operations Center (NOC), or field office.

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase order was created and issued to the vendor. Principal business event timestamp for procurement commitment tracking.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the purchase order. Ten-digit numeric code used for vendor communication and three-way match processing.

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order in the procurement workflow. Tracks progression from draft through approval, goods receipt, invoice verification, and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_process|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order based on procurement scenario: standard (goods procurement), subcontracting (material provided to vendor), consignment (vendor-owned inventory), stock transfer (inter-plant), service (professional services), or framework (blanket agreement).

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for this purchase order. Three-character code identifying the individual or team handling vendor negotiations and order management.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Four-character alphanumeric code representing the division or business unit authorized to negotiate and execute purchase agreements.

attributes.name: quotation_number
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor quotation or Request for Quotation (RFQ) that preceded this purchase order. Links to the sourcing process.

attributes.name: release_strategy
attributes.description: Approval workflow strategy code determining the approval path based on PO value, material group, or purchasing organization. Defines the sequence of approvers and thresholds.

attributes.name: requisitioner
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who requested the procurement. Links to the originating purchase requisition for accountability.

attributes.name: shipping_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for the vendor regarding packaging, labeling, shipping method, or delivery requirements. Free-text field for logistics coordination.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage area within the plant where materials will be stocked. Four-character code for inventory management and goods receipt posting.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the purchase order based on jurisdiction and tax codes.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the purchase order including all line items, before taxes and discounts. Used for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) and Operational Expenditure (OPEX) commitment tracking.

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: Effective end date for framework or blanket purchase orders. Defines the expiration of the procurement agreement period.

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date for framework or blanket purchase orders. Defines the beginning of the procurement agreement period.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Project work breakdown structure element for Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) tracking and project accounting. Used for network infrastructure projects, Radio Access Network (RAN) deployments, and Fiber to the Home (FTTH) rollouts.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the purchase order record. Captured for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: purchase_order_line
products.description: Individual line item within a procurement purchase order, specifying the material or service being procured, quantity, unit price, delivery schedule, account assignment (cost center, WBS element, asset), and goods receipt/invoice receipt quantities. Enables granular spend tracking by GL account and controlling object, supporting CAPEX/OPEX classification at the line level for telecom infrastructure and operational procurement.
products.reference: SAP MM PO Line Item (EKPO)

attributes.name: purchase_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent purchase order header. Links this line item to its containing purchase order document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement - Purchase Order Header

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Fixed asset number if this line item represents a capital asset acquisition. Used for asset accounting and depreciation tracking.

attributes.name: contract_line_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the referenced contract. Links this purchase order line to specific contract terms and pricing.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to a master contract or blanket purchase agreement under which this line item is procured. Used for contract compliance and spend tracking.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this purchase order line item in the system. Used for accountability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line item record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and procurement cycle time analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary values on this line item (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item has been marked for deletion. Deleted lines are excluded from further processing but retained for audit purposes.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or requested delivery date for the material or service on this line item. Used for supply chain planning and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: expenditure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the line item as either capital expenditure (CAPEX) for long-term assets or operational expenditure (OPEX) for ongoing operations. Critical for financial planning and EBITDA analysis.

attributes.name: final_invoice_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating that the final invoice has been received for this line item and no further invoices are expected. Used to close procurement transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Invoice Verification - Final Settlement

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which the expense or asset value of this line item will be posted. Critical for financial accounting and reporting.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether goods receipt is required for this line item. Controls whether inventory movements must be posted before invoice verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement - GR-Based Invoice Verification

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Incoterms code defining the delivery terms and transfer of risk between buyer and seller (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Used for international procurement.

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Specific location associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., port of shipment, destination city). Clarifies the point of delivery or risk transfer.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice receipt is expected for this line item. Controls invoice verification requirements.

attributes.name: item_category_code
attributes.description: Purchase order item category code that controls the procurement process flow and account assignment for this line (e.g., standard item, consignment, subcontracting, service).

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this purchase order line item. Tracks change history for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this purchase order line item record was last updated. Tracks changes for audit and version control purposes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the purchase order. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement - Line Item Numbering

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order line item. Tracks progression from order placement through receipt and closure.

attributes.name: line_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, specifications, or instructions specific to this purchase order line item.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number for the material. Used for technical specifications and warranty tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Master - Manufacturer Part

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Reference to the material or service being procured. Links to the master material catalog for network equipment, infrastructure components, or operational services.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the material or service being procured on this line. Provides human-readable context for the procurement item.

attributes.name: material_group_code
attributes.description: Classification code grouping similar materials or services together for procurement analysis and reporting. Used for spend categorization.

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Total net value of this line item before taxes and discounts. Calculated as (quantity_ordered * unit_price / price_unit).

attributes.name: open_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity yet to be received or invoiced. Calculated as quantity_ordered minus the greater of quantity_received or quantity_invoiced.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement - Open Item Management

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the receiving plant or facility location for the procured material. Used for inventory management and logistics planning.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: The quantity of units to which the unit price applies. For example, if price_unit is 100, the unit_price applies to 100 units rather than 1.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_line_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the originating purchase requisition. Used for end-to-end procurement tracking from requisition to order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement - Purchase Requisition Item

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase requisition document that triggered this purchase order line. Provides procurement traceability.

attributes.name: quantity_invoiced
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity invoiced by the vendor against this purchase order line. Updated through invoice receipt transactions.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: The quantity of material or service units ordered on this line item. Represents the total amount requested from the vendor.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of goods or services received against this purchase order line. Updated through goods receipt transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Inventory Management - Goods Receipt

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or business user who requested this material or service. Used for procurement tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific storage location within the plant where the material will be received and stored.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount calculated for this line item based on the tax code and net order value.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining the tax treatment and rate applicable to this line item. Used for tax calculation and compliance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the ordered quantity is measured (e.g., EA for each, KG for kilogram, HR for hour). Standardizes quantity interpretation.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Price per single unit of the material or service. Used to calculate the total line item value before taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: The vendor's own material or part number for the procured item. Used for vendor communication and order fulfillment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Procurement - Vendor Material Info

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: Work breakdown structure element code for project-based procurement. Used to track capital expenditure (CAPEX) and project costs for network infrastructure investments.

Essential for financial consolidation, intercompany elimination, and group EBITDA reporting.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Intercompany transaction originates from a sending profit center. N:1 relationship (many transactions from one profit center). The sending_profit_center_id FK will link to profit_center.profit_center_

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.service_territory. attributes.description: The percentage rate applied for cost or revenue allocation when the allocation method is percentage-based.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the intercompany transaction requires management approval before posting, typically for transactions above materiality thresholds.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the intercompany transaction was approved for posting to the general ledger.

attributes.description: The three-letter ISO currency code of the corporate group reporting currency (typically USD, EUR, or GBP).

attributes.name: profit_center_sending

products.name: cost_allocation
products.description: Record of internal cost distribution transactions in SAP Controlling — periodic assessment and distribution cycles that allocate shared infrastructure costs (NOC operations, shared RAN, IT platforms, corporate overhead) from sender cost centers to receiver cost centers, profit centers, or WBS elements. Each record captures the allocation cycle ID, sender/receiver controlling objects, allocation basis (percentage, statistical key figure, activity type/rate), allocated amount, fiscal period, and reversal indicator. Produces corresponding journal_entry_line postings. Essential for accurate product-line P&L, network cost-per-subscriber analysis, and EBITDA by segment.
products.reference: SAP CO Assessment/Distribution Cycle (KSUB/KSVB)
