attributes.description: Asset number for the AuC master record where project costs are capitalized during construction. Converted to fixed asset upon project completion.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting - AuC; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: budget_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the approved budget. Typically the local currency of the operating company.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Finance - Currency

attributes.name: budget_variance_amount
attributes.description: Calculated variance between approved budget and actual costs (approved_budget_amount - actual_cost_amount). Positive indicates under budget.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Budget Control; PMI PMBOK - Earned Value Management

attributes.name: budget_variance_percentage
attributes.description: Budget variance expressed as percentage of approved budget. Key performance indicator for project financial control.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK - Cost Performance Index; TM Forum SID - KPI

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Business unit or operating segment that will benefit from the capital investment. Links project to strategic business objectives.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when project costs are transferred from AuC to fixed assets on the balance sheet. Marks the start of depreciation.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting - Asset Capitalization; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: committed_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total committed costs from purchase orders, contracts, and reservations. Represents financial obligations not yet invoiced.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Commitment Management; SAP MM - Purchase Orders

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area for cost accounting and internal reporting. Links project costs to management accounting structures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the project record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Change Documents; SOX Compliance - Audit Trail

attributes.name: environmental_impact_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project requires environmental impact assessment under NEPA or state environmental regulations.
attributes.references: NEPA - National Environmental Policy Act; FCC Environmental Rules

attributes.name: forecast_final_cost_amount
attributes.description: Projected total cost at project completion based on current actuals, commitments, and remaining work estimates. Updated monthly.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK - Estimate at Completion (EAC); SAP Project System (PS) - Forecasting

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Business function or division responsible for project delivery. Used for cross-functional portfolio analysis and resource allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Functional Area; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Primary geographic region or market where the capital investment is deployed. Used for regional portfolio analysis and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Geographic Address; FCC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: Date when the capital asset is placed into operational service and begins generating revenue or operational benefits. Triggers depreciation start.
attributes.references: SAP Asset Accounting - Capitalization Date; IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment

attributes.name: investment_category
attributes.description: Strategic investment classification for portfolio management and CAPEX allocation analysis. Aligns with network planning and technology roadmap. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ran_expansion|core_network|transport_network|access_network|it_systems|facilities|spectrum — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain; 3GPP Network Architecture

attributes.name: irr_percentage
attributes.description: Internal rate of return calculated for the project investment. Used for comparing investment alternatives and portfolio optimization.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; TM Forum SID - Financial Management

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the project record. Tracks data currency and change frequency for analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - Change Documents; SOX Compliance - Audit Trail

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional project information, special instructions, or contextual details not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: npv_amount
attributes.description: Calculated net present value of the project investment based on discounted cash flow analysis. Key metric for capital allocation decisions.
attributes.references: IAS 36 Impairment of Assets; TM Forum SID - Financial Management

attributes.name: payback_period_months
attributes.description: Expected number of months to recover the capital investment through operational benefits and revenue generation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Financial Management; PMI PMBOK - Business Case

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date for project completion and final deliverable acceptance. Baseline for schedule variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Project Dates; PMI PMBOK - Schedule Management

attributes.name: planned_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total planned cost estimate for the project based on detailed engineering and procurement planning. Updated throughout project lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Planning; PMI PMBOK - Cost Management

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Strategic priority ranking for resource allocation and portfolio management. Critical projects receive preferential funding and resources.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK - Portfolio Management; TM Forum eTOM - Strategy & Commit

attributes.name: project_definition_code
attributes.description: External business identifier for the project definition in SAP PS. Used for cross-system integration and reporting.

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description and scope of the capital project, including objectives, deliverables, and strategic alignment.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the capital project (e.g., '5G NR Rollout Phase 3 - Metro Region', 'FTTH Fiber Deployment - Northeast Corridor').

attributes.name: project_phase
attributes.description: Current execution phase of the project within its lifecycle. Used for milestone tracking and phase-gate governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initiation|planning|design|procurement|construction|testing|commissioning|closeout — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Project Phase; PMI PMBOK

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capital project. Controls budget availability, settlement processing, and asset capitalization workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planning|approved|in_progress|on_hold|completed|closed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Project Status; TM Forum eTOM

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by investment category. Determines capitalization rules, depreciation schedules, and financial reporting treatment.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Project Type; TM Forum SID

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project requires regulatory approval from FCC, state PUC, or other telecommunications authorities before execution.
attributes.references: FCC Part 1 - Practice and Procedure; State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment for the project considering technical, financial, schedule, and regulatory risks. Determines oversight and contingency requirements.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK - Risk Management; ISO 31000 Risk Management

attributes.name: roi_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target ROI percentage established during project approval. Used for investment prioritization and post-implementation review.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Financial Management; IAS 36 Impairment of Assets

attributes.name: settlement_profile
attributes.description: SAP settlement profile defining rules for transferring project costs to fixed assets (AuC - Assets under Construction) or expense accounts.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Settlement; SAP Asset Accounting

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual start date of project execution. Marks the beginning of budget consumption and resource allocation.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - Project Dates; PMI PMBOK - Schedule Management

attributes.name: technology_domain
attributes.description: Primary technology domain or platform that the project delivers or enhances. Critical for technology portfolio management and ROI measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 5g_nr|lte|ftth_gpon|iptv|ims_volte|sdn_nfv|oss_bss|data_center|spectrum — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP Technical Specifications; TM Forum TAM; ETSI NFV/SDN Standards

attributes.name: wbs_root_element
attributes.description: Top-level WBS element code representing the entire project hierarchy. Parent node for all sub-WBS elements and cost collection.
attributes.references: SAP Project System (PS) - WBS Element; PMI PMBOK - WBS

products.name: tax_posting
products.description: Tax-related financial posting record capturing VAT, GST, withholding tax, and other indirect tax transactions processed through SAP S/4HANA Tax Management. Captures tax code, tax jurisdiction, base amount, tax amount, tax type (input/output), reporting period, and tax return reference. Supports statutory tax compliance, tax return preparation, and transfer pricing documentation for the telecom enterprise across multiple jurisdictions.
products.reference: SAP FI Tax Item (BSET)

attributes.name: tax_posting_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax posting record. Primary key for the tax posting entity.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Tax posting is made by a legal entity. N:1 relationship (many tax postings per company). The company_code_id FK will link to company_code.company_code_id. The existing company_code STRING attribute is

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tax posting may be charged to a cost center for cost tracking. N:1 relationship (many tax postings per cost center). The cost_center_id FK will link to cost_center.cost_center_id. The existing cost_ce

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the customer associated with this tax posting, applicable for output tax scenarios on sales transactions.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Tax postings in GL reference source billing invoices for VAT/GST reconciliation, tax authority audits, and indirect tax compliance. Critical for matching tax collected to tax remitted.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Tax posting may be charged to a profit center for profitability tracking. N:1 relationship (many tax postings per profit center). The profit_center_id FK will link to profit_center.profit_center_id. T

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the vendor or supplier associated with this tax posting, applicable for input tax and withholding tax scenarios.

attributes.name: base_amount
attributes.description: The gross base amount on which the tax is calculated, before tax is applied. This is the taxable amount in the transaction currency.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area or division code for cross-company reporting and consolidation purposes.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax liability or receivable was cleared or settled through payment or offset.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the payment or clearing transaction that settled this tax posting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code within the enterprise to which this tax posting belongs.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center code associated with this tax posting for internal cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on the original tax document or invoice that triggered this tax posting.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this tax posting transaction in the financial system.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when the tax posting occurred.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the tax posting is recorded for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account code to which this tax posting is recorded. Typically a tax payable or tax receivable account.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this tax posting record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax posting record was last updated or modified. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: local_base_amount
attributes.description: The tax base amount converted to the local reporting currency of the company.

attributes.name: local_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code of the company's local reporting currency.

attributes.name: local_tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount converted to the local reporting currency of the company.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax posting was recorded in the financial ledger. This is the principal business event timestamp for the tax transaction.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the tax posting in the financial system workflow.

attributes.name: posting_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created or posted this tax transaction in the financial system.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: The profit center code associated with this tax posting for segment reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this tax posting is a reversal or correction of a previous posting.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason code or description explaining why this tax posting was reversed or corrected.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original tax posting that this record reverses, if applicable.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount for this posting in the transaction currency. This is the principal quantitative result of the tax calculation.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax code that defines the tax type, rate, and calculation method applied to this posting. Examples include VAT codes, GST codes, withholding tax codes.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate
attributes.description: The certificate or authorization number supporting the tax exemption claim for this posting.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this transaction qualifies for tax exemption under applicable regulations.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The tax jurisdiction or authority code under which this tax posting is governed. Identifies the country, state, or local tax authority.

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the tax jurisdiction or authority (e.g., United States IRS, UK HMRC, India GST Council).

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied to the base amount to calculate the tax amount. For example, 20.00 for 20% VAT.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_period
attributes.description: The statutory tax reporting period to which this posting belongs, formatted as YYYY-MM or YYYY-QQ for monthly or quarterly tax returns.

attributes.name: tax_return_reference
attributes.description: The reference number of the tax return filing in which this tax posting is included. Links the posting to the statutory tax return submission.

attributes.name: tax_return_status
attributes.description: The current status of the tax return associated with this posting in the tax compliance workflow.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax transaction indicating whether it is input tax (recoverable), output tax (payable), withholding tax, use tax, reverse charge, or import tax.

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or notes providing additional context about the tax posting transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the tax transaction was originally recorded (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, INR).

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: The transfer pricing methodology applied for intercompany transactions subject to tax, as per OECD guidelines.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_certificate
attributes.description: The certificate number issued for withholding tax deducted, required for vendor tax credit claims.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this posting represents withholding tax deducted at source.

products.name: bank_account
products.description: SSOT for corporate treasury and cash management in SAP S/4HANA — bank account master data and transactional activity. Captures account master attributes (bank key, account number, type, currency, SWIFT/BIC, IBAN, cash pool assignment, signatories) and electronic bank statement data (MT940/CAMT.053 imports, opening/closing balances, transaction lines, value dates, auto-matching status). Supports daily cash position reporting, automated bank reconciliation, liquidity forecasting, and payment processing across the telecom group's treasury operations.
products.reference: SAP TR Bank Account Master (BNKA/T012)

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank account master record in SAP S/4HANA treasury management. Primary key for the bank account entity.

attributes.name: cash_pool_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this bank account to a cash pooling arrangement. Cash pooling enables centralized liquidity management by consolidating balances across multiple accounts for interest optimization and overdraft protection.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Bank account is owned by a legal entity. N:1 relationship (many bank accounts per company). The company_code_id FK will link to company_code.company_code_id. The existing company_code STRING attribute

attributes.name: house_bank_id
attributes.description: Internal identifier for the house bank in SAP S/4HANA. House banks are the primary banking partners used for payment processing, cash management, and treasury operations. Links to the house bank master data.

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was closed with the financial institution. Null for active accounts. Used for historical reporting and account lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Management

attributes.name: account_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code representing the native currency of the bank account. All transactions in this account are denominated in this currency. Critical for multi-currency treasury operations and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity that holds the bank account as registered with the financial institution. Typically matches the company legal name for corporate accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Master Data

attributes.name: account_id_sap
attributes.description: Five-character alphanumeric account identifier within the house bank structure in SAP S/4HANA. Used in payment programs, bank statement processing, and cash position reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Management

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title of the bank account as registered with the financial institution. Used for identification in treasury reports, payment processing, and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Master Data

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: The date when the bank account was originally opened with the financial institution. Used for relationship tracking and historical analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Management

attributes.name: account_purpose
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business purpose or use case for this bank account (e.g., payroll disbursements, vendor payments, customer collections, tax payments, intercompany settlements). Used for treasury reporting and account rationalization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Management

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the bank account. Active accounts are available for transactions; inactive accounts are temporarily suspended; closed accounts are permanently terminated; blocked accounts have restrictions; dormant accounts have no recent activity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Management

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account based on its operational purpose and banking product type. Determines transaction rules, interest calculation, and cash management behavior.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Account Management

attributes.name: authorized_signatories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of employee IDs or names authorized to approve payments and transactions from this bank account. Used for dual-control enforcement and audit trail. Confidential due to internal control sensitivity.

attributes.name: auto_reconciliation_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether automated bank reconciliation is enabled for this account. When true, SAP S/4HANA automatically matches bank statement lines to open GL items using matching rules and algorithms.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The balance available for immediate use after accounting for holds, pending transactions, and reserve requirements. Critical for payment processing and overdraft prevention.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: The unique account number assigned by the financial institution. This is the primary account identifier used for all banking transactions, electronic bank statements, and payment processing. Restricted due to financial sensitivity.

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific branch or office of the financial institution where the account is domiciled. Relevant for regional banking relationships and local cash management.

attributes.name: bank_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the bank account is domiciled. Critical for regulatory reporting, tax compliance, and cross-border payment routing.

attributes.name: bank_key
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the financial institution in the bank directory. In US context this is the ABA routing number; in European context this is the national bank code. Used for payment processing and bank statement reconciliation.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the financial institution where the account is held. Used for reporting, reconciliation, and correspondence.

attributes.name: cash_pool_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cash pooling structure this account participates in. Physical pooling involves actual fund transfers; notional pooling calculates interest on aggregated balances without transfers; zero-balance accounts sweep funds daily; target-balance accounts maintain specified levels.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this bank account master record in the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account master record was first created in SAP S/4HANA. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: The real-time or most recently updated balance of the bank account. Reflects all posted transactions and is used for daily cash position reporting and liquidity management.

attributes.name: electronic_format
attributes.description: The electronic file format used for importing bank statements into SAP S/4HANA. MT940 and CAMT.053 are international standards; BAI2 is common in North America; MT942 is for interim statements; proprietary formats are bank-specific.
attributes.references: ISO 20022, SWIFT Standards, BAI (Bank Administration Institute)

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account number in the chart of accounts where bank transactions for this account are posted. Links bank account activity to financial statements and enables automated bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - General Ledger Accounting

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number used for cross-border payments and SEPA transactions. Mandatory for European banking operations and increasingly used globally for international wire transfers.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used by the financial institution to calculate interest on this account. Daily balance calculates interest on end-of-day balances; average balance uses the period average; tiered applies different rates to balance ranges; none indicates non-interest-bearing accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Interest Calculation

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: The annual interest rate applied to this bank account, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 for 2.50%). Used for interest accrual calculations and cash flow forecasting. May be positive for deposit accounts or negative for overdraft facilities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Interest Calculation

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this bank account master record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this bank account master record was last modified in SAP S/4HANA. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date when the most recent bank reconciliation was completed for this account. Used to monitor reconciliation timeliness and compliance with internal controls.

attributes.name: last_statement_balance
attributes.description: The closing balance reported on the most recent bank statement. Used as the reconciliation baseline to match against the general ledger balance and identify unreconciled items.

attributes.name: last_statement_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent electronic bank statement (MT940 or CAMT.053 format) imported into SAP S/4HANA. Used to track reconciliation currency and identify gaps in statement processing.

attributes.name: minimum_balance_requirement
attributes.description: The minimum balance that must be maintained in the account to avoid fees or meet contractual obligations. Used for cash positioning and liquidity planning.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the beginning of the current reporting period or fiscal year. Used as the starting point for cash flow analysis, reconciliation, and liquidity forecasting.

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: The maximum negative balance (credit line) authorized by the financial institution for this account. Used for liquidity management and to prevent payment failures. Confidential due to credit facility sensitivity.

attributes.name: payment_method_enabled
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of payment methods enabled for this bank account (e.g., wire_transfer, ACH, check, SEPA_credit_transfer, SEPA_direct_debit). Determines which payment formats and channels can be used for outbound payments from this account.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current state of the bank reconciliation process for this account. Reconciled indicates GL and bank statement balances match; pending indicates reconciliation in progress; variance indicates discrepancies requiring investigation; not_started indicates no reconciliation activity.

attributes.name: signatory_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum transaction amount that can be approved by a single authorized signatory. Transactions exceeding this limit require dual approval or escalation. Critical for fraud prevention and internal controls.

attributes.name: statement_import_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which electronic bank statements are automatically imported from the financial institution. Daily is standard for operational accounts; intraday supports real-time cash management; weekly or monthly may be used for low-activity accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Bank Statement Processing

attributes.name: swift_bic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code (BIC)
attributes.description: SWIFT Business Identifier Code uniquely identifying the bank and branch for international wire transfers and correspondent banking. Format: 8 or 11 characters (bank code, country code, location code, optional branch code).

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this bank account record is effective and available for use in SAP S/4HANA. Supports time-dependent master data management and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Master Data Management

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date until which this bank account record is effective. After this date, the account is no longer available for new transactions. Null or far-future date indicates an open-ended validity period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Master Data Management

products.name: bank_statement
products.description: Electronic bank statement record imported into SAP S/4HANA Cash Management from banking partners via MT940/CAMT.053 formats. Each record represents a single statement for one bank account on one date, containing opening/closing balances and individual transaction lines (credits, debits, fees). Captures statement number, statement date, value dates, transaction codes, payer/payee references, and auto-matching status against open AR/AP items. Supports daily cash position reporting, automated bank reconciliation, and liquidity forecasting for the telecom enterprise's treasury operations.
products.reference: SAP TR Electronic Bank Statement (FEBEP/FEBRE)

attributes.name: bank_statement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bank statement record. Primary key for the bank statement entity.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bank account for which this statement was issued. Links to the bank account master data.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Bank statement is for a legal entity. N:1 relationship (many bank statements per company). The company_code_id FK will link to company_code.company_code_id. The existing company_code STRING attribute

attributes.name: house_bank_id
attributes.description: SAP house bank identifier linking this statement to the telecommunications enterprises banking partner configuration. Used for payment processing and cash management setup.

attributes.name: account_holder_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the account holder as registered with the bank. Typically matches the company name for corporate accounts.

attributes.name: account_id_sap
attributes.description: SAP-internal account identifier used in cash management configuration. Links the external bank account to internal SAP master data.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The bank-assigned account number for which this statement was generated. May be in local format or IBAN depending on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: available_balance
attributes.description: The available balance reported by the bank, accounting for holds and pending transactions. Used for liquidity forecasting and cash position analysis.

attributes.name: balance_verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the opening balance matches the previous statement closing balance. Flags continuity breaks requiring investigation.

attributes.name: bank_identifier_code
attributes.description: SWIFT BIC code of the bank that issued the statement. Uniquely identifies the financial institution in international transactions.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the banking institution that issued the statement. Provides human-readable identification of the bank.

attributes.name: closing_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the end of the statement period. Used for daily cash position reporting and liquidity forecasting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this statement. Defines the denomination of opening balance, closing balance, and all transaction amounts.

attributes.name: forward_available_balance
attributes.description: Projected available balance including future-dated transactions. Supports treasury cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning.

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number in ISO 13616 format. Standardized account identifier used for cross-border payments and reconciliation.

attributes.name: import_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch job that imported this statement. Groups statements processed together for operational tracking.

attributes.name: import_file_name
attributes.description: Name of the source file from which this statement was imported. Provides traceability back to the original electronic banking file.

attributes.name: import_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the bank statement file was imported into SAP S/4HANA Cash Management. Record audit timestamp for data lineage.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this statement record. Provides accountability for changes and manual interventions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this bank statement record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change for audit and data lineage purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments added by treasury analysts regarding exceptions, manual adjustments, or special handling for this statement.

attributes.name: opening_balance
attributes.description: The account balance at the start of the statement period. Represents the closing balance from the previous statement.

attributes.name: previous_statement_closing_balance
attributes.description: Closing balance from the immediately preceding statement. Used to validate continuity and detect discrepancies between statements.

products.name: budget_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of budget funds from financial plans to specific network infrastructure rollout zones. It captures the financial commitment linking budget plans to rollout zones, tracking allocated amounts, fiscal periods, budget categories (CAPEX/OPEX), approval status, and variance thresholds. Each record represents a specific funding allocation from one budget plan to one network rollout zone, enabling zone-level budget control, program financial management, and tracking of how capital and operational budgets are distributed across the network infrastructure portfolio.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications network infrastructure programs, budget plans routinely allocate funds to multiple rollout zones (e.g., a FY2024 5G Densification Budget funds 50+ zones across multiple markets), and each rollout zone receives funding from multiple budget plans simultaneously (e.g., a zone receives CAPEX from the fiber build program, OPEX from maintenance budgets, and subsidy funds from government programs). The business actively manages these allocations as distinct financial commitments, tracking allocated amounts, approval status, actual spend, and variance thresholds at the zone-plan level.

products.name: finance_project_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between capital_project and employee. It captures the staffing and resource allocation for capital expenditure projects across the telecommunications enterprise. Each record links one capital_project to one employee with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment relationship, including role, time allocation, billing rates, and assignment duration.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications capital project execution, projects require multiple employees in different functional roles (project manager, network engineers, field technicians, business analysts) working concurrently, and employees routinely work across multiple capital projects simultaneously with varying time allocations. The business actively manages project staffing through assignment records that track role, allocation percentage, billable rates, and actual hours worked - this is operational project resource management, not analytical correlation.

products.name: budget_approval
products.description: This association product represents the approval workflow between budget_plan and employee. It captures the multi-stage approval process where budget plans require sequential approvals from multiple employees (department head, finance controller, CFO) with role-specific authority limits and delegation tracking. Each record links one budget_plan to one employee approver with attributes that exist only in the context of this approval relationship.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications budget approval workflows, a single budget plan requires sequential approvals from multiple employees in different roles (department head, finance controller, CFO), each with role-specific authority limits. Simultaneously, each employee approves multiple budget plans across different business units and fiscal periods. The business actively manages approval hierarchies, delegation chains, and approval status tracking as a core financial control process.

products.name: enterprise_contract
products.description: Master record for all commercial contracts between the telco and a corporate account. Covers all enterprise agreement types via a type discriminator: master service agreements (MSA), government frameworks (G-Cloud, Crown Commercial Service, GSA Schedule), MVNO host agreements, and wholesale contracts. Captures contract reference, type (commercial, government, wholesale, MVNO), effective/expiry dates, auto-renewal flag, minimum commitment (MRR/ARR), discount schedule reference, penalty clauses, governing law, status, signatory details. For government-type contracts: security clearance requirements, data sovereignty obligations, audit rights, FOIA compliance flag, contract ceiling value, task order structure, procurement vehicle, and agency-specific billing codes. SSOT for all enterprise contractual obligations regardless of customer segment or procurement vehicle.

attributes.name: breach_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration in minutes that the service was in breach of the SLA target during the measurement period. Null if no breach occurred. Used to calculate service credits and assess severity.

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the measured value breached (failed to meet) the target value for this measurement period. True indicates a breach occurred; False indicates target was met or exceeded.

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: Classification of the breach severity based on the magnitude of deviation from target and business impact. Severity levels typically determine credit entitlement amounts and escalation procedures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: credit_currency_code

attributes.name: credit_entitlement_amount
attributes.description: The monetary credit amount (in contract currency) that the enterprise customer is entitled to receive as compensation for this SLA breach, calculated according to the credit schedule defined in the SLA contract.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enterprise customer was notified of this SLA measurement result, particularly for breach events. True if notification was sent; False otherwise.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer was notified of this SLA measurement result. Null if no notification was sent. Used for compliance with notification SLAs.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: A quality score (0-100) indicating the reliability and completeness of the measurement data. Lower scores may indicate gaps in monitoring coverage, probe failures, or data collection issues that affect measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enterprise customer has disputed this SLA measurement result. True if disputed; False otherwise. Disputed measurements may require investigation and resolution before credit processing.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the dispute resolution process for this measurement. Null if no dispute was raised. Tracks the lifecycle of customer challenges to SLA measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: exclusion_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any contractual exclusions were applied to this measurement (e.g., planned maintenance windows, force majeure events, customer-caused outages). True if exclusions were applied; False otherwise.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why an exclusion was applied to this measurement, referencing the specific SLA contract clause. Null if no exclusion was applied.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA measurement record was last updated. Audit field for tracking changes and data quality.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual measured value of the SLA metric during the measurement period. Units depend on metric_type (e.g., percentage for availability, milliseconds for latency, percentage for packet loss).

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: The method used to capture the SLA metric. Options include automated network probes, synthetic transactions, passive traffic monitoring, customer-reported incidents, or manual calculation from operational data.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end
attributes.description: The end date and time of the measurement period for this SLA metric observation. Defines the close of the window during which performance was measured.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start
attributes.description: The start date and time of the measurement period for this SLA metric observation. Defines the beginning of the window during which performance was measured.

attributes.name: measurement_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or network monitoring platform that captured this SLA measurement (e.g., Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, ServiceNow, third-party monitoring tool). Provides data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this SLA measurement record. Draft measurements are preliminary; validated measurements have passed quality checks; approved measurements are ready for reporting; disputed measurements are under review; finalized measurements are locked for billing and reporting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context about this measurement, such as unusual circumstances, data quality issues, or operational events that affected the measurement.

attributes.name: reporting_period
attributes.description: The business reporting period to which this measurement belongs (e.g., 2024-Q1, 2024-03, Week-12-2024). Used for aggregating measurements into periodic SLA reports and dashboards.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The contractually agreed target value for this SLA metric as defined in the SLA contract. Performance is evaluated by comparing measured_value against this target.

products.name: bandwidth_profile
products.description: Defines committed and burst bandwidth profiles for enterprise MPLS/SD-WAN/DIA services — CIR, PIR, burst allowance, traffic class mappings, and QoS parameters

attributes.name: bandwidth_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bandwidth profile. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: enterprise_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enterprise.segment. Business justification: Bandwidth profiles are designed for specific customer segments (e.g., SMB profiles with lower CIR, enterprise profiles with higher SLA targets). Currently bandwidth_profile has applicable_customer_seg

attributes.name: parent_profile_bandwidth_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to a parent bandwidth profile for hierarchical bandwidth management. Enables envelope-based policing where multiple child profiles share a parent bandwidth constraint. Null for top-level profiles.

attributes.name: application_priority
attributes.description: Primary application type this bandwidth profile is optimized for: voice (VoIP, UC), video (conferencing, streaming), data (general business applications), management (network control), scavenger (low-priority bulk).
attributes.references: RFC 4594 - Configuration Guidelines for DiffServ Service Classes

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for this bandwidth profile. New or modified profiles require approval before becoming active for provisioning.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bandwidth profile was approved for production use. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who approved this bandwidth profile for production use. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: availability_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target service availability percentage for circuits using this bandwidth profile, typically expressed as uptime percentage (e.g., 99.99% = four nines).
attributes.references: ITU-T E.800, TM Forum SID - Service Level Specification

attributes.name: bidirectional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bandwidth profile applies symmetrically to both ingress and egress traffic (true) or is unidirectional (false). Most enterprise services use symmetric profiles.

attributes.name: burst_allowance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage above CIR that burst traffic is allowed, calculated as ((PIR - CIR) / CIR) * 100. Represents the burst capacity as a percentage of committed rate.

attributes.name: cbs_bytes
attributes.description: Committed Burst Size - the maximum amount of data in bytes that can be transmitted at line rate while remaining conformant to the CIR. Defines the token bucket depth for committed traffic.

attributes.name: cir_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Committed Information Rate (CIR) in Megabits per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: Committed Information Rate - the guaranteed minimum bandwidth in megabits per second that the service provider commits to deliver under normal conditions. This is the baseline bandwidth the customer can always expect.
attributes.references: MEF 10.3 - Ethernet Services Attributes, ITU-T Y.1731

attributes.name: color_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bandwidth profile policing is color-blind (ignores existing packet color markings) or color-aware (respects pre-marked packet colors from upstream devices).

attributes.name: cos_marking
attributes.description: IEEE 802.1p Class of Service priority value (0-7) for Layer 2 traffic marking. Used for VLAN-tagged Ethernet frames to indicate priority at the data link layer.

attributes.name: coupling_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused committed tokens can be used for excess traffic (true) or if committed and excess buckets are independent (false). Affects burst behavior.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this bandwidth profile record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bandwidth profile record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: dscp_marking
attributes.description: DSCP value used to mark packets conforming to this bandwidth profile. Can be specified as a standard class (EF, AF11-AF43, CS0-CS7, BE) or numeric value (0-63).

attributes.name: ebs_bytes
attributes.description: Excess Burst Size - the maximum amount of excess data in bytes that can be transmitted above the CBS up to the PIR. Defines the token bucket depth for excess traffic.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this bandwidth profile is retired and no longer available for new provisioning. Existing services may continue using the profile until migration. Null indicates no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this bandwidth profile becomes active and available for provisioning new services. Part of the profile lifecycle management.

attributes.name: envelope_coupling_flag
attributes.description: For hierarchical bandwidth profiles, indicates whether unused tokens from one envelope can be shared with another envelope within the same profile hierarchy.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage scope for services using this bandwidth profile: local (metro), regional (multi-city), national (country-wide), international (multi-country), global (worldwide).

attributes.name: jitter_target_ms
attributes.description: Target packet delay variation (jitter) in milliseconds for traffic using this bandwidth profile. Critical for real-time applications like VoIP and video.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who most recently modified this bandwidth profile record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bandwidth profile record was most recently modified. Updated on every change to track the latest modification time.

attributes.name: latency_target_ms
attributes.description: Target one-way network latency in milliseconds for traffic using this bandwidth profile. Part of the QoS performance objectives.

attributes.name: metering_type
attributes.description: Token bucket metering algorithm used for bandwidth policing: single rate two color (srTCM), single rate three color, or two rate three color (trTCM). Determines how traffic is classified and policed.

attributes.name: mtu_bytes
attributes.description: Maximum Transmission Unit - the largest packet size in bytes that can be transmitted without fragmentation for this bandwidth profile. Standard Ethernet is 1500 bytes; jumbo frames can be up to 9000 bytes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about this bandwidth profile, including configuration rationale, special considerations, or operational guidance.

attributes.name: oversubscription_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of total subscribed bandwidth to available physical bandwidth on the network segment. A value of 1.0 means no oversubscription; higher values indicate statistical multiplexing.

attributes.name: packet_loss_target_percentage
attributes.description: Target maximum packet loss ratio as a percentage for traffic using this bandwidth profile. Typically expressed as a very small percentage (e.g., 0.01% = 0.0001).

attributes.name: pir_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Peak Information Rate (PIR) in Megabits per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: Peak Information Rate - the maximum bandwidth in megabits per second that the service can burst to when network capacity is available. Traffic above CIR up to PIR may be delivered on a best-effort basis.
attributes.references: MEF 10.3 - Ethernet Services Attributes, ITU-T Y.1731

attributes.name: policing_action
attributes.description: Action taken on traffic exceeding the bandwidth profile limits: drop (discard excess packets), remark (change DSCP/CoS to lower priority), shape (buffer and delay), pass (allow through without action).

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Billing model for services using this bandwidth profile: flat rate (fixed monthly), usage based (per GB), tiered (volume discounts), burstable billing (95th percentile).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Product Offering Price

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the bandwidth profile, used for external reference and catalog management. Unique across all profiles.

attributes.name: profile_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the bandwidth profile, including use cases, target customer segments, and technical characteristics.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the bandwidth profile, describing its purpose or tier (e.g., Gold Enterprise 100M, Silver SD-WAN 50M).

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bandwidth profile. Active profiles are available for provisioning; deprecated profiles are phased out; retired profiles are no longer used.

attributes.name: qos_tier
attributes.description: Quality of Service tier indicating the priority and treatment level for traffic using this bandwidth profile. Higher tiers receive better latency, jitter, and packet loss guarantees.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Specification, ITU-T Y.1541

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of enterprise service this bandwidth profile applies to: MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching), SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network), DIA (Dedicated Internet Access), VPLS (Virtual Private LAN Service), EVPL (Ethernet Virtual Private Line), EPL (Ethernet Private Line).
attributes.references: MEF (Metro Ethernet Forum) CE 2.0, TM Forum SID

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier associated with this bandwidth profile, determining performance guarantees, support response times, and credit entitlements for breaches.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Service Level Specification

attributes.name: traffic_class
attributes.description: Primary traffic class mapping for this bandwidth profile using DiffServ Code Point (DSCP) classes: EF (Expedited Forwarding - real-time), AF1-AF4 (Assured Forwarding classes 1-4), BE (Best Effort).
attributes.references: RFC 2597 (Assured Forwarding), RFC 3246 (Expedited Forwarding), ITU-T Y.1541

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this bandwidth profile definition. Incremented when profile parameters are modified, enabling change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: upgraded_from_bandwidth_profile_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bandwidth_profile (upgraded_from_bandwidth_profile_id)

products.name: site_access
products.description: This association product represents the authorization and access control relationship between field technicians and enterprise customer sites. It captures security clearances, site-specific credentials, training requirements, and access validity periods that exist only in the context of a technician being authorized to access a specific enterprise site. Each record links one technician to one site with security and access management attributes. Critical for secure site access management in telecommunications field operations where technicians must access sensitive customer facilities (data centers, government buildings, corporate campuses).. Existence Justification: In telecommunications field operations, technicians require authorized access to multiple enterprise customer sites (a regional technician may have credentials for 50+ sites across their territory), and each enterprise site has multiple authorized technicians (primary technician, backup technicians, and specialists for different service types like fiber, CPE, or network equipment). The business actively manages site access authorizations as a security and compliance function, tracking clearance levels, badge numbers, training completion, and access validity periods for each technician-site combination.

products.name: enterprise_account_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the assignment relationship between corporate_account and employee in the context of enterprise account management. It captures the multi-role coverage model where enterprise accounts require dedicated teams with specific roles (account executive, solutions engineer, customer success manager, technical account manager). Each record links one corporate_account to one employee with attributes that define the role, territory, quota allocation, and ownership status of that specific coverage assignment.. Existence Justification: In telecommunications enterprise B2B operations, corporate accounts require multi-role team coverage where multiple employees serve each account in specialized roles (account executive, solutions engineer, customer success manager, technical account manager). Each employee typically covers multiple corporate accounts with varying quota allocations and territory responsibilities. The business actively manages these coverage assignments with role definitions, quota splits, primary ownership flags, and territory scopes.

attributes.name: quota_allocation_percentage

attributes.name: territory_coverage
