attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this coverage assignment record was last updated.

domains.name: people
domains.description: SSOT for all internal workforce identities, organizational structure, HR master data, employee records, roles, departments, and reporting hierarchies across the telecommunications enterprise

products.name: employee
products.description: Master record for every internal workforce identity across the telecommunications enterprise — full-time, part-time, and fixed-term employees. Captures legal name, employee number, national ID, date of birth, gender, marital status, nationality, employment type, employment status (active, on-leave, terminated, retired), hire date, original hire date (for rehires), termination date, termination reason, probation end date, notice period, work location, primary work email, work phone, personal email, personal mobile, emergency contact name and relationship, emergency contact phone, preferred language, and HR system source identifier. This is the SSOT for all internal person identities and is the anchor entity for the entire people domain. Distinct from workforce.technician (field operations personnel) and customer.subscriber (external subscribers).
products.reference: HR Employee Master

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee record. Primary key for the employee entity. System-generated surrogate key used across all internal systems.

attributes.name: location_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary physical work location or office where the employee is based. Used for space planning, emergency response, and regional compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Work Location

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record of this employee's direct manager. Used for reporting hierarchy, approval workflows, and organizational structure visualization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Reporting Structure

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department to which the employee is assigned. Used for cost allocation, reporting hierarchies, and organizational analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Organizational Unit

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Employee's date of birth. Used for age verification, benefits eligibility, retirement planning, and compliance with labor laws.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person to contact in case of employee emergency. Used for workplace incidents, medical emergencies, and critical notifications.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the designated emergency contact. Used for urgent notifications and workplace incident response.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact to the employee (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling, friend). Used to validate contact authority and prioritize notifications.

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique employee identifier assigned by Human Resources. Used on badges, timesheets, and payroll systems. Externally-known identifier for the employee.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Personnel Number

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the employee within the organization. Determines access rights, payroll processing, and system permissions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Personnel Status

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's employment arrangement. Determines benefits eligibility, work schedule expectations, and contract terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Employment Type

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of full-time hours the employee is contracted to work. 100.00 represents full-time; part-time employees have values less than 100. Used for headcount reporting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Employee's self-identified gender. Used for diversity reporting, benefits administration, and compliance with equal employment opportunity regulations.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the employee most recently joined the organization. For rehires, this is the date of the most recent hire event. Used for seniority calculations, benefits vesting, and anniversary recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Hire Date

attributes.name: hr_system_source_code
attributes.description: Original identifier from the source HR system of record. Used for data lineage, system integration, and reconciliation with upstream HR platforms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Personnel Number

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Employee's current job title or position name. Used for organizational charts, business cards, email signatures, and role-based access control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Position

attributes.name: legal_first_name
attributes.description: Employee's legal first name as it appears on government-issued identification documents. Used for payroll, tax forms, and official HR records.

attributes.name: legal_last_name
attributes.description: Employee's legal last name (surname/family name) as it appears on government-issued identification documents. Used for payroll, tax forms, and official HR records.

attributes.name: legal_middle_name
attributes.description: Employee's legal middle name or initial as it appears on government-issued identification documents. Optional field; may be null if not applicable.

attributes.name: marital_status
attributes.description: Employee's current marital status. Used for tax withholding calculations, benefits enrollment, and emergency contact validation.

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in USA, National Insurance Number in UK). Used for tax reporting, benefits administration, and legal compliance.

attributes.name: nationality
attributes.description: Employee's country of citizenship using ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Used for work authorization verification, international assignment eligibility, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days of advance notice required for voluntary resignation or termination, as specified in the employment contract. Used for workforce planning and transition management.

attributes.name: original_hire_date
attributes.description: Date the employee first joined the organization, even if they left and were rehired. Used for calculating total service time and long-term benefits eligibility.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Employee's compensation grade or band within the organization's salary structure. Used for compensation planning, equity analysis, and career progression tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Compensation

attributes.name: personal_email
attributes.description: Employee's personal email address. Used for emergency communications, benefits notifications, and post-employment correspondence.

attributes.name: personal_mobile
attributes.description: Employee's personal mobile phone number. Used for emergency contact, two-factor authentication, and urgent business communications.

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: Employee's preferred language for business communications and system interfaces, using ISO 639-1 two-letter language code. Used for localization, training materials, and HR communications.

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: Name the employee prefers to be called in day-to-day business interactions. May differ from legal name. Used in email signatures, directory listings, and internal communications.

attributes.name: probation_end_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's probationary period ends. Used to trigger performance reviews, benefits eligibility changes, and employment status updates.

attributes.name: rehire_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for rehire based on their employment history and termination circumstances. Used for recruitment screening and applicant tracking.

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: Employee's security clearance or access authorization level. Used for physical access control, data access permissions, and project assignment eligibility. Null if no clearance required.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's employment ended. Null for active employees. Used for final payroll processing, benefits termination, and access revocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Termination Date

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for employment termination. Used for turnover analysis, exit interview tracking, and rehire eligibility determination. Null for active employees.
attributes.value_regex: voluntary resignation|involuntary termination|retirement|end of contract|layoff|mutual agreement

attributes.name: union_membership_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a member of a labor union. Used for collective bargaining agreement compliance, dues deduction, and labor relations reporting.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this employee record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: Employee's primary corporate email address. Used for business communications, system notifications, and authentication. Typically follows company email naming convention.

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Employee's primary work phone number (desk phone or assigned mobile). Used for business contact and directory listings.

attributes.name: work_schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's work schedule pattern. Used for time tracking, shift planning, and workforce management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Work Schedule

products.name: org_unit
products.description: Master record for every organizational unit (department, division, business unit, cost center group, team) within the telecommunications enterprise hierarchy. Captures org unit code, name, description, org unit type (division, department, team, cost center group), parent org unit reference for hierarchy traversal, effective start and end dates, org unit head employee reference, legal entity association, geographic region, functional area classification (network operations, commercial, finance, IT, HR, legal, regulatory), headcount budget, and active status. Supports multi-level organizational hierarchy modeling for reporting, access control, and workforce planning.
products.reference: Organizational Unit / Cost Center

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the organizational unit within the telecommunications enterprise hierarchy.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Organizational units map to cost centers for hierarchy-based budget rollups and management reporting. Telecommunications requires alignment between HR org structure and financial reporting structure.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity to which this organizational unit belongs, used for financial consolidation, regulatory reporting, and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: parent_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent organizational unit in the hierarchy, enabling multi-level organizational structure traversal and roll-up reporting. Null for top-level units.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Shared Information/Data Model

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Organizational units in telecommunications align to profit centers for P&L reporting by business segment (consumer mobile, enterprise, wholesale). Enables revenue/cost center alignment and segment pro

attributes.name: actual_headcount
attributes.description: Current actual headcount or number of employees assigned to this organizational unit, used for variance analysis against budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Organizational Assignment

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total annual operating budget allocated to this organizational unit for OPEX (Operational Expenditure) planning and financial control.

attributes.name: budget_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the annual budget amount, supporting multi-currency enterprise operations.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Higher-level business unit code to which this organizational unit belongs, used for strategic reporting and business segment analysis.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the organizational unit is primarily located or headquartered.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for contacting this organizational unit, used for internal communication and directory services.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for contacting this organizational unit, used for internal communication and directory services.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating the primary country of operation for this organizational unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit ceased operations or was dissolved. Null for currently active units. Supports historical organizational structure analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this organizational unit became active and operational within the enterprise structure, supporting temporal hierarchy modeling.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Primary functional area or business domain classification of the organizational unit (e.g., network operations, commercial, finance, IT, HR, legal, regulatory, customer service). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: network_operations|commercial|finance|information_technology|human_resources|legal|regulatory|customer_service|engineering|marketing|sales|procurement|supply_chain — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Enhanced Telecom Operations Map

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or territory served or managed by this organizational unit, used for regional reporting and market segmentation.

attributes.name: head_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who serves as the head, manager, or leader of this organizational unit, responsible for its operations and performance.

attributes.name: headcount_budget
attributes.description: Approved headcount budget or authorized number of full-time equivalent (FTE) positions allocated to this organizational unit for workforce planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Workforce Planning

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level of this organizational unit within the enterprise hierarchy, with 1 being the top level (e.g., CEO office) and increasing numbers representing deeper levels.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Party Hierarchy Model

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Full hierarchical path from root to this organizational unit, typically represented as a delimited string of org unit codes or IDs for efficient hierarchy queries.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Party Hierarchy Model

attributes.name: is_customer_facing
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this organizational unit has direct customer interaction responsibilities (e.g., customer service, sales, field operations).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Customer Facing Processes

attributes.name: is_revenue_generating
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this organizational unit directly generates revenue (e.g., sales, commercial units) or is a support/cost center.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last updated, supporting change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: manager_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the organizational unit head or manager (e.g., Vice President, Director, Manager, Team Lead).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Position Management

attributes.name: office_location
attributes.description: Specific office location, building name, or site identifier where the organizational unit is physically located.

attributes.name: org_unit_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the organizational unit, used in financial systems, reporting hierarchies, and access control. Typically alphanumeric and unique across the enterprise.

attributes.name: org_unit_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the organizational unit's purpose, responsibilities, scope of work, and role within the broader enterprise structure.

attributes.name: org_unit_name
attributes.description: Official name of the organizational unit as recognized in corporate documentation, organizational charts, and HR systems.

attributes.name: org_unit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit indicating whether it is active, inactive, pending activation, suspended, dissolved, or merged into another unit.

attributes.name: org_unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit indicating its hierarchical level and structural role within the enterprise (e.g., division, department, team, cost center group, business unit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: division|department|team|cost_center_group|business_unit|function|region|subsidiary — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated or short form name of the organizational unit used in reports, dashboards, and user interfaces where space is limited.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Shared Information/Data Model

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA tier classification for this organizational unit indicating priority level for internal service delivery and support escalation.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the primary operating location of this organizational unit, used for scheduling and workforce management.

attributes.name: workforce_type
attributes.description: Primary workforce composition type for this organizational unit (e.g., permanent employees, contractors, hybrid, outsourced, offshore).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Workforce Planning

products.name: position
products.description: Master record for every approved headcount position within the organizational structure — the slot that an employee fills, independent of the person occupying it. Captures position code, position title, position grade/band, job family, job function, org unit assignment, reporting position (manager position), FTE allocation, position type (permanent, fixed-term, contractor slot), required qualifications summary, required clearance level, budgeted flag, filled/vacant status, effective start and end dates, and position creation reason. Enables workforce planning, vacancy tracking, and succession management independent of individual employee records.
products.reference: Position Management / Headcount Slot

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the position record. Primary key for the position entity.

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to people.job_profile. Business justification: Link each Position to its standardized Job_Profile, consolidating duplicate descriptive fields and enabling consistent reporting.

attributes.name: location_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary work location or site where the position is based. Links to facility or office location master data.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit (department, division, cost center) to which this position is assigned. Links position to the organizational hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Organizational Management

attributes.name: reporting_position_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager position to which this position reports. Establishes the reporting hierarchy independent of individual employees. Null for top-level executive positions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Organizational Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was officially approved by management or HR governance. Marks formal authorization to create and fund the position.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Position Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or manager who approved the position creation. Used for governance and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: budgeted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is included in the approved headcount budget. True if budgeted and approved for funding, False if not budgeted or pending budget approval.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center to which the position's compensation and benefits expenses are charged. Used for financial planning and expense allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the position record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: creation_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason for creating the position. Captures whether the position was created for new business needs, as a replacement, due to restructuring, expansion, regulatory requirements, or project needs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Position Management

attributes.name: critical_position_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is designated as business-critical or key to operations. True for positions where vacancy would significantly impact business continuity or service delivery.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the position is scheduled to end or was eliminated from the organizational structure. Null for ongoing permanent positions. Used for fixed-term positions and position elimination tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the position becomes active and available in the organizational structure. Marks the beginning of the position's lifecycle.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Standard employment classification indicating whether the position is full-time, part-time, job-share, or on-call. Complements FTE allocation with categorical classification.

attributes.name: exempt_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exempt Status
attributes.description: Classification of the position under Fair Labor Standards Act for overtime eligibility. Exempt positions are not eligible for overtime pay, non-exempt positions are eligible.

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Full-time equivalent allocation for the position. 1.00 represents a full-time position, 0.50 represents half-time, etc. Used for headcount planning and budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Workforce Planning

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the position record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was last reviewed for relevance, classification accuracy, and organizational fit. Used for periodic position management and organizational design reviews.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next position review. Used to ensure regular evaluation of position relevance and classification accuracy.

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the position, typically used in HR systems and organizational charts. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each approved headcount slot.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Position Management

attributes.name: position_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the position's responsibilities, duties, and scope. Provides comprehensive overview of what the role entails independent of the incumbent.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the position. Indicates whether the position is active and available, currently filled, vacant and open for recruitment, frozen (temporarily unavailable), eliminated, or pending approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Position Management

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the position based on employment duration and nature. Distinguishes between permanent headcount, fixed-term roles, contractor slots, and temporary positions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Position Management

attributes.name: required_clearance_level
attributes.description: Minimum security clearance or background check level required for the position. Relevant for positions with access to sensitive network infrastructure, customer data, or classified information.

attributes.name: required_qualifications_summary
attributes.description: Summary of minimum required qualifications, certifications, education, and experience for the position. Used for recruitment and succession planning.

attributes.name: span_of_control
attributes.description: Number of direct report positions that report to this position. Used for organizational design and management capacity planning. Zero for non-supervisory positions.

attributes.name: succession_plan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal succession plan exists for this position. True if succession planning is active, False otherwise. Typically True for critical and leadership positions.

attributes.name: supervisory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position has supervisory or management responsibilities. True if the position manages direct reports, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Organizational Management

attributes.name: travel_requirement_percentage
attributes.description: Expected percentage of time the position requires business travel. Expressed as integer percentage (0-100). Used for role expectations and expense planning.

attributes.name: union_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for union membership or covered by collective bargaining agreements. Relevant for labor relations and compliance.

attributes.name: work_arrangement
attributes.description: Standard work arrangement or location flexibility for the position. Indicates whether the role is on-site, fully remote, hybrid, field-based, or mobile.

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on position (reports_to_position_id)

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Reference master defining standardized job profiles and role definitions used across the telecommunications enterprise. Captures job profile code, job title, job family (e.g., Network Engineering, Sales, Finance, IT, HR, Legal), job subfamily, job level/grade band, FLSA classification (exempt/non-exempt), standard job description, core competencies required, minimum education requirement, minimum years of experience, typical career path predecessor and successor roles, and active status. Serves as the canonical reference for job architecture and compensation banding. Distinct from position (which is an org-specific headcount slot) and from workforce.skill (which tracks individual proficiency).
products.reference: Job Architecture / Job Profile

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job profile. Primary key for the job profile reference master.

attributes.name: bonus_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the job profile is eligible for performance-based bonus or incentive compensation. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Primary business unit or division to which the job profile is aligned. May be null for enterprise-wide job profiles applicable across multiple business units.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Enhanced Telecom Operations Map

attributes.name: commission_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the job profile is eligible for sales commission or variable compensation tied to revenue generation. True if eligible, False otherwise. Typically applies to sales and business development roles.

attributes.name: core_competencies
attributes.description: List of essential skills, knowledge areas, and behavioral competencies required for successful performance in the role. May include technical skills (e.g., Long-Term Evolution (LTE), 5G New Radio (5G NR), Software-Defined Networking (SDN)), leadership competencies, and domain expertise.
attributes.references: TM Forum TAM - Telecom Application Map

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Default cost center code for budgeting and financial planning purposes associated with the job profile. Used in headcount planning and Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) / Operational Expenditure (OPEX) allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the job profile record was first created in the system. Record audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the job profile was or will be retired or deprecated. Null for currently active profiles with no planned end date. Used for temporal validity and historical tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the job profile became or will become active and available for use in the organization. Used for temporal validity and historical tracking.

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether the role is exempt or non-exempt from overtime pay requirements. Critical for payroll compliance and labor law adherence.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) - U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: grade_band
attributes.description: Compensation grade or pay band assigned to the job profile. Determines salary range, bonus eligibility, and benefits tier. Confidential business-sensitive data used in compensation planning.

attributes.name: is_customer_facing
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the job profile involves direct interaction with external customers. True if the role regularly engages with customers, False otherwise. Used for Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and training planning.

attributes.name: is_people_manager
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the job profile includes direct people management responsibilities (supervising, coaching, performance evaluation of subordinates). True if the role manages people, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_safety_sensitive
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the job profile is classified as safety-sensitive, requiring adherence to occupational health and safety regulations, drug testing, and specialized training. True for roles such as field technicians, network engineers working on infrastructure, False otherwise.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Comprehensive narrative describing the purpose, responsibilities, duties, and scope of the job profile. Used in recruitment, performance management, and role clarification.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the job profile into a major functional area or discipline. Primary classification for workforce segmentation and career pathing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Network Engineering|Sales|Finance|Information Technology|Human Resources|Legal|Customer Service|Marketing|Operations|Product Management|Supply Chain|Security|Compliance|Data Analytics|Corporate Strategy — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Enhanced Telecom Operations Map

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level or seniority tier of the job profile within the organizational structure. Used for compensation banding, reporting hierarchy definition, and career progression planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Individual Contributor|Team Lead|Manager|Senior Manager|Director|Senior Director|Vice President|Senior Vice President|Executive Vice President|C-Level — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: job_profile_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the job profile across the enterprise. Used in Human Resources (HR) systems, payroll, and workforce planning. Business identifier for external reference.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Shared Information/Data Model

attributes.name: job_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile. Active profiles are available for use in hiring and workforce planning. Inactive or deprecated profiles are retained for historical reference but not used for new hires.

attributes.name: job_subfamily
attributes.description: Secondary classification within the job family providing finer granularity. For example, within Network Engineering: Radio Access Network (RAN), Core Network, Transport, Operations Support Systems (OSS).
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Enhanced Telecom Operations Map

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title as it appears in organizational charts, offer letters, and employee records. Human-readable identity label for the role.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the job profile record was most recently updated. Record audit field for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when the job profile was last reviewed and validated by Human Resources (HR) or the business owner. Used to ensure job profiles remain current and aligned with organizational needs.

attributes.name: minimum_education_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum level of formal education required for the job profile. Used in candidate screening and workforce planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: High School Diploma|Associate Degree|Bachelor Degree|Master Degree|Doctoral Degree|Professional Certification|No Formal Requirement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: minimum_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for the job profile. Used in recruitment and succession planning.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of the job profile. Used for governance and ensuring job architecture remains aligned with business strategy.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the job profile is eligible for overtime compensation. Typically aligns with Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) non-exempt classification. True if eligible, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) - U.S. Department of Labor

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Human Resources (HR) business partner or functional leader responsible for maintaining and governing the job profile. Accountability field for data stewardship.

attributes.name: predecessor_job_profile_code
attributes.description: Job profile code of the typical prior role in the career path leading to this job profile. Used for career progression planning and internal mobility analysis. May be null for entry-level roles.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Shared Information/Data Model

attributes.name: remote_work_eligibility
attributes.description: Classification of the job profiles eligibility for remote or hybrid work arrangements. Reflects organizational policy and role requirements.

attributes.name: security_clearance_required

attributes.name: work_schedule_pattern

attributes.name: superseded_assignment_id

products.name: compensation
