attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Payment Method Configuration

attributes.name: payslip_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique payslip reference number used for employee inquiries and audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Payroll Document Numbering

attributes.name: payslip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payslip document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Payroll Document Status

attributes.name: pension_employee_contribution
attributes.description: Employee contribution to retirement pension plan deducted from gross pay.
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) - Pension Plan Requirements

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this payslip, such as adjustments, corrections, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: shift_differential
attributes.description: Additional compensation for working non-standard shifts (night, weekend, holiday).
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) - Shift Premium Guidelines

attributes.name: social_security_employee
attributes.description: Employee portion of social security tax deducted from gross pay.
attributes.references: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) - Social Security Tax

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all deductions from gross pay including taxes, insurance, pension, loans, and other withholdings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Total Deductions Calculation

attributes.name: union_dues
attributes.description: Union membership dues deducted from gross pay as per collective bargaining agreement.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) - Union Dues Collection

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code of the physical work location or site where the employee was assigned during this pay period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Personnel Area Configuration

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross earnings from the start of the calendar or fiscal year through this pay period.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Annual Wage Reporting (Form W-2)

attributes.name: ytd_income_tax
attributes.description: Cumulative income tax withheld from the start of the calendar or fiscal year through this pay period.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Tax Withholding Reporting

attributes.name: ytd_net_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative net pay from the start of the calendar or fiscal year through this pay period.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Annual Wage Reporting (Form W-2)

attributes.name: correction_of_payslip_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payslip (correction_of_payslip_id)

products.name: benefit_plan
products.description: Reference master defining all employee benefit plans offered by the telecommunications enterprise — health insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, pension/retirement, employee stock purchase, wellness programs, and telecom service discounts. Captures plan code, plan name, benefit category (medical, dental, vision, life, disability, pension, EAP, telecom_discount, wellness), plan provider name, plan description, eligibility criteria (employment type, minimum tenure, grade band), employee contribution rate, employer contribution rate, coverage tiers (employee only, employee+spouse, family), enrollment window type (open enrollment, life event, new hire), effective start and end dates, and active status.
products.reference: Benefits Plan Master

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee benefit plan. Primary key for the benefit plan entity.

attributes.name: allows_dependent_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan allows employees to enroll eligible dependents (spouse, children, domestic partner) for coverage. True if dependent coverage is available; false if employee-only.

attributes.name: annual_coverage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay in benefits per covered individual per year. Nullable for plans with unlimited coverage. Applicable primarily to health, dental, and vision plans.

attributes.name: benefit_category
attributes.description: Classification of the benefit plan by type of coverage or program. Segments benefit offerings into major categories for reporting, compliance, and employee decision-making. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life_insurance|disability|pension|retirement|stock_purchase|wellness|telecom_discount|employee_assistance — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) - Plan Classification

attributes.name: carrier_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy or contract number assigned by the insurance carrier or benefit provider. Used for claims processing, provider verification, and carrier communications.
attributes.references: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) - Policy Identification Standards

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan is subject to COBRA continuation coverage requirements. True for group health plans; false for plans exempt from COBRA (e.g., certain retirement plans).
attributes.references: COBRA - Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act of 1985

attributes.name: coinsurance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of covered expenses the employee pays after meeting the deductible, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2000 represents 20% coinsurance). The plan pays the remaining percentage.

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are made to the benefit plan. Determines payroll deduction schedule and plan funding cadence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Payroll Processing Frequency

attributes.name: copay_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the employee pays for specific covered services (e.g., doctor visit, prescription). Applicable to health, dental, and vision plans. May vary by service type.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage provided by the plan, indicating who is covered under the benefit (employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, full family, or domestic partner). Affects premium calculations.
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA) - Coverage Tier Definitions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount the employee must pay out-of-pocket before the plan begins to pay benefits. Applicable to health, dental, and vision insurance plans. Varies by coverage tier.
attributes.references: ACA Section 1302 - Essential Health Benefits Package

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit plan ceases to be active and is no longer available for new enrollments. Nullable for open-ended plans with no predetermined termination date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the benefit plan becomes active and available for employee enrollment. Represents the beginning of the plan's coverage period.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Textual description of requirements employees must meet to enroll in the plan, including employment type (full-time, part-time, contractor), minimum tenure, grade band, location, or other qualifying conditions.

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount contributed by the employee per pay period or per month, if the plan uses flat-rate contributions instead of percentage-based. Nullable if percentage-based contribution is used.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Payroll Deduction Management

attributes.name: employee_contribution_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of plan cost paid by the employee, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 represents 25%). Used to calculate payroll deductions for benefit premiums.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code Section 125 - Cafeteria Plans

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount contributed by the employer per pay period or per month, if the plan uses flat-rate contributions instead of percentage-based. Nullable if percentage-based contribution is used.

attributes.name: employer_contribution_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of plan cost paid by the employer, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 represents 75%). Represents the company's subsidy of the benefit plan.

attributes.name: employer_match_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount or percentage of salary the employer will match per year in retirement plans. Represents the cap on employer matching contributions.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code Section 401(k) - Contribution Limits

attributes.name: employer_match_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of employee contributions that the employer will match in retirement or savings plans, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 represents 50% match). Applicable to 401(k), 403(b), and similar plans.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code Section 401(k) - Matching Contributions

attributes.name: employment_type_eligibility
attributes.description: Employment classification required for plan eligibility. Specifies which employment types are eligible to enroll in this benefit plan.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) - Employee Classification

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment window closes for this benefit plan. Employees must complete enrollment actions before this date to participate in the plan for the coverage period.

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment window opens for employees to enroll in or make changes to this benefit plan. Applicable for open enrollment and special enrollment periods.

attributes.name: enrollment_window_type
attributes.description: Type of enrollment period during which employees can enroll in or modify this benefit plan. Open enrollment is annual; life event is triggered by qualifying events; new hire is during onboarding; special enrollment is for exceptional circumstances.

attributes.name: erisa_plan_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Employee Retirement Income Security Act (ERISA) Plan Number
attributes.description: Three-digit plan number assigned for ERISA reporting purposes. Required for Form 5500 annual reporting. Each benefit plan under the same plan sponsor must have a unique ERISA plan number.

attributes.name: grade_band_eligibility
attributes.description: Organizational grade bands or job levels eligible for this plan (e.g., 'Executive', 'Management', 'Individual Contributor', 'All Grades'). Used for tiered benefit offerings.

attributes.name: hipaa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this benefit plan is subject to HIPAA privacy and security requirements. True for health plans that handle protected health information (PHI); false for non-health benefits.
attributes.references: HIPAA - Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrollment in this benefit plan is mandatory for eligible employees (true) or voluntary (false). Certain benefits like basic life insurance may be mandatory.

attributes.name: lifetime_coverage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount the plan will pay in benefits per covered individual over their lifetime. Nullable for plans with unlimited coverage. Prohibited for essential health benefits under ACA but may apply to supplemental benefits.

attributes.name: minimum_tenure_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months an employee must be employed before becoming eligible for this benefit plan. Zero indicates immediate eligibility upon hire.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this benefit plan record. Used for audit trail and change management.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this benefit plan record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum amount an employee will pay in a plan year for covered services. After reaching this limit, the plan pays 100% of covered expenses. Applicable to health insurance plans.

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the benefit plan in HR systems and employee communications. Used for enrollment, payroll deduction, and benefits administration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Benefits Administration

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the benefit plan including coverage details, key features, exclusions, and value proposition for employees. Used in benefits guides and enrollment materials.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 102 - Summary Plan Description Requirements

attributes.name: plan_document_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Benefit Plan Document Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: Web address or document management system link to the official plan document, summary plan description, or benefits guide. Provides employees access to detailed plan terms and conditions.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 104(b) - Plan Document Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the benefit plan as displayed to employees during enrollment and on benefits statements (e.g., 'Comprehensive Health Plus', 'Basic Dental Coverage', 'Employee Stock Purchase Plan 2024').
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Domain

attributes.name: plan_sponsor_ein
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number of the organization sponsoring the benefit plan. Used for tax reporting and regulatory filings. Format: XX-XXXXXXX.

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit plan. Active plans are available for enrollment; inactive plans are no longer offered; pending plans are awaiting approval; suspended plans are temporarily unavailable; terminated plans have been permanently closed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Benefits Plan Status Management

attributes.name: plan_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the specific type or structure of the benefit plan (e.g., HMO, PPO for health; 401K, 403B for retirement; ESPP for stock purchase). Used for regulatory reporting and plan categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: HMO|PPO|EPO|POS|HDHP|FSA|HSA|401K|403B|457|ESPP|RSU|PENSION — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code - Qualified Plan Types

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year or fiscal year for which this benefit plan is offered (e.g., 2024). Used for annual benefits planning, compliance reporting, and historical tracking.

attributes.name: provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier, financial institution, or third-party administrator providing the benefit plan (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield', 'Fidelity Investments', 'MetLife').

attributes.name: tax_treatment
attributes.description: Tax status of employee contributions to the plan. Pre-tax contributions reduce taxable income; post-tax contributions are made with after-tax dollars; Roth contributions are post-tax but grow tax-free; tax-exempt applies to certain benefits.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Code Section 125 - Cafeteria Plans Tax Treatment

attributes.name: vesting_period_months
attributes.description: Number of months an employee must participate in the plan before employer contributions become fully owned by the employee. Applicable to retirement plans, stock purchase plans, and pension plans. Zero indicates immediate vesting.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this benefit plan record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: superseded_benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on benefit_plan (superseded_benefit_plan_id)

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Transactional record of an employee's enrollment in a specific benefit plan for a coverage period. Captures employee reference, benefit plan reference, coverage tier selected (employee only, employee+spouse, employee+children, family), enrollment date, coverage start date, coverage end date, enrollment event type (new hire, open enrollment, qualifying life event, voluntary change), employee monthly contribution amount, employer monthly contribution amount, dependent count, enrollment status (active, pending, terminated, waived), waiver reason if applicable, and benefit provider enrollment confirmation number.
products.reference: Benefits Enrollment

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrollment record. Primary key for the benefit enrollment transaction.

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific benefit plan in which the employee is enrolling. Links to the benefit plan master record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee enrolling in the benefit plan. Links to the employee master record in the people domain.

attributes.name: beneficiary_designation_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has designated beneficiaries for this benefit plan. Applicable primarily to life insurance and retirement benefits. True indicates beneficiary forms are complete, false indicates missing or incomplete.
attributes.references: ERISA - Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: carrier_acknowledgement_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the benefit carrier has acknowledged receipt and acceptance of the enrollment. True indicates carrier confirmed enrollment, false indicates no acknowledgement or rejection.

attributes.name: carrier_acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the benefit carrier acknowledged the enrollment. Used for reconciliation and SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking with external providers.

attributes.name: cobra_election_deadline_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Deadline Date
attributes.description: Date by which the employee must elect COBRA continuation coverage. Typically 60 days from the qualifying event or notice date, whichever is later. Populated only when COBRA eligible is true.
attributes.references: COBRA - Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of this enrollment. True indicates COBRA rights apply, false indicates not eligible. Applicable primarily to health insurance enrollments.
attributes.references: COBRA - Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act

attributes.name: contribution_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for contribution amounts. Typically USD for US-based telecommunications operations but supports multi-currency for global workforce.

attributes.name: coverage_end_date
attributes.description: Date when benefit coverage terminates. Nullable for active ongoing enrollments. Populated upon termination, plan change, or employment separation.

attributes.name: coverage_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date when benefit coverage begins. May differ from enrollment date due to waiting periods or plan year alignment.

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage selected by the employee indicating who is covered under the benefit plan. Determines premium amounts and coverage scope.

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this enrollment. Used for coverage verification and premium calculation validation.

attributes.name: employee_monthly_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount deducted from employee paycheck for this benefit enrollment. Represents the employee share of the benefit cost.

attributes.name: employer_monthly_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Monthly premium amount paid by the employer for this benefit enrollment. Represents the employer subsidy or contribution toward the benefit cost.

attributes.name: enrollment_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the enrollment was approved by HR or benefits administrator. Null if approval is not required or still pending.

attributes.name: enrollment_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Unique confirmation number provided by the benefit provider upon successful enrollment. Used for tracking and verification with external benefit administrators.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the employee submitted the enrollment election. Represents the business event timestamp when the enrollment decision was made.

attributes.name: enrollment_event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the event that triggered this enrollment. New hire indicates initial employment enrollment, open enrollment indicates annual election period, qualifying life event indicates mid-year change due to marriage/birth/etc, voluntary change indicates employee-initiated modification, annual renewal indicates automatic continuation, rehire indicates return to employment.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the employee completed the enrollment. Online portal indicates self-service web enrollment, paper form indicates manual submission, phone indicates call center enrollment, benefits fair indicates in-person event, HR representative indicates assisted enrollment, mobile app indicates mobile self-service.

attributes.name: enrollment_source_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this enrollment record in the source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

attributes.name: enrollment_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or benefits administration platform from which this enrollment record originated. Examples include SAP S/4HANA HCM, Workday, ADP, or third-party benefits administration systems.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment. Active indicates coverage is in effect, pending indicates awaiting approval or effective date, terminated indicates coverage has ended, waived indicates employee declined coverage, suspended indicates temporary hold, cancelled indicates enrollment was reversed before taking effect.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: enrollment_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the enrollment was submitted by the employee. Provides audit trail for compliance with election deadlines and regulatory windows.

attributes.name: enrollment_transmitted_to_carrier_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the enrollment was transmitted to the benefit provider or insurance carrier. Used for tracking integration SLA (Service Level Agreement) and troubleshooting transmission failures.

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee must provide medical evidence of insurability for this enrollment. Typically required for late enrollments or coverage amounts exceeding guaranteed issue limits. True indicates EOI is required, false indicates no medical underwriting needed.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: evidence_of_insurability_status
attributes.description: Current status of the evidence of insurability review process. Not required indicates no medical underwriting needed, pending indicates awaiting carrier decision, approved indicates coverage granted, denied indicates coverage declined, incomplete indicates additional information needed.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special circumstances, or administrative notes related to this enrollment. Used by HR and benefits administrators for case management and documentation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this enrollment is effective. Benefit plans typically operate on annual cycles aligned with plan years.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: provider_enrollment_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the external benefit provider or insurance carrier for this enrollment. Used for coordination with carrier systems and claims processing.

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_date
attributes.description: Date when the qualifying life event occurred. Used to validate enrollment timing and compliance with 30-day or 60-day election windows mandated by regulations.
attributes.references: ERISA - Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: qualifying_life_event_type
attributes.description: Specific type of qualifying life event that permitted mid-year enrollment change. Examples include marriage, divorce, birth, adoption, loss of other coverage, change in employment status. Populated only when enrollment event type is qualifying life event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death_of_dependent|loss_of_coverage|employment_status_change|dependent_age_out|court_order|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA - Employee Retirement Income Security Act

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this enrollment record was first created in the data warehouse. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this enrollment record was last modified in the data warehouse. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the benefit enrollment was terminated. Examples include employment termination, plan change, employee request, loss of eligibility, retirement, death. Populated only when coverage end date is set and enrollment status is terminated.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the reason for enrollment termination. Employment termination indicates separation from company, plan change indicates switch to different benefit plan, employee request indicates voluntary cancellation, loss of eligibility indicates no longer qualified, retirement indicates employee retired, death indicates employee deceased.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: tobacco_user_status
attributes.description: Employee self-reported tobacco use status. Used for premium rating in health and life insurance plans. User indicates tobacco use within specified lookback period, non-user indicates no tobacco use, declined to answer indicates employee chose not to disclose.
attributes.references: HIPAA - Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by employee when declining benefit coverage. Populated only when enrollment status is waived. Used for compliance documentation and trend analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing why the employee waived coverage. Spouse coverage indicates covered under spouses plan, other employer indicates coverage through another job, government program indicates Medicare/Medicaid/VA, cost indicates unaffordable, not needed indicates no perceived need, other for miscellaneous reasons.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: prior_benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on benefit_enrollment (prior_benefit_enrollment_id)

products.name: leave_entitlement
products.description: Master record tracking an employee's leave balance and entitlement for each leave type within a leave year. Captures employee reference, leave year, leave type (annual leave, sick leave, maternity leave, paternity leave, parental leave, bereavement leave, study leave, unpaid leave, compensatory leave), entitlement days, carried-forward days from prior year, accrued days to date, taken days, pending days (approved but not yet taken), forfeited days, remaining balance, accrual frequency (monthly, annual, per-pay-period), and balance as-of date. Supports leave liability reporting and workforce availability planning.
products.reference: Leave Balance / Absence Entitlement

attributes.name: leave_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave entitlement record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that created this leave entitlement record. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who holds this leave entitlement. Links to the employee master record in the people domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Personnel Administration

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or process that last modified this leave entitlement record. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: accrual_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which leave accrual ends for this entitlement record. Typically the end of the leave year or the employees termination date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: accrual_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which leave days are accrued for this entitlement. Monthly indicates leave accrues each month; annual indicates full entitlement granted at start of year; per_pay_period indicates accrual aligned with payroll cycles; daily indicates daily accrual; quarterly indicates accrual every quarter.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: accrual_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which leave accrual begins for this entitlement record. Typically the start of the leave year or the employees hire date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: accrued_days
attributes.description: Number of leave days accrued to date within the current leave year, based on the accrual frequency and the employees tenure. Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether manager or HR approval is required before leave can be taken for this entitlement (True) or if leave can be taken without prior approval (False).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: balance_as_of_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the leave balance figures (accrued, taken, pending, remaining) are accurate. Used for point-in-time reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: carried_forward_days
attributes.description: Number of unused leave days carried forward from the previous leave year, subject to company policy and regulatory limits. Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: carryover_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date by which carried-forward leave days must be used, after which they will be forfeited. Null indicates no expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: carryover_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of leave days that can be carried forward to the next leave year, as per company policy or regulatory requirements. Null indicates no limit. Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave entitlement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: entitlement_days
attributes.description: Total number of leave days the employee is entitled to for this leave type in the specified leave year, as per company policy, employment contract, or statutory requirements. Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the leave entitlement record. Active indicates the entitlement is currently valid and available for use; inactive indicates it is not currently in effect; expired indicates the leave year has ended; suspended indicates temporary hold; pending indicates awaiting approval or activation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: forfeited_days
attributes.description: Number of leave days forfeited due to expiration, policy limits, or failure to use within the allowed timeframe. Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: is_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave type is paid (True) or unpaid (False).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Payroll

attributes.name: is_statutory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave entitlement is mandated by statutory or regulatory requirements (True) or is a company-provided benefit (False).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two or three-letter code identifying the legal jurisdiction (country or state/province) whose labor laws govern this leave entitlement (e.g., US, UK, CA, DE).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave entitlement record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: leave_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of leave (e.g., AL for annual leave, SL for sick leave, ML for maternity leave, PL for paternity leave, PRNT for parental leave, BRV for bereavement leave, STD for study leave, UNP for unpaid leave, COMP for compensatory leave).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: leave_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the leave type (e.g., Annual Leave, Sick Leave, Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Parental Leave, Bereavement Leave, Study Leave, Unpaid Leave, Compensatory Leave).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: leave_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year for which this leave entitlement applies. Typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: liability_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial liability for unused leave days, calculated based on the employees current salary and remaining leave balance. Used for financial reporting and accrual accounting. Measured in the companys reporting currency.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) - IAS 19 Employee Benefits

attributes.name: liability_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the leave liability amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to this leave entitlement (e.g., special approvals, adjustments, policy exceptions).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: pending_days
attributes.description: Number of leave days that have been approved but not yet taken (future-dated leave requests). Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: policy_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the company policy document or section that governs this leave entitlement (e.g., policy number, handbook section, collective bargaining agreement clause).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Organizational Management

attributes.name: proration_factor
attributes.description: Factor used to prorate leave entitlement for employees who join or leave mid-year, or who work part-time. A value of 1.0000 indicates full entitlement; values less than 1.0000 indicate prorated entitlement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: remaining_balance_days
attributes.description: Current remaining leave balance available for the employee to use, calculated as (entitlement_days + carried_forward_days + accrued_days - taken_days - pending_days - forfeited_days). Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this leave entitlement record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this leave entitlement data originated (e.g., SAP_HCM, WORKDAY, ORACLE_HCM).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: taken_days
attributes.description: Number of leave days already taken by the employee for this leave type in the specified leave year. Measured in days and may include fractional days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Time Management

attributes.name: carried_from_leave_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on leave_entitlement (carried_from_leave_entitlement_id)

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Transactional record of an employee's leave application and approval workflow. Captures employee reference, leave type, requested start date, requested end date, number of days requested, half-day flag, leave reason (optional), manager approver reference, submission timestamp, approval/rejection timestamp, approval status (pending, approved, rejected, cancelled, recalled), rejection reason, HR override flag, substitute employee reference, and return-to-work confirmation date. Feeds leave entitlement balance updates and workforce availability calendars.
products.reference: Leave Request / Absence Request

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave request transaction. Primary key for the leave request record.

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in the people domain.

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_substitute_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee designated to cover responsibilities during the leave period. Optional field used for workforce continuity planning.

attributes.name: attachment_count
attributes.description: Number of supporting documents attached to the leave request (e.g., medical certificates, travel documents). Used to enforce documentation requirements for certain leave types.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes added by the employee, manager, or HR during the leave request lifecycle. Used for communication and audit trail.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Financial cost center to which the employees leave time is charged. Used for labor cost allocation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the leave request record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_requested
attributes.description: Total number of leave days requested, including partial days. Calculated based on working days between start and end dates, accounting for half-day flags and organizational calendar.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Leave Quota Calculation

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manager approved or rejected the leave request. Null for pending requests. Used for SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking and approval turnaround metrics.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational department of the requesting employee at the time of submission. Used for workforce availability reporting and departmental leave analytics.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Optional phone number where the employee can be reached during the leave period in case of urgent business matters. Confidential contact information.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the requested leave period. Inclusive end date for leave duration calculation.

attributes.name: entitlement_balance_after
attributes.description: Calculated leave entitlement balance after deducting the approved leave days. Updated when request_status changes to APPROVED and used to prevent over-allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Leave Quota Management

attributes.name: entitlement_balance_before
attributes.description: Snapshot of the employees leave entitlement balance for the applicable leave type at the time of request submission. Used for audit trail and balance reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Leave Quota Management

attributes.name: half_day_period
attributes.description: Specifies which half of the day is requested when is_half_day is true. Used for workforce scheduling and shift coverage planning.

attributes.name: hr_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HR manually overrode the standard approval workflow or entitlement rules for this request. Used for audit and exception reporting.

attributes.name: hr_override_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why HR overrode standard rules. Required when hr_override_flag is true to maintain audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: is_half_day
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the leave request is for a half-day (morning or afternoon) rather than a full day. Affects leave balance deduction and workforce availability calculation.

attributes.name: leave_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the leave request type. Determines entitlement rules, approval workflow, and balance deduction logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ANNUAL|SICK|PERSONAL|PARENTAL|BEREAVEMENT|UNPAID|COMPENSATORY — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Time Management Leave Types

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the leave request record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Optional free-text explanation provided by the employee for the leave request. May be required for certain leave types per organizational policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Leave Request Notes

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the manager when rejecting a leave request. Required when request_status is REJECTED to ensure transparency and compliance.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the leave request, formatted as LR-YYYYNNNN for external reference and tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management - Leave Request Object

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the leave request in the approval workflow. Drives downstream workforce availability and entitlement balance updates.

attributes.name: requires_documentation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave type or duration requires supporting documentation per organizational policy. Used to validate request completeness before approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM - Leave Policy Rules

attributes.name: return_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employees return to work has been confirmed by the manager or HR. Used to close the leave transaction and trigger final balance updates.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Actual date the employee returned to work after the leave period. Used to confirm leave completion and reconcile any discrepancies between planned and actual leave duration.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the requested leave period. Used to calculate leave duration and check entitlement balance availability.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee submitted the leave request. Used for audit trail and to enforce advance notice policy rules.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the employees primary work location at the time of the leave request. Used for site-level workforce availability planning and compliance with location-specific leave policies.

attributes.name: original_leave_request_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on leave_request (original_leave_request_id)

products.name: performance_cycle
products.description: Reference master defining the performance management cycles (annual, mid-year, quarterly check-in) configured for the telecommunications enterprise. Captures cycle code, cycle name, performance year, cycle type (annual appraisal, mid-year review, probation review, pip review, 360-degree feedback), cycle start date, cycle end date, goal-setting window start and end, self-assessment window start and end, manager review window start and end, calibration window start and end, rating scale reference, eligible employee population criteria, and cycle status (planned, active, closed).
products.reference: Performance Management Cycle

attributes.name: performance_cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance management cycle. Primary key.

attributes.name: cycle_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Human Resources (HR) business partner or administrator responsible for managing and overseeing this performance cycle.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or administrator who created this performance cycle configuration. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or administrator who last modified this performance cycle configuration. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance reviews in this cycle require formal approval by Human Resources (HR) or senior leadership before finalization (True) or can be finalized by managers directly (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: calibration_end_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which all calibration sessions must be completed and final ratings approved.

attributes.name: calibration_start_date
attributes.description: The date when calibration sessions begin, where leadership reviews and normalizes performance ratings across teams to ensure fairness and consistency.

attributes.name: compensation_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance ratings from this cycle directly impact compensation decisions such as merit increases, bonuses, or incentive payouts (True) or are for development purposes only (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance cycle record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the performance cycle (e.g., FY2024-ANNUAL, Q2-2024-CHECKIN). Used for external reference and reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: cycle_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the performance cycle, including its purpose, scope, key objectives, and any special instructions or considerations for participants.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: cycle_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the performance cycle officially ends. Marks the conclusion of the performance period and all review activities.

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the performance cycle (e.g., 2024 Annual Performance Review, Q2 2024 Quarterly Check-In).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: cycle_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the performance cycle officially begins. Marks the start of the performance period being evaluated.

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance cycle: planned (configured but not started), active (currently running), in_progress (reviews underway), calibration (manager calibration phase), closed (completed and finalized), cancelled (terminated before completion).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Type of performance management cycle: annual appraisal (comprehensive year-end review), mid-year review (mid-cycle checkpoint), quarterly check-in (frequent touchpoint), probation review (new hire evaluation), PIP review (Performance Improvement Plan assessment), or 360-degree feedback (multi-rater assessment).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: distribution_guideline
attributes.description: Textual description of the rating distribution guideline or target percentages for each rating level (e.g., Exceeds: 15-20%, Meets: 70-75%, Below: 5-10%). Applies when forced_distribution_flag is True.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: eligible_population_criteria
attributes.description: Business rules defining which employees are included in this performance cycle (e.g., all full-time employees with 90+ days tenure, all managers and above, specific departments or business units). May reference employee attributes such as employment type, tenure, job level, or organizational unit.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: enable_360_feedback_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether 360-degree feedback (multi-rater feedback from peers, direct reports, and other stakeholders) is enabled for this performance cycle (True) or disabled (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: enable_calibration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether calibration sessions are enabled for this performance cycle (True) or disabled (False). When enabled, leadership reviews and normalizes ratings across teams.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: enable_goal_setting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether goal setting is enabled for this performance cycle (True) or disabled (False). When enabled, employees and managers must define performance objectives.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: enable_self_assessment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employee self-assessment is enabled for this performance cycle (True) or disabled (False). When enabled, employees complete self-evaluations before manager reviews.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: forced_distribution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether forced (or guided) distribution of performance ratings is required for this cycle (True) or not (False). When enabled, managers must distribute ratings according to predefined percentages (e.g., 20% top performers, 70% meets expectations, 10% below expectations).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: goal_setting_end_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which all performance goals and objectives must be finalized and approved.

attributes.name: goal_setting_start_date
attributes.description: The date when employees and managers can begin setting performance goals and objectives for the cycle.

attributes.name: manager_review_end_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which managers must complete all performance reviews and submit ratings for their direct reports.

attributes.name: manager_review_start_date
attributes.description: The date when managers can begin conducting performance reviews and providing ratings for their direct reports.

attributes.name: mandatory_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participation in this performance cycle is mandatory for eligible employees (True) or optional (False). Mandatory cycles require completion for all eligible employees.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this performance cycle record was last modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: notification_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated email or system notifications are enabled for this performance cycle (True) to remind employees and managers of upcoming deadlines, or disabled (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year this performance cycle applies to (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: promotion_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether performance ratings from this cycle are used to determine promotion eligibility (True) or not (False).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: rating_scale_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the performance rating scale used for this cycle (e.g., SCALE_5PT, SCALE_4PT_FORCED). Links to the rating scale configuration defining rating levels and distribution guidelines.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Human Resources Management

attributes.name: self_assessment_end_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which employees must complete and submit their self-assessment evaluations.

attributes.name: self_assessment_start_date
attributes.description: The date when employees can begin completing their self-assessment evaluations.

attributes.name: prior_performance_cycle_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on performance_cycle (prior_performance_cycle_id)

products.name: performance_review
products.description: Transactional record of an individual employee's performance appraisal within a performance cycle. Captures employee reference, performance cycle reference, manager reviewer reference, overall performance rating (numeric and label — e.g., 1=Below Expectations, 2=Meets Expectations, 3=Exceeds Expectations, 4=Outstanding), goal achievement score, competency assessment score, manager narrative comments, employee self-assessment narrative, calibration adjusted rating, calibration session reference, final rating confirmed flag, rating confirmation date, performance improvement plan flag, PIP start date, PIP end date, and review status (not started, in progress, submitted, calibrated, acknowledged, closed).
products.reference: Performance Appraisal Record

attributes.name: performance_review_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance review record. Primary key for the performance review entity.

attributes.name: calibration_session_id
attributes.description: Reference to the calibration session during which this performance review was discussed and potentially adjusted. Links to the calibration session master record.

attributes.name: performance_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the performance cycle or appraisal period during which this review was conducted. Links to the performance cycle master record.

attributes.name: primary_performance_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee being reviewed. Links to the employee master record in the people domain.

attributes.name: calibration_adjusted_rating
attributes.description: Performance rating after calibration session adjustments. May differ from the initial overall_rating_numeric if the calibration committee adjusted the rating for consistency across the organization.

attributes.name: competency_assessment_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score representing the employees demonstration of core competencies and behavioral attributes during the performance cycle. Typically expressed as a percentage or decimal.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center to which the employee was assigned during the review period. Used for financial reporting and workforce cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the department to which the employee belonged during the review period. Used for organizational reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: development_plan_created_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether an individual development plan was created as part of this performance review. True indicates a development plan exists.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee acknowledged receipt and review of their performance appraisal. Indicates the employee has been informed of their rating.

attributes.name: employee_self_assessment
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the employee reflecting on their own performance, accomplishments, challenges, and development needs during the performance cycle.

attributes.name: final_rating_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the final performance rating has been confirmed and locked. True indicates the rating is final and cannot be changed without formal override.

attributes.name: goal_achievement_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score representing the percentage or degree to which the employee achieved their assigned goals during the performance cycle. Typically expressed as a percentage (0-100) or decimal (0.00-1.00).

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Organizational job level or grade of the employee during the review period. Used for calibration and compensation planning.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Job title or position held by the employee during the review period. Provides context for performance expectations and competency assessment.

attributes.name: manager_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments provided by the manager summarizing the employees performance, strengths, areas for improvement, and development recommendations.

attributes.name: merit_increase_recommended_pct
attributes.description: Recommended merit increase percentage based on the performance rating. Used as input to compensation planning and salary adjustment processes.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the performance review record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: overall_rating_label
attributes.description: Textual label corresponding to the numeric performance rating. Provides human-readable interpretation of the overall rating.

attributes.name: overall_rating_numeric
attributes.description: Numeric performance rating assigned to the employee. Typically on a scale such as 1-5 where 1=Below Expectations, 2=Meets Expectations, 3=Exceeds Expectations, 4=Outstanding, 5=Exceptional.

attributes.name: pip_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled end date for the Performance Improvement Plan. Represents the target date by which performance improvement is expected. Null if no PIP was triggered.

attributes.name: pip_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a Performance Improvement Plan was triggered as a result of this review. True indicates the employee has been placed on a PIP.

attributes.name: pip_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Performance Improvement Plan commenced. Null if no PIP was triggered.

attributes.name: promotion_recommended_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the manager recommended the employee for promotion based on this performance review. True indicates a promotion recommendation.

attributes.name: rating_confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final performance rating was confirmed and locked. Represents the official date the rating became final.

attributes.name: review_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the performance review was completed and submitted by the manager. Used to measure adherence to review timelines.

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the performance review should be completed and submitted. Used for tracking review completion timeliness.

attributes.name: review_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the performance review. Typically follows a pattern such as PR-YYYY-NNNNNN where YYYY is the year and NNNNNN is a sequential number.

attributes.name: review_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance period being evaluated in this review. Defines the conclusion of the timeframe for which performance is assessed.

attributes.name: review_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance period being evaluated in this review. Defines the beginning of the timeframe for which performance is assessed.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the performance review. Tracks the review through its workflow from initiation to completion and acknowledgment.

attributes.name: reviewer_comments
attributes.description: Additional comments provided by secondary reviewers or HR business partners during the review process. Supplements manager comments with broader organizational perspective.

attributes.name: succession_readiness_level
attributes.description: Assessment of the employees readiness for succession into higher-level roles. Used for talent management and succession planning.

attributes.name: prior_performance_review_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on performance_review (prior_performance_review_id)

products.name: goal
products.description: Master record for individual employee performance goals set within a performance cycle. Captures employee reference, performance cycle reference, goal title, goal description, goal category (business objective, development goal, behavioral competency), goal weight percentage, target metric and unit, target value, actual achievement value, achievement percentage, goal status (draft, committed, in-progress, completed, cancelled), goal source (cascaded from manager, self-created, HR-assigned), alignment to org unit objective, mid-year progress note, year-end achievement note, and manager acknowledgment flag.
products.reference: Employee Goal / OKR

attributes.name: goal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee performance goal record. Primary key.

attributes.name: goal_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee to whom this goal is assigned. Links to the employee master record in the people domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Human Capital Management (HCM) - Personnel Number

attributes.name: goal_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee's direct manager who is responsible for reviewing, approving, and evaluating this goal. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: parent_goal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent goal from which this goal was cascaded (typically a manager's or organizational goal). Null if this is a top-level or self-created goal. Enables goal hierarchy and alignment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Cascading

attributes.name: performance_cycle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the performance management cycle (annual, semi-annual, quarterly) within which this goal is set and evaluated.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Performance Form Template

attributes.name: achievement_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of goal achievement calculated as (actual_value / target_value) * 100. Values over 100% indicate over-achievement. Used to compute weighted contribution to overall performance rating.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Rating Calculation

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the goal was completed or the performance cycle ended and final achievement was recorded. Null if the goal is still in progress.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Completion

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The actual quantitative value achieved by the employee at the end of the performance cycle (e.g., 99.97 for 99.97% uptime achieved, 45 for 45 training hours completed). Populated during year-end evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Achievement

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: General comments, notes, or additional context about the goal. May include employee self-assessment notes, manager feedback, or collaborative discussion points.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Notes

attributes.name: competency_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the competency framework or skill taxonomy that this goal develops or demonstrates (e.g., 'LEAD-001' for leadership, 'TECH-5G' for 5G technical skills). Applicable primarily to development and behavioral goals.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Competency Management - Competency Library

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this goal record was first created in the system. Audit trail for goal lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has formally acknowledged and accepted this goal. True means the employee has reviewed and committed to the goal; False means it is still pending employee acceptance.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Commitment

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee formally acknowledged and committed to this goal. Null if not yet acknowledged.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Commitment

attributes.name: goal_category
attributes.description: Classification of the goal type: business_objective (tied to KPIs and business outcomes), development_goal (skill building, training, career growth), behavioral_competency (leadership, collaboration, communication), operational_excellence (process improvement, efficiency), customer_satisfaction (NPS, CSAT improvement), or innovation (new initiatives, R&D).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Category Configuration

attributes.name: goal_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the goal, including context, expected outcomes, success criteria, and any relevant background information.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Plan Template

attributes.name: goal_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the goal, typically formatted as cycle-employee-sequence (e.g., 2024-EMP12345-G01).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Plan Template

attributes.name: goal_source
attributes.description: Origin of the goal: cascaded_from_manager (manager assigned from their own goals), self_created (employee proposed), hr_assigned (HR or talent management assigned), org_objective_aligned (derived from organizational unit objectives), peer_suggested (recommended by peer or cross-functional partner).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Creation Source

attributes.name: goal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goal: draft (being defined), committed (approved and active), in_progress (employee working on it), completed (cycle ended, achievement recorded), cancelled (goal no longer applicable), deferred (postponed to next cycle).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal State Model

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goal is mandatory for the employee's role or performance evaluation. True means the goal must be included and achieved; False means it is optional or supplementary.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Configuration

attributes.name: is_stretch_goal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a stretch goal (aspirational, beyond normal expectations). True means this is a stretch goal; False means it is a standard performance goal. Stretch goals may have different evaluation criteria.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Type Configuration

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal review or check-in for this goal. Used to track review cadence and ensure timely progress assessments.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Review History

attributes.name: linked_training_plan_reference
attributes.description: Reference to a training or development plan that supports achievement of this goal. Enables tracking of learning activities tied to performance goals.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System (LMS) - Learning Plan

attributes.name: manager_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the manager has formally acknowledged and approved this goal. True means the goal has been reviewed and accepted by the manager; False means it is still pending manager review.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Approval Workflow

attributes.name: manager_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manager formally acknowledged and approved this goal. Null if not yet acknowledged.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Approval Workflow

attributes.name: mid_year_progress_note
attributes.description: Narrative assessment of progress toward the goal at the mid-year review checkpoint. Captures manager and employee observations, challenges encountered, and any adjustments to approach or target.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Mid-Year Review

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this goal record was last modified. Tracks updates to goal details, progress, or status throughout the performance cycle.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal review or check-in for this goal. Helps managers and employees plan progress discussions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Review Schedule

attributes.name: org_unit_objective_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit's strategic objective to which this goal is aligned. Enables tracking of individual goal contribution to departmental and enterprise objectives.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Organizational Goal Alignment

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The relative priority or urgency of this goal compared to the employee's other goals: critical (must achieve, business-critical), high (important, significant impact), medium (standard priority), low (nice-to-have, stretch goal).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance & Goals - Goal Prioritization

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which this goal is reviewed and progress is assessed: weekly, bi_weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi_annual, annual, or ad_hoc (as needed). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|ad_hoc — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: kpi_definition
