products.name: cell_coverage_footprint
products.description: Master record for the predicted and measured radio coverage footprint of an individual RAN cell sector — the spatial representation of a single cell's coverage at a specific technology, band, and configuration. Captures footprint identifier, cell reference (links to network.ran_cell), technology (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G_NSA, 5G_SA), frequency band (700MHz, 850MHz, 1800MHz, 2100MHz, 2600MHz, 3500MHz, 26GHz), azimuth, tilt, antenna height, geometry (polygon WKT), outdoor coverage area (sq km), indoor penetration depth, predicted RSRP (dBm), predicted SINR (dB), generation method (propagation_model, drive_test, crowdsourced_RF), model version, effective date, and expiry date. Distinct from coverage_area which represents aggregated technology-level coverage — this is cell-sector-level spatial data.
products.reference: 3GPP TS 36.213 / ITU-R M.2135 / Atoll / Planet RF Planning

attributes.name: cell_coverage_footprint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cell coverage footprint record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: coverage_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to location.coverage_area. Business justification: Cell coverage footprints belong to a specific coverage area; linking provides hierarchical context and removes the silo.

attributes.name: ran_cell_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific RAN cell sector that generates this coverage footprint. Links to the network.ran_cell master data product.

attributes.name: antenna_gain_dbi
attributes.description: The gain of the antenna in dBi (decibels relative to an isotropic radiator). Higher gain increases coverage range in the direction of the main lobe.

attributes.name: antenna_height_meters
attributes.description: The height of the antenna above ground level in meters. Key parameter for propagation modeling and coverage prediction.

attributes.name: azimuth_degrees
attributes.description: The horizontal direction in degrees (0-360) that the antenna is pointing, measured clockwise from true north. Critical for coverage prediction and interference analysis.

attributes.name: beamwidth_horizontal_degrees
attributes.description: The horizontal beamwidth of the antenna in degrees, defining the angular coverage in the azimuth plane. Typically 65 or 90 degrees for sector antennas.

attributes.name: beamwidth_vertical_degrees
attributes.description: The vertical beamwidth of the antenna in degrees, defining the angular coverage in the elevation plane. Affects coverage distance and shape.

attributes.name: clutter_type
attributes.description: The predominant terrain clutter classification within the coverage footprint. Affects propagation loss and coverage prediction accuracy.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level of the coverage prediction as a percentage (0-100). Higher values indicate greater certainty in the footprint accuracy.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this coverage footprint record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or tool that generated this coverage footprint record (e.g., Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, Atoll propagation tool).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this coverage footprint becomes active and valid for network planning and service delivery decisions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this coverage footprint is no longer valid, typically due to network configuration changes or updated measurements. Null indicates indefinite validity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: footprint_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the coverage footprint, typically combining cell identifier, technology, and band for human-readable reference.

attributes.name: footprint_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this coverage footprint record. Active footprints are used for operational planning and customer-facing coverage maps.

attributes.name: frequency_band
attributes.description: The frequency band on which this cell sector operates. Determines propagation characteristics, coverage range, and capacity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 700MHz|850MHz|1800MHz|2100MHz|2600MHz|3500MHz|26GHz — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: generation_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to generate this coverage footprint: propagation_model (theoretical prediction), drive_test (field measurement), or crowdsourced_rf (aggregated device measurements).
attributes.references: TM Forum TMF638 Service Inventory API

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.description: The spatial polygon representing the predicted or measured coverage boundary in Well-Known Text format. Used for GIS analysis and coverage visualization.

attributes.name: indoor_penetration_depth_db
attributes.description: The estimated signal penetration loss in decibels for indoor environments within the coverage footprint. Used to assess indoor coverage quality.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this coverage footprint record was last updated. Enables change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this coverage footprint was last verified or validated through field measurements or updated propagation modeling.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: measurement_sample_count
attributes.description: The number of RF measurement samples used to generate or validate this coverage footprint. Applicable for drive_test and crowdsourced_rf generation methods.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, exceptions, or special considerations related to this coverage footprint.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: outdoor_coverage_area_sq_km
attributes.description: The total outdoor geographic area covered by this cell sector in square kilometers, calculated from the coverage polygon.

attributes.name: population_covered
attributes.description: The estimated population count within the coverage footprint boundary. Used for network capacity planning and market analysis.

attributes.name: predicted_rsrp_dbm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Predicted Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) in Decibels-Milliwatt (dBm)
attributes.description: The predicted average Reference Signal Received Power at the coverage boundary in dBm. Key metric for LTE and 5G coverage quality assessment.

attributes.name: predicted_sinr_db
attributes.description: The predicted Signal-to-Interference-plus-Noise Ratio at the coverage boundary in dB. Indicates expected data throughput and service quality.

attributes.name: propagation_model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the propagation model or measurement methodology used to generate this footprint. Enables traceability and model comparison.

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: The radio access technology generation for this coverage footprint. Determines the air interface standard and capabilities.

attributes.name: tilt_degrees
attributes.description: The vertical tilt angle of the antenna in degrees. Negative values indicate downtilt. Affects coverage shape and interference footprint.

attributes.name: transmit_power_dbm
attributes.description: The configured transmit power of the cell sector in dBm. Directly impacts coverage range and signal strength at the cell edge.

attributes.name: superseded_cell_coverage_footprint_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on cell_coverage_footprint (superseded_cell_coverage_footprint_id)

products.name: duct_route
products.description: Master record for underground duct and conduit route segments in the outside plant (OSP) civil infrastructure — the physical pathways through which fiber cables, copper cables, and other telecommunications infrastructure are routed. Captures duct route identifier, route name, route type (underground_duct, aerial_span, submarine, direct_buried, building_riser), geometry (linestring WKT), total length (metres), duct material (HDPE, PVC, concrete, steel), duct diameter (mm), number of sub-ducts, occupied sub-duct count, available sub-duct count, route status (active, planned, decommissioned, damaged), ownership (owned, leased, IRU), road authority reference, permit reference, installation date, and last inspection date. Provides the civil infrastructure layer for fiber route planning and capacity management.

attributes.name: duct_route_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the underground duct and conduit route segment in the outside plant (OSP) civil infrastructure.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that last modified this duct route record, used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: primary_duct_start_geo_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic point entity representing the starting endpoint of the duct route.

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service territory within which this duct route is located, used for operational planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: asset_condition
attributes.description: Current physical condition assessment of the duct route infrastructure based on inspection findings, used for maintenance prioritization and capital planning.

attributes.name: available_subduct_count

attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: change_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the location data change was committed to the master data repository. Represents the business event time of the modification in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: The category of change operation performed on the location entity. Distinguishes between lifecycle events such as initial creation, attribute updates, decommissioning, entity merges, splits, and reclassifications.

attributes.name: changed_field_name
attributes.description: The specific attribute or field name within the location entity that was modified. Captures the column-level granularity of the change for precise audit trail tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: The specific regulatory or compliance framework that governs this location data change. Examples include FCC Universal Service requirements, GDPR data accuracy obligations, or national telecommunications licensing conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this change event record was first inserted into the location change event audit table. Represents the technical record creation time, distinct from the business change_timestamp.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Automated data quality assessment score for the location data change, ranging from 0.00 to 100.00. Evaluates completeness, accuracy, consistency, and conformance to business rules. Higher scores indicate higher confidence in data quality.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date when the location data change becomes active and should be applied in operational systems and reporting. May differ from change_timestamp for scheduled or backdated changes.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Temporal Data Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date when the location data change is no longer valid and should be superseded by subsequent changes. Null for current active changes. Supports temporal data management and historical analysis.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Temporal Data Management

attributes.name: geocoding_confidence
attributes.description: Confidence level percentage for geocoded location coordinates when the change involves address or geographic data. Ranges from 0.00 to 100.00. Null for non-geographic changes. Indicates reliability of latitude/longitude assignments.

attributes.name: impact_scope
attributes.description: Assessment of the business impact magnitude of the location data change. Considers factors such as number of affected customers, service availability implications, network planning dependencies, and regulatory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Assurance Process Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this change event record was last updated in the audit table. Tracks modifications to approval status, validation results, or other mutable fields after initial event capture.

attributes.name: location_entity_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the specific location entity record that was modified. References the primary key of the corresponding location master table based on location_entity_type.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Location Domain Model

attributes.name: location_entity_type
attributes.description: The type of location entity that was changed. Categorizes the master data record type within the location domain hierarchy.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Location Domain Model

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The updated value of the changed field after the modification was applied. Stored as string representation to accommodate all data types. Null for decommission operations.

attributes.name: old_value
attributes.description: The previous value of the changed field before the modification was applied. Stored as string representation to accommodate all data types. Null for create operations.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location data change must be included in regulatory compliance reporting to governing bodies such as FCC, ITU, or national telecommunications authorities. True for changes affecting coverage obligations, service territories, or franchise boundaries.

attributes.name: rollback_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this change event represents a rollback or reversal of a previous location data modification. True when the change undoes a prior change due to error correction or business decision reversal.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier of the operational system that originated the location data change. Examples include GIS platforms, OSS/BSS systems, CRM, field workforce management, or external authoritative sources like postal authorities.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - System Integration Framework

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: The unique transaction or batch identifier from the source system that generated this change event. Enables correlation of multiple related changes within a single business transaction or bulk update operation.

attributes.name: validation_error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error or warning message generated by data quality validation rules when the location data change failed validation checks. Provides diagnostic information for data stewards to remediate quality issues.

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: The outcome of automated data quality validation rules applied to the location data change. Indicates whether the change passed all validation checks, failed critical rules, generated warnings, or was not subject to validation.

attributes.name: reversal_change_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on change_event (reversal_change_event_id)

products.name: black_spot
products.description: Master record for identified mobile and broadband black spot locations — geographic areas with no or inadequate telecommunications coverage that are subject to government black spot programmes, universal service obligations (USO), or internal network expansion prioritisation. Captures black spot identifier, black spot name, black spot type (mobile_no_coverage, mobile_poor_coverage, broadband_no_service, broadband_underserved), geometry (point or polygon WKT), affected premises count, affected population estimate, nearest serviceable location, programme reference (Mobile Black Spot Programme, MBSP, FCC Connect America, BDUK), nomination source (community, government, operator), nomination date, programme status (nominated, approved, funded, in_build, resolved, not_funded), resolution date, and resolving technology. Supports regulatory reporting and government subsidy programme management.
products.reference: ACMA Mobile Black Spot Programme / FCC Connect America Fund / BDUK / USDA ReConnect

attributes.name: black_spot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the telecommunications black spot location record. Primary key for the black spot master data entity.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Geographic Address ABE

attributes.name: administrative_region_id
attributes.description: Reference to the administrative region (state, province, county, municipality) in which the black spot is located. Used for regulatory reporting, government programme alignment, and jurisdictional compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; TM Forum SID - Geographic Address ABE

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that last modified this black spot record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: location_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the nearest location or network site that currently has adequate telecommunications service. Used for network extension planning, backhaul routing, and cost estimation for black spot remediation.

attributes.name: ran_cell_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.ran_cell. Business justification: Black spot remediation requires identifying nearest serving cell for coverage extension planning, signal propagation analysis, and universal service obligation compliance. Critical for government-fund

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service territory or operational region within which this black spot is located. Used for operational planning, resource allocation, and regional performance tracking.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Geographic Site ABE

attributes.name: affected_population_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of individuals residing or working within the black spot area who are impacted by inadequate telecommunications coverage. Used for social equity analysis, government subsidy justification, and community impact assessment.
attributes.references: ITU ICT Development Index; National Census Data

attributes.name: affected_premises_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of residential and business premises within the black spot area that lack adequate telecommunications service. Used for programme prioritisation, funding allocation, and Universal Service Obligation (USO) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund; BDUK Broadband Delivery UK Programme

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the black spot remediation project was formally approved for funding or inclusion in a network expansion programme. Used for project tracking and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: area_square_km
attributes.description: Total geographic area of the black spot coverage deficiency zone measured in square kilometers. Used for network planning, infrastructure investment sizing, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Geographic Site ABE

attributes.name: black_spot_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the black spot location, typically referencing the geographic area, community, or landmark (e.g., 'Rural Valley Township', 'Highway 101 Corridor', 'Remote Island Settlement').

attributes.name: black_spot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of telecommunications coverage deficiency at this location. Distinguishes between mobile network gaps (no coverage, poor signal), broadband service gaps (no service, underserved with inadequate speeds), and fixed-line unavailability.
attributes.references: FCC Form 477; Ofcom Connected Nations Report; ACMA Regional Telecommunications Review

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geographic centroid of the black spot area in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for mapping, distance calculations, and proximity analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard representation of geographic point location

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geographic centroid of the black spot area in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for mapping, distance calculations, and proximity analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard representation of geographic point location

attributes.name: community_petition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this black spot was identified through a formal community petition or public consultation process. True if community-nominated, False otherwise.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Customer Relationship Management

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when physical construction or network deployment activities commenced to remediate the black spot. Used for project management, milestone tracking, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this black spot record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format; TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system or data provider from which this black spot record was obtained (e.g., 'Nokia NetAct', 'Ericsson Network Manager', 'Government Black Spot Database', 'Community Petition Portal').
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: distance_to_serviceable_location_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distance to Nearest Serviceable Location Kilometers
attributes.description: Distance in kilometers from the black spot centroid to the nearest location with adequate telecommunications service. Used for infrastructure cost estimation, technology selection (fiber vs wireless), and programme feasibility assessment.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Geographic Address ABE

attributes.name: economic_zone_classification
attributes.description: Economic classification of the black spot area (e.g., 'rural', 'remote', 'regional', 'indigenous community', 'agricultural zone', 'tourism area'). Used for programme eligibility, funding prioritisation, and socio-economic impact analysis.
attributes.references: OECD Regional Typology; National Statistical Classification Systems

attributes.name: environmental_constraints
attributes.description: Description of environmental or regulatory constraints that may impact black spot remediation (e.g., 'national park restrictions', 'heritage site limitations', 'protected wildlife habitat', 'indigenous land rights'). Used for project planning and compliance management.
attributes.references: National Environmental Protection Acts; UNESCO World Heritage Guidelines

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External system identifier or reference code for this black spot record in upstream or partner systems (e.g., government programme database ID, GIS system reference, regulatory filing number).
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: funding_amount
attributes.description: Total funding amount allocated for remediation of this black spot location, including government subsidies, operator co-investment, and any third-party contributions. Expressed in local currency.
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Fund; BDUK Funding Guidelines

attributes.name: funding_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the funding amount (e.g., USD, GBP, AUD, EUR).

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.description: Spatial geometry of the black spot area represented in Well-Known Text (WKT) format. May be a POINT for a specific location or a POLYGON for a broader coverage deficiency area. Used for GIS analysis, network planning, and regulatory mapping.
attributes.references: ISO 19125 (Simple Feature Access); OGC Well-Known Text

attributes.name: identifier
attributes.description: External business identifier or reference code for the black spot location, used in government programmes, regulatory reporting, and inter-agency coordination. May be assigned by FCC, BDUK, ACMA, or internal network planning systems.
attributes.references: FCC Connect America Fund; BDUK Mobile Infrastructure Project

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this black spot record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data currency validation, and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format; TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: last_survey_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent coverage survey or field measurement was conducted to verify the black spot status. Used for data currency validation and re-assessment scheduling.

attributes.name: measured_download_speed_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Measured Download Speed Megabits Per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: Measured broadband download speed at the black spot location in megabits per second (Mbps). Used to quantify the severity of broadband underservice and validate remediation outcomes.
attributes.references: ITU-T Y.1540 (IP Performance Metrics); FCC Measuring Broadband America

attributes.name: measured_signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Measured mobile network signal strength at the black spot location in dBm (decibel-milliwatts). Negative values indicate signal strength (e.g., -110 dBm is very weak, -70 dBm is strong). Used for coverage gap quantification and technology selection.

attributes.name: measured_upload_speed_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Measured Upload Speed Megabits Per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: Measured broadband upload speed at the black spot location in megabits per second (Mbps). Used to assess service adequacy for applications requiring upstream bandwidth (video conferencing, cloud backup, telehealth).
attributes.references: ITU-T Y.1540 (IP Performance Metrics); FCC Measuring Broadband America

attributes.name: nomination_date
attributes.description: Date when the black spot location was formally nominated or identified for inclusion in a coverage improvement programme. Used for programme tracking, prioritisation, and regulatory reporting timelines.

attributes.name: nomination_source
attributes.description: Origin or source of the black spot nomination. Indicates whether the coverage deficiency was identified by community petition, government agency, telecommunications operator internal planning, regulatory body, or third-party survey.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Strategy Infrastructure & Product

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the black spot, including special circumstances, stakeholder feedback, technical challenges, or programme-specific information.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for black spot remediation based on factors such as affected population, economic impact, safety considerations, and government programme requirements. Used for project sequencing and resource allocation.
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Strategy Infrastructure & Product

attributes.name: programme_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name of the government black spot programme, universal service obligation (USO) initiative, or subsidy scheme under which this location is registered (e.g., 'Mobile Black Spot Programme Round 5', 'FCC Connect America Fund Phase II', 'BDUK Gigabit Voucher Scheme').
attributes.references: FCC Universal Service Administrative Company; BDUK Programme Guidelines; ACMA Regional Telecommunications Review

attributes.name: programme_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the black spot within the government or operator remediation programme. Tracks progression from nomination through approval, funding, construction, and resolution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nominated|under_review|approved|funded|in_build|resolved|not_funded|deferred — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TM Forum eTOM - Fulfillment Process; FCC Universal Service Fund Reporting

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current status of this black spot record in the master data repository. Indicates whether the record is active, archived (historical), superseded by a newer record, or marked for deletion.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entity Definitions

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name or code of the regulatory authority or jurisdiction responsible for telecommunications oversight in this black spot area (e.g., 'FCC', 'Ofcom', 'ACMA', 'CRTC'). Used for compliance reporting and programme coordination.
attributes.references: ITU Member State Regulatory Authorities; National Telecommunications Regulatory Bodies

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date when the black spot was officially resolved and adequate telecommunications service was made available to the affected area. Marks completion of the remediation project.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format; TM Forum eTOM - Fulfillment Process

attributes.name: resolving_technology
attributes.description: Primary telecommunications technology deployed to remediate the black spot and provide adequate coverage (e.g., 5G New Radio (NR), Long-Term Evolution (LTE), Fiber to the Home (FTTH), fixed wireless access, satellite broadband). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 5G|LTE|FTTH|FTTC|fixed_wireless|satellite|microwave_backhaul|hybrid — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 3GPP Technical Specifications; ITU-T Recommendations; TM Forum SID - Resource Domain

attributes.name: safety_critical_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the black spot is in a location where telecommunications coverage is critical for public safety, emergency services, or disaster response (e.g., remote highways, fire-prone areas, flood zones). True if safety-critical, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FCC Enhanced 911 (E911) Requirements; National Emergency Management Frameworks

attributes.name: survey_method
attributes.description: Method used to identify or verify the black spot coverage deficiency (e.g., drive test, walk test, crowdsourced data, RF propagation modeling, satellite imagery analysis, community reporting).
attributes.references: 3GPP TS 36.133 (LTE Measurements); TM Forum SID - Performance Management ABE

attributes.name: target_service_level
attributes.description: Minimum service level or performance target that must be achieved to consider the black spot resolved (e.g., '25 Mbps download / 3 Mbps upload', '-95 dBm outdoor signal strength', '99% availability'). Used for Quality of Service (QoS) validation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FCC Broadband Speed Standards; Ofcom Universal Service Obligation; ITU-T Y.1540

attributes.name: terrain_type
attributes.description: Physical terrain classification of the black spot area. Influences technology selection, infrastructure cost, and signal propagation characteristics for remediation planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flat|hilly|mountainous|coastal|island|desert|forest|urban_canyon — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ITU-R P.1546 Propagation Models; TM Forum SID - Geographic Site ABE

attributes.name: uso_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this black spot is subject to a Universal Service Obligation (USO) requirement, mandating the operator to provide service regardless of commercial viability. True if USO applies, False otherwise.
attributes.references: EU Universal Service Directive 2002/22/EC; FCC Section 254; National USO Frameworks

attributes.name: merged_into_black_spot_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on black_spot (merged_into_black_spot_id)

products.name: address_geocode
products.description: Master record storing the authoritative geocoding result for each address — the definitive latitude/longitude and spatial attributes assigned to an address after validation and geocoding. Captures geocode identifier, address reference, latitude (WGS84), longitude (WGS84), elevation (metres), geocode accuracy level (rooftop, parcel_centroid, street_interpolated, street_centroid, suburb_centroid, postcode_centroid), geocode method (GNAF_match, USPS_match, HERE_API, Google_API, manual_survey, GPS_capture), horizontal accuracy (metres), geocoding provider, geocoding timestamp, confidence score, mesh block reference (ABS), census block reference (US), output area reference (UK), and is_authoritative flag. Separates the geocoding concern from the address master to allow multiple geocoding attempts and provider comparisons.
products.reference: GNAF Geocoded National Address File / HERE Geocoding / Google Maps Geocoding API

attributes.name: address_geocode_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address geocoding record. Primary key for the address geocode entity.

attributes.name: location_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the address master record that this geocode result applies to. Links to the authoritative address in the location_address product.

attributes.name: primary_address_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that performed the last verification of this geocode. May be an employee ID for manual verification or a system identifier for automated verification. Used for audit trail and quality accountability.

attributes.name: accuracy_level
attributes.description: Classification of the geocoding precision achieved. Rooftop is the most precise (exact building location), postcode_centroid is the least precise (center of postal code area). Critical for network planning and service delivery decisions.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Location Domain; ISO 19115 - Geographic Information Metadata

attributes.name: census_block_reference
attributes.description: United States Census Bureau census block identifier. The smallest geographic unit used by the US Census Bureau, used for demographic analysis and regulatory reporting. Essential for FCC (Federal Communications Commission) reporting and Universal Service Fund compliance.

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score assigned by the geocoding provider, typically expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Higher scores indicate greater confidence in the accuracy of the geocoded location. Used to filter low-quality geocodes in network planning and service provisioning workflows.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this geocode record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Distinct from geocoding_timestamp which represents when the geocoding operation was performed; created_timestamp represents when the record was persisted to the data product.

attributes.name: crs_code
attributes.description: EPSG code identifying the coordinate reference system used for the latitude and longitude values. Default is EPSG:4326 (WGS84). Included to support scenarios where alternative coordinate systems are used for specialized network planning or regional requirements.
attributes.references: EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset; ISO 19111 - Spatial Referencing by Coordinates

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or process that created this geocode record. Examples: address_validation_batch_20240115, salesforce_crm_integration, field_survey_team_3. Used for data lineage tracking and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: elevation_meters
attributes.description: Elevation above mean sea level in meters. Used for network planning, signal propagation modeling, and terrain analysis. Nullable if elevation data is not available from the geocoding provider.

attributes.name: exchange_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the telecommunications exchange serving this geocoded location. Derived from the geocoded coordinates by spatial proximity analysis. Critical for fixed-line service provisioning, FTTH planning, and wholesale access management.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier used by external systems to reference this geocode record. Enables cross-system traceability and integration with third-party geocoding services, GIS (Geographic Information System) platforms, and network planning tools.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: geocode_identifier
attributes.description: External or provider-assigned unique identifier for this geocoding result. May be used for traceability back to the geocoding provider's system.
attributes.references: ISO 19112 - Spatial Referencing by Geographic Identifiers

attributes.name: geocode_method
attributes.description: The method or provider used to obtain this geocoding result. GNAF_match refers to Australian Geocoded National Address File, USPS_match refers to United States Postal Service address matching. Enables comparison of geocoding quality across providers.

attributes.name: geocode_quality_flag
attributes.description: Overall quality classification of the geocode result based on accuracy_level, confidence_score, and match_score. High quality geocodes are suitable for all use cases including FTTH (Fiber to the Home) planning. Low quality geocodes may require manual verification before use in service provisioning.

attributes.name: geocode_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the geocode record. Active indicates the geocode is in use. Superseded indicates a newer geocode has replaced this one. Rejected indicates the geocode failed quality validation. Pending_review indicates the geocode is awaiting manual verification. Expired indicates the geocode is no longer valid due to address changes.

attributes.name: geocoding_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or service that provided the geocoding result. Examples: Google Maps Platform, HERE Technologies, Esri ArcGIS, internal survey team. Used for quality tracking and vendor performance analysis.

attributes.name: geocoding_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the geocoding operation was performed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Enables tracking of geocoding currency and identification of stale geocodes that may need refresh.

attributes.name: horizontal_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated horizontal accuracy of the geocoded coordinates in meters. Represents the radius of uncertainty around the reported latitude/longitude. Lower values indicate higher precision. Critical for FTTH (Fiber to the Home) planning and CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) installation.

attributes.name: is_authoritative
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this geocode record is the authoritative, production-approved geocode for the address. True indicates this is the official geocode used for network planning, service delivery, and customer management. False indicates this is an alternative or historical geocode retained for comparison or audit purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this geocode record was last updated. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Updated whenever any attribute of the geocode record changes. Used for change tracking and data currency assessment.

attributes.name: last_verified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the geocode was last verified as accurate, either through automated validation or manual field verification. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Null if the geocode has never been verified. Used to identify geocodes requiring re-verification.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate in decimal degrees using the WGS84 coordinate reference system. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000. Positive values represent North, negative values represent South.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location; WGS84 (EPSG:4326)

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate in decimal degrees using the WGS84 coordinate reference system. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000. Positive values represent East, negative values represent West.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 - Standard Representation of Geographic Point Location; WGS84 (EPSG:4326)

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Score indicating how well the input address matched the geocoding provider's reference database, typically expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Distinct from confidence_score; match_score reflects address string similarity while confidence_score reflects coordinate accuracy. Used to identify addresses requiring manual review.

attributes.name: mesh_block_reference
attributes.description: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) mesh block identifier. The smallest geographic area defined by the ABS, used for census data collection and demographic analysis. Critical for market segmentation and regulatory reporting in Australia.
attributes.references: Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) - Australian Statistical Geography Standard (ASGS)

attributes.name: network_coverage_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the network coverage area that contains this geocoded location. Derived from the geocoded coordinates by spatial intersection with coverage area polygons. Used to determine technology availability (LTE, 5G NR, FTTH) and QoS (Quality of Service) expectations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information about the geocode. May include details about geocoding challenges, manual adjustments made, field technician observations, or special instructions for future verification. Used for operational context and knowledge capture.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Common Business Entities

attributes.name: output_area_reference
attributes.description: United Kingdom Office for National Statistics (ONS) output area identifier. The smallest census geography in the UK, used for demographic analysis and market research. Required for Ofcom regulatory reporting in the UK market.
attributes.references: UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) - Census Geography

attributes.name: plus_code
attributes.description: Open Location Code (Plus Code) representation of the geocoded location. A grid-based geocoding system that provides a short, human-readable code for any location. Useful for areas without formal street addresses, common in emerging markets and rural areas.

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the service territory that contains this geocoded location. Derived from the geocoded coordinates by spatial intersection with service territory boundaries. Used for dispatch routing, SLA (Service Level Agreement) assignment, and workforce management.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the accuracy of the geocode. Field_survey indicates a technician physically visited the location. GPS_capture indicates coordinates were captured on-site using GPS equipment. Customer_confirmation indicates the customer validated the location. Automated_validation indicates system-based verification against reference data.

attributes.name: what3words_address
attributes.description: What3Words three-word address representation of the geocoded location. Each 3m x 3m square in the world has been assigned a unique three-word identifier. Used by field technicians for precise location identification during CPE (Customer Premises Equipment) installation and fault management.

attributes.name: superseded_address_geocode_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on address_geocode (superseded_address_geocode_id)

products.name: infrastructure_corridor
products.description: Master record for major telecommunications infrastructure corridors — long-haul fiber routes, submarine cable landing corridors, microwave line-of-sight paths, and power line corridors used for infrastructure co-location. Captures corridor identifier, corridor name, corridor type (long_haul_fiber, submarine_cable, microwave_LOS, power_line_colocated, rail_corridor, highway_corridor), geometry (linestring WKT), total length (km), start location reference, end location reference, corridor owner, IRU holder, corridor status (active, planned, under_construction, decommissioned), capacity (fiber count or bandwidth), protection type (unprotected, ring_protected, diverse_route), permit authority, and strategic importance flag. Supports long-haul network planning, route diversity analysis, and infrastructure investment decisions.
products.reference: TM Forum SID Physical Infrastructure / ITU-T G.872

attributes.name: infrastructure_corridor_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the telecommunications infrastructure corridor. Primary key for the infrastructure corridor master record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that last modified this corridor record. Used for audit trails and accountability.

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service territory that this corridor serves or passes through. Used for regional planning and operational assignment.

attributes.name: annual_opex_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Operating Expenditure (OPEX) in United States Dollars
attributes.description: Estimated annual operational expenditure for maintaining and operating the corridor, measured in United States Dollars. Includes maintenance, inspections, lease payments, and regulatory compliance costs.

attributes.name: backup_route_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an alternative backup route exists that can carry traffic if this corridor fails. True for corridors with diverse route protection; false for single-path corridors. Critical for network resilience assessment.

attributes.name: capacity_bandwidth_gbps
attributes.description: Total designed bandwidth capacity of the corridor measured in Gigabits per second, applicable to microwave and other non-fiber corridors. Represents aggregate throughput capability. Null for fiber corridors where capacity is measured in fiber count.

attributes.name: capacity_fiber_count
attributes.description: Total number of fiber strands available in the corridor for fiber-based corridors (long_haul_fiber, submarine_cable). Null for non-fiber corridors. Represents total capacity for wavelength provisioning and service delivery.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the corridor was officially placed into operational service and made available for traffic. Marks the transition from construction to active status.

attributes.name: construction_start_date
attributes.description: Date when physical construction of the corridor began. Used for project tracking, CAPEX amortization, and regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: corridor_identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier or code for the corridor, used for operational reference and inter-system communication.

attributes.name: corridor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the infrastructure corridor, typically reflecting geographic endpoints or route designation (e.g., 'New York-Boston Fiber Route', 'Trans-Pacific Cable Landing Corridor').

attributes.name: corridor_owner
attributes.description: Legal entity or organization that owns the physical infrastructure corridor. May be the telecommunications operator, a third-party infrastructure provider, utility company, or government entity.

attributes.name: corridor_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the corridor in its lifecycle. Active corridors are in service; planned corridors are approved but not yet built; under_construction corridors are being deployed; decommissioned corridors are retired; suspended corridors are temporarily out of service; maintenance corridors are undergoing scheduled work.

attributes.name: corridor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the infrastructure corridor based on the primary transport medium and deployment method. Determines planning, permitting, and operational considerations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corridor record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which this corridor record originated (e.g., Netcracker OSS, Oracle Communications, GIS system). Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the corridor was officially retired from service and removed from the active network. Null for corridors that remain in service.

attributes.name: end_location_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name for the ending point of the corridor, typically a major network node, Point of Presence (POP), cable landing station, or exchange location.

attributes.name: environmental_zone
attributes.description: Environmental or ecological zone classification for the corridor route, indicating special environmental considerations, protected areas, or habitat restrictions that affect construction and maintenance activities.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier used by external systems, partners, or regulatory bodies to reference this corridor. Enables cross-system reconciliation and partner data exchange.

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.description: Spatial representation of the corridor route as a LINESTRING in Well-Known Text format, capturing the geographic path from start to end including intermediate waypoints. Used for GIS analysis, route diversity calculations, and network planning.

attributes.name: installation_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure (CAPEX) for constructing and commissioning the corridor, measured in United States Dollars. Includes materials, labor, permitting, and right-of-way acquisition costs. Used for ROI analysis and asset valuation.

attributes.name: interconnect_points_count
attributes.description: Number of intermediate interconnection points, splice points, or access nodes along the corridor where other network segments can connect. Indicates flexibility for network expansion and service delivery.

attributes.name: iru_holder
attributes.description: Entity holding the Indefeasible Right of Use for the corridor, granting long-term exclusive usage rights without ownership. Common in submarine cable and long-haul fiber arrangements. Null if corridor is fully owned and operated.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection or survey of the corridor infrastructure. Used for maintenance planning and asset condition tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corridor record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: mttr_target_hours
attributes.description: Target Mean Time to Repair for corridor outages, measured in hours. Represents the maximum acceptable time to restore service after a failure. Used for SLA compliance monitoring and workforce planning.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the next scheduled preventive maintenance or inspection is planned for the corridor. Used for workforce planning and outage scheduling.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special considerations, historical context, or other relevant information about the corridor that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: permit_authority
attributes.description: Government agency, regulatory body, or authority responsible for issuing construction and operational permits for the corridor. Critical for compliance tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: permit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current construction or operational permit for the corridor expires. Null for corridors with perpetual permits. Used for compliance tracking and renewal planning.

attributes.name: protection_type
attributes.description: Network protection and redundancy strategy for the corridor. Unprotected corridors have no backup; ring_protected corridors are part of a self-healing ring topology; diverse_route corridors have physically separate backup paths; mesh_protected corridors have multiple redundant paths; dual_homing corridors connect to multiple network nodes.

attributes.name: regulatory_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory classification or designation assigned to the corridor by governing authorities (e.g., interstate, intrastate, international, critical infrastructure). Determines applicable regulations and reporting requirements.

attributes.name: right_of_way_type
attributes.description: Legal arrangement governing the right to construct and maintain infrastructure along the corridor path. Owned indicates full property ownership; leased indicates rental agreement; easement indicates legal right to use another's property; shared_utility indicates co-location with utility infrastructure; public_right_of_way indicates use of public land; licensed indicates regulatory permission.

attributes.name: route_diversity_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the route diversity group or bundle to which this corridor belongs. Corridors in the same group serve similar endpoints and are evaluated together for diversity analysis and risk assessment.

attributes.name: seismic_risk_zone
attributes.description: Seismic activity risk classification for the corridor route. High-risk zones require enhanced structural design and more frequent inspections. Critical for submarine cables and long-haul fiber in geologically active regions.
attributes.references: USGS Seismic Hazard Maps, ITU-T L-series

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Service level tier assigned to the corridor, defining restoration time objectives, availability targets, and support priority. Higher tiers receive faster response and stricter uptime guarantees.

attributes.name: start_location_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or name for the starting point of the corridor, typically a major network node, Point of Presence (POP), cable landing station, or exchange location.

attributes.name: strategic_importance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corridor is designated as strategically important for the network backbone, critical infrastructure, or national security. True for corridors that are essential for network resilience and business continuity.

attributes.name: total_length_km
attributes.description: Total physical length of the infrastructure corridor measured in kilometers, representing the end-to-end distance along the route. Critical for capacity planning, cost estimation, and network design.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Current utilization of the corridor's total capacity, expressed as a percentage. For fiber corridors, represents percentage of fibers in use; for bandwidth corridors, represents percentage of bandwidth allocated. Used for capacity planning and investment prioritization.

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary vendor or contractor responsible for constructing or maintaining the corridor infrastructure. Used for vendor management and support escalation.

attributes.name: weather_exposure_level
attributes.description: Classification of the corridor's exposure to severe weather events (hurricanes, floods, ice storms, extreme temperatures). Influences design specifications, maintenance frequency, and disaster recovery planning.
attributes.references: NOAA Weather Data, TM Forum SID

attributes.name: branched_from_infrastructure_corridor_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on infrastructure_corridor (branched_from_infrastructure_corridor_id)

products.name: mdu_building
products.description: Master record for Multi-Dwelling Unit (MDU) and Multi-Tenanted Building (MTB) structures — apartment complexes, office towers, shopping centres, and mixed-use developments that require building-level telecommunications infrastructure planning and in-building network design. Captures MDU identifier, building name, building type (residential_apartment, commercial_office, mixed_use, shopping_centre, hotel, student_accommodation, retirement_village), address reference, total floors, total units, total tenancies, building owner name, building manager contact, body corporate reference, in-building network type (FTTP_riser, HFC_riser, VDSL_riser, WiFi_only, 5G_small_cell), MDU agreement status (agreement_in_place, negotiating, no_agreement), serviceable unit count, connected unit count, and building commissioning date. Critical for MDU rollout planning and in-building coverage management.
products.reference: NBN Co MDU Programme / TM Forum SID Geographic Place

attributes.name: mdu_building_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the MDU or multi-tenanted building record. Primary key for the mdu_building product.

attributes.name: exchange_id
attributes.description: Reference to the telecommunications exchange or central office that serves this MDU building. Determines backhaul connectivity and service availability.

attributes.name: location_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized location address record for this MDU building. Links to the location_address product for full address details.

attributes.name: network_element_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.element. Business justification: MDU buildings have dedicated network termination equipment (building switches, ONTs, fiber distribution). Critical for service activation, fault isolation, capacity management, and in-building network

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service territory within which this MDU building is located. Determines the responsible field team, dispatch zone, and operational jurisdiction.

attributes.name: access_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any physical access restrictions, security requirements, or special procedures required for field technicians to access the MDU building infrastructure (e.g., 'Security escort required', 'Access via building manager only').

attributes.name: agreement_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current MDU access agreement or infrastructure deployment agreement with the building owner expires. Triggers renewal or renegotiation activities.

attributes.name: body_corporate_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the body corporate, owners corporation, or homeowners association governing the MDU building. Required for infrastructure installation approvals.

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the MDU building, used across network planning, service provisioning, and field operations. Typically assigned by network planning or property management systems.

attributes.name: building_commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the MDU building telecommunications infrastructure was commissioned and made available for service provisioning. Marks the transition from construction to operational status.

attributes.name: building_height_meters
attributes.description: Total height of the MDU building structure in meters from ground level to roof. Used for radio frequency propagation modeling and small cell placement planning.

attributes.name: building_manager_contact
attributes.description: Primary contact information (phone or email) for the building manager or property management company. Used for coordinating site access and installation activities.

attributes.name: building_name
attributes.description: Common name or marketing name of the MDU building (e.g., 'Sunset Towers', 'Central Business Plaza', 'University Village Apartments').

attributes.name: building_owner_name
attributes.description: Name of the legal entity or individual that owns the MDU building. Critical for access negotiations and infrastructure agreement discussions.

attributes.name: building_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MDU building in the network planning and service delivery context. Determines whether the building is available for service provisioning.

attributes.name: building_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MDU building structure based on primary usage and tenancy model. Determines infrastructure design requirements and service delivery approach.

attributes.name: connected_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of dwelling units or premises within the MDU building that currently have active telecommunications service connections. Used for penetration rate and take-up analysis.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year when the physical MDU building structure was originally constructed. Influences infrastructure retrofit requirements and access constraints.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MDU building record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or data collection method that provided this MDU building record (e.g., 'Netcracker Resource Inventory', 'Field Survey 2024-Q1', 'Property Database Import').

attributes.name: fiber_entry_point
attributes.description: Description of the physical location where external fiber optic cables enter the MDU building (e.g., 'South wall basement conduit', 'Underground vault access'). Critical for outside plant to inside plant handoff.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ANSI/TIA-568

attributes.name: five_g_small_cell_installed
attributes.description: Indicates whether 5G small cell equipment has been deployed within or on the MDU building to provide enhanced indoor mobile coverage. Relevant for 5G New Radio (5G NR) network planning.

attributes.name: footprint_area_sqm
attributes.description: Ground-level footprint area of the MDU building in square meters. Used for site planning and infrastructure density calculations.

attributes.name: idf_count
attributes.description: Number of intermediate distribution frames or floor-level distribution points installed within the MDU building. Indicates the granularity of in-building network distribution.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ANSI/TIA-568

attributes.name: in_building_network_type
attributes.description: Type of telecommunications infrastructure deployed or planned within the MDU building. Determines service capabilities and technology limitations for end-user provisioning.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, 3GPP, ETSI

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MDU building record was most recently updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_site_survey_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent physical site survey or infrastructure audit was conducted for the MDU building. Used to assess data currency and plan re-survey activities.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the MDU building centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for network coverage analysis and field dispatch routing.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the MDU building centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for network coverage analysis and field dispatch routing.

attributes.name: mdf_location
attributes.description: Physical location description of the main distribution frame or primary telecommunications room within the MDU building (e.g., 'Basement Level 1, Room B-12'). Critical for field technician access.
attributes.references: TM Forum SID - Resource Domain, ANSI/TIA-568

attributes.name: mdu_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the access agreement or infrastructure deployment agreement with the building owner or body corporate. Determines whether service provisioning is authorized.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance or infrastructure inspection activity for the MDU building telecommunications equipment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the MDU building that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: parking_availability
attributes.description: Availability of parking facilities for field technician vehicles during installation and maintenance activities. Impacts field dispatch planning and service appointment scheduling.

attributes.name: power_backup_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether backup power (UPS or generator) is available for telecommunications equipment within the MDU building. Impacts service reliability and SLA commitments.

attributes.name: riser_available_capacity
attributes.description: Number of unused fiber or cable pairs currently available in the vertical riser infrastructure. Used for capacity planning and service provisioning feasibility checks.

attributes.name: riser_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of fiber or cable pairs available in the vertical riser infrastructure within the MDU building. Determines the maximum serviceable unit count.

attributes.name: serviceable_unit_count
attributes.description: Number of dwelling units or premises within the MDU building that are technically serviceable with telecommunications infrastructure. May be less than total units due to infrastructure limitations.

attributes.name: total_floors
attributes.description: Total number of floors or levels in the MDU building, including basement and ground levels. Critical for vertical infrastructure planning and riser design.

attributes.name: total_tenancies
attributes.description: Total number of commercial tenancies, office suites, or business premises within the MDU building. Relevant for mixed-use and commercial buildings.

attributes.name: total_units
attributes.description: Total number of individual dwelling units, apartments, or residential premises within the MDU building. Used for capacity planning and penetration rate calculations.

attributes.name: wifi_coverage_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether managed WiFi coverage is available within common areas or individual units of the MDU building. Relevant for converged fixed-mobile service offerings.

attributes.name: parent_mdu_building_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on mdu_building (parent_mdu_building_id)

products.name: coverage_gap
products.description: Master record identifying and tracking specific geographic gaps in telecommunications coverage — areas where coverage analysis has identified that current network infrastructure does not meet minimum service thresholds. Captures gap identifier, gap type (no_4G_coverage, no_5G_coverage, no_broadband, below_minimum_speed, poor_indoor_coverage, no_emergency_coverage), geometry (polygon WKT), affected premises count, affected population estimate, gap severity (critical, high, medium, low), gap identification method (propagation_model, drive_test, customer_complaint_cluster, regulatory_audit), identification date, assigned programme or project reference, remediation plan status (unplanned, planned, funded, in_progress, resolved), target resolution date, and actual resolution date. Drives network investment prioritisation and regulatory compliance gap closure.
products.reference: Ofcom Connected Nations / FCC Broadband Map / ACMA Coverage Obligations

attributes.name: coverage_gap_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the coverage gap record. Primary key.

attributes.name: administrative_region_id
attributes.description: Reference to the administrative region (county, municipality, district) where the coverage gap is located, used for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: assigned_team_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network planning or engineering team responsible for analyzing and remediating this coverage gap.

attributes.name: primary_coverage_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual engineer or project manager assigned ownership of this coverage gap remediation.

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service territory within which this coverage gap is located, used for operational assignment and resource planning.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the coverage gap was resolved and service quality verified to meet minimum thresholds.

attributes.name: affected_population_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of individuals residing or working within the coverage gap area who are impacted by the service deficiency.

attributes.name: affected_premises_count
attributes.description: Number of residential and business premises located within the coverage gap area that lack adequate service.

attributes.name: area_square_km
attributes.description: Total geographic area of the coverage gap measured in square kilometers.

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geographic centroid of the coverage gap area, in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geographic centroid of the coverage gap area, in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this coverage gap record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_complaint_count
attributes.description: Number of customer complaints or trouble tickets associated with poor coverage in this geographic area, used as supporting evidence for gap identification.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or tool from which the coverage gap data was derived (e.g., Nokia NetAct, Ericsson Network Manager, propagation modeling tool).

attributes.name: estimated_remediation_cost_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Remediation Cost in United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Estimated capital expenditure required to remediate the coverage gap, expressed in USD.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The source of funding for gap remediation (e.g., internal CAPEX, government subsidy, Universal Service Fund, public-private partnership).

attributes.name: gap_identifier
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier or code for the coverage gap, used for external reference and reporting to regulatory bodies.

attributes.name: gap_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the coverage gap, typically referencing the geographic area or community affected.

attributes.name: gap_severity
attributes.description: Business priority classification of the coverage gap based on impact to service delivery, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

attributes.name: gap_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the coverage gap record in the remediation workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: identified|validated|prioritized|assigned|in_remediation|resolved|closed|deferred — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gap_type
attributes.description: Classification of the coverage gap based on the type of service deficiency: no 4G coverage, no 5G coverage, no broadband, below minimum speed threshold, poor indoor coverage, or no emergency coverage.

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.description: Geographic boundary of the coverage gap represented as a polygon in Well-Known Text format, defining the precise area where coverage does not meet minimum thresholds.

attributes.name: identification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the coverage gap was first identified and recorded in the system.

attributes.name: identification_method
attributes.description: The methodology or data source used to identify and validate the existence of the coverage gap.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this coverage gap record was last updated, tracking changes to status, remediation plans, or other attributes.

attributes.name: measured_signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: The actual measured signal strength in dBm within the gap area, as determined by drive testing or propagation modeling.

attributes.name: measured_throughput_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Measured Throughput in Megabits per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: The actual measured data throughput in Mbps within the gap area, as determined by speed testing or network performance monitoring.

attributes.name: minimum_signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable signal strength threshold in dBm that defines adequate coverage; values below this threshold constitute a gap.

attributes.name: minimum_throughput_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Throughput in Megabits per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable data throughput in Mbps that defines adequate service quality; throughput below this threshold constitutes a gap.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, or special considerations related to the coverage gap and its remediation.

attributes.name: priority_score
attributes.description: Numerical priority score assigned to the coverage gap for investment planning, based on factors such as population impact, regulatory requirements, and business case.

attributes.name: programme_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the network investment programme or project to which this coverage gap has been assigned for remediation.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory authority or jurisdiction responsible for oversight of coverage requirements in this area (e.g., FCC, Ofcom, state PUC).

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage gap must be reported to regulatory authorities as part of compliance obligations.

attributes.name: remediation_method
attributes.description: The planned or implemented technical solution for closing the coverage gap (e.g., new macro site, small cell deployment, FTTH extension, capacity upgrade).

attributes.name: remediation_plan_status
attributes.description: Current status of the remediation plan for closing this coverage gap, tracking progression from identification through resolution.

attributes.name: resolution_verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify that the coverage gap has been successfully closed (e.g., post-deployment drive test, customer feedback analysis, network KPI monitoring).

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: The planned or committed date by which the coverage gap is expected to be resolved and service restored to acceptable levels.

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: The telecommunications technology for which the gap exists (e.g., LTE, 5G NR, FTTH, Fixed Wireless, DSL).

attributes.name: universal_service_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this coverage gap falls within an area subject to Universal Service Obligations requiring mandatory service provision.

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the coverage gap was validated through field testing or additional analysis to confirm the deficiency.

attributes.name: split_from_coverage_gap_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on coverage_gap (split_from_coverage_gap_id)

products.name: reference_code
products.description: Reference master for standardized location classification codes and type taxonomies used across the location domain — address types, premise types, site types, zone types, region types, and coverage tier codes. Captures code identifier, code set name (address_type, premise_type, site_type, zone_type, region_type, coverage_tier, geocode_accuracy_level, rollout_zone_type), code value, code label, code description, display order, is_active flag, effective date, expiry date, and governing standard reference (ISO, TM Forum, operator-defined). Provides the controlled vocabulary for all location classification attributes, ensuring consistent categorisation across all location master records.
products.reference: TM Forum SID / ISO 3166 / OGC Standards

attributes.name: reference_code_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the location reference code record. Primary key for the location reference code master table.

attributes.name: primary_reference_employee_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the user or system account that last modified this reference code record. Supports accountability and audit trail for reference data governance. May reference an enterprise identity management system or data stewardship platform.

attributes.name: alternate_code_value
attributes.description: An alternative identifier or legacy code value used in external systems, partner interfaces, or historical data. Supports cross-system mapping and data migration scenarios where multiple code schemes must be reconciled (e.g., legacy BSS system codes, partner MVNO codes, regulatory reporting codes).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval state of this reference code in the data governance workflow.
